description: <h2><strong>Who we are </strong></h2> <h3><strong>About Stripe</strong></h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.</span></p> <h3><strong>About the team</strong></h3> <p>Abuse Operations is the front-line incident response and remediation function handling active product abuse and fraud impacting Stripe and its merchants. This multi-disciplinary group, spanning Incident Managers, Investigators, Forward Deployed Security Engineers, and Data Scientists, neutralizes active attacks, gathers requirements for operational tooling, and leads incidents. The team&nbsp; works directly with impacted merchants to resolve technical incidents and policy abuse rapidly. Operating primarily across Eastern, Pacific and Western European time zones, these team members regularly coordinate with global stakeholders across the world.</p> <h2><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h2> <p>You'll play a critical role in safeguarding our financial ecosystem by investigating high-risk accounts and identifying complex patterns of fraud during incidents. You will lead incident response for product abuse and fraud events, conducting deep-dive analyses to identify root causes. By collaborating cross-functionally, you will drive improvements that enhance our fraud detection and prevention strategies at scale. Your expertise will be essential in automating response processes through agentic approaches, allowing us to safeguard merchants and neutralize threats with speed and precision.</p> <h3><strong>Responsibilities</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Investigate, mitigate, and remediate urgent fraud incidents (e.g., ATO, card testing), utilizing FT3-mapped detection and signals enrichment to reduce uncertainty and accelerate response.</li> <li>As part of incidents, analyze high-risk accounts to identify fraudulent merchants, card testing, account takeovers, and other fraud vectors, classifying them using FT3 (Fraud Taxonomy 3.0) to standardize threat intelligence.</li> <li>Lead incident root cause analyses to identify gaps in current systems and strategies, leveraging the FT3 framework, data-driven model to drive enhancements and process improvements for emerging fraud risks.</li> <li>Streamline incident response capabilities, ensuring the tooling and processes are clear, accurate and efficient</li> <li>Work cross-functionally with security, fraud and data science teams to build agentic solutions for responding to abuse incidents at scale</li> <li>Effectively communicate cross-functionally with legal and policy teams to assess and mitigate risks, while demonstrating strong problem-solving under pressure.</li> <li>Collaborate effectively with teammates, leading projects, mentoring others, and developing and championing quality standards within the team</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Who you are</strong></h2> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.</span></p> <h3><strong>Minimum requirements</strong></h3> <ul> <li>10+ years of experience conducting incident response in security, product abuse or trust domains</li> <li>10+ years experience analyzing large data sets to solve problems and/or building models with a behavioral approach to fraud detection</li> <li>B.S. or M.S. Computer Science or related field, or equivalent experience</li> <li>Expert knowledge of Python and SQL, and familiarity with other programming languages</li> <li>Existing experience with log analysis (e.g. first or third party applications, system / data access, event logs), network security, digital forensics, and incident response investigations</li> <li>Ability to communicate results clearly and focus on impact</li> <li>Ability to think creatively and holistically about reducing risk in a complex environment</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Preferred qualifications</strong></h3> <ul> <li>An adversarial mindset, understanding the goals, behaviors, and TTPs of threat actors.</li> <li>Experience with engineering, data processing and analysis tools (e.g. Databricks, Trino, etc.)</li> <li>Familiarity with common open-source frameworks for big data processing and/or data science (PySpark, Pandas, Sci-kit Learn, etc.)</li> <li>Experience with tactical threat intelligence and/or hunting for sophisticated threat actors in an enterprise environment</li> <li>Ability to proactively challenge the status quo by leveraging data and taking a user-centric approach to address complex product integrity challenges</li> </ul>

title: Abuse Research Engineer
description: <h2>Who we are</h2> <h3>About Stripe</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.</span></p> <h3>About the team</h3> <p>Abuse Research Group (ARG) handles proactive threat hunting and adversary behavior analysis across Stripe products. Rather than reacting to alerts, the team maps end-to-end fraud and abuse paths, validates novel attack vectors, and identifies product conditions that enable fraud. Using agentic automated testing and simulation tools, ARG translates research into actionable threat advisories, strategic control recommendations, and regression scenarios to systematically eliminate vulnerabilities.</p> <h2>What you’ll do</h2> <p>As an Abuse Research Engineer in the Abuse Research Group, you will play a critical role in safeguarding Stripe’s financial ecosystem by proactively hunting for advanced threats, dissecting complex fraud vectors, and extracting actionable adversary intelligence. &nbsp;Rather than relying solely on reactive alerts, you will develop and execute hypothesis-driven threat hunting operations across internal telemetry and external sources to uncover fraudulent tools, tactics, and techniques (TTPs) before they impact Stripe’s platform. Central to this work is FT3 (Fraud Taxonomy 3.0), Stripe’s multi-layered taxonomy that decomposes monolithic fraud into structured kill chains. &nbsp;Collaborating cross-functionally with Fraud Ops, Strategy, Risk, Onboarding, and Security, you will integrate threat intelligence, build agentic simulation workflows, and systematically eliminate product vulnerabilities.</p> <h3>Responsibilities</h3> <ul> <li>Proactive Threat Hunting &amp; Kill Chain Analysis: Formulate hypotheses and conduct iterative threat hunting operations across Stripe systems and external data.</li> <li>FT3 Taxonomy: Apply and enrich the FT3 framework across empirical datasets and incidents, standardizing threat intelligence across kill chain phases and targeted API endpoints. &nbsp;</li> <li>Threat Intelligence &amp; Signal Expansion: Partner with teams like Fraud Intelligence to integrate, curate, and automate threat feeds into engineering workflows. &nbsp;</li> <li>Cross-Functional Advisories &amp; Strategic Controls: Translate raw research and retrospective findings into actionable threat advisories and control recommendations (policy, technical systems, support workflows, and detection mechanisms) for stakeholders across Fraud, Risk, Onboarding, and Security. &nbsp;</li> <li>Agentic Testing &amp; Adversary Simulation: Utilize agentic automated testing frameworks to simulate adversary TTPs, validate whether deployed controls interrupt empirical kill chains, and generate regression scenarios to exercise controls. &nbsp;</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Who you are</strong></h2> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.</span></p> <h3>Minimum requirements</h3> <ul> <li>5+ years of experience conducting threat intelligence, threat hunting, or technical incident response within cyber security, product abuse, or trust domains.&nbsp;&nbsp;</li> <li>5+ years of experience analyzing large, complex datasets using data analytics tools to identify anomalies, map behavioral trends, and solve complex fraud problems.&nbsp;&nbsp;</li> <li>B.S. or M.S. in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.&nbsp;&nbsp;</li> <li>Expert proficiency in Python and SQL, with demonstrated experience using code and scripting to automate workflows, build investigative tools, or query big data pipelines.&nbsp;&nbsp;</li> <li>Hands-on experience in log analysis (e.g., application logs, API route telemetry, network security events), digital forensics, and cyber investigation methodologies.&nbsp;&nbsp;</li> <li>Strong communication skills with a proven ability to translate complex technical research into clear, actionable recommendations and advisories for cross-functional partners.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Preferred qualifications</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Deep technical understanding of threat actor motivations, infrastructure, and TTPs specific to financial fraud (e.g., ATO, Card Testing, Credential Stuffing).&nbsp;</li> <li>Familiarity with standardized taxonomies such as FT3 or MITRE ATT&amp;CK.&nbsp;&nbsp;</li> <li>Proficiency with engineering, data processing, and analysis platforms such as Databricks, Trino, PySpark, Pandas, or Scikit-Learn.&nbsp;&nbsp;</li> <li>Proven background utilizing Threat Intelligence Platforms (TIPs), tactical threat feeds, OSINT, and breach intelligence.&nbsp;</li> <li>Demonstrated capability building or leveraging agentic LLM tools, automated testing systems, or control validation frameworks to model adversary behavior at scale.&nbsp;&nbsp;</li> <li>Participation in industry conferences, webinars, or threat-sharing groups, alongside relevant professional certifications (e.g., GCTI, GCFA, OSCP).</li> </ul>

title: AI Engineer
description: <h2><strong>Who We Are</strong></h2> <h3><strong>About Stripe</strong></h3> <p>Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.</p> <h3><strong>About The Team</strong></h3> <p>The Solutions Architecture (SA) organization helps Stripe's most strategic customers design and validate technical solutions that drive their business forward. Within SA, our team builds the tools, workflows, and custom technical assets that make the broader SA org more effective—turning individual ingenuity into org-wide capability.</p> <p>We are looking for AI Engineers who are energized by working close to the business and the users we serve. You'll operate as an embedded, high-context engineer focused on the highest-leverage opportunities across the SA org—building production-quality tooling, supporting our most strategic engagements, and shipping automation that meaningfully improves how Solutions Architects work every day.</p> <h2><strong>What You'll Do</strong></h2> <p>As an AI Engineer, you'll be embedded directly with the Solutions Architecture team—building alongside them, deeply understanding their workflows, and shipping tools and automation that permanently change how they operate. Your measure of success is SA productivity: the engagements you've accelerated, the workflows you've transformed, and the tools you've built that the org adopts as default.</p> <p>You'll ship code daily. You'll discover where SAs lose time and build high-impact solutions. You'll take what works for one person and scale it to work for the org. And when our most strategic customer engagements need custom technical assets, you'll build those too.</p> <p>This is a role for someone who wants to work at the intersection of engineering and business impact—close to customers, close to revenue, and building for people you can see using your work every day.</p> <h3><strong>Responsibilities</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Collaborate with Solutions Architects, SA leadership, Product, and Engineering to scope technical work and translate ambiguous business needs into well-defined deliverables</li> <li>Evaluate and integrate AI capabilities (LLMs, agents, workflow automation) where they provide genuine leverage—not for novelty, but for measurable productivity improvement</li> <li>Architect and build internal tools, agents, and automated workflows that accelerate SA and manager productivity across technical discovery, solution design, demoing, user engagements, territory/pipeline management, and product interlock</li> <li>Take high-potential tools and workflows built by SAs and managers and harden them into scalable, maintainable, production-grade solutions</li> <li>Identify patterns across SA workflows and proactively build solutions that address recurring friction</li> <li>Build custom demo environments, PoC applications, and technical assets for Stripe's most strategic customer engagements</li> <li>Document tools, architectures, and usage patterns so others can adopt and extend what you've built</li> <li>Debug, extend, and maintain backend systems across a variety of codebases and infrastructure</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Minimum Requirements</strong></h3> <ul> <li>4+ years of experience as an engineer shipping production systems</li> <li>Strong backend engineering fundamentals: you can debug a failing system, trace issues across services, and reason about data flows</li> <li>Experience building and deploying AI agents, LLM-powered tools, or workflow automation beyond basic prompt engineering</li> <li>Experience scoping and delivering work with minimal oversight in a fast-moving, cross-functional environment</li> <li>Proficiency in at least two of: Ruby, Node.js, Python, or Next.js</li> <li>Familiarity with cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP) including deployment, monitoring, and basic DevOps</li> <li>Experience building internal tools, developer platforms, or workflow automation</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to work across multiple codebases and technology stacks simultaneously</li> <li>Hands-on experience using AI/LLM tools in your engineering workflow—you're fluent with AI-assisted development but not dependent on it; you can reason through problems and debug without AI as a crutch</li> <li>Strong written and verbal communication skills; you can translate technical decisions for non-technical stakeholders and navigate cross-functional collaboration naturally</li> <li>Comfort with ambiguity—you can take a loosely-defined business problem, scope the engineering work, and ship iteratively without waiting for a perfect spec</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Preferred Qualifications</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Experience designing systems that non-engineers can build on top of or extend themselves (e.g., platforms, low-code frameworks, template systems)</li> <li>Experience in a Solutions Engineering, Sales Engineering, or GTM Engineering role—or a product engineering role where you worked closely with customers or go-to-market teams</li> <li>Familiarity with Stripe's products, APIs, or the payments/fintech domain</li> <li>Experience integrating with third-party platforms (Salesforce, Gong, etc.)</li> <li>Track record of building tools or systems that were adopted beyond your immediate team</li> <li>Background in consulting, professional services, or other roles that blend technical depth with business context</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Who You Are</strong></h2> <p>Beyond the technical requirements, we're looking for a specific kind of engineer:</p> <ul> <li><strong>You want to be close to the business.</strong> You're energized by seeing your work directly impact how a sales team wins a deal or how a customer succeeds.</li> <li><strong>You're a pragmatic builder.</strong> You ship working solutions quickly, iterate based on real usage, and know when "good enough now" beats "perfect later." You'd rather show a working prototype today than present a roadmap deck next quarter.</li> <li><strong>You're a software engineer by practice.</strong> You can architect systems, debug production issues, write clean code, and reason about tradeoffs. AI is a tool in your belt, not a substitute for engineering judgment.</li> <li><strong>You're a pattern recognizer.</strong> When you build something that works for one person, you immediately see how it generalizes. You think in reusable systems, not one-off scripts.</li> <li><strong>You thrive without a traditional product team structure.</strong> No PRDs landing in your lap, no dedicated PM, no sprint ceremonies. You identify the highest-leverage problem, scope the work, and ship it. You're comfortable trading on-call rotations and rigid processes for autonomy and impact.</li> <li><strong>You're a strong communicator.</strong> You can partner with SAs who are domain experts, understand their workflows deeply enough to build great tools, and explain your technical choices to leadership.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p>

description: <h2><strong>Who we are&nbsp;&nbsp;</strong></h2> <p><strong>About Stripe</strong></p> <p>Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. We are finance transformation and AI experts working side-by-side with Finance, Product, and Engineering teams to redefine processes and build the finance organization of the future.&nbsp;This is an opportunity for someone who enjoys working across disciplines: part solution developer, part data architect, part workflow designer, and part coach. You’ll have room to shape how applied AI is built and scaled both from a technical and end-user perspective.</p> <h2><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h2> <p>You'll work side-by-side with Finance subject matter experts to understand how work gets done, identify the highest impact opportunities, and partner with domain teams to chart a transformation plan which balances future ambitions with rapid impact.&nbsp; You'll work independently to automate manual processes, design and build agents and required data solutions using internal platforms, and enable Finance teams to maintain these solutions long-term.&nbsp;</p> <p>You’ll build with your partner teams, not simply deliver solutions to them. You’ll help colleagues move from a manual workflow, to a first AI-enabled win, to a reliable solution they can confidently operate and improve themselves. Success means the workflow stays transformed after the initial build, the team trusts the output, and the people closest to the process can own what comes next.&nbsp;</p> <p>You’ll favor learning through building. When possible, you’ll put a useful prototype in front of a Finance user, test it against a real deliverable, and improve it quickly rather than spend weeks describing a theoretical future state. When you encounter platform limitations—which you will—you’ll find creative, supportable approaches, collaborate with Engineering to scope and test custom tools, and escalate strategically when needed.</p> <p>This role requires a blend of process automation, data operations, technical problem-solving, and stakeholder enablement. You'll spend your time building agents, optimizing data pipelines that feed them, creating knowledge layers that make them more accurate, and training Finance teams to use and maintain them. Success means Finance teams can independently run agents you've built while you provide light support and focus on the next automation opportunity.</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li>Embed with Finance teams to diagnose workflows, identify high-leverage opportunities, and translate business, data, and control requirements into practical AI and automation solutions.</li> <li>Build and operationalize AI agents for Finance use cases, delivering end-to-end solutions from prototype through validation, monitoring, documentation, and handoff.</li> <li>Write and optimize SQL for data extraction, transformation, calculation, and validation, ensuring Finance-facing outputs are accurate, explainable, and reliable.</li> <li>Design reusable knowledge layers, evaluation methods, validation patterns, data-quality frameworks, and components that improve agent accuracy and accelerate future use cases.</li> <li>Identify agentic limitations and new possibilities; determine when to use existing capabilities, develop an alternative approach, or partner with Engineering to scope and test custom tools and integrations, including tools using Model Context Protocol where appropriate.</li> <li>Build alongside users, gather feedback through real deliverables, and iterate until the solution fits the workflow and earns user trust.</li> <li>Enable long-term ownership through clear SOPs, runbooks, training, and self-service tooling; coach Finance teams to operate, maintain, and evolve what has been built.</li> <li>Establish monitoring and observability for deployed agents, including metrics, alerting, and incident-response processes that support reliable operation.</li> <li>Diagnose technical and data issues, resolve problems independently where possible, and collaborate with Engineering when solutions require deeper platform changes.</li> <li>Measure adoption and impact, share lessons and wins, and turn successful implementations into standards, components, and playbooks for the broader Finance AI portfolio.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Who you are</strong></h2> <p>We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.</p> <p><strong>Minimum requirements</strong></p> <ul> <li>5+ years of experience in data analytics, technical operations, business intelligence, automation, solutions delivery, or a related field.</li> <li>Of which, 2+ years of experience in program management, working directly alongside business leaders to develop and execute process transformation programs</li> <li>Hands-on experience building AI-enabled tools, agents, automations, or workflows that changed a real business process—not solely using AI as a conversational tool,&nbsp;</li> <li>Strong SQL proficiency, including experience writing complex queries using CTEs, window functions, and joins for data analysis, transformation, or pipeline logic.</li> <li>A track record of independently scoping and delivering technical solutions for process improvement, demonstrating ownership from problem definition through adoption.</li> <li>Strong analytical and investigative skills, including the ability to identify root causes, debug complex data problems, and resolve inconsistencies.</li> <li>Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences and work effectively with domain experts and Engineering partners.</li> <li>Experience teaching, coaching, enabling users, or transferring ownership of a solution through documentation, training, or self-service tools.</li> <li>Working knowledge of development practices such as version control, testing, code review, and iterative delivery.</li> <li>Experience using low-code tools, scripting, workflow automation, AI-assisted development, or custom integrations, paired with curiosity and the ability to learn evolving technologies.</li> </ul> <p><strong>You will also likely have (not required):</strong></p> <ul> <li>Domain experience in Finance Operations, Financial Planning &amp; Analysis (FP&amp;A), Accounting, Treasury, Tax, Payments, or other areas.</li> <li>Familiarity with modern data tools and practices, such as Python, Databricks, ETL/ELT processes, data pipelines, and data-quality controls.</li> <li>Experience with Model Context Protocol or another extensibility or integration framework.</li> <li>Experience navigating financial systems and understanding how data flows through accounting, reporting, reconciliation, forecasting, or payments processes.</li> <li>Experience with change management, organizational transformation, or large-scale enablement programs.</li> <li>Experience building internal tools, templates, components, or playbooks that were adopted beyond the original team or use case.</li> <li>Experience working in a high-growth technology company with rapidly evolving processes and tools.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Note on technical depth</strong>: This role involves working at the intersection of no-code AI tools and custom development. While software engineering expertise is not required, you should be comfortable applying technical concepts, collaborating closely with Engineering teams, and using AI-assisted development tools to extend platform capabilities when needed.</p>

description: <h2>Who we are</h2> <h3>About Stripe</h3> <p>Stripe is a technology company focused on improving the conditions for economic growth and prosperity. We build programmable financial infrastructure, rethinking from first principles how financial services should work, to make it easier and cheaper for any business to start and scale. More than 10 million <a href="https://stripe.com/customers">businesses</a> build on Stripe, spanning the economic frontier—from solo founders to established enterprises—united by a practical focus on growth. The most ambitious companies in the world use Stripe as core infrastructure to grow faster. They process trillions of dollars a year on Stripe, equivalent to around 1.6% of global GDP. While economic growth makes everyone better off, open markets also enable greater variety. When any business can easily serve a global customer base, the quality and diversity of products in the world increase, and craft and creativity are unleashed into the smallest niches. Our own growth is wholly contingent on the success of the businesses building on Stripe. We therefore invest back into our technology at an unusual rate. We make <a href="https://stripe.com/roadmap">upgrades to our products</a> every single day to deliver compounding gains to our customers. We maintain some of the most <a href="https://status.stripe.com/">reliable APIs</a> on the internet. We build entirely new <a href="https://tempo.xyz/">pieces</a> of <a href="https://mpp.dev/">financial</a> <a href="https://joinopenstandard.com/">infrastructure</a> to enable new ideas. And our significant advances in <a href="https://stripe.com/radar">risk and fraud</a> infrastructure over many years are making the internet economy safer and more accessible.</p> <p>Though people at Stripe don’t tend to take themselves seriously, Stripe is a fairly serious place: our customers are depending on us for their livelihoods. We admire ambition, intensity, curiosity, humility, and rigor. The most effective people become knowledgeable about many domains besides their own. Any company is an applied exercise in understanding some aspect of society or the market. In working with so many (especially the new and innovative ones), we think that Stripe is one of the very best places to learn about how the world works.</p> <h3>&nbsp;</h3> <h3>About the team</h3> <p>Data Science at Stripe is a vibrant community where data analysts and data scientists learn and grow together. You'll work with some of the most fundamental data at Stripe, and use that data to help drive company-wide initiatives. We have a variety of Data Analytics roles and teams across Stripe and will seek to align you to the most relevant team based on your background.</p> <h2>&nbsp;</h2> <h2>What you’ll do</h2> <p>As an intern at Stripe you’ll work on projects across our stack that directly impact the way millions of businesses operate. You’ll own problems end to end with the support of your manager and teammates. It’s an opportunity to work alongside some of the most creative and technically rigorous data analysts and scientists in the industry. You'll partner deeply with teams across Stripe to ensure that our users, our products, and our business have the models, data products, and insights needed to make decisions and grow responsibly. You'll work closely with partners to extract insights from the rich and complex data at Stripe. You'll build metrics, scalable data pipelines, dashboards, and reports to inform and run the business. You'll deliver actionable business recommendations through analyses and data storytelling.</p> <p>Our internship program is competitive and the expectations are high.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h3>Responsibilities</h3> <ul> <li>Analyze data and running experiments to drive impact</li> <li>Ensure that our users, our products, and our business have the models, data products, and insights needed to make decisions and grow responsibly</li> <li>Create metrics, reports, and dashboards to inform and run the business</li> <li>Extend Stripe’s metrics semantic layer</li> <li>Build new data assets and improve existing data assets to support decision-making, products, and business processes</li> <li>Assess the impact of decisions, product launches, and product improvements using business analytics and A/B testing</li> <li>Learn quickly by asking great questions, finding how to work with your mentor and teammates effectively, and communicating the status of your work clearly</li> <li>Present your work to the Data Science team, partner teams, and fellow interns</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h2>Who you are</h2> <ul> <li>Ambitious builder: You’re energized by building solutions without clear precedent and solving problems with far-reaching consequences. Successful Stripes are deeply curious, and prefer the joy of discovery to the comfort of certainty.</li> <li>Rigorous thinker: You appreciate that things worth doing are rarely simple. You enjoy working on problems that have never been tackled before.</li> <li>Adaptable problem solver: You adapt quickly and treat obstacles as opportunities. At Stripe we embrace kindness while encouraging Stripes to take measured risks and act boldly, even in the absence of consensus.</li> </ul> <h3>&nbsp;</h3> <h3>Minimum requirements</h3> <ul> <li>Enrolled in a quantitative <strong><em>Bachelor’s or Master's degree program</em></strong> (e.g. Data Analytics, Statistics, Economics, Mathematics, etc.) with the expectation of graduating in December 2027 or spring/summer 2028</li> <li>Experience with SQL</li> <li>Proficiency with AI tools to accelerate model development, analysis, and coding</li> <li>Experience communicating and collaborating with multidisciplinary stakeholders in a team environment</li> </ul> <h3>&nbsp;</h3> <h3>Preferred qualifications</h3> <ul> <li>Experience writing and debugging data pipelines</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to evaluate and receive feedback from mentors, peers, and stakeholders via experience from previous internships or other multi-person projects</li> <li>Ability to learn new systems and form an understanding of those systems, through independent research and working with a mentor and subject matter experts</li> </ul>

We make <a href="https://stripe.com/roadmap">upgrades to our products</a> every single day to deliver compounding gains to our customers. We maintain some of the most <a href="https://status.stripe.com/">reliable APIs</a> on the internet. We build entirely new <a href="https://tempo.xyz/">pieces</a> of <a href="https://mpp.dev/">financial</a> <a href="https://joinopenstandard.com/">infrastructure</a> to enable new ideas. And our significant advances in <a href="https://stripe.com/radar">risk and fraud</a> infrastructure over many years are making the internet economy safer and more accessible.</p> <p>Though people at Stripe don’t tend to take themselves seriously, Stripe is a fairly serious place: our customers are depending on us for their livelihoods. We admire ambition, intensity, curiosity, humility, and rigor. The most effective people become knowledgeable about many domains besides their own. Any company is an applied exercise in understanding some aspect of society or the market. In working with so many (especially the new and innovative ones), we think that Stripe is one of the very best places to learn about how the world works.</p> <h3>&nbsp;</h3> <h3>About the team</h3> <p>Data Science at Stripe is a vibrant community where data analysts and data scientists learn and grow together. We have a variety of Data Analytics roles and teams across Stripe and will seek to align you to the most relevant team based on your background.</p> <h2>&nbsp;</h2> <h2>What you’ll do</h2> <p>As an intern at Stripe you’ll work on projects across our stack that directly impact the way millions of businesses operate. You'll work closely with partners to extract insights from the rich and complex data at Stripe. You'll build metrics, scalable data pipelines, dashboards, and reports to inform and run the business. Set quality standards, establish community rituals (knowledge sharing, peer reviews, office hours), and cultivate a strong local data culture.</p> <p>• Act as the go-to point of contact for data craft standards, tooling, and best practices for co-located analysts, even those outside your direct reporting line.</p> <p>• Partner with managers and leads across the broader Data org to ensure consistency in methodology, tooling, and quality bar.</p> <p>• Support onboarding and integration of new data hires in the Bengaluru office.</p> <p>• Over time, this role has the potential to evolve into a Center of Excellence (COE) model—becoming the single point of data leadership in India across multiple product pillars (e.g., Payments, Growth, Marketing), not just Risk.</p> <h3>Responsibilities</h3> <p>• Build, manage, and develop a high-performing, geographically distributed data team.</p> <p>• Define and drive the data roadmap in close partnership with product, engineering, and business stakeholders—ensuring analytical work is tightly coupled to business outcomes.</p> <p>• Establish and raise the bar on analytical rigor, experimentation frameworks, and data science best practices across the team.</p> <p>• Recruit and retain skilled data talent, crafting a compelling hiring narrative anchored in local leadership and craft excellence.</p> <p>• Champion a culture of technical excellence, intellectual curiosity, and operational discipline.</p> <p>• Collaborate with cross-functional partners and other data leaders globally to align priorities, share learnings, and maintain org-wide consistency.</p> <p>• Communicate insights, recommendations, and team progress clearly to senior leadership.</p> <h2>Who you are</h2> <p>We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.</p> <h3>Minimum requirements</h3> <p>• 10+ years of experience in data science, analytics, or a related quantitative field, with 3+ years in a people management role leading data scientists or analysts</p> <p>• Strong technical foundation in SQL, Python or R, statistical modeling, and experimentation design</p> <p>• Demonstrated ability to translate ambiguous business problems into structured analytical frameworks and actionable insights</p> <p>• Experience managing and developing individual contributor talent across multiple levels, including coaching, career pathing, and performance management</p> <p>• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills—able to influence without authority across functions and time zones along with proven ability to drive alignment and execution across distributed, cross-functional teams</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h3>Preferred qualifications</h3> <p>• Advanced degree (M.S. or Ph.D.) in a quantitative discipline such as Statistics, Economics, Computer Science, Mathematics, or a related field</p> <p>• Experience working in the payments, fintech, or financial services industry</p> <p>• Prior experience building and scaling data teams in a high-growth environment—particularly standing up 0 → 1 functions or teams</p> <p>• Track record of being a builder who has personally architected the rituals, standards, hiring bar, and craft culture for a data team from the ground up</p> <p>• Familiarity with risk, verifications, or compliance-related data domains</p> <p>• Experience operating across Asia-Pacific markets and navigating the nuances of multi-region team management</p> <p>• Passion for developing others and creating environments where individual contributors do the best work of their careers</p>

description: <h2>Who we are</h2> <h3>About Stripe</h3> <p>Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.</p> <h3>About the team</h3> <p>Data Science at Stripe is a vibrant community where data scientists and data analysts learn and grow together. The Treasury Finance Data Science team builds the models, risk frameworks, and decision tools behind how Stripe manages money at global scale: liquidity, funding, counterparty risk, and foreign exchange.</p> <p>Stripe moves funds across 135+ currencies every day. That creates FX exposure from merchant flows, multi-currency balances, and entity funding. In this role, you'll be a thought partner and builder alongside Stripe's FX team. Together you'll develop the quantitative foundation for how Stripe measures, forecasts, and hedges FX exposure.</p> <h2>What you'll do</h2> <p>You'll be the senior quantitative lead for FX within Treasury Finance Data Science. You'll co-build with Treasury, the FX hedging team, Finance, and Engineering: shaping the research agenda, turning ideas into rigorous models, and building the systems that put those models to work. Data Science owns these systems. They produce the decision-critical outputs and analyses that the FX team and Treasury leadership rely on. This is a hands-on role. You'll design the methodology, write the code, and ship it into production.</p> <h3><strong>Responsibilities</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Partner with the FX team to build and evolve FX risk measurement: exposure aggregation across entities and currencies, VaR / Expected Shortfall, stress testing, and scenario analysis</li> <li>Develop forecasting models for FX exposures and multi-currency cash flows. Quantify forecast uncertainty so it can inform hedge sizing and timing.</li> <li>Co-design hedge optimization and decision frameworks with the FX team that weigh hedge cost, residual risk, P&amp;L volatility, and liquidity constraints</li> <li>Build ML and statistical systems for trading and risk (signal research, anomaly detection on flows, execution and cost analytics), and take them from prototype to production</li> <li>Own the production systems that generate decision-critical FX outputs, partnering with Engineering on reliability, SLAs, monitoring, alerting, and incident response for risk-critical workflows</li> <li>Partner deeply with Treasury Finance stakeholders to turn business questions into quantitative frameworks. Anticipate needs and help shape FX risk strategy rather than reacting to requests.</li> <li>Produce clear, trusted analyses and reporting that inform Treasury and Finance leadership decisions, including leadership-level reporting such as MBRs and QBRs</li> <li>Use AI tools (code assistants, LLM-based agents) to speed up modeling, analysis, and automation, while maintaining rigor, validation, and auditability</li> <li>Raise the technical bar for FX quantitative work within Data Science: methodology standards, model validation, documentation, and mentoring other data scientists</li> </ul> <h2>Who you are</h2> <p>We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. You will partner closely with designers, other engineers, and partners to execute and evolve the site, bringing technical craft and creativity to the expansive scope of Stripe's web presence.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h3><strong>Responsibilities</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Collaborate with our team's designers and partners to both create new experiences for and maintain Stripe.com</li> <li>Work closely with other design engineers, pairing, mentoring, and continually building a culture of excellence</li> <li>Prototype and implement web animations and interaction-heavy product launch materials</li> <li>Build beautiful, best-in-class end-user experiences to solve complex problems</li> <li>Utilize, maintain, and extend our design systems</li> <li>Integrate our web platform with self-serve authoring and experimentation</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Who you are</strong></h2> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.</span></p> <h3><strong>Minimum requirements</strong></h3> <ul> <li>6+ years of relevant web front-end development or creative technology experience at a tech-forward, product-driven company</li> <li>Advanced knowledge of modern HTML and CSS</li> <li>Experience writing clear, elegant code in a team environment</li> <li>A zeal for the web as a storytelling medium, demonstrable through a portfolio of design work and frontend code showcasing design systems, engaging microsites, Figma plugins, webGL experiments, CSS art, or anything else—you tell us</li> <li>Experience designing and building public-facing websites that work elegantly across commonly used browsers and devices</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Preferred qualifications</strong></h3> <ul> <li>A good understanding of the formal elements of design, not just limited to the web and including typography, layout, balance, and proportion</li> <li>Proficiency with React, with a focus on interactions, animation, performance, and polish</li> <li>Experience with A/B testing, synthetic monitoring, or accessibility testing</li> </ul>

title: Designer, Web Presence & Platform
description: <h2><strong>Who we are </strong></h2> <h3><strong>About Stripe</strong></h3> <p>Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.</p> <h3>&nbsp;</h3> <h3><strong>About the team:<br></strong></h3> <p>Web Presence &amp; Platform (WPP) is organized into two pillars: <strong>Platform</strong> and <strong>Presence</strong>. The Platform pillar builds internal systems, tooling, and infrastructure to support the web. The Presence pillar owns Stripe’s public-facing storytelling across <strong>stripe.com</strong>, including our homepage, product landing pages, industry and solutions pages, and other high-impact go-to-market surfaces. Together, we shape how millions of people understand what Stripe is and what it can do for them.</p> <p>Designers on the Presence team work at the intersection of craft and impact—balancing clarity, polish, and systems thinking with strategic storytelling and experimentation. We collaborate closely with engineering, marketing, content, and product to deliver work that is not only beautiful, but measurably moves the business.</p> <h3><strong>&nbsp;</strong></h3> <h2><strong>What you’ll do<br></strong></h2> <p>As a Designer on the Presence team, you'll contribute to the strategy and execution of Stripe’s most visible web surfaces. You’ll design new product pages, evolve storytelling for specific industries or audiences, and refine reusable patterns that make it easier to scale exceptional work across stripe.com. This is a high-impact role for a thoughtful, collaborative designer who deeply values visual craft, user clarity, and iteration.</p> <p>We’re looking for someone who’s excited to operate at the intersection of storytelling, systems, and scale—and who takes pride in the pixels. Your work will directly shape how millions of users understand Stripe, and help convert interest into action across a range of audiences—from founders to enterprise CTOs.</p> <h2><strong>&nbsp;</strong></h2> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h3><strong>Responsibilities</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Design new and improved experiences across stripe.com, including product, industry, and solution landing pages</li> <li>Collaborate with engineers, PMMs, and content designers to define problems, explore solutions, and bring them to life</li> <li>Partner with other designers to maintain and evolve systems that uphold Stripe’s design standards at scale</li> <li>Balance storytelling with usability to create pages that are engaging, credible, and easy to navigate</li> <li>Use user research, user testing, and data to guide and validate your decisions</li> <li>Participate in critique and feedback sessions, contributing to the overall quality bar of the team</li> <li>Demonstrate a meticulous attention to craft—ensuring designs are not only functional, but visually excellent</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Who you are</strong></h2> <p>We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these, we encourage you to apply—even if you don’t meet every preferred qualification.</p> <h3><strong>Minimum requirements</strong></h3> <ul> <li>2–4 years of relevant design experience, ideally in web or product marketing contexts</li> <li>A strong portfolio of web design work that demonstrates exceptional <strong>visual design skills</strong>, systems thinking, and attention to detail</li> <li>Ability to independently scope and lead small to medium-sized projects</li> <li>Strong communication skills and a collaborative mindset</li> <li>Fluency in layout, typography, color, hierarchy, and interaction fundamentals</li> <li>Comfortable using Figma and working in component-based systems</li> <li>Experience working on CMS-driven websites and modular systems</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Preferred qualifications</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Familiarity with front-end development workflows or an ability to speak fluently with engineers</li> <li>Understanding of web performance, accessibility, and SEO best practices</li> <li>Experience designing for international audiences or multilingual websites</li> <li>Previous experience in fast-paced, cross-functional environments</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h3><strong>How we work</strong></h3> <p>We care deeply about craft—but also about moving with urgency and focus. We seek feedback early and often, because we believe design gets stronger through collaboration and iteration. We keep our users front and center—whether that’s a small business owner evaluating Stripe for the first time, or a CTO trying to understand a complex product at a glance. And we take pride in delivering work that is not only beautiful and precise, but that delivers clear, measurable impact.</p> <p>We value curiosity, humility, and resilience. You’ll do well here if you love to learn, enjoy working across disciplines, and bring energy and optimism into your work.</p> <p>This is a great opportunity for someone eager to grow. Designers on the Presence team have gone on to lead major product launches, shape system-wide improvements, and take on leadership roles. You'll be supported by experienced peers and have space to develop your craft, influence, and ownership over time.</p>

title: Financial Crimes Investigator, Luxembourg
description: <h2 id="who-we-are">Who we are</h2> <h3 id="about-stripe-and-bridge">About Stripe and Bridge</h3> <p>Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.</p> <p>Bridge, acquired by Stripe in 2025 and operating as a Stripe subsidiary, is a stablecoin-powered payments platform built to simplify global money movement.</p> <h3 id="about-the-team">About the team</h3> <p>The Financial Crime, Compliance and Risk Oversight (FinCRO) Investigations Management team provides second-line-of-defence (2LoD) financial crime risk oversight and coordinates casework across Stripe’s EMEA region. The team manages user risk and synthesises investigative information into decision-ready analysis and intelligence for MLROs, RCOs, and other key stakeholders. It also identifies control weaknesses, coordinates complex investigations, and supports local examinations and inquiries from financial partners, law enforcement, and other external stakeholders.</p> <h2 id="what-youll-do">What you’ll do</h2> <p>We are looking for a financial crime professional with Luxembourg- and EU-specific experience to join the EMEA Investigations Management team. Based in Luxembourg, you will focus primarily on Bridge Building S.A. while also supporting Stripe’s broader investigations work.</p> <p>As an Investigator on the EMEA Investigations Management team, you will:</p> <ul> <li>Review high-risk investigative casework and provide 2LoD oversight across a wide variety of financial crime risk types</li> <li>Prepare and submit Luxembourg Suspicious Transaction Reports (STRs) to the Cellule de renseignement financier (CRF) for Bridge Building S.A., working closely with the MLRO and in line with established governance</li> <li>Oversee local customer risk decisions for Bridge Building S.A., including matters escalated through country- or entity-specific risk management forums, in close partnership with the MLRO and Investigations Leads</li> <li>Review high-risk sanctions investigations, such as potential matches against relevant regional lists, and handle related submissions</li> <li>Use and evolve AI and agentic tools to enhance casework research and analysis, surface actionable intelligence, and improve investigative workflows while applying expert judgement and maintaining human oversight of risk decisions and regulatory filings</li> <li>Assess casework to produce clear investigative analyses, intelligence briefs, and other decision-ready outputs that identify threats, support reporting workstreams, and inform MLROs, RCOs, and other stakeholders</li> <li>Identify potential control gaps through casework analysis and recommend solutions to mitigate financial crime risks across the programme and in individual cases</li> <li>Serve as a point of contact for investigation-related inquiries from law enforcement and FIUs, financial partners, auditors, and other external stakeholders</li> <li>Demonstrate sound judgement and the ability to navigate complex, high-risk cases where the correct decision may not be immediately clear</li> </ul> <h2 id="who-you-are">Who you are</h2> <h3 id="minimum-requirements">Minimum requirements</h3> <ul> <li>3+ years of experience in investigative roles within financial crime, AML, risk, intelligence research, or a related field</li> <li>Fluency in English and French</li> <li>Demonstrated experience preparing regulatory disclosures, including direct experience with Luxembourg STR filings and goAML</li> <li>A deep understanding of financial technologies, including payments, cryptocurrency, stablecoins, and Banking-as-a-Service products</li> <li>Strong knowledge of Luxembourg and EU AML, terrorist financing, and sanctions regulations</li> <li>Stakeholder management skills, including the ability to work effectively with MLROs and communicate complex risk decisions clearly</li> <li>Excellent research and writing skills and the ability to produce concise, decision-ready investigative outputs</li> <li>The ability to synthesise large amounts of information, including transaction data, using tools such as SQL, Excel, and AI</li> <li>The ability to work efficiently and independently in a fast-paced environment</li> <li>The ability to handle sensitive matters with discretion</li> </ul> <h3 id="preferred-qualifications">Preferred qualifications</h3> <ul> <li>ACAMS or a similar professional certification</li> <li>Familiarity with macOS and Google products</li> <li>Technical curiosity and an interest in evolving financial crime compliance trends</li> </ul>

title: Financial Data Analyst Intern, Technical Operations
description: <h2><strong>Who we are</strong></h2> <h3><strong>About Stripe</strong></h3> <p>Stripe is a technology company focused on improving the conditions for economic growth and prosperity. We build programmable financial infrastructure, rethinking from first principles how financial services should work, to make it easier and cheaper for any business to start and scale. More than 10 million <a href="https://stripe.com/customers">businesses</a> build on Stripe, spanning the economic frontier—from solo founders to established enterprises—united by a practical focus on growth. The most ambitious companies in the world use Stripe as core infrastructure to grow faster. They process trillions of dollars a year on Stripe, equivalent to around 1.6% of global GDP. While economic growth makes everyone better off, open markets also enable greater variety. When any business can easily serve a global customer base, the quality and diversity of products in the world increase, and craft and creativity are unleashed into the smallest niches. Our own growth is wholly contingent on the success of the businesses building on Stripe. We therefore invest back into our technology at an unusual rate. We make <a href="https://stripe.com/roadmap">upgrades to our products</a> every single day to deliver compounding gains to our customers. We maintain some of the most <a href="https://status.stripe.com/">reliable APIs</a> on the internet. We build entirely new <a href="https://tempo.xyz/">pieces</a> of <a href="https://mpp.dev/">financial</a> <a href="https://joinopenstandard.com/">infrastructure</a> to enable new ideas. And our significant advances in <a href="https://stripe.com/radar">risk and fraud</a> infrastructure over many years are making the internet economy safer and more accessible.&nbsp;</p> <p>Though people at Stripe don’t tend to take themselves seriously, Stripe is a fairly serious place: our customers are depending on us for their livelihoods. We admire ambition, intensity, curiosity, humility, and rigor. The most effective people become knowledgeable about many domains besides their own. Any company is an applied exercise in understanding some aspect of society or the market. In working with so many (especially the new and innovative ones), we think that Stripe is one of the very best places to learn about how the world works.</p> <h2><strong>About the team</strong></h2> <p>The APAC Payments TechOps team ensures the accuracy of financial data flowing through Stripe's payment infrastructure, manages aging balances, maintains compliance with partner and regulatory requirements, and builds tooling to detect and resolve data quality issues at scale. Through the internship, you will work with real financial data, gain experience in payments data analysis and operational problem-solving, and have opportunities to present your work to your team and the wider org. Each intern has a dedicated intern manager, and every project is part of the team's roadmap and will directly help Stripe's mission.</p> <h2><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h2> <p>Every internship at Stripe centers around a real, legitimate project that our team urgently needs. We will support you in shipping it. Yes, you will actually ship it. Example projects include building data quality checks for payment flows, creating dashboards to surface aging balance trends, automating compliance reporting, or analyzing cost structures across partner networks. As a Stripe intern, you'll be tackling important projects while working alongside exceptional people who insist on doing their best work. You'll learn from people with high standards who are great at inspiring others to do more and go further. We value technical and personal growth, and see our internship program as a vehicle to foster both.</p> <h3>Responsibilities</h3> <ul> <li>Analyze financial data by writing queries and examining data quality, reconciliation accuracy, or cost structures across Stripe's payment flows</li> <li>Write code or build tooling that will be used in production and has meaningful impact to Stripe's payment operations</li> <li>Give and receive technical feedback through code reviews, data model discussions, or analysis walkthroughs</li> <li>Collaborate with engineers, product managers, and finance stakeholders to seek and incorporate feedback on your work</li> <li>Learn quickly by asking great questions, by working with your intern manager and teammates effectively, and by communicating the status of your work clearly</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Who you are</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Ambitious builder:</strong> You’re energized by building solutions without clear precedent and solving problems with far-reaching consequences. Successful Stripes are deeply curious, and prefer the joy of discovery to the comfort of certainty.</li> <li><strong>Rigorous thinker: </strong>You appreciate that things worth doing are rarely simple. You enjoy working on problems that have never been tackled before.&nbsp;</li> <li><strong>Adaptable problem solver:</strong> You adapt quickly and treat obstacles as opportunities. At Stripe we embrace kindness while encouraging Stripes to take measured risks and act boldly, even in the absence of consensus.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Minimum requirements</strong></h3> <ul> <li>A strong fundamental understanding of quantitative analysis through pursuit of a Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD degree in computer science, data science, finance, economics, information systems, or a related discipline</li> <li>Some experience and familiarity with programming or data analysis, either through side projects or coursework. We work mostly in SQL, Python, and Ruby. We believe new programming languages can be learned if the fundamentals and general knowledge are present</li> <li>Experience from previous internships or other multi-person projects, including open source contributions, that demonstrate evaluating and receiving feedback from mentors, peers, and stakeholders</li> <li>Ability to learn unfamiliar systems and form an understanding of those systems, through independent research and working with a mentor and subject matter experts</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Preferred qualifications</strong></h3> <ul> <li>At least 2 years of university education, or equivalent work experience</li> <li>Familiarity with SQL and querying relational databases, either through coursework or personal projects</li> <li>Interest in payments, fintech, or financial systems</li> <li>Comfort with developer tools (e.g. git) and data visualization</li> <li>A strong interest in understanding how financial data flows through complex payment systems and ensuring its accuracy</li> <li>Ability to write clearly to explain analytical findings to stakeholders, team members, and other Stripes</li> </ul>

title: Firmware Engineer
description: <h3><strong>About Stripe</strong></h3> <p>Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.<strong>&nbsp;</strong></p> <h3><strong>About the team</strong></h3> <p>Stripe Terminal helps Stripe users extend their online presence into the physical world. The Terminal team’s mission is to make it as easy for businesses to accept in-person payments as the Stripe API has done for online payments. With Terminal, businesses can unlock in-person payments use cases that are right for their business model—whether it’s creating a flagship retail experience, extending their website to a pop-up store, or enabling a mobile point-of-sale at their next event.&nbsp;</p> <h3><strong>We are looking for:</strong></h3> <p>You will be responsible for all aspects of software development, which includes building, writing automated tests, and deploying software on our embedded payments platforms. This team works closely with partner teams throughout the hardware and software product lifecycle, from hardware manufacturing to Android application teams.&nbsp;</p> <h3><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Design, develop and maintain user interfaces and underlying functionality for embedded point-of-sale software that handle secure payment processing across several products simultaneously.</li> <li>Implement industry standard protocols to match product capabilities.</li> <li>Create, maintain, and execute application unit tests as part of Continuous Integration.</li> <li>Analyze bug reports and manage the defect resolution process (disposition issues, resolve issues, and report issue status).</li> <li>Work closely with QA staff to ensure appropriate test cases are created, maintained, and executed.</li> <li>Collaborate on system-side code, communication protocol design, and kernel development.</li> <li>Interact with global teams with excellent communication skills to provide support information.</li> <li>Routinely perform code reviews to ensure high quality designs and implementation.</li> <li>Assist in ensuring quality and timeliness of product and feature development.</li> <li>Proactively solve problems and work independently and within a team environment, with limited guidance.</li> <li>Work closely with your hardware counterparts on product design and have the ability to read schematics, provide feedback on I/O mapping, developing manufacturing test software to ensure the devices are built to specification.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Who you are</strong></h3> <p>We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.</p> <p><strong>Minimum requirements</strong></p> <ul> <li>2+ years software development experience.</li> <li>2+ years working with embedded, mobile, or other connected devices.</li> <li>Proficiency in embedded programming language C.</li> <li>Experience using automated testing, build systems, or device firmware communication.</li> <li>Experience with embedded systems, knowledge of operating systems, familiarity with software development tools, understanding of hardware-software interfaces.</li> <li>Experience architecting and developing multithreaded applications, preferably in embedded systems.</li> <li>Experience with common communications protocols (e.g., SPI, UART, I2C, USB, and others), debugging practices (e.g., JTAG and associated GDB integrations), and basic electrical design principles.</li> <li>Experience adding, monitoring and parsing telemetry data to proactively resolve issues.</li> <li>Degree in CS, EE, or equivalent practical experience.</li> <li>Fluent in spoken and written English.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Preferred qualifications</strong></p> <ul> <li>Proficiency in C++ or Golang is highly advantageous.</li> <li>Experience developing on ARM platforms.</li> <li>Experience with point-of-sale hardware and peripherals.</li> <li>Knowledge of EMV standards and payment protocols.</li> <li>Knowledge of PCI standards, transaction processing, and related retail payment technologies.</li> <li>Knowledge of low-level security architectures, including TrustZone, anti-tamper mechanisms, Secure Boot, and Hardware Root of Trust.</li> <li>Knowledge of foundational cryptography, including symmetric/asymmetric algorithms and secure key exchange protocols.</li> </ul>

title: Food Experience Manager
description: <h2><strong>Who we are </strong></h2> <h3><strong>About Stripe</strong></h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.</span></p> <h3><strong>About the team</strong></h3> <p>The Stripe Workplace team creates and operates inspiring, comfortable, and innovative spaces that bring Stripe’s culture and values to life and provide a foundation for achieving our mission. In this role, you will be part of the team that supports and builds food programs worldwide, from our food philosophy and safety standards to our vendor management and feedback systems. Our team is strategically distributed across all regions but operating as one cohesive unit that shares ownership of our entire global portfolio. To further strengthen our ability to provide real-time partnership across all time zones, we are looking for a leader as a Food Experience Manager to join us. This role reports to the Global Head of Food, and is based in South San Francisco.</p> <h2><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h2> <p>As a Food Experience Manager, you will be a key architect of our global food programs, based in our Oyster Point Headquarters, but with a worldwide impact.</p> <h3><strong>Responsibilities</strong></h3> <ul> <li><strong>Global Program Builder:</strong> You will take the lead in designing, building, and documenting our scalable, global "playbooks" for core operational functions (e.g., vendor QBRs, new site launches, budget management).</li> <li><strong>Drive Global Program Execution:</strong> You will be responsible for the successful execution of our global standards across a fluid portfolio of offices, which may span multiple regions. Your role is to ensure consistency, compliance, and high performance, regardless of location.</li> <li><strong>Synthesize Global Data: </strong>You will analyze user feedback and operational data from across our entire global portfolio to identify systemic trends, risks, and opportunities, transforming that data into actionable business intelligence for the whole team.</li> <li><strong>Lead High-Stakes Vendor Partnerships:</strong> You will manage the relationship and performance of our strategic food service partner(s), ensuring strict adherence to our Statements of Work (SOWs) and leading rigorous Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs).</li> <li><strong>Advise on Global Growth: </strong>As a direct partner to the Global Head of Food, you will serve as a strategic advisor for all new office builds and expansions, providing expert input on design and operational readiness, no matter the location.</li> <li><strong>Developing communication strategies:</strong> Lead program change by developing adoption plans, training, and communication strategies that drive consistent execution across regions.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Who you are</strong></h2> <p>We’re looking for someone who is passionate about food and hospitality but thinks like a systems architect for a global product. While deep hospitality experience is a plus, we are excited to consider exceptional candidates from diverse operational backgrounds, including tech, logistics, or high-end retail, who have a proven track record of building scalable, user-obsessed systems.</p> <ul> <li>You are an expert in creating world-class customer experiences and are obsessed with using scalable, data-driven systems to deliver them consistently across cultures.</li> <li>You have a proven track record of managing complex, multi-unit or multi-regional operations, and have experience building a single, consistent standard and deploying it across a diverse portfolio.</li> <li>You are deeply analytical and data-fluent, able to synthesize disparate data sets from multiple regions into a single, cohesive strategic narrative.</li> <li>You are a "first-principles" thinker who is energized by questioning industry conventions and building something new.</li> <li>You are a natural stakeholder manager, able to partner effectively with cross-functional teams like Real Estate, Finance, and Legal to influence outcomes.</li> <li>You have direct experience managing high-stakes third-party vendor relationships, including contract negotiation and performance management.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Minimum requirements</strong></h3> <ul> <li>8+ years of leadership experience building and scaling complex, customer-facing operations (e.g., in the food &amp; beverage, high-end retail, or tech industries).</li> <li>Direct experience in concept development, multi-unit operations, or scaling a service-oriented business.</li> <li>Demonstrable experience managing a P&amp;L and using data to drive business decisions.</li> </ul>

The playbook will be rewritten as we learn. You thrive in that environment.</li> </ul> <h3>Minimum requirements</h3> <ul> <li>5+ years of professional experience in a role requiring diagnostic thinking, problem-solving, and cross-functional collaboration</li> <li>Demonstrated, hands-on experience building and deploying AI-powered agents, tools, automations, or workflows that real people use in their actual work, whether that made existing processes meaningfully more efficient or made previously unviable work possible for the first time</li> <li>Proficiency with AI development tools and platforms (e.g., Claude Code, Codex, custom agent frameworks, API integrations, workflow automation tools)</li> <li>Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences and adapt your style to different learners</li> <li>Comfort working across multiple workstreams and relationships simultaneously (you'll be supporting 25–45 marketers at varying stages of their AI journey)</li> <li>Track record of coaching, teaching, or enabling others, with evidence that people you've helped actually changed how they work</li> </ul> <h3>Preferred qualifications</h3> <ul> <li>Experience in a formal AI transformation role where the job was substantially about identifying opportunities for workflow transformation and executing on them with hands-on builds</li> <li>Experience helping people become more expert AI users and capable builders</li> <li>Experience in marketing, marketing operations, growth, or a closely adjacent function, including familiarity with marketing technology stacks (e.g., Marketo, Salesforce, analytics platforms, content management tools)</li> </ul>
