title: Forward Deployed Engineer, Privy
description: <h2>Who we are</h2> <h3 id="about-privy">About Privy</h3> <p>Our mission is to make privacy and user ownership the default online. To do so, we build simple, flexible APIs and tools for developers that make it easy to build new products on crypto rails.</p> <p>Privy owns the abstractions and infrastructure layer above wallets, integrating across chains, third-party providers, and Stripe products like Treasury and Link. We get to solve hard technical problems while leveraging Stripe's distribution to reach customers like Ramp, Klarna, Deel, Kraken, Hyperliquid, and Fomo — powering experiences for both mainstream users and crypto natives.</p> <h3 id="about-privy">About the team</h3> <p>Engineering at Privy is distinguished by</p> <ul> <li>High urgency—Shipping very small iterations, very fast, to learn very quickly</li> <li>Product taste—Our customers <em>are</em> developers, and to build effective products for them requires technical knowledge—you will often be "the PM."</li> <li>Security mindset—A great portion of our product is trust. While we have a dedicated security team, every engineer brings security to their designs from the start.</li> </ul> <p>In practice, we use&nbsp;<a href="https://mcfunley.com/choose-boring-technology">boring technology</a> like Node, React, and AWS so we can focus our engineering energy entirely on pushing the boundaries of Privy's core product, e.g. through hardware enclaves, multi-region low latency APIs, and blockchain abstractions that are accessible to mainstream developers.</p> <h2>What you’ll do</h2> <p data-pm-slice="1 1 []">We're looking for an exceptional Forward Deployed Engineer to join our team and be the primary technical owner for building out new capabilities with Privy's most important customers. In this role, you will combine technical expertise with a deep understanding of customer and business objectives to architect, develop, and deploy software features that address customers’ needs and evolve the capabilities of Privy’s core products.&nbsp;Customer obsession is a core part of Privy’s culture. You’ll work closely with fellow engineers, product, and business teams to ensure Privy's customers achieve their desired outcomes and are delighted by our products.</p> <h3>Responsibilities<span style="font-weight: 400;">&nbsp;</span></h3> <ul> <li>Work directly with customers to understand their technical and operational objectives, scope requirements, and prototype and propose software solutions</li> <li>Design, code, and launch features that improve and innovate on Privy’s core product using tools like&nbsp;<strong>TypeScript</strong>, <strong>React</strong>, and <strong>Next.js</strong>, and own end-to-end development</li> <li>Drive product deployments, including configuration, testing, and troubleshooting</li> <li>Champion customer success, ensuring the team understands, prioritizes, and pursues customer feedback and pain points</li> <li>Dive deep into customer codebases to understand product usage and friction points, and uncover opportunities for improvements</li> <li>Partner with internal stakeholders to continuously align product roadmap and strategy with customer needs and objectives</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Who you are</strong></h2> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.</span></p> <h3>Minimum requirements</h3> <ul> <li>5+ years of professional, hands-on full-stack development experience with languages such as JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Python, Go, or Java</li> <li>Excel at rapid prototyping while maintaining appropriate quality standards</li> <li>Superb problem-solving skills and ability to understand the product and business side of development (in other words, you see the big picture)</li> <li>Experience building and owning features end-to-end</li> <li>Excellent ability to communicate and collaborate with both technical and non-technical stakeholders</li> <li>A passion for handling ambiguity and picking up new technologies, frameworks, and tools</li> <li>An entrepreneurial and high ownership mindset</li> <li>A desire for impact and a deep sense of urgency for your work</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Preferred qualifications</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Written open-source developer tooling</li> <li>Published your work (code, presentations, papers, blog posts, etc.)</li> <li>Experience building web3 applications</li> </ul>

title: Forward Deployed Security Engineer
description: <h2><strong>Who we are </strong></h2> <h3><strong>About Stripe</strong></h3> <h3><span style="font-weight: 400;">Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.</span></h3> <h3><strong>About the team</strong></h3> <p>Abuse Operations is the front-line incident response and remediation function handling active product abuse and fraud impacting Stripe and its merchants. This multi-disciplinary group, spanning Incident Managers, Investigators, Forward Deployed Security Engineers, and Data Scientists, neutralizes active attacks, gathers requirements for operational tooling, and leads incidents. The team works directly with impacted merchants to resolve incidents and policy abuse rapidly. Operating primarily across Eastern, Pacific and Western European time zones, these team members regularly coordinate with global stakeholders across the world.</p> <h2><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h2> <p>In this role, you will play a critical part in safeguarding our financial ecosystem through two main pillars: actively responding to live fraud and abuse incidents as a hands-on security engineer, and serving as a key bridge between incidents and merchants to help them remediate threats, improve security posture, and protect their accounts. Leveraging your technical depth in fraud, abuse, and security engineering, you will investigate high-risk accounts, perform post-incident analyses, gather operational requirements, and drive agentic response capabilities ensuring we neutralize threats with speed and precision while elevating Stripe's product integrity function.</p> <h3><strong>Responsibilities</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Respond to live fraud and abuse incidents as a Forward Deployed Security Engineer, investigating high-risk activity, neutralizing active attacks, and mitigating security risks across the ecosystem.</li> <li>Investigate, mitigate, and remediate urgent fraud incidents (e.g., ATO, card testing), utilizing FT3-mapped&nbsp; (Fraud Taxonomy 3.0) detection and signals enrichment to reduce uncertainty and accelerate response.</li> <li>As part of incidents, analyze high-risk accounts to identify fraudulent merchants, card testing, account takeovers, and other fraud vectors, classifying them using FT3 to standardize threat intelligence.</li> <li>Develop, document, and execute incident response strategies, runbooks, and capabilities to continuously improve fraud and abuse detection and prevention.</li> <li>Act as a dedicated technical bridge during and after incidents to work directly with impacted merchants and customers, helping them investigate root causes, remediate vulnerabilities, and secure their accounts.</li> <li>Serve as an operational and technical liaison for legal teams, policy partners, and threat intelligence communities.</li> <li>Build and nurture strong strategic relationships across external threat intelligence communities, peer working groups, and law enforcement agencies.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Who you are</strong></h2> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.</span></p> <h3><strong>Minimum requirements</strong></h3> <ul> <li>10+ years of experience leading security or fraud incident response;&nbsp;</li> <li>B.S./M.S. in Computer Science or equivalent experience.</li> <li>Expert knowledge of Python and SQL, and familiarity with other programming languages</li> <li>Existing experience with log analysis (e.g. first or third party applications, system / data access, event logs), network security, digital forensics, and incident response investigations</li> <li>Proven ability to build automated response workflows, leverage threat intelligence, and make risk mitigation recommendations.</li> <li>Strong written and verbal communication skills with a track record of driving cross-functional alignment with minimal oversight.</li> <li>Previous work with law enforcement</li> <li>Engagement in threat intelligence sharing communities</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Preferred qualifications</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Broad expertise across fraud and abuse mitigation, risk management, product trust, and threat intelligence in a complex platform environment.</li> <li>An adversarial mindset, understanding the goals, behaviors, and TTPs of threat actors.</li> <li>Experience with engineering, data processing and analysis tools (e.g. Databricks, Trino, etc.)</li> <li>Familiarity with common open-source frameworks for big data processing and/or data science (PySpark, Pandas, Sci-kit Learn, etc.)</li> <li>Experience with tactical threat intelligence and/or hunting for sophisticated threat actors in an enterprise environment</li> <li>Ability to proactively challenge the status quo by leveraging data and taking a user-centric approach to address complex product integrity challenges.</li> <li>Speaker or participant in external conferences or similar industry engagements</li> </ul>

title: Fraud Architect
description: <h2><strong>Who we are </strong></h2> <h3><strong>About Stripe</strong></h3> <p>Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.</p> <h3><strong>About the team</strong></h3> <p>The Fraud Architect team helps Stripe’s largest and most complex users manage fraud and abuse across the customer lifecycle. We combine deep fraud expertise, technical investigation, and product knowledge to help users understand emerging threats, optimize Radar, and implement durable prevention strategies tailored to their business and risk tolerance. Our goal is to enable users’ growth by proactively reducing fraud while protecting legitimate customer activity and turning frontline insights into better products and defenses.</p> <h2><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h2> <p>Stripe users face fraud and abuse across the customer lifecycle, including payment fraud, free-trial farming, multi-account abuse, and usage-based billing exploitation. They need a partner who understands their business, anticipates emerging threats, and helps them put effective protections in place as their business and the threat landscape evolve.</p> <p>As a member of our Fraud Architect team, you’ll be the fraud and risk specialist embedded in strategic user relationships for a small portfolio of named users, acting as a technical extension of their teams. You’ll help users get more from Radar, build a proactive prevention strategy, and turn complex fraud problems into practical decisions.</p> <p>This role combines analytical rigor, deep fraud investigation, and product judgment. You’ll develop a deep understanding of how Radar scores and classifies transactions, how integrations and available signals affect its decisions, and where its capabilities and limitations matter for a user. You’ll explain what the evidence supports, investigate what it does not yet explain, and translate both into action: better rules and thresholds, integration guidance, or model and feature gaps to pursue with our product teams.</p> <p>Your focus is proactive, user-specific risk ownership and durable prevention. You’ll provide user context, communicate implications and next steps, and turn incident findings into an implemented and verified prevention plan. You’ll help build, expand, and evolve defenses as user needs and fraud patterns change.</p> <h3><strong>Responsibilities</strong></h3> <ul> <li><strong>Own each user’s prevention strategy. </strong>Maintain a current risk baseline, threat model, and agreed prevention plan for every assigned account. Understand payment methods, integrations, billing flows, trial and promotion mechanics, existing controls, and risk preferences; identify the top risks and gaps across the full customer lifecycle.</li> <li><strong>Make Radar’s behavior understandable and actionable. </strong>Investigate scoring, classification, rule behavior, and signal coverage using transaction evidence and technical context. Explain observed behavior and uncertainty clearly, distinguish configuration or integration issues from potential model or feature gaps, and recommend the right next step for the user and our product teams.</li> <li><strong>Design and improve user protections.</strong> Help users configure and optimize Radar for their business model and risk tolerance. Develop and validate user-facing rules, thresholds, and integration recommendations, test their expected impact, and guide approved implementation. Balance fraud prevention with legitimate payment acceptance and false-positive risk, without taking on internal-rule deployment or model operations.</li> <li><strong>Anticipate established and emerging fraud vectors.</strong> Investigate payment, account, and behavioral patterns to understand how abuse works and where it may move next. Advise on payment fraud, trial and promotion abuse, multi-accounting, bot activity, and usage-based billing exploitation. Evaluate defenses across payment methods and flows rather than treating each attack surface in isolation.</li> <li><strong>Deliver consistent proactive coverage. </strong>Run a weekly risk-health review for every assigned account, including those without active incidents, and share a concise health update. Establish early-warning thresholds and notification paths; translate changes in fraud, disputes, early fraud warnings, approval rates, and false positives into timely user conversations and prevention actions. Lead deeper periodic reviews with technical and business stakeholders.</li> <li><strong>Own follow-through, not just recommendations.</strong> Maintain a user action plan with named owners, due dates, expected impact, and implementation status. Follow recommendations through user acceptance, implementation, and verification of effectiveness. Revisit residual risk and adjust controls as traffic, threats, and user priorities change.</li> <li><strong>Connect incident response to durable prevention. </strong>During incidents, provide user context and prioritization, coordinate user-facing updates with the account team, conduct merchant-specific root-cause analysis, synthesize findings with Engineering, and translate them into an implemented prevention plan. Verify that prevention measures are implemented and effective after handoff.</li> <li><strong>Turn user evidence into product improvements.</strong> Partner with Radar Product, Engineering, and Fraud Data Science to investigate limitations and define actionable requirements. Maintain a cross-user backlog of signal, model, integration, and payment-method gaps with clear owners and follow-up milestones. Advocate for durable fixes, explain progress to users, and help them adopt and validate delivered improvements.</li> <li><strong>Enable others to act. </strong>Build reusable playbooks, investigation tools, and prevention frameworks. Train Customer Success Managers, Technical Account Managers, and Account Executives to recognize common fraud patterns, explain risk tradeoffs, and know when to involve a specialist.</li> <li><strong>Build and evolve the program.</strong> Shape account segmentation, coverage expectations, tooling, and hiring as the function grows. Work with leadership and partner teams to protect proactive capacity and establish clear incident handoffs. Measure success through current prevention plans and consistent coverage across the portfolio, recommendations implemented and proven effective, and improvements in user risk outcomes—not the volume of analysis produced.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Who you are</strong></h2> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.</span></p> <h3><strong>Minimum requirements</strong></h3> <ul> <li>8+ years in a technical role with substantial direct user engagement, such as solutions architecture, technical account management, fraud consulting, professional services, engineering, or technical product work, at a payments company, fintech, risk management platform, or fraud-prevention provider.</li> <li>Hands-on experience investigating fraud or abuse and translating findings into effective controls or user guidance. You can reason about adversarial behavior, payment flows, and the tradeoffs between fraud prevention and legitimate user activity.</li> <li>Depth in payment fraud, account takeover, subscription or trial abuse, multi-accounting, dispute management, and network monitoring programs such as VAMP, ECM, or EFM.</li> <li>Technical depth to understand API integrations, trace data and signal flows, investigate system behavior, and discuss technical limitations and implementation options with engineers. You can connect those details to a user’s business problem.</li> <li>Practical understanding of machine-learning-based risk decisions and rule systems, including how signal availability, model behavior, rules, and thresholds interact. You can explain findings clearly without overstating what the evidence establishes.</li> <li>Strong investigative and data science fundamentals: SQL proficiency and experience using Python, R, or a similar language to test hypotheses, investigate unfamiliar patterns, and evaluate controls. You can assess data quality, account for delayed fraud outcomes, and interpret precision, recall, false positives, and business impact.</li> <li>Experience managing multiple user relationships or technical engagements while maintaining proactive coverage and driving recommendations through implementation and measured results.</li> <li>Strong communication and product judgment. You can explain fraud exposure to a CFO, discuss rule logic and integration behavior with an engineer, and turn a user problem into a clear, prioritized product requirement.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Preferred qualifications</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Experience with Stripe Radar or similar fraud-prevention platforms such as Forter, Sift, Ravelin, or Signifyd.</li> <li>Experience designing, testing, and safely tuning fraud rules or thresholds in production, including shadow evaluation, user approval, and post-launch effectiveness reviews.</li> <li>Experience partnering with product managers, engineers, and data scientists to diagnose model or signal gaps and translate user evidence into shipped improvements.</li> <li>Familiarity with device intelligence, alternative payment methods, abuse prevention beyond payments, or usage-based business models.</li> <li>Experience building and scaling a technical advisory function, reusable prevention practices, or a multi-account service model.</li> </ul>

Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.</p> <h3>About the team</h3> <p>As a leading player in the internet economy, Stripe has a responsibility to protect itself, our users, end customers, and the broader financial ecosystem from harm. Fraud Operations proactively reduces fraud, making it difficult and unprofitable for fraudsters to carry out attacks through Stripe. We build scalable, high-judgement investigation and review operations while minimizing user friction. We work across products, customer segments, and markets and serve as a core pillar of the Stripe risk strategy.</p> <h2>What you'll do</h2> <p>Stripe is hiring a people leader to run our Fraud Operations Center in Bangalore. You'll lead leaders and senior operators responsible for core fraud investigations and complex, high-impact investigations. You'll be accountable for operational excellence across fraud review workflows—setting the operating cadence, defining and evolving team metrics, strengthening quality and consistency of decision-making, and scaling processes through tooling and vendor partnerships. This role is both strategic and hands-on: you'll stay close to day-to-day fraud workflows, regularly reviewing cases and serving as an escalation point and decision-making resource for the team.</p> <h3>Responsibilities</h3> <ul> <li>Lead the Bangalore Fraud Operations Center by managing team leads and senior associates, setting clear expectations, coaching performance, and building a high-judgement culture rooted in strong decisioning and customer empathy</li> <li>Own core fraud investigations and complex investigations, including escalations and time-sensitive incident response in partnership with global Fraud and Risk stakeholders</li> <li>Establish and run the operating system for the org, including goal setting, team cadences, SOPs, change management, queue health, SLAs, QA programs, calibration, and readiness for new products and markets</li> <li>Define, develop, and represent key operational and risk metrics for the Bangalore center (through dashboards and recurring readouts), translating data into actions and priorities</li> <li>Drive process development and continuous improvement through root cause analysis, defect reduction, policy adherence, and consistency across reviewers and teams</li> <li>Partner with other Risk teams to evolve fraud tooling and workflows (manual and automated actioning), including safe rollout and measurement of changes</li> <li>Support outsourcing relevant workflows by identifying transition candidates, designing and standardizing processes for handoff, and supporting training as needed</li> <li>Own staffing models, capacity planning, scheduling, hiring plans, onboarding, and training strategy to meet business needs while maintaining a high bar for quality and user experience</li> <li>Maintain close 'floor' engagement by regularly diving into cases, reviewing decisions, supporting frontline judgment, and ensuring feedback loops translate into measurable improvements</li> <li>Partner with recruiting to define role profiles and interview loops, drive bar-raising hiring decisions, and build a diverse team</li> <li>Own career development and succession planning, team health and engagement</li> <li>Build a great culture, a destination workplace, fostering our values, serving as a beacon of the Stripe user-centric philosophy and culture of transparency, empathy, inclusion, and empowerment</li> </ul> <h2>Who you are</h2> <p>We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.</p> <h3>Minimum requirements</h3> <ul> <li>Experience leading cross-functional initiatives and driving change through ambiguity, including new workflows for new products, markets, or emerging fraud patterns</li> <li>Experience leading fraud, risk, trust and safety, or investigations operations in a high-scale environment, including managing managers and team leads</li> <li>An ability to partner effectively with internal globally distributed stakeholders and lead internal teams and vendors</li> <li>Proven ability to define and operationalize metrics (e.g., accuracy and quality, SLAs, throughput, loss outcomes, appeals and rework, user friction) and use data to drive priorities</li> <li>Comfort working across detection systems and manual and automated actioning systems, with the ability to translate operational needs into product and engineering requirements</li> <li>Strong operational background, including new process launches, service delivery, and building operating models</li> <li>Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including presenting in operational reviews and representing the team in high-pressure escalations in English</li> <li>Skill and credibility doing the core work of a user-facing team with a high bar for quality, and a willingness to lead by example</li> <li>7+ years of direct people management experience, including performance management, coaching, and mentoring</li> <li>Experience with payments, risk, compliance, or financial industry operations</li> </ul> <h3>Preferred qualifications</h3> <ul> <li>Demonstrated ability to run an operations center, including capacity planning, scheduling, queue management, performance management, and quality programs</li> <li>Strong fraud domain depth across investigation workflows, risk vectors, and decision frameworks, with the ability to independently review cases and guide frontline judgment</li> <li>Experience scaling or transforming fraud review operations through process redesign, tooling improvements, and vendor partnerships</li> <li>Experience with payments risk (CNP and card testing, ATO, merchant fraud, transaction fraud) and familiarity with how upstream detection and downstream enforcement interact</li> <li>Strong analytics proficiency (building and owning dashboards, querying data directly) and comfort partnering deeply with data science and engineering</li> <li>Experience operating in a global, follow-the-sun model and partnering across time zones</li> </ul>

You bring sound judgment, calm execution under pressure, and a bias toward data-backed solutions and measurable improvements in both fraud outcomes and user experience.</p> <h3><strong>Minimum requirements</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Experience leading fraud, risk, trust &amp; safety, or investigations operations in a high-scale environment.</li> <li>Proven ability to manage a team of frontline operations associates and own their individual performance/productivity.</li> <li>Experience with payments, risk, compliance, or financial industry operations.</li> <li>Proven ability to define and operationalize team-level metrics (e.g., accuracy/quality, SLAs, throughput) and use data to drive team priorities.</li> <li>Strong operational background in new process launches, service delivery, and building operating models at the unit/team level.</li> <li>Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including presenting operational updates and representing the team in escalations in English.</li> <li>Skill and credibility doing the core work of a user facing team with a high bar for quality, and a willingness to lead by example.</li> <li>At least 3+ years of direct people management experience; this includes handling performance management and proactively coach/mentor individuals.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Preferred qualifications</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Strong fraud domain depth across investigation workflows, risk vectors, and decision frameworks</li> <li>Experience in optimizing unit-level fraud review operations through process redesign and tooling improvements.</li> <li>Experience with payments risk (CNP/card testing, ATO, merchant fraud, transaction fraud) and familiarity with how upstream detection and downstream enforcement interact.</li> <li>Strong analytics proficiency (comfort with data to track team performance) and comfort partnering with data science/engineering.</li> </ul>

description: <h2><strong>Who we are&nbsp;</strong></h2> <p><strong>About Stripe</strong></p> <p>Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.</p> <p><strong>About the team</strong></p> <p>Fraud Strategy is responsible for building scaled fraud mitigation systems that prevent fraud and protect the financial ecosystem, while minimizing disruption to good users. The fraud team’s mission is to protect Stripe, our users, and the broader financial ecosystem from actors who abuse Stripe accounts for financial gain.</p> <h2><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h2> <p>As a Fraud Strategist, you will be responsible for building strategies to mitigate fraud (buyer fraud, seller fraud and account fraud) on new and existing Stripe products. You will enable safer money movement for our users and help Stripe manage fraud risks intelligently. The stakes are high, and you will be up against ever-evolving challenges. You will face some of the most complex and dynamic problems at the company, and the nature of your work will evolve rapidly to combat new and more sophisticated challenges to Stripe's integrity in the financial ecosystem.&nbsp;</p> <p>You'll partner closely with Product, Engineering, Data Science, Operations and other Risk Strategy functions to ensure fraud controls are embedded in every Stripe product. Beyond protecting against fraud risk, you'll drive innovation in how Stripe approaches fraud management— staying ahead of emerging fraud trends and pushing the boundaries of what effective, scalable fraud risk management looks like at a global payments company.</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities&nbsp;</strong></p> <ul> <li>Monitor portfolio to identify, mitigate and predict risky behavior that could result in losses for Stripe, our users, and the financial ecosystem</li> <li>Collaborate with internal partners like Product, Engineering, Data Science, Risk Partnerships, and Operations, to tailor fraud risk management techniques to various products and payment methods across the globe</li> <li>Continually evaluate products for gaps and propose risk controls to enhance the product while enabling growth</li> <li>Scale risk processes to cover a large and complex landscape of fraud risks. Effectively design, outsource and automate manual/repetitive workflows</li> <li>Work with Stripe users to educate them and guide them on how to prevent potential fraud risks to their business</li> <li>Effectively and clearly communicate with other Stripes, Stripe's users, and Stripe's financial and regulatory partners</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Who you are</strong></h2> <p>We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.</p> <p><strong>Minimum requirements</strong></p> <ul> <li>&nbsp; 6+ years of relevant experience, preferably in Financial Services, Payments or FinTech</li> <li>&nbsp;&nbsp;Curiosity and passion for risk management - you dig into anomalies and solve root causes</li> <li>&nbsp;&nbsp;Decisiveness and openness to learning, with comfort making high-impact calls daily</li> <li>&nbsp;&nbsp;Data-driven judgment - skilled at using quantitative analysis to drive and defend decisions</li> <li>&nbsp;&nbsp;Empathy for early-stage businesses and the ability to balance enforcement with user experience</li> <li>&nbsp;&nbsp;Strong analytical skills, including the ability to frame complex tradeoffs through data and visualization</li> <li>&nbsp;&nbsp;Advanced SQL skills with hands-on experience in business environments</li> <li>&nbsp;&nbsp;Proven ability to collaborate and execute cross-functionally with Engineering, Product, Data Science, and Operations</li> <li>&nbsp;&nbsp;Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to convey complex ideas clearly across teams</li> <li>&nbsp;&nbsp;Holistic thinking and the ability to build scaled processes that bridge systemic gaps</li> <li>&nbsp;&nbsp;Track record of deriving actionable insights from complex problem spaces and influencing product direction</li> <li>&nbsp;&nbsp;Ownership mentality and the ability to lead without formal authority</li> <li>&nbsp; Proficient with AI tools to accelerate productivity and process automation</li> </ul> <p><strong>Preferred qualifications</strong></p> <ul> <li>Expertise with quantitative tools such as Python, R, etc</li> <li>Experience with payments, risk, or trust &amp; safety</li> <li>Experience working with machine learning teams</li> <li>Experience working in fast-paced and rapidly changing start-up environments</li> </ul>

title: Fraud Strategist
description: <h2>Who we are</h2> <h3>About Stripe</h3> <p>Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies, from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups, use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and pursue new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet. We have significant work ahead, which gives you the opportunity to do important work that expands access to the global economy.</p> <h3>About the APAC Risk team</h3> <p>The APAC Risk team helps Stripe launch and grow products responsibly across a diverse and rapidly evolving region. We work closely with global and regional partners across Product, Engineering, Data Science, Operations, Partnerships, and Risk to identify emerging risks, define practical controls, and make risk decisions easier to execute at scale.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>The team supports Stripe’s growth in APAC by combining deep regional context with strong analytical judgment. We assess how fraud patterns, payment methods, user behavior, market structures, and regulatory expectations vary across countries. We use those insights to build strategies that protect Stripe and the broader payments ecosystem while preserving a strong experience for legitimate users.</p> <h2>What you’ll do</h2> <p>As a Fraud Strategist on the APAC Risk team, you will be responsible for identifying and reducing transaction and merchant fraud across Stripe’s products and markets in the region. You will monitor the health of Stripe’s APAC portfolio, investigate emerging threats, and build scalable strategies that reduce losses without creating unnecessary friction for legitimate businesses.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>You will work on complex and fast moving problems where the available information is often incomplete and fraud patterns evolve quickly. Your work may range from investigating an anomalous fraud trend to designing a regional control, defining a model feature, improving a manual review workflow, or shaping the risk approach for a new product, payment method, or country launch.</p> <h3>Responsibilities</h3> <ul> <li>Monitor transaction and merchant fraud trends across APAC and investigate anomalous behavior at the merchant, account, and transaction level.</li> <li>Define, build, and maintain regional fraud health metrics. Set targets, identify material changes, and communicate the drivers of performance.</li> <li>Develop short and long term fraud strategies for APAC markets, products, and payment methods. Translate investigations into clear controls, product requirements, model improvements, and operational actions.</li> <li>Partner with Product, Engineering, Data Science, Operations, Partnerships, and other Risk teams to scope, prioritize, and deliver fraud mitigation work.</li> <li>Assess fraud risks for new country, product, and local payment method launches. Define mitigations before launch and monitor outcomes after launch.</li> <li>Balance fraud loss, user experience, operational cost, conversion, and growth when recommending or implementing controls.</li> <li>Improve and automate fraud risk workflows through data, internal tools, and agent based solutions where these can increase consistency, speed, or coverage.</li> <li>Work with users and external partners when needed to explain fraud risks, improve controls, and support a healthy payments ecosystem.</li> <li>Produce clear regional reporting for senior stakeholders, risk governance forums, and other internal audiences.</li> </ul> <h2>Who you are</h2> <p>We are looking for someone who is naturally curious, analytically strong, and comfortable making decisions in ambiguous situations. You investigate unusual patterns until you understand the underlying mechanism. You can turn data and domain context into a clear risk decision, then work across teams to make that decision operational.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>You understand that effective fraud strategy is not simply about reducing losses. It requires thoughtful tradeoffs between protection, growth, user experience, and operational complexity. You communicate those tradeoffs clearly and remain open to new evidence and feedback.</p> <h3>Minimum requirements</h3> <ul> <li>4 - 8 years of relevant experience in fraud strategy, payments risk, financial services, fintech, trust and safety, data, or a related field.</li> <li>Experience investigating fraud or other risk patterns using account and transaction data.</li> <li>Strong analytical judgment and the ability to frame business decisions and tradeoffs through quantitative analysis.</li> <li>Intermediate SQL skills and experience applying SQL in a business environment.</li> <li>Experience defining metrics, assessing performance, and translating analysis into practical recommendations.</li> <li>Experience partnering with technical and operational teams such as Product, Engineering, Data Science, Operations, or Partnerships.</li> <li>Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex risk issues to technical and nontechnical audiences.</li> <li>Demonstrated project management skills and the ability to drive execution across teams with different priorities.</li> <li>Sound decision making in ambiguous or time sensitive situations, with a willingness to learn and iterate as new evidence emerges.</li> <li>Empathy for legitimate users and an ability to balance scaled risk controls with user experience.</li> </ul> <h3>Preferred qualifications</h3> <ul> <li>Experience with transaction fraud, merchant fraud, account takeover, or abuse in an online payments environment.</li> <li>Experience working across APAC markets or with regional payment methods and local market structures.</li> <li>Advanced SQL skills or experience with quantitative tools such as Python, R, or Stata.</li> <li>Experience partnering with machine learning or Data Science teams on model features, rules, detection, or measurement.</li> <li>Experience assessing fraud risk for new products, payment methods, or country launches.</li> <li>Experience designing risk controls, monitoring frameworks, operational workflows, or policy.</li> <li>Experience using automation, AI tools, or agent based workflows to improve risk processes.</li> <li>Experience in a fast moving environment where threats, products, and priorities change quickly.</li> </ul>

You’ll independently drive frontend projects from problem definition through rollout, working closely with designers, product engineers, and other Sail engineers. Today, many of these workflows are fragmented, manual, or built around processes and tools that predate recent advances in AI.</p> <p>We are a small, AI-native team reimagining how Stripe builds, ships, and ramps products. We experiment with new approaches across AI agents, automation, and process—and scale the ones that work. Our initial areas of focus include reinventing launch readiness from gates into guidelines, giving product teams richer and more timely context, and shortening the feedback loops between builders, users, Sales, and Support.</p> <p>Our users are Stripe’s product managers, engineers, designers, researchers – and we help to simplify the interactions with the cross-functional teams that help bring products to market. We work closely with teams including all of our business unit PMs, Product Operations, and Kai, Stripe’s internal AI platform.</p> <h2>What you'll do</h2> <p>We’re looking for product-minded engineers who want to rethink how products get built—not simply digitize existing processes. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. Millions of companies - from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.</p> <h3><strong>About the team</strong></h3> <p>Specialist Solutions Architects (SSAs) are domain experts aligned to Stripe’s solutions and the customer buying centers they serve. We combine deep product and industry expertise with an understanding of our customers’ most complex business and technical challenges.</p> <p>The SSA team partners with specialist sellers and the broader pre-sales organization to shape strategic opportunities, develop pipeline, improve revenue attainment, and turn Stripe’s product capabilities into measurable customer outcomes. We also bring field insights to Product and Engineering, helping influence Stripe’s roadmap and go-to-market strategy.</p> <h2><strong>What you'll do</strong></h2> <p>As Head of Specialist Solutions Architecture for Revenue in the Americas, you will lead the regional strategy, execution, and growth of the SSA organization supporting Stripe’s Revenue Suite. You will define how Stripe engages customers around billing, monetization, and revenue management—from initial business and technical discovery through solution design, adoption, value realization, and expansion.</p> <p>You will build and develop a high-performing team of specialist architects and create the operating model, playbooks, and cross-functional partnerships needed to scale the organization. Working closely with Sales, Marketing, Alliances, Professional Services, Support, Product, and Engineering, you will help customers modernize their revenue infrastructure while accelerating adoption and growth for Stripe’s Revenue Suite across the United States, Canada, and Latin America.</p> <p>This is an opportunity to shape a growing regional function at an important point in Stripe’s expansion beyond payments. You will connect deep technical expertise to customer value and commercial outcomes while ensuring that the needs of AMER customers influence Stripe’s global product and go-to-market direction.</p> <h3><strong>Responsibilities</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Own and execute the AMER technical sales strategy for Stripe’s Revenue Suite, aligning specialist coverage, priorities, and investments with regional growth opportunities</li> <li>Recruit, lead, and develop a high-performing team of specialist solutions architects, establishing clear expectations for technical excellence, customer impact, and execution quality.</li> <li>Advance Stripe’s external thought leadership through executive briefings, industry events, white papers, and reference architectures focused on billing, monetization, and revenue management</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Who you are</strong></h2> <p>We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.</p> <h3><strong>Minimum requirements</strong></h3> <ul> <li>10+ years of experience in technical sales, solutions architecture, solution consulting, or another customer-facing technical role in enterprise technology</li> <li>5+ years of experience building and scaling pre-sales or solutions architecture teams, including hiring, managing, coaching, and developing senior individual contributors</li> <li>Demonstrated success partnering with sales leaders on complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise opportunities and connecting technical strategy to commercial outcomes</li> <li>Deep understanding of enterprise monetization models, including subscription, consumption-based, marketplace, platform, and hybrid models, and how they shape billing and revenue-management requirements</li> <li>Experience designing or advising on complex enterprise architectures and integrations involving financial or revenue-management systems</li> <li>Experience operating across the United States, Canada, and Latin America, with an ability to adapt leadership and go-to-market approaches across different markets and cultures</li> <li>Strong executive communication, relationship-building, and cross-functional leadership skills</li> <li>Ability to communicate complex business and technical concepts clearly to audiences ranging from developers and architects to finance leaders and C-level executives</li> <li>Willingness to travel up to 30% of the time</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Preferred qualifications</strong></h3> <ul> systems</li> <li>Experience building a regional technical go-to-market function during a period of rapid product or organizational growth</li> <li>A track record of translating field insights into title: High School Internship, Software Engineering (Summer 2027)
description: <h2><strong>This role is intended for current high school students graduating in 2027 or later.</strong></h2> <h2>&nbsp;</h2> <h2><strong>Who we are&nbsp;</strong></h2> <h3><strong>About Stripe</strong></h3> <p>Stripe is a technology company focused on improving the conditions for economic growth and prosperity. We build programmable financial infrastructure, rethinking from first principles how financial services should work, to make it easier and cheaper for any business to start and scale. More than 10 million <a href="https://stripe.com/customers">businesses</a> build on Stripe, spanning the economic frontier, from solo founders to established enterprises, united by a practical focus on growth. The most ambitious companies in the world use Stripe as core infrastructure to grow faster. They process trillions of dollars a year on Stripe, equivalent to around 1.6% of global GDP. While economic growth makes everyone better off, open markets also enable greater variety. When any business can easily serve a global customer base, the quality and diversity of products in the world increase, and craft and creativity are unleashed into the smallest niches.</p> <p>Our own growth is wholly contingent on the success of the businesses building on Stripe. We therefore invest back into our technology at an unusual rate. We make&nbsp;<a href="https://stripe.com/roadmap">upgrades to our products</a> every single day to deliver compounding gains to our customers. We maintain some of the most <a href="https://status.stripe.com/">reliable APIs</a> on the internet. We build entirely new <a href="https://tempo.xyz/">pieces</a> of <a href="https://mpp.dev/">financial infrastructure</a> to enable new ideas. And our significant advances in <a href="https://stripe.com/radar">risk and fraud</a> infrastructure over many years are making the internet economy safer and more accessible.</p> <p>Though people at Stripe do not tend to take themselves seriously, Stripe is a fairly serious place: our customers are depending on us for their livelihoods. We admire ambition, intensity, curiosity, humility, and rigor. The most effective people become knowledgeable about many domains besides their own. Any company is an applied exercise in understanding some aspect of society or the market. In working with so many, especially the new and innovative ones, we think that Stripe is one of the very best places to learn about how the world works.</p> <h2>What you’ll do</h2> <p>This is a small, selective internship for exceptional high school students and recent graduates whose technical work already stands out well beyond what we typically see at this stage. We are not looking for potential or credentials alone. We are looking for students who can show, through what they have built, researched, or contributed, that they are ready to do substantive engineering work with a Stripe team.<br>You will spend 12 consecutive weeks between May and August working in person from Stripe’s San Francisco or Seattle office on a scoped engineering project. You will own a problem end to end with support from your manager and teammates, contribute to Stripe’s codebase, and learn how engineers build reliable systems used by millions of businesses. Recent Stripe intern projects include expanding Payments Foundation Model capabilities to improve generalized anomaly detection, building more approachable fraud controls, creating safer payouts, and developing user-facing solutions that prevent costly pricing mistakes and make merchant checkout setup easier.</p> <p>You will work alongside Stripe’s collegiate interns and full-time employees. That means participating in the same team environment, learning how engineers at different stages approach technical decisions, and building relationships across the broader Stripe community.</p> <p>This is not a trainee or classroom-based program. You will receive support from your manager and teammates, but you will be expected to contribute to your team’s work, learn quickly, communicate clearly, ask strong questions, and produce work that holds up under technical review.</p> <p>As with Stripe’s collegiate internships, strong performance may lead to consideration for future opportunities at Stripe, including full-time employment for interns who meet the relevant eligibility and hiring requirements. Future opportunities are not guaranteed and will depend on individual performance and Stripe’s hiring needs.</p> <h3>Responsibilities</h3> <ul> <li style="font-weight: 400;">Participate fully in the team you join, including team discussions, decisions, and the technical design process.</li> <li style="font-weight: 400;">Write, test, and document software intended for production use by Stripe teams and users.</li> <li style="font-weight: 400;">Give and receive technical feedback through code reviews and design discussions.</li> <li style="font-weight: 400;">Collaborate with engineers and cross-functional partners to seek and incorporate feedback.</li> <li style="font-weight: 400;">Learn unfamiliar systems through independent research and close work with your manager, mentor, teammates, and subject matter experts.</li> <li style="font-weight: 400;">Communicate the status of your work clearly, including progress, risks, open questions, and where you need help.</li> <li style="font-weight: 400;">Use current AI development tools thoughtfully while applying rigorous judgment to review, refine, test, and validate outputs.</li> </ul> <h2>What We Look For</h2> <p>We don't have a test score threshold. We look for people who have already started acting like the engineers and operators we most admire.</p> <ul> <li><strong>Ambitious builder: Y</strong>ou are energized by building solutions without a clear precedent and working through difficult technical problems. You can point to technical work that shows unusual initiative, depth, or originality for someone at your stage.</li> <li><strong>Rigorous thinker:&nbsp;</strong>You care about whether your work is correct, not just whether it runs. You test your assumptions, examine edge cases, and can explain the choices you made.</li> <li><strong>Adaptable problem solver:&nbsp;</strong>You learn quickly, respond well to feedback, and keep making progress when the path is unclear.</li> <li><strong>Collaborative teammate:&nbsp;</strong>You communicate clearly, treat others with kindness, and know when to work independently and when to ask for help.<strong><br></strong></li> </ul> <h3>Minimum requirements</h3> <ul> <li style="font-weight: 400;">Currently enrolled in high school, or graduating from high school before the internship begins.</li> <li style="font-weight: 400;">Available to work full-time and in person from Stripe’s San Francisco or Seattle office for 12 consecutive weeks during a mutually agreed period between May and August 2027. We cannot accommodate remote participation, a shorter internship, or breaks within the 12-week period.</li> <li style="font-weight: 400;">Experience programming through independent projects, research, coursework, competitions, open source contributions, a startup, or another setting. We work mostly in Ruby, Java, JavaScript, Go, and Scala. We believe new programming languages can be learned when the fundamentals are strong.</li> <li style="font-weight: 400;">Evidence of exceptional technical achievement for your stage. This could include a product or system you built, a substantial open source contribution, original research, meaningful work at a startup, advanced competition performance, or another body of work that demonstrates comparable depth and ownership.</li> <li style="font-weight: 400;">Ability to explain your individual contribution to the work you submit, including the problem, technical decisions, tradeoffs, testing, feedback, and what you would improve.</li> <li style="font-weight: 400;">Experience working with others on a technical project and incorporating feedback from peers, mentors, teachers, users, or collaborators.</li> <li style="font-weight: 400;">Ability to learn unfamiliar systems through independent research and work with a mentor or subject matter expert.</li> <li style="font-weight: 400;">Clear written and verbal communication.</li> <li style="font-weight: 400;">Ability to meet the employment eligibility, minimum age, and documentation requirements for the role’s location by the internship start date. Final contract language is subject to Legal review.</li> </ul> <h3>Preferred qualifications</h3> <ul> <li style="font-weight: 400;">One or more areas of deeper technical knowledge, such as frontend, backend, infrastructure, data, machine learning, security, or developer tools, balanced with strong general programming fundamentals.</li> <li style="font-weight: 400;">Experience writing high-quality pull requests, tests, technical documentation, or design notes.</li> <li style="font-weight: 400;">Familiarity navigating an unfamiliar codebase or contributing to a multi-person project.</li> <li style="font-weight: 400;">A record of sustained technical work over time, not only one-time awards or credentials.</li> <li style="font-weight: 400;">Curiosity about how businesses operate and how software can improve the conditions for economic growth.</li> </ul> <h2>What to submit</h2> <ul> <li style="font-weight: 400;">A resume or short summary of your technical experience.</li> <li style="font-weight: 400;">In that summary please include one or two examples of your strongest work, such as a repository, live product, technical paper, research abstract, competition submission, or project write-up. Private work may be described without sharing confidential material.</li> <li style="font-weight: 400;">For each example, a short explanation of the problem, what you personally contributed, the hardest technical decision, how you tested the work, and what you learned.</li> <li style="font-weight: 400;">Optional: High school transcript, standardized test scores.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><em>Please note that this is an hourly position with a pay rate of $60 per hour.</em></p>

The position will be based in the US and report to the International Indirect Tax Advisory Lead.</p> <h3><strong>Responsibilities</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Be an indirect tax subject matter expert (global VAT/GST) and resource to our business and finance teams in Stripe, managing aspects of our indirect tax planning and operations</li> <li>Support Stripe's expansion internationally</li> <li>Participate in policy matters affecting indirect taxes internationally</li> <li>Collaborate with the international indirect tax compliance leads and the international accounting teams on VAT/GST compliance, assisting with the ongoing enhancement of the indirect tax compliance processes</li> <li>Support management of indirect tax audits and other indirect tax matters involving tax authorities internationally</li> <li>Work with other tax team members and product and engineering teams to help define requirements and collaborate on the design of tax solutions for our users</li> <li>Promote indirect tax awareness and knowledge, including training and liaising with business and tax partners on changes to indirect tax legislation, systems, policies, and processes</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Who you are</strong></h2> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.</span></p> <h3><strong>Minimum requirements</strong></h3> <ul> <li>4–6 years of relevant indirect tax knowledge, laws, and regulations</li> <li>Bachelor's degree and professional qualification in tax or law</li> <li>Previous in-house experience within a multinational business and either legal or accounting firm experience</li> <li>Experience with indirect taxes as they relate to the distribution of digital services and physical products</li> <li>Accounting experience and proficiency with ERP systems and related data analytics skills</li> <li>Ability to clearly and concisely interface with all levels of management</li> <li>Excellent written and oral communication skills</li> <li>Project management experience, detail-oriented individual who takes ownership of projects</li> <li>Ability to extract, analyze, and review data and make appropriate recommendations</li> <li>Ability to work in a fast-paced, informal, and often ambiguous environment</li> <li>Willingness to learn and ability to quickly acquire knowledge</li> <li>Ability to work autonomously or within a team</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Preferred qualifications</strong></h3> <ul> <li>An advanced degree</li> <li>Experience working in technology, payments, or financial services</li> <li>Experience working in a high-growth, rapidly scaling environment</li> <li>A willingness to work with a diverse crew of tax nerds who care deeply about Stripe's tax issues and each other</li> </ul>

title: Infrastructure Engineer, Privy
description: <h2 id="who-we-are">Who we are</h2> <h3 id="about-privy">About Privy</h3> <p>Our mission is to make privacy and user ownership the default online. To do so, we build simple, flexible APIs and tools for developers that make it easy to build new products on crypto rails.</p> <p>Privy owns the abstractions and infrastructure layer above wallets, integrating across chains, third-party providers, and Stripe products like Treasury and Link. We get to solve hard technical problems while leveraging Stripe's distribution to reach customers like Ramp, Klarna, Deel, Kraken, Hyperliquid, and Fomo — powering experiences for both mainstream users and crypto natives.</p> <p>Learn more about Privy: <a href="https://privy.io/blog/announcing-our-acquisition-by-stripe">Privy and Stripe: Bringing crypto to everyone</a></p> <h3>About the team</h3> <p>Engineering at Privy is distinguished by:</p> <ul> <li>High urgency: Shipping very small iterations, very fast, to learn very quickly.&nbsp;</li> <li>Product taste: Our customers <em>are</em> developers, and to build effective products for them requires technical knowledge - you will often be "the PM".</li> <li>Security mindset: A great portion of our product is trust. While we have a dedicated security team, every engineer brings security to their designs from the start.</li> </ul> <p>In practice, we use&nbsp;<a href="https://mcfunley.com/choose-boring-technology">boring technology</a> like Node, React, and AWS so we can focus our engineering energy entirely on pushing the boundaries of Privy's core product, e.g. through hardware enclaves, multi-region low latency APIs, and blockchain abstractions that are accessible to mainstream developers.</p> <h2>What you’ll do</h2> <ul> <li>Manage and architect multi-tenant infrastructure that serves billions of requests every month</li> <li>Design our build and deploy systems across the stack, from SDKs to apps to high-traffic APIs to complex secure enclaves, and more – all for a team that ships daily</li> <li>Drive observability across our product and help keep our systems up and performant in our role in the most critical parts of our customers' stacks</li> <li>Advocate for making the right technical investments at the right time in a company with ever-evolving technical needs</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Who you are</strong></h2> <h3>Minimum requirements</h3> <ul> <li>8+ years of experience in building highly available production systems</li> <li>Knowledge of Typescript or Python, Terraform or similar, Cloudflare, and AWS infrastructure</li> <li>An understanding of modern web and API development best practices</li> <li>Experience building delightfully simple developer experiences</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Preferred qualifications</strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">&nbsp;</span></h3> <ul> <li>An ability to quickly learn new skills and take on new challenges</li> <li>Experience at rapidly growing startups and the flexibility it requires</li> <li>Excitement about authentication, security, or in web3</li> <li>An understanding of EC2 Nitro Enclaves and ASGs/Kubernetes</li> </ul>

title: Instructional Designer, Global Sales Enablement
description: <h2><strong>Who we are</strong></h2> <h3><strong>About Stripe</strong></h3> <p>Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Through self-serve content, practice, and feedback, we help sellers build and apply skills in their day-to-day work.<br><br></p> <h2><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h2> <p>You’ll design, build, and maintain learning content that gives Stripe’s sales teams a consistent foundation for their work. title: Integrated Campaigns Manager
description: <h2><strong>Who we are</strong></h2> <h3><strong>About Stripe</strong></h3> <p>Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. We build, deliver, monitor, and evolve campaign delivery across a broad suite of content, tactics, and channels. Using a broad suite of metrics, we continuously measure our work and refine our strategies to improve outreach, enhance the customer journey, and support revenue growth for the organization.</p> <h2><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h2> <p>In this role, you'll quarterback the integrated campaign strategies, plans, and playbooks focused on Stripe’s stablecoin and crypto products (including Bridge). You'll champion the needs of the core audiences for this product area, holding deep market and audience insight and direct business accountability. You'll lead a large, global, cross-functional workstream to build campaign strategies and content, then work with regional teams to craft local strategies and to deliver activations through integrated channels. Ultimately, you'll be accountable for acquisition, engagement, and pipeline growth.</p> <h3><strong>The ideal candidate</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Excels in leading and driving large, complex, global campaigns or programs</li> <li>Has strong analytics skills, with the ability to interpret, analyze, and communicate campaign performance across marketing and sales KPIs</li> <li>Works with and influences across cross-functional stakeholder groups, including senior sales, marketing, and product leaders</li> <li>Has a proven track record developing global campaigns and delivering campaign playbooks for international localisation and execution</li> <li>Is a passionate advocate for their users/audiences/customers</li> <li>“Sees around corners”; anticipates and unblocks challenges, stays ahead of market/audience trends, and anticipates regional/country needs and nuance</li> <li>Understands modern storytelling and content trends, and can translate those into thoughtful, resonant campaign strategies</li> <li>Is agile, iterative, AI-fluent, and comfortable with ambiguity and high growth environments</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Responsibilities</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Own the overall campaign strategy and plan for Stripe’s stablecoin and crypto products (including Bridge), and drive the global, cross-functional workstream for activation and impact</li> <li>Partner with comms, product marketing, channel teams, regional and field marketing, partner marketing, sales teams, and more to define and implement campaigns.</li> <li>Work with regional marketing to ensure local relevance and advise on campaign delivery</li> <li>Use your multi-channel expertise to deliver campaigns via digital, web, email, online events, direct mail, social, events, sales plays, and more, all in partnership with functional and regional teams</li> <li>Partner with product marketing and content/editorial teams to develop compelling, relevant campaign materials and content sets, including whitepapers, guides, blogs, checklists, interactive content, promotions/offers, etc.</li> <li>Use and/or recommend leading tools to improve or accelerate the work of the campaigns function</li> <li>Act as an expert for your owned audience/solution to champion market trends, competitive context, and customer insights, ultimately shaping all industry campaign strategies.</li> <li>Track, analyze, and report on campaign performance metrics with a focus on lead generation, pipeline, and target account penetration. Share learnings regularly to improve overall campaign efficacy.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Who you are</strong></h2> <p>We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.</p> <h3><strong>Minimum requirements</strong></h3> <ul> <li>8+ years of enterprise B2B marketing experience that includes some mix of integrated campaigns, content marketing, regional/field marketing, and/or account-based marketing, with demonstrated increase in scope</li> <li>Exceptional knowledge of fintech industry landscape, trends, and technology</li> <li>Proven expertise in partnering with regional marketing and sales teams to build, grow, and develop pipeline</li> <li>Analytical acumen, with the ability to build, interpret, and adjust measurement tools and data</li> <li>Exceptional presentation, writing, and communication skills, especially to executive stakeholders</li> <li>Appetite and ability to work through ambiguity, evaluate and recommend solutions, and drive clarity across complex, global stakeholder groups</li> <li>Ability to build campaigns and programs from the ground, orchestrating many moving parts across disparate functions</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Preferred qualifications</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Experience at a highly dynamic, fast-growing growth tech company</li> <li>Experience in the payments, financial technology, or adjacent industries or marketing fintech and/or crypto solutions&nbsp;</li> <li>Integrated campaigns experience focused on select audiences: crypto, enterprise, financial services, fintech companies</li> <li>Product campaigns experience focused on payments, crypto, financial services, and/or embedded finance</li> </ul>

You will work on the highest visibility projects to provide technical expertise to our customers to help accelerate their knowledge, solution design and integrations with Stripe. This role is responsible for leading strategic conversations and developing plans that will transform the payments and financial infrastructure for leading enterprises. We're building an AI-first team. Using AI to work efficiently, and to deliver faster and better outcomes for our users, will be a key part of this role.</p> <h2><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h2> <h3><strong>Responsibilities</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Plan and execute integration engineering end-to-end, from high-level architecture down to code implementation. This includes conducting discovery sessions with users to understand their goals, parsing out specific use cases, and guiding users to implement high complexity integrations.&nbsp;</li> <li>Think on your feet and communicate technical concepts, explaining how Stripe works from both a product feature and API architecture perspective. Manage user expectations on timelines and product changes.</li> <li>Be the primary, ongoing technical point of contact for our largest users' and partners' technical teams. You will be responsible for resolving user integration issues and owning escalations for operational issues and priority requests.</li> <li>Apply AI across the engagement lifecycle to reduce manual effort, accelerate delivery, and improve the quality of what we hand to users.</li> <li>Collaborate with Sales, Solution Architecture and Implementation teams to drive client engagement, customer wins, and revenue on behalf of the Professional Services team</li> <li>Collaborate closely with Product and Engineering to proactively identify potential enhancements and new features based on feedback you’ll gather from the field.</li> <li>Provide deep technical support and debugging, inspecting and understanding the Stripe codebase and thoroughly testing functionality to best advise users, while also building and demonstrating proof-of-concept integrations, creating user-specific test plans, and answering ad-hoc technical questions.</li> <li>In some cases, lead "Hands On Keyboard" implementations for user engagements, providing material feedback on coding practices, CI/CD, and software architecture.</li> <li>Review and optimize existing user integrations and provide recommendations to improve performance, reliability, and efficiency.</li> <li>Build tools and analytics; create dashboards, run queries, and generate custom data reports to support user business reviews and operational needs.</li> <li>Develop and share knowledge, building reusable processes to enable the larger Professional Services team.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Who you are</strong></h2> <p>We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.</p> <h3><strong>Minimum requirements</strong></h3> <ul> <li>4 years + experience in a Software Engineering / Integration Engineering role.</li> <li>Ability to write code (in programming languages like Go, Java, C/C++ etc.) and quickly debug user code snippets.</li> <li>Comfortable with various code-level debugging (Stripe code and user code) and using code as a tool for problem-solving.</li> <li>Strong generalist technical experience, including proficiency in SQL and an understanding of data structures and algorithms.</li> <li>Understanding of the payments domain and API security topics.</li> <li>Be comfortable talking about technical concepts, and explaining how Stripe works, both from a product features and API architecture perspective.</li> <li>A user first approach &amp; empathy with our users, capable of mapping business requirements into reliable technical solutions.</li> <li>Confident and comfortable with customers, with the ability to lead strategic technical conversations.</li> <li>Hands-on experience using AI tools (e.g. coding assistants, LLM-based agents) to improve how you work, and a strong appetite to continue to build that experience quickly.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Preferred qualifications</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Enjoy the puzzle of solving open-ended problems, both individually and as a member of our team.<br>Willingness to learn and teach others, including mentoring newer team members.</li> <li>Collaborative, communicative, consultative; able to apply specific methodologies to ensure repeatability of engagements.</li> <li>Intellectually curious, with great problem solving skills.</li> <li>Technical writing skills to document complex integration guidance and processes.</li> </ul>
