title: Integration Reliability Engineer Intern, Technical Operations
description: <h2><strong>Who we are</strong></h2> <h3><strong>About Stripe</strong></h3> <p>Stripe is a technology company focused on improving the conditions for economic growth and prosperity. We build programmable financial infrastructure, rethinking from first principles how financial services should work, to make it easier and cheaper for any business to start and scale. More than 10 million <a href="https://stripe.com/customers">businesses</a> build on Stripe, spanning the economic frontier—from solo founders to established enterprises—united by a practical focus on growth. The most ambitious companies in the world use Stripe as core infrastructure to grow faster. They process trillions of dollars a year on Stripe, equivalent to around 1.6% of global GDP. While economic growth makes everyone better off, open markets also enable greater variety. When any business can easily serve a global customer base, the quality and diversity of products in the world increase, and craft and creativity are unleashed into the smallest niches. Our own growth is wholly contingent on the success of the businesses building on Stripe. We therefore invest back into our technology at an unusual rate. We make <a href="https://stripe.com/roadmap">upgrades to our products</a> every single day to deliver compounding gains to our customers. We maintain some of the most <a href="https://status.stripe.com/">reliable APIs</a> on the internet. We build entirely new <a href="https://tempo.xyz/">pieces</a> of <a href="https://mpp.dev/">financial</a> <a href="https://joinopenstandard.com/">infrastructure</a> to enable new ideas. And our significant advances in <a href="https://stripe.com/radar">risk and fraud</a> infrastructure over many years are making the internet economy safer and more accessible.&nbsp;</p> <p>Though people at Stripe don’t tend to take themselves seriously, Stripe is a fairly serious place: our customers are depending on us for their livelihoods. We admire ambition, intensity, curiosity, humility, and rigor. The most effective people become knowledgeable about many domains besides their own. Any company is an applied exercise in understanding some aspect of society or the market. In working with so many (especially the new and innovative ones), we think that Stripe is one of the very best places to learn about how the world works.</p> <h3><strong>About the team</strong></h3> <p>APAC Payments TechOps is a team based in Singapore. Our charter is to improve the health and resilience of our payment acquiring volume, making it easier for Stripe to build and operate the integrations that support hundreds of billions of dollars in payments annually. Our team partners closely with payments and platform engineering teams to assess systems or processes that create high operational workloads, then develops durable solutions via code, tooling, data, and process improvements. We are responsible for the financial data quality of key systems at Stripe, ensuring that data is quarantined without impacting downstream systems while implementing the right changes upstream to prevent recurring issues.</p> <h2><strong>What you'll do</strong></h2> <p>Every internship at Stripe centers around a real, legitimate project that our team urgently needs, touching many parts of our operations and stack. We will support you in shipping it. Yes, you will actually ship it. Example projects include building automation to detect anomalies in financial data, improving reconciliation tooling, or streamlining certificate management workflows. As a Stripe intern, you'll be tackling important projects while working alongside exceptional people who insist on doing their best work. You'll learn from people with high standards who are great at inspiring others to do more and go further. We value technical and personal growth, and see our internship program as a vehicle to foster both.</p> <h3><strong>Responsibilities</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Investigate problems in systems by examining code, writing SQL queries, reading logs, and inspecting data pipelines to understand system behavior</li> <li>Write code that will be used in production and has meaningful impact to Stripe's payment operations</li> <li>Give and receive technical feedback through code reviews or design discussions</li> <li>Collaborate with other engineers and cross-functional stakeholders to proactively seek and incorporate feedback</li> <li>Learn quickly by asking great questions, by working with your intern manager and teammates effectively, and by communicating the status of your work clearly</li> </ul> <p>In exchange, you'll have the support and opportunity to pursue big ideas and change how things work, with a high degree of autonomy. You’ll be mentored by some of the most creative and technically rigorous people in the industry, working on teams reshaping how money moves and how businesses grow.</p> <h2><strong>Who you are</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Ambitious builder:</strong> You’re energized by building solutions without clear precedent and solving problems with far-reaching consequences. Successful Stripes are deeply curious, and prefer the joy of discovery to the comfort of certainty.</li> <li><strong>Rigorous thinker:</strong> You appreciate that things worth doing are rarely simple. You enjoy working on problems that have never been tackled before.&nbsp;</li> <li><strong>Adaptable problem solver:</strong> You adapt quickly and treat obstacles as opportunities. At Stripe we embrace kindness while encouraging Stripes to take measured risks and act boldly, even in the absence of consensus.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Minimum requirements</strong></h3> <ul> <li>A strong fundamental understanding of computer science through pursuit of a Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD degree in computer science, information systems, data science, or a related discipline</li> <li>Some experience and familiarity with programming, either through side projects or classwork. We work mostly in Ruby, Go, and Python. We believe new programming languages can be learned if the fundamentals and general knowledge are present</li> <li>Experience from previous internships or other multi-person projects, including open source contributions, that demonstrate evaluating and receiving feedback from mentors, peers, and stakeholders</li> <li>Ability to learn unfamiliar systems and form an understanding of those systems, through independent research and working with a mentor and subject matter experts</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Preferred qualifications</strong></h3> <ul> <li>At least 2 years of university education, or equivalent work experience</li> <li>Familiarity with SQL and working with data, either through coursework or personal projects</li> <li>Comfort with developer tools (e.g. git)</li> <li>A strong interest in understanding the root cause of issues and building durable solutions</li> <li>One or more areas of specialized knowledge balanced with general skills, such as data engineering, systems debugging, or financial data analysis</li> <li>Ability to write clearly to explain your work to stakeholders, team members, and other Stripes</li> </ul>

description: <h2>Who we are</h2> <h3>About Stripe</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.</span></p> <h3>About the team</h3> <p>Growth Platform builds the machine learning systems that help businesses discover and use the Stripe products that meet their needs. Our recommendations reach users across the Dashboard, email, onboarding, documentation, and AI agent interfaces. We combine an understanding of each business with models that decide which recommendation is useful, when to show it, and how to learn from the outcome.</p> <p>Our work spans recommendation and ranking models, contextual bandits, agent-based recommendations, and the data and evaluation systems behind them. We build shared capabilities that product, marketing, and sales teams can use across Stripe. Success means helping businesses take useful actions and adopt products that help them grow, while keeping recommendations relevant and avoiding unnecessary messages.</p> <h2>What you’ll do</h2> <p>You will build and operate production ML systems that improve how Stripe recommends products, content, and next steps to businesses. You will own work from problem definition and feature development through training, evaluation, deployment, monitoring, and iteration. Working with data scientists, engineers, and product partners, you will turn model improvements into measurable user and business outcomes.</p> <h3>Responsibilities</h3> <ul> <li>Design, train, evaluate, deploy, and maintain models for recommendation, ranking, and personalized action selection across Growth Platform surfaces.</li> <li>Improve contextual bandit and policy-learning approaches, including exploration, reward design, and how recommendations adapt to user context and feedback.</li> <li>Build agent-based recommendation capabilities that use business context to identify relevant products and integration options, with evaluations that test recommendation quality and usefulness.</li> <li>Develop reliable data and feature pipelines for training and inference. Improve data freshness, feature quality, and consistency between training and production.</li> <li>Build reusable tooling for model evaluation, retraining, and safe rollout so the team can test and ship improvements faster.</li> <li>Own the quality and operation of the team's ML components: write tested production code, monitor models and pipelines, investigate failures, and improve reliability, latency, and cost.</li> <li>Design and analyze online experiments with data science partners. Connect offline evaluation to product adoption and incremental impact, with guardrails for dismissals, unsubscribes, and user experience.</li> <li>Partner with product engineering to integrate models into recommendation delivery systems, and with ML infrastructure teams to use and improve Stripe's shared training, feature, and serving capabilities.</li> <li>Work with product, marketing, and sales partners to identify problems that shared ML capabilities can solve, and make practical choices about where modeling adds value.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Who you are</strong></h2> <p>You are a machine learning engineer with a builder mindset. You care about the business problem, the quality of the model, and what happens after it ships. You can move between modeling and software engineering, make practical tradeoffs, and take ownership of an ambiguous problem through production and measurement.</p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.</span></p> <h3>Minimum requirements</h3> <ul> <li>3+ years of industry experience in machine learning engineering, software engineering, or applied data science, with hands-on experience building and shipping ML models in production.</li> <li>Strong programming skills in Python and experience writing maintainable, tested production code.</li> <li>Practical experience designing, training, and evaluating ML models using frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, XGBoost, or scikit-learn.</li> <li>Experience building data or feature pipelines, proficiency in SQL, and familiarity with distributed data processing tools such as Spark or PySpark.</li> <li>A strong understanding of statistics, model evaluation, and experimentation, including the ability to recognize data leakage and distinguish offline model improvements from business impact.</li> <li>Experience deploying, monitoring, and debugging production ML systems, and evaluating tradeoffs among model quality, reliability, latency, and cost.</li> <li>Ability to turn an open-ended business problem into a technical approach and collaborate effectively with engineering, data science, product, and business partners.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Preferred qualifications</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Experience with recommendation systems, ranking, personalization, or marketplace and advertising optimization.</li> <li>Experience with contextual bandits, policy learning, causal inference, or off-policy evaluation.</li> <li>Experience building and evaluating LLM applications, including structured extraction, embeddings, or recommendations grounded in user and business context.</li> <li>Experience building reusable ML capabilities used by multiple products or teams, including training automation, feature systems, or model monitoring.</li> <li>Experience with product growth, lifecycle messaging, or systems that balance short-term engagement with longer-term You move fast without breaking things, you're comfortable leading through ambiguity, and you're excited to work at the frontier of payments and AI, turning advances in machine learning into production systems that address new forms of fraud and abuse.</p> <p>We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.</p> <h3><strong>Minimum requirements</strong></h3> <ul> <li>5+ years of experience developing, evaluating, and deploying machine learning models in a production environment.</li> <li>A track record of leading ML projects from problem definition to production, with measurable impact.</li> <li>Deep foundations in machine learning, statistics, model evaluation, and experiment design.</li> <li>Strong programming and software-engineering skills, with experience writing tested, maintainable code for production ML applications.</li> <li>Experience designing and operating production ML systems, including several of: large-scale data and feature pipelines, distributed model training, low-latency inference, model deployment, or production monitoring.</li> <li>Experience mentoring engineers or technically leading projects with multiple contributors.</li> <li>Ability to investigate ambiguous problems, reason from data, and choose pragmatic technical approaches.</li> <li>Ability to communicate technical ideas and results clearly and collaborate effectively across disciplines.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Preferred qualifications</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Experience applying ML to fraud detection, integrity, trust and safety, identity, cybersecurity, or another adversarial domain.</li> <li>Experience developing or productionizing modern deep learning, graph-learning, or LLM-based approaches.</li> <li>Experience building and optimizing real-time, low-latency ML systems at scale.</li> <li>Experience owning the operational health of critical ML systems, including on-call, incident response, and migrations.</li> <li>Experience rapidly building 0→1 products or working directly with customers.</li> <li>Experience building AI-assisted tooling or agents that measurably increased a team's velocity.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p>

Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.</span></p> <h3><strong>About the team</strong></h3> <p>The Competitive Programs team, which is part of the Go-to-Market (GTM) Strategic Programs team, is a new team dedicated to establishing and scaling Stripe’s Competitive Programs capability. Stripe operates in a dynamic and evolving competitive landscape. This role will help Stripe understand market developments and translate competitive insights into actionable guidance for teams and users.</p> <p>In partnership with Market Intelligence, you will identify meaningful threats and opportunities early, mobilize cross-functional action, and turn market and deal signals into better Product, Marketing, and GTM decisions. You will own the competitive operating system: program design, cross-functional coordination, deal triage and routing, visibility, and accountability. Product, Sales, PMM, Pricing, and other functions retain ownership for decisions and delivery in their domains.&nbsp;</p> <p>This is a player-coach role: you will build the team, lead the most complex programs, and apply the same skills to other high-priority GTM programs as business needs evolve.</p> <h2><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h2> <p>You will lead and develop a team of program managers that helps Stripe compete more effectively in its highest-priority situations. You will turn an emerging capability into a durable operating model: set team goals and work plans, prioritize scarce capacity with Stripe leadership and Market Intelligence, and ensure centrally staffed competitor programs are measurable and connected to the functional teams that own decisions and delivery.&nbsp;</p> <p>This is a high-ambiguity management role. You will partner with senior leaders across Sales, Product, Product Operations, Marketing, Market Intelligence, Pricing, Finance &amp; Strategy, and GTM Operations to turn unclear competitive problems into focused programs with clear objectives, owners, decision forums, operating cadences, and measures of success.</p> <p>Initially, you will:</p> <ul> <li>Lead and develop the Competitive Programs team, setting objectives, allocating work, and maintaining a high bar for judgment, execution, and stakeholder management.&nbsp;</li> <li>Establish the P0/P1 portfolio and operating model with Market Intelligence and GTM Strategic Programs leadership.</li> <li>Personally lead the highest-complexity programs and build the playbooks, escalation paths, and operating mechanisms that enable faster, more coordinated responses without centralizing functional decisions.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Responsibilities</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Set the team’s SOKRs, portfolio priorities in partnership with Stripe leadership, work plans, and success measures; allocate program-management capacity across the highest-priority competitive needs.</li> <li>Develop, coach and retain a high-performing team of program managers who can operate independently in ambiguous, high-stakes environments.</li> <li>Directly lead—and coach program managers to lead—the design, launch, and lifecycle of centrally staffed P0 and P1 competitor programs, including recommendations to continue, adjust, graduate, or re-elevate programs as the market changes.</li> <li>Build and continuously improve the program-management layer of Stripe’s competitive operating system, including playbooks, program standards, decision logs, operating reviews, escalation mechanisms, and executive reporting.</li> <li>Partner with Market Intelligence to translate competitive, customer, and deal signals into prioritized actions; ensure Product, PMM, Sales, Pricing, Product S&amp;O, and other functional partners have clear accountable owners.</li> <li>Create decision-oriented updates for senior leadership on program health, competitive risks, outcomes, capacity needs, and recommendations.</li> <li>Lead select cultural initiatives, surface systemic friction, and ensure the appropriate functional teams own durable solutions.</li> <li>Apply the team’s program-design and execution capabilities to other strategic GTM priorities as business needs evolve.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Who you are</strong></h2> <p>We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.<br><br>You are a strategic, hands-on people leader who is energized by ambiguous, cross-functional business problems. You set direction without waiting for perfect information, move fluidly between executive strategy and program detail, and maintain the operational rigor needed to deliver durable results.</p> <p>You help senior leaders make trade-offs while ensuring programs have clear owners, milestones, decisions, and success measures. You build trust across functions, name risks directly, resolve ambiguity, and hold partners accountable to commitments. You are excited by the intersection of market dynamics, product and commercial strategy, GTM execution, and organizational change—and understand that Competitive Programs makes Stripe faster and more coordinated without replacing functional ownership.</p> <h3><strong>Minimum requirements</strong></h3> <p>9+ years of experience in program management, business operations, GTM strategy, management consulting, or a related discipline, including experience in a commercial organization such as Sales, Marketing, Product, or GTM Operations.</p> <p>2+ years of people-management experience, including setting objectives, allocating work, coaching experienced ICs, and managing performance.</p> <ul> <li>Demonstrated success leading complex, global, cross-functional programs from problem definition through implementation, adoption, and durable operational handoff.</li> <li>A player-coach mindset: high ownership, sound judgment, adaptability under pressure, and a collaborative, hands-on approach that sets a high bar for quality.</li> <li>Experience establishing goals, work plans, operating cadences, decision forums, and success measures for initiatives spanning regions, segments, product lines, and multiple stakeholders.</li> <li>Strong judgment in prioritizing competing demands and allocating limited team capacity to the highest-value work.</li> <li>Ability to navigate senior stakeholders with differing incentives and decision rights; drive alignment while making trade-offs and escalation paths explicit.</li> <li>Proven ability to structure qualitative and quantitative inputs into clear recommendations, assess program health and risk, and guide prioritization with data.</li> <li>Strong executive communication skills, including facilitation of senior working sessions and decision-oriented reporting.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Preferred qualifications</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Experience managing competitive programs, strategic-account programs, product-launch programs, commercial transformation, or other high-stakes GTM initiatives.</li> <li>Experience building a new operating model, program-management team, or repeatable playbook from the ground up.</li> <li>Experience partnering closely with Product, Product Operations, PMM, Sales, Pricing, Finance &amp; Strategy, Market Intelligence, and GTM Systems.</li> <li>Familiarity with competitive intelligence, win/loss analysis, sales enablement, pricing, commercial strategy, product-feedback mechanisms, or executive account programs.</li> <li>Experience at a B2B technology, enterprise software, fintech, payments, or platform company; comfort using SQL, BI tools, or similar methods to analyze pipeline, adoption, revenue, and operational data.</li> </ul>

consumption environment&nbsp;</li> <li>Experience leading sales or account management in a high-growth technology environment</li> <li>Ability to hire, train, and coach a high-performing user-facing team</li> <li>Ability to support the Customer Success Managers’ efforts through strategic advice on account strategies, and serving as executive sponsor with key relationships</li> <li>Ability to operate in a high-growth environment and work through ambiguity to solve complex customer and business problems</li> <li>Demonstrated passion for Stripe’s mission, and helping users succeed</li> </ul> <p><strong>Nice to haves:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Prior experience at a high-growth stage Internet/software company</li> </ul>

That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.</span></p> <h3><strong>About the team</strong></h3> <p>The Financial Crimes team plays a critical role in ensuring a healthy financial ecosystem and maintaining trust in Stripe's platform. We ensure that prohibited parties cannot utilize our services and identify bad actors engaging in money laundering, terrorist financing, or other financial crimes. As Stripe's user base and global footprint grow dramatically, this team is essential for mitigating risk and upholding regulatory compliance, directly contributing to Stripe's mission of increasing the GDP of the internet safely and responsibly.</p> <h2><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h2> <p>As the Manager, Global Sanctions, you will own and evolve an established sanctions function across geographies. You will be responsible for leading regional teams, driving the next phase of sanctions transformation, and partnering with Engineering and Product to modernize how sanctions operations work at Stripe.</p> <h3><strong>Responsibilities</strong></h3> <ul> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Lead and develop sanctions managers and analysts across regions, ensuring investigative quality, consistency, and throughput at scale</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;">Own the strategic direction of Stripe's global sanctions program, screening coverage, alert logic, escalation frameworks, and quality assurance</li> <li style="font-weight: 400;">Drive the sanctions transformation roadmap, identify where manual workflows and vendor tooling are limiting scale, and lead the shift toward automation and smarter detection</li> <li style="font-weight: 400;">Partner with Engineering and Product as a genuine co-designer, translate sanctions requirements into tooling inputs, challenge screening logic, and lead operational readiness for new capabilities</li> <li style="font-weight: 400;">Ensure every process and system change is built with audit trails, explainability, and examiner-readiness by design; lead the function through regulatory exams and supervisory inquiries</li> <li style="font-weight: 400;">Serve as the senior escalation point for complex casework</li> <li style="font-weight: 400;">Maintain deep awareness of evolving sanctions regulations globally (OFAC, EU, HMT, UN, and others) and translate changes into program requirements ahead of deadlines</li> <li style="font-weight: 400;">Report on sanctions program health, emerging typologies, and team performance to senior leadership</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Who you are</strong></h2> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.</span></p> <h3><strong>Minimum requirements</strong></h3> <ul> <li style="font-weight: 400;">At least 10 years of experience in sanctions compliance or financial crimes, with senior leadership experience managing cross-regional teams</li> <li style="font-weight: 400;">Deep expertise in major global sanctions regimes (OFAC, EU, HMT, UN) and sanctions screening methodologies</li> <li style="font-weight: 400;">Proven track record of improving sanctions program operations</li> <li style="font-weight: 400;">Experience evaluating or transitioning sanctions tooling, including vendor platforms and in-house or automated solutions</li> <li style="font-weight: 400;">Ability to partner credibly with Engineering and Product on tooling design, screening logic, and workflow automation</li> <li style="font-weight: 400;">Effective communicator across audiences, regulators, senior leadership, and engineering teams</li> <li style="font-weight: 400;">Experience with sanctions screening platforms and familiarity with AI-assisted screening tools</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Preferred qualifications</strong></h3> <ul> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">CAMS or equivalent certification</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;">Background handling regulatory examinations or voluntary self-disclosure processes</li> <li style="font-weight: 400;">Experience at a global payments platform or fintech at scale</li> </ul>

You’ll combine field insights, performance data, and business context to identify needs, guide investments, and help customer-facing teams improve how they serve Stripe’s users.</p> <h3><strong>Responsibilities</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Develop and execute an Enablement Business Partner strategy aligned with Stripe’s GTM priorities</li> <li>Lead and develop a team of Enablement Business Partners, strengthening their capabilities in consulting, stakeholder management, learning delivery, data interpretation, and change leadership</li> <li>Establish a consistent intake, prioritization, planning, and escalation model that balances strategic priorities with urgent business needs</li> <li>Partner with GTM leaders to identify performance and capability gaps, then translate them into targeted plans for specific regions, segments, and roles</li> <li>Coordinate the deployment and adaptation of global programs while embedding applied learning, manager coaching, and reinforcement into business rhythms</li> <li>Use conversation intelligence, competency data, learning signals, and business indicators to prioritize investments, evaluate behavior change, and make recommendations to senior leadership</li> <li>Build cross-functional partnerships and repeatable processes that clarify ownership, improve execution, and increase the impact of the Enablement Business Partner function</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Who you are</strong></h2> <p>We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. title: Manager - Legal Entity Controller
description: <p><strong>Who we are</strong></p> <p><strong>About Stripe</strong></p> <p>Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.</p> <p><strong>About the team</strong></p> <p>As our user base and global footprint grow dramatically, we have unique support problems resulting from both our type of scale and the type of businesses we partner with. The Bangalore Finance (SDC) strategy will provide operational leverage and expand our portfolio of operational capabilities to support the scaled needs for external users and internal Stripe teams.</p> <p><strong>What you'll do</strong></p> <p>Joining the Finance team will put you amongst some of the most talented finance and operations leaders in the world. We're looking for a proven leader to build and lead the fast-growing International Accounting team within our Bangalore Finance. You will guide intellectually ambitious nonfiction from acquisition through final proofs and production-ready handoff, upholding Press’s standards for rigor, clarity, accuracy, and editorial distinction.</p> <p>This role calls for exceptional editorial judgment and project management skills. You will work closely with Stripe Press’s editors, production manager, designers, authors, agents, and external specialists. You will also help build the systems and contributor network needed to support a growing list without compromising quality.</p> <h3><strong>Responsibilities</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Own the editorial path of every Stripe Press book from acquisition through final proofs and handoff to production.</li> <li>Establish and manage editorial schedules spanning manuscript delivery, editorial review, revision, copyediting, fact-checking, permissions, indexing, proofreading, and final approval.</li> <li>Evaluate manuscripts for structure, argument, clarity, pacing, voice, evidence, and accessibility, ensuring that complex ideas remain accurate and intellectually substantive.</li> <li>Establish clear expectations with authors and provide candid, actionable guidance throughout development. Provide direct developmental or line-editing support when a project requires senior intervention.</li> <li>Determine the appropriate editorial and verification process for each book, including when to commission technical, legal, or other specialist review.</li> <li>Build, commission, and supervise a trusted network of developmental editors, line editors, copyeditors, fact-checkers, proofreaders, indexers, typesetters, and specialist reviewers.</li> <li>Give final editorial approval before manuscripts enter production, and remain responsible for editorial decisions and author review through the proof stages.</li> <li>Maintain the Stripe Press house style and create clear, repeatable workflows and handoffs across editorial and production.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Who you are</strong></h2> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.</span></p> <h3><strong>Minimum requirements</strong></h3> <ul> <li>You have significant experience managing complex nonfiction books at a trade, academic, journalistic, or ideas-focused publishing organization.</li> <li>You demonstrate exceptional editorial judgment across structure, argument, prose, evidence, and authorial voice.</li> <li>You are comfortable working with technical, scientific, economic, historical, or otherwise research-intensive nonfiction.</li> <li>You have deep knowledge of developmental editing, line editing, copyediting, fact-checking, permissions, proofreading, and editorial-production workflows.</li> <li>You are an exceptional project manager, capable of coordinating multiple complex projects and timelines with a high degree of precision.</li> <li>You enjoy operating in a small, ambitious organization where systems are still being built, and you share Stripe Press’s appetite for ideas that can improve how people understand and shape the world.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Preferred qualifications</strong></h3> <ul> <li>You have helped launch or materially scale a publishing program, list, or imprint.</li> <li>You have developed editorial standards, tools, or workflows that improved quality and execution in a growing organization.</li> </ul>

title: Offensive Security Engineer
description: <h2><strong>Who we are</strong></h2> <h3><strong>About Stripe</strong></h3> <p>Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.</p> <h3><strong>About the team</strong></h3> <p>The Proactive Threat team is responsible for identifying vulnerabilities and security weaknesses across Stripe's systems, applications, networks, and cloud infrastructure — before adversaries do. We operate as a hybrid offensive function: conducting penetration testing, emulating real-world threat actors through red team operations, and partnering closely with our defensive security teams to validate detection capabilities and improve Stripe's overall security posture.</p> <p>We are builders first. Our team develops custom tooling, automation frameworks, and internal platforms that scale our offensive capabilities and enable repeatable, high-fidelity assessments. We believe the best offensive security engineers are equal parts hacker and engineer.</p> <p>The team is distributed across the United States, primarily operating in Eastern and Pacific time zones, and collaborates regularly with security, engineering, and product stakeholders across Stripe — including teams in Europe and Asia.</p> <h2><strong>What you'll do</strong></h2> <p>As an Offensive Security Engineer on the Proactive Threat team, you will simulate the tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs) of real-world adversaries to uncover security risks across Stripe's products and infrastructure. You'll conduct hands-on penetration testing, lead red team engagements, and collaborate with blue team counterparts to validate and improve detection and response capabilities. Your work will directly influence how Stripe builds, ships, and secures financial infrastructure used by millions of businesses worldwide.</p> <p>Beyond assessments, you'll design and build offensive tooling and automation that amplifies the team's impact. You'll leverage threat intelligence to prioritize testing efforts, contribute to incident investigations when needed, and act as a subject-matter expert for security initiatives across the company.</p> <h3><strong>Responsibilities</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Conduct comprehensive penetration tests across web applications, APIs, cloud environments (AWS/GCP/Azure), mobile applications, and internal infrastructure</li> <li>Plan and execute red team engagements that emulate the TTPs of cyber and criminal threat actors targeting financial services, including initial access, lateral movement, persistence, and data exfiltration scenarios</li> <li>Perform assumed-breach and objective-based assessments to test detection and response capabilities in coordination with defensive teams</li> <li>Partner with detection engineering, threat intelligence, and incident response teams to validate security controls, identify coverage gaps, and improve detection fidelity</li> <li>Contribute adversary tradecraft insights to inform detection rule development, threat hunting hypotheses, and incident response playbooks</li> <li>Support incident investigations by providing offensive expertise, log analysis, and root cause analysis when required</li> <li>Design, develop, and maintain custom offensive tools, scripts, and automation frameworks to enhance assessment efficiency and coverage</li> <li>Build internal platforms and workflows that enable scalable, repeatable offensive operations</li> <li>Contribute to internal security tooling repositories and champion engineering best practices within the team</li> <li>Automate repetitive testing tasks, payload generation, and reporting workflows using modern development practices</li> <li>Produce clear, actionable reports that communicate technical findings, business risk, and remediation guidance to both technical and non-technical stakeholders</li> <li>Act as a subject-matter expert and primary point of contact for stakeholder teams engaged in offensive security programs and Stripe-wide security initiatives</li> <li>Lead offensive security projects end-to-end, mentor junior team members, and foster a culture of continuous learning and knowledge sharing</li> <li>Stay current with emerging threats, vulnerabilities, and attack techniques; share research internally and contribute to the broader security community</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Who you are</strong></h2> <p>We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.</p> <h3><strong>Minimum requirements</strong></h3> <ul> <li>5+ years of experience in offensive security, penetration testing, red teaming, or a related field</li> <li>Strong programming skills in Python, Go, or similar languages, with demonstrated experience building tools, automation, or custom exploits</li> <li>Deep knowledge of web application security, including OWASP Top 10, ASVS, and common vulnerability classes (injection, auth flaws, business logic, etc.)</li> <li>Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP), including cloud-native attack techniques and misconfigurations</li> <li>Proficiency with offensive tooling such as Burp Suite, Cobalt Strike, Mythic, Sliver, BloodHound, or similar frameworks</li> <li>Familiarity with adversary tradecraft and frameworks such as MITRE ATT&amp;CK, including TTPs for initial access, privilege escalation, lateral movement, and exfiltration</li> <li>Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate complex technical findings into clear, risk-based recommendations</li> <li>Ability to think like an adversary — creative, persistent, and able to holistically assess risk in complex environments</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Preferred qualifications</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Experience conducting offensive security in fintech, financial services, or other highly regulated environments</li> <li>Background in vulnerability research, exploit development, or CVE discovery</li> <li>Experience collaborating with threat intelligence, detection engineering, or incident response teams (purple team operations)</li> <li>Familiarity with big data and log analysis tools (Splunk, Databricks, PySpark, osquery, etc.) for threat hunting or investigative support</li> <li>Proficiency with AI/LLM-assisted development tools (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot) and experience applying them to offensive security workflows</li> <li>Interest or experience in agentic automation — using LLMs or autonomous agents to augment reconnaissance, vulnerability discovery, or exploitation workflows</li> <li>Experience testing AI/ML systems or LLM-based applications for security weaknesses (prompt injection, training data extraction, model manipulation, etc.)</li> <li>Contributions to open-source security tools, published research, blog posts, or conference presentations</li> <li>Relevant certifications such as OSCP, OSWE, OSEP, OSED, CRTO, CPTS, PNPT, GXPN, or cloud security certifications</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Location</strong></h2> <p>This role is remote within the United States. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.</p> <p><strong>About the team</strong></p> <p>As Stripe’s user base and global footprint grows dramatically, we have distinctly unique support problems resulting from both our type of scale and the type of businesses we partner with. The Stripe Delivery Center (SDC) strategy will provide operational leverage and expand Stripe’s portfolio of operational capabilities to support the scaled needs for external users and internal Stripe teams.</p> <p><strong>What you’ll do</strong></p> <p>Stripe is launching Stripe Delivery Centers - a new global team to design, implement and grow Stripe’s operations for the next decade. We are looking for dynamic and curious people that have a passion for solving global user issues, building operations, driving process improvements and that want to play a front-line role in building this new operational capability for Stripe and accelerating Stripe’s growth.</p> <p>In this role, you will recruit, manage, and develop a group of Operations Associates that are focused on user support. This person will cultivate the happiness of their team members while guiding them to be the best they can be, through feedback, coaching, mentoring, and advocacy within the organization. This means helping to set team goals, and using metrics to efficiently measure and guide team performance in pursuit of those goals. To be a fit, you will have a strong operations mindset, be able to move quickly, and be passionate about delivering an incredible user experience.&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li>Recruit, manage, coach, and develop a new team of in-office Operations Associates&nbsp;</li> <li>Drive strong operational delivery and process improvement helping to mitigate risk while balancing operational efficiency and user impact</li> <li>Identify gaps in current systems, policies and strategies, and recommend enhancements and process improvements to mitigate risks</li> <li>Build a great culture and ensure team members are happy, effective, and growing in their career</li> <li>Set clear goals and direction, and provide regular feedback on team members’ performance</li> <li>Be data-driven in your analysis of performance, and in your decision making</li> <li>Transmit and foster our values, serving as a beacon of Stripe’s user-centric philosophy and culture of transparency, empathy, inclusion, and empowerment</li> </ul> <p><strong>Who you are</strong></p> <p>We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.</p> <p><strong>Minimum requirements</strong></p> <ul> <li>At least 8+ years experience leading operations support teams</li> <li>Experience working cross-functionally with multiple teams to deliver high impact initiatives&nbsp;</li> <li>Experience in delivering weekly and monthly business metrics and reporting</li> <li>Excellent written and verbal communication skills</li> <li>An ability to partner effectively with internal stakeholders</li> <li>Background of identifying and remediating quality gaps in team performance</li> <li>Passion for process improvement and innovation</li> <li>Ability to periodically work a weekend day for which you will receive a weekday off; the SDC operates during daytime hours with shifts from the morning through early evening</li> </ul> <p><strong>Preferred qualifications&nbsp;</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience in building and scaling new teams from zero&nbsp;</li> <li>Strong operational background including experience with new process launches and service delivery in a high growth technology company</li> </ul>

title: PhD Data Scientist, Intern
description: <h2>Who we are</h2> <h3>About Stripe</h3> <p>Stripe is a technology company focused on improving the conditions for economic growth and prosperity. We build programmable financial infrastructure, rethinking from first principles how financial services should work, to make it easier and cheaper for any business to start and scale. More than 10 million <a href="https://stripe.com/customers">businesses</a> build on Stripe, spanning the economic frontier—from solo founders to established enterprises—united by a practical focus on growth. The most ambitious companies in the world use Stripe as core infrastructure to grow faster. They process trillions of dollars a year on Stripe, equivalent to around 1.6% of global GDP. While economic growth makes everyone better off, open markets also enable greater variety. When any business can easily serve a global customer base, the quality and diversity of products in the world increase, and craft and creativity are unleashed into the smallest niches. Our own growth is wholly contingent on the success of the businesses building on Stripe. We therefore invest back into our technology at an unusual rate. We make <a href="https://stripe.com/roadmap">upgrades to our products</a> every single day to deliver compounding gains to our customers. We maintain some of the most <a href="https://status.stripe.com/">reliable APIs</a> on the internet. We build entirely new <a href="https://tempo.xyz/">pieces</a> of <a href="https://mpp.dev/">financial</a> <a href="https://joinopenstandard.com/">infrastructure</a> to enable new ideas. And our significant advances in <a href="https://stripe.com/radar">risk and fraud</a> infrastructure over many years are making the internet economy safer and more accessible.</p> <p>Though people at Stripe don’t tend to take themselves seriously, Stripe is a fairly serious place: our customers are depending on us for their livelihoods. We admire ambition, intensity, curiosity, humility, and rigor. The most effective people become knowledgeable about many domains besides their own. Any company is an applied exercise in understanding some aspect of society or the market. In working with so many (especially the new and innovative ones), we think that Stripe is one of the very best places to learn about how the world works.</p> <h3>&nbsp;</h3> <h3>About the team</h3> <p>Our Data Science team partners deeply with teams across Stripe to ensure that our users, our products, and our business have the models, data products, and insights needed to make decisions and grow responsibly. We're looking for data scientists with a passion for analyzing data, building machine learning and statistical models, and running experiments to drive impact. Our Fraud, Losses, and Financial Crime Data Science team builds the models and data products that protect Stripe and its users from fraud, account takeover, and financial crime. We own the full fraud and loss modeling stack - from account takeover detection and card fraud classification to merchant-level loss estimation, unsupervised anomaly detection, and financial crime risk modeling. We partner with Fraud Engineering, Financial Crimes Engineering, and Risk Operations to bring these systems into production and ensure they have measurable impact on Stripe's financial integrity and user trust.</p> <h2>&nbsp;</h2> <h2>What you’ll do</h2> <p>As an intern at Stripe you’ll work on projects across our stack that directly impact the way millions of businesses operate. You’ll own problems end to end with the support of your manager and teammates. It’s an opportunity to work alongside some of the most creative and technically rigorous data analysts and scientists in the industry. title: Product Manager, E-Invoicing
description: <h2><strong>About Stripe</strong></h2> <p>Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies — from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups — use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to grow the GDP of the internet, and we won't stop until we've made it easy for any business anywhere to participate in the digital economy.</p> <h2><strong>About the role</strong></h2> <p>Governments around the world are fundamentally changing how businesses report and exchange transactions. Continuous Transaction Controls (CTC) and e-invoicing mandates — now active or imminent in France, Germany, Spain, Poland, and across Latin America — require businesses to transmit structured invoice data through certified government networks in real time. For Stripe's global user base, compliant e-invoicing is rapidly becoming a prerequisite for conducting commerce, not a nice-to-have.</p> <p>We're building the e-invoicing infrastructure that makes this invisible for Stripe users. That means embedding compliant invoice generation, validation, and transmission directly into Stripe Billing and Invoicing — abstracting the full complexity of regional mandates and network certification behind a seamless product experience.</p> <p>This is a high-impact, greenfield role. You'll own Stripe's e-invoicing product end-to-end: setting the strategy, driving execution, and making Stripe the go-to solution for businesses navigating the global shift to real-time invoicing compliance. You'll work at the intersection of product, engineering, partnerships, and go-to-market — and you'll be laying the foundation for a capability that will matter to every Stripe user operating in a mandated market.</p> <h2><strong>What you'll do</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Own the e-invoicing product vision and roadmap, translating complex and evolving regulatory requirements into a coherent reliability, and activation metrics that hold every component of the e-invoicing stack accountable, and use those metrics to drive continuous improvement</li> <li>Partner with GTM, Sales, and CTC frameworks, structured invoice formats (Factur-X, XRechnung, PEPPOL BIS), and the regulatory dynamics driving mandates in Europe and Latin America</li> <li>Strong technical fluency: you can credibly partner with engineers on API design, data schemas, and network integration architecture</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to run a build/buy/partner analysis and translate the output into access point certification or direct integrations with national tax authority platforms (e.g., Chorus Pro, KSeF)</li> <li>Exposure to B2B invoicing workflows in mid-market or enterprise contexts</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Why this role, why now</strong></h2> <p>E-invoicing is one of the most consequential shifts in global business compliance in a decade, and Stripe is early in building the infrastructure to make it effortless. title: Product Manager, Foreign Exchange
description: <h2><strong>Who we are</strong></h2> <h3><strong>About Stripe</strong></h3> <p>Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies, from the world’s largest enterprises to ambitious startups, use Stripe to accept payments, manage their businesses, and grow their revenue. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a significant amount of work ahead. You’ll have an opportunity to help put the global economy within everyone’s reach.&nbsp;</p> <h2><strong>About the team</strong></h2> <p>The Foreign Exchange team builds the products and infrastructure that help Stripe users operate across currencies. Businesses increasingly operate globally from the moment they launch, collecting revenue, holding balances, paying suppliers, and managing expenses across multiple currencies.</p> <p>Managing those currencies remains fragmented. Finance teams must decide what to hold, when to convert, how to manage currency exposure, and how to reconcile the results. Today, these workflows often span banks, spreadsheets, treasury systems, and specialist FX providers.</p> <p>Stripe is uniquely positioned to simplify this. We sit at the center of the payments, Billing, balances, payouts, and settlement flows that create a business’s currency needs. Our vision is to make Stripe the financial home for businesses operating internationally, with a unified offering for holding, converting, and managing currencies and FX risk.</p> <p>A core part of this vision is making currency management agentic. We believe software agents will increasingly help businesses understand their FX position, recommend actions, and manage currencies within defined policies and controls.</p> <p>This could include Stripe-native agents that monitor exposure and take approved actions. It could also mean enabling customers’ own agents to use Stripe’s infrastructure to understand balances and exposures, obtain pricing, execute conversions or hedges, and reconcile the results.</p> <p>Our goal is to make Stripe the currency-management layer that both people and agents can build on.</p> <p>We will build these capabilities both for globally operating businesses and for the platforms and marketplaces that use Connect.</p> <p><strong>What you’ll do</strong></p> <p>We’re looking for a Product Manager to build a new area of Stripe’s FX and currency-management offering. This is a zero-to-one product role at the intersection of FX, treasury, and agentic AI. You will help define what agentic currency management should look like. That could mean Stripe-native agents that understand exposure, recommend actions, and execute within customer-defined policies. It could also mean enabling customers’ own agents to use Stripe’s FX infrastructure to understand balances, obtain pricing, manage risk, execute transactions, and reconcile the results.</p> <p>You will work directly with globally operating businesses to understand their most important currency-management problems. You will identify the right initial product wedge and take it from discovery through launch and iteration. Today, treasury teams assemble exposures from multiple systems, determine hedge requirements, monitor changing positions, request pricing, execute trades, and reconcile the results. We believe much of this workflow can become continuous, intelligent, and increasingly automated.</p> <p>You might build products that combine Stripe’s real-time view of payments, balances, and settlement activity with customer forecasts and policies to identify exposures and recommend actions. You might also define the APIs, permissions, controls, and financial primitives that allow customer or third-party agents to safely take those actions through Stripe.</p> <p>Over time, these systems could move from surfacing insights to requesting quotes, executing conversions or hedges, rebalancing positions, and escalating exceptions within clearly defined permissions.</p> <p>You will determine which intelligence Stripe should provide directly, which capabilities we should expose for others to build on, where humans should remain in the decision loop, and how we evaluate whether agents are making good decisions. Your product area could also include automated conversion and balance policies, recurring currency-management workflows, or capabilities distributed through Connect.</p> <p>The opportunity is broad. Your job will be to make it focused. You will determine where Stripe can create differentiated value, build the first product, measure whether it works, and use those learnings to shape the roadmap.</p> <p>You will work closely with Engineering and Design on product experiences, APIs, data models, agent behavior, controls, and system reliability. You will also partner with Treasury, Risk, Legal, Finance, Sales, and Product Marketing to ensure the products are economically sound, operationally scalable, and ready for customers.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h2><strong>Responsibilities</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Deeply understand how global businesses and platforms manage currencies, including holding, converting, forecasting, hedging, and reconciliation.</li> <li>Own the strategy, roadmap, and success metrics for a focused area of Stripe’s FX and currency-management offering.</li> <li>Identify high-value customer problems and take new products from discovery through launch, adoption, and iteration.</li> <li>Define Stripe’s approach to agentic currency management, including Stripe-native experiences, agent-ready APIs, permissions, controls, and evaluation.</li> <li>Partner closely with Engineering and Design to build simple, reliable products across user experiences, APIs, data models, and financial infrastructure.</li> <li>Work across Treasury, Risk, Legal, Finance, Sales, and Product Marketing to ensure products are economically sound, operationally scalable, and successful with customers.</li> <li>Use customer insights and product results to shape Stripe’s broader FX and currency-management strategy.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Who you are</strong></h2> <p>We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. Preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.</p> <h3><strong>Minimum requirements</strong></h3> <ul> <li>5+ years of product management experience, including taking technically complex products from problem definition through launch and iteration.</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to turn ambiguous customer problems into clear product strategies and focused roadmaps.</li> <li>Experience building financial infrastructure, enterprise software, APIs, regulated products, AI-native products, or similarly complex systems.</li> <li>Strong technical judgment and experience partnering with engineers on APIs, data flows, reliability, and system behavior.</li> <li>Strong customer instincts and experience translating complex financial or operational workflows into simple, scalable products.</li> <li>Strong analytical judgment and ability to make decisions with incomplete information.</li> <li>Strong written and verbal communication, including the ability to explain product decisions, risks, and tradeoffs across technical and nontechnical teams.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Preferred qualifications</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Experience with foreign exchange, multi-currency products, treasury, cross-border money movement, hedging, or financial risk management.</li> <li>Experience building AI-native or agentic products, especially systems that can recommend or take actions within defined controls.</li> <li>Experience building products for finance or treasury teams at globally operating businesses.</li> <li>Experience with API-first, configurable, or automated financial products.</li> <li>Familiarity with the economics, accounting, liquidity, regulatory, or operational considerations involved in FX products.</li> </ul>

do</h2> <ul> <li>Own the self-serve growth roadmap: identify the highest-leverage opportunities to grow activation across our ex-US markets, and build the case for investment</li> <li>Build a deep case</li> <li>Collaborate with Stripe's global product teams to ensure regional needs are reflected in platform decisions, and advocate for regional investment at the right moments</li> </ul> <h2>Who title: Product Manager, Identity & Access Management
description: <h2>Who we are</h2> <h3>About Stripe</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.</span></p> <h3>About the team</h3> <p>IAM is the nerve center of Stripe. We control how millions of businesses grant access to their account, including employees, AI agents, apps, and API integrations, across the Dashboard, API, CLI, and MCP. We're also a platform team, building the unified, fine-grained permissions model that every product at Stripe builds on.</p> <p>AI agents are changing how businesses operate, and how they get authorized, governed, and secured is being defined right now—largely by us. We’re tackling challenging and unsolved problems for real businesses, like how to model agents when they blur the line between acting on behalf of a human vs. standalone principals, or how to authorize entire agent workflows rather than step-by-step actions. We’re collaborating directly with the frontier AI labs on the evolution of MCP, new identity protocols, and agent integrations. We build for solo founders and Fortune 500s alike, and the tension between those two is where the real product work lives.</p> <h2>What you’ll do</h2> <p>You'll set the vision and drive the roadmap for how every principal, human, agent, or app, gets access to a Stripe account. You'll do it by talking directly to the founders, admins, and developers who use it.</p> <ul> <li><strong>Design the experience of granting access, everywhere.</strong> Signing up, inviting a teammate, creating an API key, authorizing an agent or a third-party app.</li> <li><strong>Design for agents specifically.</strong> Design for agents as a new principal within Stripe, including how they authenticate, what they're allowed to do, and how businesses stay in control, including approvals and human-in-the-loop checkpoints for actions involving real money. You're defining an experience that will set the industry standard.&nbsp;</li> <li><strong>Drive least privilege, made easy.</strong> Take holistic ownership across Stripe to ensure that every user, app and agent has only the permissions it requires. Build custom roles, smart permission defaults, and permission recommendations based on real API usage to make least-privilege authorization easy rather than tedious.&nbsp;</li> <li><strong>Push toward a world without secrets.</strong> Make secretless authentication (Workload Identity Federation) the default way developers integrate with Stripe to prevent emerging security threats from increasingly sophisticated and AI-powered attackers.&nbsp;</li> <li><strong>Partner across all of Stripe.</strong> Pitch an ambitious vision, then get teams across Dashboard, API Platform, Security, Payments and Money Movement genuinely excited to build it with you.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Who you are</strong></h2> <p>The hardest part of this job, and the most fun, is the constant trade-off: usability vs. security, flexibility vs. simplicity. It takes taste to find a shape that feels effortless for a solo founder and holds up at Fortune 500 scale.</p> <h3>Minimum requirements</h3> <ul> <li>5+ years in PM, shipping platform or infrastructure products that other teams build on</li> <li>Background in security, identity, auth, or developer platforms, or serious curiosity about the space</li> <li>A habit of talking to users to find the real problem, not the reported one</li> <li>Technical fluency to go deep with engineers on authorization and authentication design</li> <li>A bias toward experimentation over big-bang launches</li> <li>Comfort setting direction in a space that's still being invented, across teams you don't manage</li> </ul>

title: Product Manager - Issuance, Bridge
description: <h2>Who we are</h2> <h3>About Bridge</h3> <p>We're creating an entirely new payments platform, built with stablecoins, to simplify global money movement. Bridge enables faster, cheaper payments and borderless access to dollars via stablecoins. Through our APIs, businesses can send and receive funds across borders faster and cheaper vs. SWIFT and other fiat-only rails. collaborative working style that builds trust.</li> <li>Someone who demonstrates leadership qualities throughout their work – taking ownership of challenges, selflessly supporting their colleagues, While you will influence senior leadership and set strategic direction, you are also the primary driver of execution. You will need to zoom out to design the long-term vision, and zoom in to manage the details—building templates, tracking deliverables, writing documentation, and directly unblocking cross-functional teams.</p> <h3><strong>Responsibilities</strong></h3> <ul> <li><strong>Own and execute high-stakes global programs end-to-end,</strong> from initial strategy and scoping to project planning, day-to-day tracking, and change management</li> <li><strong>Drive step-change improvements</strong> in our operational processes, rolling up your sleeves to build systems and workflows that directly improve business outcomes and top-line metrics&nbsp;</li> <li><strong>Bridge compliance and commercial strategy</strong> by partnering with GTM and account leadership to turn complex regulatory requirements into a competitive advantage that builds deep user trust</li> <li><strong>Build and run operating models</strong> across diverse cross-functional teams (including Product, Engineering, Legal, Risk, and Compliance), keeping highly distributed workstreams aligned and accountable&nbsp;</li> <li><strong>Serve as a trusted advisor</strong> by preparing strategic reviews for senior stakeholders and managing critical escalations&nbsp;</li> <li><strong>Translate user friction into program evolution</strong> by establishing structured, data-driven approaches to gather user feedback and turning those insights into actionable product and operational improvements&nbsp;</li> <li><strong>Diagnose and resolve systemic operational gaps</strong> before they impact our users, building self-healing processes and scalable internal infrastructure</li> <li><strong>Champion Stripe’s Operating Principles</strong> by fostering a high-performance culture that values rigorous thinking, rapid execution, and putting users first</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Who you are</strong></h2> <p>You are a highly strategic operator, a masterful communicator, and a systems thinker with operational grit. You thrive in the gray area, possessing the ability to translate ambiguous global challenges into elegant, structured, and highly actionable operational frameworks.&nbsp;</p> <p>You are a natural leader who leads by influence and by example. You have a deep empathy for the user, an unyielding bias toward action, and you take pride in the craft of execution. No problem is too complex for you to deconstruct, and no detail is too small if it impacts the user experience.</p> <h3><strong>Minimum requirements</strong></h3> <ul> <li>6+ years of experience in Program Management, Strategy &amp; Operations, Management Consulting, or Go-to-Market (GTM) Strategy in a fast-paced, high-growth environment&nbsp;</li> <li>Hands-on execution track record: Proven ability to work independently as an individual contributor, managing complex, multi-stakeholder project plans and deliverables from inception to completion&nbsp;</li> <li>Exceptional communication &amp; storytelling: Excellent written and verbal communication skills; a proven ability to distill highly complex, technical, or regulatory topics into clear, succinct, and persuasive narratives to external and senior audiences&nbsp;</li> <li>Systems and infrastructure builder: Deep experience designing, launching, and scaling complex cross-functional operating models, feedback loops, and PMO frameworks&nbsp;</li> <li>Growth mindset: A high willingness to learn, adapt quickly to changing environments, and actively seek and act on feedback to continuously improve</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Preferred qualifications</strong></h3> <ul> <li>3+ years of experience in high-growth technology or fintech environments&nbsp;</li> <li>Deep cross-functional partnership: Prior experience working alongside Engineering, Product, Legal, Compliance, and GTM/Sales&nbsp;</li> <li>Data fluency: Experience leveraging data visualization tools and analytical frameworks to back up strategic decisions and measure program success</li> </ul>

description: <h2>Who we are</h2> <h3><strong>About Stripe</strong></h3> <p>Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. We work hand-in-hand with our Sales team to build demand, help users get the most out of our products, and craft marketing plans that truly resonate with local audiences.&nbsp;</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>In the DACH region, our team partners with some of the most ambitious innovators across Germany, Austria, and Switzerland—brands like DeepL, refurbed, N26, and Nestlé. We help them use Stripe’s financial infrastructure to unlock new revenue, navigate local complexities, and scale globally. What we learn from these relationships directly influences how Stripe builds its products. The opportunity in this region is massive. We’re tackling it as a diverse, international team that thrives on collaboration, bold innovation, and genuine curiosity. If you love to learn and want to make a meaningful impact, we'd love to have you join us.</p> <h2><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h2> <p>You’ll lead marketing strategy and plan execution for the DACH region and serve as the primary Marketing partner on the DACH Leadership Team. You’ll set the regional strategy and investment plan, with Germany as the main market, and shape priorities across Austria and Switzerland. You’ll be accountable for demand, pipeline, customer advocacy, and Stripe’s long-term market position in the region.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>As a senior individual contributor, you will align regional and global cross-functional teams around shared priorities, secure the necessary resources, and navigate trade-offs between global strategies and local market needs. You will directly lead high-priority initiatives across the region.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>Leveraging deep market and account insights, you will identify key growth opportunities across target industries and audiences. In close partnership with Sales, you will build tailored programs for strategic accounts and high-potential prospects aligned with their business models, technical environments, and commercial objectives.</p> <h2><strong>Responsibilities</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Define and own the integrated DACH marketing strategy, turning business goals, market dynamics, and competitive context into clear priorities.</li> <li>Partner with DACH GTM leadership, Sales, Sales Development, and Partnerships to set shared priorities, join business and pipeline reviews, and focus investment on the highest-value opportunities.</li> <li>Build and oversee a full-funnel DACH marketing plan across brand, demand generation, account-based marketing, pipeline acceleration, executive engagement, and customer advocacy.</li> <li>Develop industry and account programs for strategic customers and high-potential prospects, helping Sales engage the right stakeholders with relevant messages.</li> <li>Bring together EMEA and global teams, including Demand Generation and Product Marketing, to deliver the DACH plan, working with Sales, Product, Solutions Engineering, Partnerships, and Communications.</li> <li>Build Stripe’s brand and local presence in DACH through regional customer stories, partner programs, and executive, industry, and ecosystem engagement, including activation around Stripe flagship and third-party events.</li> <li>Own metrics across demand, pipeline, opportunity progression, priority-account engagement, and return on investment. Use results to improve programs and stop or change those that aren’t delivering.</li> <li>Represent DACH across EMEA and global marketing teams, bringing market insight into planning and sharing successful programs across markets.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Who you are</strong></h2> <p>You’re an experienced B2B marketer who has owned a country, regional, or similarly broad marketing strategy. You can set direction, make investment trade-offs, and work credibly with senior Sales and GTM leaders. We hire and train SDRs in a way that prepares them to be a high performing source of talent for Stripe Sales and Go to Market teams.&nbsp;</p> <h3><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h3> <p>For the first few months, you’ll be a part of our <strong>Sales Development Associate program</strong>, which is designed to accelerate onboarding and support new grads transition into their first roles in a corporate setting. During this period you’ll also be partnered with a senior SDR on the team as a mentor. Along with your manager, your mentor will be there as an additional resource to help support you.&nbsp;</p> <p>Within a few weeks of starting at Stripe you'll be reaching out to potential Stripe customers, pitching them on the products that could best support their business model, and partnering with senior sellers on the team who will ultimately help close deals. Most regularly we see our top performing SDRs promoted into Account Executive roles.&nbsp;</p> <p>If you enjoy working in a fast-paced environment, interacting with customers, and being responsible for generating revenue, we’d love to hear from you!&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li>Contact potential customers through cold-calling, email, and social channels, or by responding to inquiries generated from Marketing activities.</li> <li>Book meetings with potential customers (prospects) and pitch them on Stripe’s products that are a match for their business model.&nbsp;</li> <li>Develop relationships with prospects to uncover specific business needs through effective, consultative questioning to qualify interest and prepare a comprehensive hand-off to sales.</li> <li>Research and create compelling outreach materials for high-value prospects, in partnership with SDRs and Account Executives.</li> <li>Execute outbound sales outreach created by marketing, leveraging strategic messaging to target specific segments.</li> <li>Follow-up with potential customers who expressed interest but did not initially result in a sales opportunity, maintaining a warm pipeline.</li> <li>Effectively manage customer outreach, consistently meeting/exceeding Service Level Agreements (SLAs), meticulously updating activity and contact information within the Customer Relationship Management system (Salesforce) to support weekly reporting efforts.</li> <li>Collaborate and provide essential feedback and insights to Marketing to help improve targeting, messaging, and overall campaign effectiveness.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Who you are</strong></h3> <p>We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply.</p> <h4><strong>Minimum requirements</strong></h4> <ul> <li>A track record of top performance or prior success in academic, extracurricular, or professional endeavors.</li> <li>Superior verbal and written communication skills, with an ability to clearly articulate complex topics.&nbsp;</li> <li>Self-starter who is highly motivated and able to operate effectively and autonomously in a hyper-growth environment.</li> <li>This role requires in-office participation three to four (3-4) days per week in our Chicago office.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Preferred Qualifications</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Professional experience in a sales, customer service, or fast-paced professional environment.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p>
