title: Sales Development Representative (Spanish fluency)
description: <h3><strong>About the team</strong></h3> <p><strong>Note: This role is an in-office position, based in our Chicago, IL office.</strong></p> <p>As a Sales Development Representative (SDR) at Stripe, you’ll work in a customer-facing role focused on connecting prospective customers with Stripe. You will work in partnership with the Marketing and Sales teams to create a high quality, predictable pipeline. We hire and train SDRs in a way that prepares them to be a high performing source of talent for Stripe Sales and Go to Market teams.&nbsp;</p> <h3><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h3> <p>For the first few months, you’ll be a part of our <strong>Sales Development Associate program</strong>, which is designed to accelerate onboarding and support new grads transition into their first roles in a corporate setting. Part of this period will be supported by the <strong><a href="https://stripesalesdevacademy.splashthat.com/">Sales Development Academy</a></strong> which&nbsp; will help you quickly build and develop the foundational skills required to be successful in this role and position you for a long-term career in Sales at Stripe. Through a mix of virtual sessions, in-person practicums, and check-point quizzes, you’ll learn all about Stripe’s products and how to be a successful SDR. During this period you’ll also be partnered with a senior SDR on the team as a mentor. Along with your manager, your mentor will be there as an additional resource to help support you.&nbsp;</p> <p>Within a few weeks of starting at Stripe you'll be reaching out to potential Stripe customers, pitching them on the products that could best support their business model, and partnering with senior sellers on the team who will ultimately help close deals. We take a data driven approach to the role and the success of our SDRs is largely dependent on their successful outreach to new Stripe customers.&nbsp;</p> <p>While onboarding spans across the course of your first few weeks at Stripe, the Academy offers continued training and enablement over the course of your first year as an SDR to ensure top performers are set up for a successful transition to other roles on the sales team. Most regularly we see our top performing SDRs promoted into Account Executive roles.&nbsp;</p> <p>If you enjoy working in a fast-paced environment, interacting with customers, and being responsible for generating revenue, we’d love to hear from you!&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li>Contact potential customers through cold-calling, email, and social channels, or by responding to inquiries generated from Marketing activities.</li> <li>Book meetings with potential customers (prospects) and pitch them on Stripe’s products that are a match for their business model.&nbsp;</li> <li>Develop relationships with prospects to uncover specific business needs through effective, consultative questioning to qualify interest and prepare a comprehensive hand-off to sales.</li> <li>Research and create compelling outreach materials for high-value prospects, in partnership with SDRs and Account Executives.</li> <li>Execute outbound sales outreach created by marketing, leveraging strategic messaging to target specific segments.</li> <li>Follow-up with potential customers who expressed interest but did not initially result in a sales opportunity, maintaining a warm pipeline.</li> <li>Effectively manage customer outreach, consistently meeting/exceeding Service Level Agreements (SLAs), meticulously updating activity and contact information within the Customer Relationship Management system (Salesforce) to support weekly reporting efforts.</li> <li>Collaborate and provide essential feedback and insights to Marketing to help improve targeting, messaging, and overall campaign effectiveness.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Who you are</strong></h3> <p>We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply.</p> <h4><strong>Minimum requirements</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Superior verbal and written communication skills in BOTH English and Spanish</li> <li>A track record of top performance or prior success in academic, extracurricular, or professional endeavors.</li> <li>Self-starter who is highly motivated and able to operate effectively and autonomously in a hyper-growth environment.</li> <li>This role requires in-office participation three to four (3-4) days per week in our Chicago office.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Preferred Qualifications</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Professional experience in a sales, customer service, or fast-paced professional environment.</li> </ul>

description: <h2><strong>Who we are </strong></h2> <h3><strong>About Stripe</strong></h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.</span></p> <h3><strong>About the team</strong></h3> <p>The world is having a monetization moment – every ambitious company is replatforming their billing solution in response to AI. Stripes Billing is a team of deep functional and technical specialists who both lead and advise on deals for one of the most strategically important products in Stripe’s portfolio. Billing Sales is tasked with attacking a $100B market opportunity for automating the entire order to cash process and helping companies not get left behind in the AI era.</p> <h2><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h2> <p>As the Head of Grower Sales (Billing),&nbsp; you will use your leadership and management skills to manage and grow a team of Account Executives to drive expansion and retention of Stripe Billing across the AMER region. You will build and lead a team of sellers, while collaborating with the core sales leadership, marketing, product marketing, and product teams to develop deep product and industry knowledge and drive strategic deals. You will own the coaching, development, and performance of your team, driving the forecast of the business. You will be instrumental in leading in-depth product discussions with existing and prospective customers and building and executing against our go-to-market strategy.</p> <h3><strong>Responsibilities</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Recruit, develop and lead a team of product sales executives focused on expansion and retention of our largest Billing Users</li> <li>Create go-to-market plans and solutions to meet our customer needs, in collaboration with Product, Sales, Finance and Marketing stakeholders.</li> <li>Manage day-to-day operations, with a focus on performance against key sales metrics.</li> <li>Be accountable for driving revenue, increasing attach rates, and new client acquisition at high rates of growth.</li> <li>Coach and guide the team in developing consultative and solution-based sales skills through all facets of the sales cycle.</li> <li>Get hands on engaged in the largest, most strategic opportunities, leading executive relationships and helping the team win new customers.</li> <li>Inspire, motivate, and enable individual development to promote career growth of direct reports.</li> <li>Lead with clarity and context with a compelling plan in line with Stripe’s direction.</li> <li>Create structure and focus for GTM ideas and product sales campaigns that the product team is exploring. Drive execution and measurement. Analyse results and make recommendations for action in a timely manner.</li> <li>Constantly innovate and improve programs and program management mechanisms, suggesting new ideas, sharing best practices, and improving the business and customer engagement model.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Who you are</strong></h2> <p>You are an adept sales leader, capable of engaging in business-level and technical conversations at multiple levels of the organization. You have a reputation and drive for building strategic relationships with executives (CEO, CFO, and CTO) across the AMER region, including core markets like NA, CA, and LATAM. You excel in building clear plans to grow a region through a high-functioning sales team, with strategic thought leadership and strong management. You see value in competitive situations and enjoy working on products that require both deep product understanding and technical knowledge, especially for AI industry users. You’re as comfortable working with clients as with internal stakeholders (including executives) and are excited to become an expert and share your knowledge. You possess an organized, self-starter mindset and excellent communication skills, with a track record for improving the processes and organizations around you.</p> <h3><strong>Minimum requirements</strong></h3> <ul> <li>10+ years of sales leadership experience, launching and growing high-functioning sales teams/products.</li> <li>15+ years of experience in hyper-growth SaaS environments across the AMER region.</li> <li>Industry experience in finance, revenue management, financial services, or similar software services.</li> <li>Proven ability to be a self-starter, capable of driving business results without significant supervision.</li> <li>Ability to understand complex technical requirements and craft solutions across multiple stakeholders.</li> <li>An enthusiastic “roll up your sleeves” mentality.</li> <li>Excellent verbal and written communication skills.</li> <li>Strong presentation skills, particularly for in-person meetings with multiple stakeholders.</li> <li>Proven ability to lead complex negotiations involving bespoke agreements with startup, SMB, and Commercial businesses.</li> </ul>

When urgent abuse vectors emerge, ACE bridges the gap using real attacker telemetry to prototype, test, and deploy software safeguards before vulnerabilities can be exploited at scale. We partner closely with Fraud, Risk and Product Engineering to run rigorous experiments, balancing aggressive risk mitigation against legitimate user conversion. Operating as both a strike team and an incubator, ACE builds automated regression suites in partnership with Abuse Research to permanently block threat recurrence and seamlessly transfers mature controls to long-term product owners across Stripe.</p> <h2><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h2> <p>As an Abuse Control Engineer on the Abuse Control Engineering (ACE) team, you will design, prototype, and incubate technical defenses that safeguard Stripe’s financial ecosystem against complex, cross-cutting abuse vectors.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>Where emerging threat patterns identify Stripe product weaknesses, ACE steps in to rapidly build and experiment with technical safeguards. Driven by empirical evidence and Stripe’s FT3 (Fraud Taxonomy 3.0) framework, you will translate threat intelligence into hard technical control requirements (e.g., API rate-limiting, step-up challenges, parameter validation, pre-debit holds).&nbsp; You will carefully balance security and product velocity, running experiments to evaluate risk reduction against user conversion impact. Managing controls through a strict incubation lifecycle, you will build automated regression suites to prevent recurrence and partner with native product teams to hand off mature, long-term defenses.&nbsp;&nbsp;</p> <h3><strong>Responsibilities</strong></h3> <ul> <li><strong>Rapid Control Prototyping: </strong>Design, prototype, and deploy technical controls across API, protocol, and product boundaries to immediately close high-impact abuse vectors. <strong>&nbsp;Evidence-Based Technical Requirements: </strong>Translate empirical attacker evidence and FT3 threat research Abuse Research, Fraud and Security into precise technical abuse requirements and control specifications.&nbsp;</li> <li><strong>Control Co-Design: </strong>Collaborate closely with teams across Stripe to co-design resilient, secure controls across payment, onboarding, identity, and Connect surfaces.<strong>&nbsp;&nbsp;</strong></li> <li><strong>Risk Experimentation: </strong>Run rigorous experiments and A/B tests to measure risk reduction against legitimate user conversion impact, optimizing controls to minimize friction while neutralizing threats. <strong>&nbsp;</strong></li> <li><strong>Regression Testing: </strong>Build comprehensive regression testing suites and automated attack simulations with Abuse Research to ensure mitigated abuse vectors do not recur.&nbsp;</li> <li><strong>Stakeholder Management: </strong>Execute ACE’s incubation model by defining handoff criteria, operational documentation, and target dates to transfer successful controls to product teams.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Who you are</strong></h2> <p>We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.</p> <h3><strong>Minimum requirements</strong></h3> <ul> <li>3+ years of experience in Security Engineering, Software Engineering, Application Security, or Anti-Abuse Engineering in a high-scale production environment.</li> <li>B.S. or M.S. in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Software Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.</li> <li>Strong software development background with expert proficiency in Python, Go, Java, or similar production languages, alongside expert SQL skills for analyzing system telemetry.</li> <li>Hands-on engineering experience building API-level safeguards, rate-limiting frameworks, authentication/authorization checks, or input validation controls.</li> <li>Demonstrated experience with automated testing frameworks, including writing unit, integration, and regression tests for critical backend software.</li> <li>Strong cross-functional collaboration and communication skills, with a track record of partnering across security, product, and platform teams to drive technical outcomes.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Preferred qualifications</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Proven track record of designing and executing A/B tests, evaluating control efficacy, and balancing security safeguards against user conversion friction.</li> <li>Deep expertise in threat modeling, secure system architecture, and modern application security design principles.</li> <li>Familiarity with established threat frameworks (e.g., FT3, MITRE ATT&amp;CK) and applying adversary kill chain analysis to build resilient defenses.</li> <li>Strong domain knowledge of financial fraud vectors, threat actor TTPs, and attacker infrastructure (e.g., Account Takeover, Card Testing, Credential Stuffing).</li> <li>Hands-on experience with large-scale data processing platforms (e.g., Databricks, Trino, PySpark) to monitor and measure control performance across distributed systems.</li> <li>Demonstrated capability in incubating software features, establishing clear operational handoff criteria, and seamlessly transitioning ownership to partner engineering teams.</li> </ul>

title: Security Engineer, Privy
description: <h2><strong>Who we are </strong></h2> <h3><strong>About Privy</strong></h3> <p>Our mission is to make privacy and user ownership the default online. To do so, we build simple, flexible APIs and tools for developers that make it easy to build new products on crypto rails.</p> <p>Privy owns the abstractions and infrastructure layer above wallets, integrating across chains, third-party providers, and Stripe products like Treasury and Link. We get to solve hard technical problems while leveraging Stripe's distribution to reach customers like Ramp, Klarna, Deel, Kraken, Hyperliquid, and Fomo — powering experiences for both mainstream users and crypto natives.</p> <p>Learn more about Privy:&nbsp;<a class=" Link " href="https://privy.io/blog/announcing-our-acquisition-by-stripe" data-js-controller="AnalyticsButton" data-analytics-category="Links" data-analytics-action="Clicked" data-analytics-label="Related content">Privy and Stripe: Bringing crypto to everyone</a></p> <h3><strong>About the team</strong></h3> <p>Engineering at Privy is distinguished by:</p> <ul> <li>High urgency: Shipping very small iterations, very fast, to learn very quickly.&nbsp;</li> <li>Product taste: Our customers <em>are</em> developers, and to build effective products for them requires technical knowledge - you will often be "the PM".</li> <li>Security mindset: A great portion of our product is trust. While we have a dedicated security team, every engineer brings security to their designs from the start.</li> </ul> <p>In practice, we use&nbsp;<a href="https://mcfunley.com/choose-boring-technology">boring technology</a> like Node, React, and AWS so we can focus our engineering energy entirely on pushing the boundaries of Privy's core product, e.g. through hardware enclaves, multi-region low latency APIs, and blockchain abstractions that are accessible to mainstream developers.</p> <h2><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h2> <p>As a Security Engineer at Privy, you will help keep a rapidly growing platform secure through hands-on investigation, operational ownership, and building real code to solve real problems. You’ll work across security operations, incident response, application and infrastructure security, and internal tooling.</p> <p>This is not a role limited to reviewing logs and designs or simply escalating findings. You will carry real ownership for the day-to-day work that protects Privy: investigating anomalies, improving security workflows, and building the automation that makes the team faster and more effective over time. You’ll work closely with engineers across Privy and alongside specialists in cryptography, application security, offensive security, and infrastructure security to turn security expertise into practical, durable outcomes.</p> <h3><strong>Responsibilities</strong></h3> <ul> <li style="font-weight: 400;">Own security engineering work end to end: investigate alerts, findings, anomalies, and security requests; identify root causes; drive remediation; and clearly document outcomes.</li> <li>Participate in Privy’s security on-call rotation, helping respond to incidents, triage alerts, support vulnerability workflows, complete access reviews, and handle security escalations.</li> <li>Build and maintain production-quality tooling that reduces manual work, including alert enrichment, automated triage and routing, remediation workflows, access-review automation, and detection improvements.</li> <li>Lead focused investigations into suspected security events or compromises, gathering evidence methodically and coordinating the appropriate response.</li> <li>Proactively identify recurring sources of operational toil and engineer durable solutions that improve the team’s speed, consistency, and ability to scale.</li> <li>Partner with product and engineering teams to assess security risks, review lower-complexity designs and implementation plans, and make practical security tradeoffs to deliver quickly with quality and soundness.</li> <li>Contribute across Privy’s application, infrastructure, cloud, and product-security surface area, developing broad context while building deeper expertise over time.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Who you are</strong></h2> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.</span></p> <h3><strong>Minimum requirements</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Experience as a security engineer, detection engineer, or similarly hands-on engineer in a technically demanding environment.</li> <li>Strong software-engineering skills in Python, Go, Ruby, or a similar language. You can build maintainable tooling and contribute directly to production fixes, not only one-off scripts.</li> <li>Experience investigating security signals, incidents, vulnerabilities, suspicious activity, or other ambiguous technical problems through to resolution.</li> <li>Familiarity with security operations, incident response, vulnerability management, detection engineering, access reviews, or related operational-security workflows.</li> <li>A strong understanding of web, browser, infrastructure, or cloud security, with the ability to apply that understanding across a broad range of problems.</li> <li>Good judgment under pressure, a methodical approach to investigation, and comfort working independently with agency despite incomplete information.</li> <li>Strong communication and collaboration skills, including the ability to explain technical findings, risks, and recommended actions clearly to clients and internal stakeholders alike.</li> <li>A self-directed approach to work: you notice gaps, make progress through ambiguity, and reliably close the loop.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Preferred qualifications</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Experience with AWS, GCP, or other cloud-security environments.</li> <li>Experience with detection engineering, security automation, incident-response tooling, or remediation pipelines.</li> <li>Bug-bounty experience, offensive-security exposure, or a strong attacker-minded approach to investigation.</li> <li>Experience with IAM, secrets management, secure production access, or secure CI/CD.</li> <li>Background in application security, infrastructure security, cryptography, or privacy engineering.</li> <li>Experience with fintech, payments, blockchain, or another diligence-forward financial product domain.</li> <li>Experience helping shape security operations, incident-response practices, vulnerability-management workflows, or a bug-bounty program.</li> </ul>

title: Senior Brand Designer, Link
description: <h2><strong>Who we are </strong></h2> <h3><strong>About Stripe &amp; Link</strong></h3> <p>At Stripe, we’ve spent the last 15 years building financial infrastructure for the internet, serving millions of people and businesses worldwide. Our flagship consumer product, Link, makes online payments and digital transactions effortless and secure—the digital wallet for what’s next.</p> <p>This is a unique opportunity to continue building a standalone brand and introduce it to new global audiences. You’ll play a key role in making payments more personal and convenient while doing some of the most impactful work of your career.</p> <h3><strong>About the team</strong></h3> <p>Sitting within Brand Studio, the Link team is building Stripe’s first consumer brand. We build, evolve, and maintain a versatile, forward-looking visual identity system and find clear, fresh ways to apply it across surfaces. The brand designers on our team are multidisciplinary: they design robust visual systems, lead art direction, and craft surfaces that prioritize brand and product storytelling.</p> <p>Working with cross-functional teams across Stripe and external partners, we set the vision and execute to a high quality bar. Our work shows up IRL, online, and everywhere between.&nbsp;</p> <h2><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h2> <p>You’ll be joining a highly creative team that spans anywhere from developing storytelling to creating digital tools, brand systems to rapid ideation. The work is highly experimental, idea driven, and very collaborative and cross-functional.</p> <h3><strong>Responsibilities</strong></h3> <ul> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">&nbsp;</span>Be an adamant maker that is genuinely curious, experimental, and loves to tinker, iterate quickly, and innovate on ideas, narrative, and making beautiful things</li> <li>Contribute to raising the team's standards and culture of craft through the quality, clarity, and consistency of your own work</li> <li>Elevate and shape a brand system that is flexible enough to work across various surfaces and exemplifies Stripe’s commitment to craft &amp; beauty</li> <li>Collaborate with like-minded creative people who have radically different skill sets and together create ideas that envision an optimistic, progressive future</li> <li>Partner widely with cross-functional teams to build upon great ideas through making things</li> <li>Give and solicit feedback from wide range of teammates and stakeholders</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Who you are</strong></h2> <p>We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.</p> <h3><strong>Minimum requirements</strong></h3> <ul> <li>5+ years of relevant design and art direction experience for technical and product-driven companies&nbsp;</li> <li>Experience creating high-quality visual design work, with strong typography and a hands-on approach to making and iterating.</li> <li>Strong track record of independently delivering work as well as influencing the work of other designers, contractors, and agencies</li> <li>Experience applying and evolving a brand in a fast-paced environment.</li> <li>Proficient in Figma, Adobe Creative Cloud, Keynote, and Google slides</li> <li>Demonstrated experimentation with AI tools to both generate ideas, get stakeholders to see where an idea is headed, and to scale design</li> <li>Exceptional craft</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Preferred qualifications</strong></h3> <ul> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">&nbsp;</span>Curiosity, ambition, and a distinct point of view on design, with strong typography skills and an appreciation for creative process, technology, and design engineering.</li> <li>Are persuasive and humble in explaining your work, process, and decisions</li> <li>Have excellent organization and presentation skills, and excel in written and verbal communication</li> <li>Love working with other designers to help them learn and grow—and invite them to help you learn and grow</li> <li>Experience partnering with cross-functional teams.</li> <li>Creative coding or creative technologist background is a nice to have</li> </ul>

title: Senior Designer, Brand Advertising
description: <h2>Who we are</h2> <h3>About Stripe</h3> <p>Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.</p> <h3>About the team</h3> <p>The Design team works across most projects at Stripe—from our brand standards to campaigns, events, digital products, and even printed publications. And since Stripe’s main audience is other people who build products, we agonize over and take pride in crafting user-friendly and user-focused experiences.</p> <p>The Brand Design team lays the foundations that help Stripe accelerate. We do this by creating, evolving, and maintaining Stripe’s high-quality, versatile, and forward-looking visual identity design system. We sweat the details. We make it seem effortless.</p> <p>Our team—and our design efforts—are multipliers for Stripe and Stripes. Our focus on principles, systems, and standards makes it easier for all Stripes to get work done—at a high quality bar, while still creating space for evolution and innovation. Collaborating with other teams at Stripe, as well as select external partners, we raise the quality and consistency of interactions with the Stripe brand.</p> <p>Brand Designers at Stripe demonstrate passion for great design and for expanding, evolving, defining, and documenting flexible design systems that achieve bar-raising quality and consistency for the brand at scale. They are user focused, have a strong understanding of the business, and are empathetic and inspiring team leaders. The ideal candidate excels across a variety of styles, crisply articulates design decisions, iterates quickly, and collaborates seamlessly with marketers, producers, leaders, other designers, and agency partners.</p> <h2>What you'll do</h2> <p>Stripe is building one of the world's most important companies, and the way we show up creatively in the world matters. As a Senior Designer, Brand Advertising, you'll sit at the center of that work, concepting and crafting campaigns that earn attention, build brand equity, and reflect Stripe's ambition. You'll work day-to-day within the Advertising team while staying in close partnership with the Stripe Identity team, making sure every campaign is rooted in who Stripe is and where the brand is going.</p> <p>This is a role for someone who thinks in campaigns and executes with craft, equally comfortable generating a big idea and sweating the details of how it comes to life across every channel. This is a high-impact, high-ownership position where you will help define what advertising and campaigns can be and feel like, with craft and beauty.</p> <h3>Responsibilities</h3> <ul> <li>Concept, develop, and execute integrated campaigns across digital, film, print, OOH, and live activations, from early brief through final delivery</li> <li>Work closely with the Advertising team to build a strong, consistent creative pipeline that connects brand to business goals</li> <li>Partner with the Stripe Identity team to ensure campaign work is grounded in and advances Stripe's visual and verbal identity</li> <li>Translate briefs, user insights, and business objectives into campaign ideas that are both strategically sharp and creatively distinctive</li> <li>Present and champion ambitious creative work to stakeholders and senior leadership, building the case without diluting the idea</li> <li>Art direct external agencies, contractors, and collaborators, maintaining quality and brand alignment throughout</li> <li>Work closely with producer leads to drive program success, managing timelines, quality, and alignment across workstreams</li> <li>Contribute to raising the team's standards and culture of craft through the quality, clarity, and consistency of your own work</li> </ul> <h2>Who you are</h2> <p>We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.</p> <h3>Minimum requirements</h3> <ul> <li>5+ years of design and art direction experience, ideally at technical or product-driven companies</li> <li>A strong track record of independently delivering work while also influencing the output of other designers, contractors, and agencies</li> <li>Deep cross-functional collaboration skills, comfortable working across creative, product, marketing, and strategy</li> <li>Strategic instincts for building ambitious, globally facing brands in fast-moving environments</li> <li>Strong instincts across film, digital, print, OOH, and activations, with a genuine pulse on culture and the ability to translate that into concepts that earn attention</li> <li>A proven ability to sell ambitious creative work: concepting ideas and presenting them in a way that earns buy-in from senior leadership without flattening them</li> <li>A strong partnership mindset, particularly with producer leads, to drive programs forward with quality, clarity, and momentum</li> <li>Confident stakeholder management skills: able to navigate ambiguity, align competing priorities, and bring people in on the creative</li> <li>Proficiency in Figma, Adobe Creative Suite, and the latest AI workflows</li> <li>Exceptional craft and impeccable taste</li> </ul> <h3>Preferred qualifications</h3> <ul> <li>Genuinely curious, ambitious, and creative, with a sharp eye for typography, a deep appreciation for craft and the creative process, and a digitally native sensibility</li> <li>Persuasive and considered in presenting your work and process; skilled at facilitating stakeholder conversations without losing creative integrity</li> <li>Active experimentation with AI tools in the creative process, with an honest point of view on how they can shape the way work gets made</li> <li>Excellent written and verbal communication; strong organization and presentation skills</li> <li>Experience in sports marketing, sponsorship activations, or brand-in-culture work, with a perspective on how brands earn credibility in spaces they don't own</li> <li>Created work that generated genuine cultural traction, beyond media spend alone</li> <li>Able to art direct at a high level and think through how a design system or campaign idea can evolve and deepen over time</li> <li>Experience in environments where product and brand both had to pull their weight, and where the product itself was central to the creative story</li> <li>A history of award-caliber work, and the perspective to know that awards aren't always the goal, but that they have a real place in raising ambition, sharpening craft, and setting a team's creative standard</li> </ul>

title: Senior Leadership Recruiter
description: <h3><strong>Who we are</strong></h3> <h3><strong>About Stripe</strong></h3> <p>Stripe is a technology company that builds economic infrastructure for the internet. Businesses of all sizes—from new startups to public companies like Amazon and Salesforce—use our software to accept online payments and run technically sophisticated financial operations in more than 100 countries. By helping businesses accept payments from anywhere in the world and accelerating the economic shift from offline to online, we aim to increase the GDP of the internet.</p> <h3><strong>About the team</strong></h3> <p>Stripe’s Leadership Recruiting Team (LRT) is a high-performing group of strategic and creative problem solvers. We are passionate about finding and hiring the very best leaders and experts from around the globe to help drive the next arc of Stripe’s growth.&nbsp;&nbsp;</p> <h3><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h3> <p>In this role, you will be directly responsible for partnering with senior stakeholders to identify, attract, assess, and hire individuals for leadership roles across the company.</p> <h3><strong>Responsibilities</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Strategically partner with executives to hire top talent for Stripe’s highest priority leadership roles</li> <li>Define, design, and implement recruiting processes and search engagements for a variety of senior leadership roles. This includes understanding and mapping the talent landscape, internal calibration and referrals, and matching those data points with the external talent supply</li> <li>Manage end-to-end leadership-level searches from inception of candidate contact to onboarding, including research, outreach strategies, candidate experience, negotiations, partnering with HR for successful onboarding, and communicating with stakeholders along the way</li> <li>Collaborate with cross-functional partners, such as People Partners, Compensation, and Business Leads, to align hiring goals with business needs</li> <li>Develop competency-based interviews that surface a candidate’s full range of capabilities, explore their aspirations, and gain insight into how their experience will apply to a leadership role at Stripe</li> <li>Foster trust-based relationships with candidates, gaining a close understanding of their requirements and concerns. Serve as a skilled problem solver, facilitator and coach in final negotiations</li> <li>Utilize team-wide systems and tools to capture current market, client, and candidate information to facilitate both the search process and market intelligence initiatives</li> <li>Contribute to a team that values creative ideas and constant improvement.</li> <li>Be a contributing member of the recruiting team that effectively embodies and promotes the culture and values of Stripe. A quick guide to Stripe’s culture is located<a href="https://stripe.com/jobs/life-at-stripe"> here</a></li> </ul> <h3><strong>Who you are</strong></h3> <p>We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.</p> <h3><strong>Minimum requirements</strong></h3> <ul> <li>10+ years proven executive search experience.</li> <li>Proven experience in identifying, engaging, and closing senior-level passive candidates.</li> <li>Outstanding sourcing skills and ability to think ‘outside the box.’</li> <li>Experience partnering with team and hiring managers, including the executive team.</li> <li>Prior use of talent market insights and data to influence decisions within the leadership groups and cross-functional teams.</li> <li>Demonstrated track record of building working relationships with leaders and cross-functional partners - we value a Users First approach to executive search, ensuring a positive experience for candidates and hiring managers alike.</li> <li>Evidence of creating and maintaining positive candidate experiences.</li> <li>Ability to distill complex information into a consumable and organized format with a focus on content, tone, and structure - we value Craft and Beauty across all of our outputs.</li> <li>Ability to take ownership and effectively manage time and process across roles.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Preferred qualifications</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Experience in both search firms and in-house</li> </ul>

description: <h2>Who we are</h2> <h3>About Stripe</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.</span></p> <h3>About the team</h3> <p>Trust is central to Stripe’s mission to grow the GDP of the internet and the Risk team advances that mission by building products and infrastructure that Stripe businesses, Stripe product teams, and Stripe’s network of regulators and financial partners rely on. From helping businesses onboard to Stripe to managing regulatory compliance at scale, Risk is at the center of what makes Stripe run. The Technical Program Manager team is responsible for delivering the cross-Stripe programs that help businesses grow on Stripe, enable products to launch safely at scale, and Stripe to maintain its position as the most trusted network in the financial ecosystem.</p> <h2>What you’ll do</h2> <p>You will lead a team of TPMs and PGMs to deliver on Stripe’s most complex, cross-cutting, and critical programs. title: Senior Mechanical and Industrial Design Engineer
description: <h2><strong>Who we are</strong></h2> <h2><strong>About Stripe</strong></h2> <p>Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies, from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups, use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.</p> <h2><strong>About the team</strong></h2> <p>Stripe Terminal helps businesses extend their online presence into the physical world. Our mission is to make it as easy for businesses to accept in-person payments as the Stripe API has made it for online payments. With Terminal, businesses can create flagship retail experiences, extend their websites to pop-up stores, or enable mobile point-of-sale payments at their next event. All of this is built on the Stripe Payments Platform, so businesses can maintain a single view of customers and sales across online and offline channels.</p> <p>Our hardware engineering team in Taiwan designs and builds the physical payment devices at the heart of that experience, including products such as the Stripe Reader S700 and Stripe Reader M2. We are expanding the team and seeking an experienced Senior Mechanical and Industrial Design Engineer who can own both the structural engineering and aesthetic form language of our next generation of payment terminals. This is a blended role. You will be equally comfortable driving design for manufacturability (DFM) for a plastic enclosure and sketching form concepts that express Stripe's design identity in hardware.</p> <h2><strong>What you'll do</strong></h2> <p>You will lead the industrial and mechanical design of next-generation Stripe Terminal payment devices, shaping their form, feel, usability, and structural performance from early concepts through mass production. You will partner with cross-functional teams and suppliers to deliver manufacturable, high-quality hardware, including enclosure design, color, material, and finish specifications, packaging, validation, and production readiness.</p> <h2><strong>Responsibilities</strong></h2> <h3><strong>Industrial design</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Lead ideation and concept development through rapid hand sketching, digital sketching, and physical foam or 3D-printed models to explore form factors early in the product lifecycle.</li> <li>Define the visual and tactile design language of Terminal hardware, including proportion, form, surface transitions, button feel, and overall product character.</li> <li>Produce photorealistic product renders using KeyShot or similar tools to communicate design intent to cross-functional teams and executive stakeholders.</li> <li>Define and manage color, material, and finish (CMF) specifications. Work directly with suppliers to qualify target surfaces, textures, and coatings.</li> <li>Manage packaging design, working directly with suppliers to qualify final deliverables and the unboxing experience.</li> <li>Apply ergonomics and human factors principles to ensure products are intuitive and comfortable for a diverse range of users and environments.</li> <li>Maintain visual consistency and brand coherence across the Terminal hardware product family, in alignment with Stripe's design identity.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Mechanical engineering</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Design mechanical components and assemblies using SolidWorks or Creo, following professional engineering standards.</li> <li>Hands on experience in mechanical designs and drawings, assess manufacturability, and resolve technical problems.</li> <li>Lead and plan problem-solving activities using scientific approaches, such as tolerance analysis, computer-aided engineering (CAE) and finite element method (FEM) simulations, design of experiments (DOE), and physical prototyping.</li> <li>Independently analyze and verify mechanical designs, identify risks, and propose mitigations.</li> <li>Manage bill of materials (BOM) cost and design schedules from a mechanical engineering perspective.</li> <li>Prepare mechanical engineering deliverables, including BOMs, component specifications, and support for failure mode and effects analysis (FMEA) activities.</li> <li>Review Design fixtures and calibration processes for high-precision mechanical assemblies.</li> <li>Verify and qualify components in first-article builds from suppliers, and participate in pilot production.</li> <li>Produce and maintain engineering documents, including specifications, design-for-excellence (DFx) guidelines, technical reports, and gate-review packages.</li> <li>Partner with Quality and Reliability teams to support successful validation outcomes and improve hardware durability standards.</li> <li>Support product compliance and certification activities, including Payment Card Industry (PCI) and regulatory certifications.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Who you are</strong></h2> <p>We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements listed below. If you meet these requirements, we strongly encourage you to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.</p> <h3><strong>Minimum requirements</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Design, or a closely related field.</li> <li>8+ years of hands-on product design experience spanning mechanical engineering and industrial design, with a portfolio of consumer or commercial hardware products. This includes experience designing consumer-grade plastic enclosures for handheld products, such as smartphones, tablets, or payment terminals, from concept through mass production.</li> <li>Ability to communicate design concepts through hand or digital sketching at the pace of a design conversation, and experience defining CMF specifications with suppliers.</li> <li>Solid understanding of manufacturing and mechanical production processes, with direct experience taking industrial design concepts through DFM, tooling, and production.</li> <li>Proficiency in mechanical CAD software. Creo is required, and SolidWorks is a plus. Expertise in creating detailed 2D drawings and performing geometric dimensioning and tolerancing (GD&amp;T) and tolerance analysis.</li> <li>Familiarity with mold design, first-article inspection (FAI) processes, and process capability (Cpk) analysis, along with experience managing supplier and factory relationships.</li> <li>Strong written and spoken English and Mandarin communication skills to collaborate directly with suppliers in Taiwan, Hong Kong, and mainland China throughout product development and production. Willingness to travel internationally, including to Hong Kong and mainland China, as needed.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Preferred qualifications</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Proficiency in rendering software, with KeyShot strongly preferred. VRED or Blender experience is also valued.</li> <li>Experience maintaining a coherent design language across a multi-SKU hardware product family or accessory ecosystem.</li> <li>Familiarity with ergonomics methodologies, including grip studies, anthropometric data, and usability evaluations, applied to handheld device design.</li> <li>Experience with point-of-sale hardware, payment terminals, or consumer electronics peripherals.</li> <li>Knowledge of PCI hardware requirements, material properties, and associated manufacturing processes.</li> <li>Proficiency in thermal calculations and an understanding of plastic material properties.</li> <li>Experience with mechanical simulation tools and metal-part design.</li> <li>Ability to create compelling design presentations for cross-functional and executive audiences, clearly articulating the rationale behind design decisions.</li> </ul>

title: Senior Product Manager, Enterprise
location: San Francisco, Seattle, New York, Chicago, Atlanta, Remote
description: <h2>Who we are</h2> <h3>About Stripe</h3> <p>Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.</p> <h3>About the team</h3> <p>The Enterprise Product team is responsible for bridging the gap between Stripe's core capabilities and the bespoke needs of the world's largest organizations. We are hiring product managers who will be aligned to specific priority industries (e.g., insurance, healthcare, public sector), with each product manager acting as the "CEO" of their assigned vertical—identifying high-leverage opportunities, building 0-to-1 products to solve industry-specific blockers, and influencing our global product roadmap. You will be a critical partner to GTM leadership (Sales, Partnerships, Marketing) and a navigator across the broader Product organization. We are looking for high-agency builders who thrive in ambiguity and know how to move mountains through both direct execution and cross-functional influence.</p> <h2>What you'll do</h2> <p>We're hiring a product manager to own Stripe's product strategy and execution across our priority industry verticals, starting with complex, regulated industries like insurance, healthcare, and public sector. We are seeking a highly-entrepreneurial, data-driven product leader who will define where Stripe plays, build 0-to-1 products to unlock new revenue, and influence Stripe's broader Product organization to meet the unique needs of enterprise customers in your vertical. The products you build will directly shape how the world's largest companies use Stripe—and how Stripe grows within one of its most strategic segments.</p> <h3>Responsibilities</h3> <ul> <li>Own the industry product roadmap—Define and execute the multi-year product strategy for your priority vertical. Translate your "where to play and how to win" thesis into a concrete roadmap—deciding what Stripe builds natively, what we solve through platform extensibility, and where we partner. Own measurable outcomes tied to revenue, adoption, and merchant satisfaction.</li> <li>Ship 0→1 products—Identify unmet needs through deep customer research, data analysis, and market intelligence. Lead the full product lifecycle for industry-relevant functionality—from problem definition and technical scoping with engineering, through PRD, API and UX design, build, launch, and post-launch iteration. You'll make hands-on trade-off decisions about scope, technical approach, and sequencing with your engineering team.</li> <li>Be a strategic partner to GTM and customers—Work deeply with our largest customers, partners, and GTM teams. Translate "market noise" into clear product signal—shaping feature requirements, and defining the data models and integration patterns that enterprise customers in your vertical need.</li> <li>Act as a force multiplier across Stripe's platform—Influence Stripe's core product teams (Payments, Billing, Connect, and beyond) to ensure their roadmaps reflect the requirements of enterprise customers in your vertical. To do this credibly, you'll need to go deep on Stripe's platform—understanding our APIs, infrastructure constraints, and extensibility model—so you can advocate for changes with technical specificity, not just business cases.</li> </ul> <h2>Who you are</h2> <p>We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.</p> <h3>Minimum requirements</h3> <ul> <li>12+ years of product management experience, with a track record of shipping successful products in complex, regulated environments.</li> <li>Technical fluency—You don't need to write code, but you're comfortable reading an API spec, reasoning about system design trade-offs, and holding your own in engineering discussions. You've shipped products where the "how we build it" mattered as much as the "what."</li> <li>Deep customer obsession—A talent for getting close to customers—talking to merchants and partners—and distilling complex pain points into simple, elegant product requirements.</li> <li>Analytical rigor—You use data—not just intuition—to prioritize. You're comfortable defining metrics frameworks, digging into usage data, and making quantitative arguments for (or against) product investments.</li> <li>A master communicator—Stripe is a writing-heavy culture. You must be able to articulate deep technical and strategic concepts through precise, persuasive prose—your narrative docs are things of beauty.</li> <li>High agency and influence—Adept at finding "homes" for initiatives, building consensus across disparate teams, and driving momentum without needing formal authority.</li> <li>Entrepreneurial mindset and bias for action—Comfortable with ambiguity, skilled at prioritizing high-impact initiatives, and experienced operating with limited resources to unlock outsized outcomes.</li> </ul> <h3>Preferred qualifications</h3> <ul> <li>Direct experience building products in Healthtech, Insurtech, Public Sector, or similarly complex, regulated industries.</li> <li>Experience building platform, API, or developer-facing products.</li> <li>Experience working closely with Enterprise Sales teams and C-suite stakeholders at Fortune 500 companies.</li> </ul>

title: Senior Staff Product Manager, Risk
description: <h2 id="who-we-are">Who we are</h2> <h3 id="about-stripe">About Stripe</h3> <p>Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and create new business models. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing some of the most important work of your career. You can read more about the business we’re building and what we’re looking forward to in our annual letter.</p> <h3 id="about-the-team">About the team</h3> <p>The Risk team builds trust, an essential ingredient for Stripe’s mission to increase the GDP of the internet. We make it possible for millions of businesses to access and use Stripe’s financial infrastructure while protecting our users, financial partners, and the broader ecosystem from harm.</p> <p>Risk sits at the center of our users’ and Stripe’s ability to grow safely. We help legitimate businesses access Stripe’s financial services, provide credit to creditworthy businesses, and increasingly help users manage their own risk. We also prevent fraud and financial crime, manage Stripe’s credit exposure, meet our obligations to regulators and financial partners, and enable Stripe’s product teams to launch and grow products safely. To do this, we set the policies and standards that guide how Stripe manages risk and develop the advanced AI, infrastructure, and product experiences that put them into practice for Stripe and our users.</p> <p>At Stripe’s scale—$1.9T in annual payment volume, equivalent to 1.6% of global GDP, across millions of businesses—we face risk problems no other company has encountered. The opportunities and complexities are only growing as AI reshapes what is possible, Stripe expands its product suite, regulators raise their expectations, and we support more businesses in more countries.</p> <h2 id="what-youll-do">What you’ll do</h2> <p>As a Senior Staff Product Manager for Risk, you will lead cross-Risk and cross-Stripe initiatives that fundamentally change how Stripe and our users manage risk. You will identify the most important opportunities that cut across Risk’s infrastructure and products, define solutions to our most ambiguous problems, and drive execution from early technical shaping through delivery and adoption.</p> <p>You will operate as a product counterpart to Risk’s senior technical leaders. You will shape infrastructure and product direction across Risk, connect work that would otherwise remain fragmented, and help product teams across Stripe build on Risk’s capabilities. You will remain deeply engaged in the work, helping teams navigate difficult technical and product decisions.</p> <p>You will partner closely with Risk leadership to shape the organization’s strategy, vision, and most important investments. As a senior member of Stripe’s product community, you will also coach other PMs, raise the quality of product thinking across Risk, and advance the product management discipline across Stripe.</p> <h3 id="responsibilities">Responsibilities</h3> <ul> <li>Identify high-leverage problems that cut across teams, turn ambiguity into clear product and technical direction, and establish measurable outcomes.</li> <li>Lead major cross-Risk and cross-Stripe initiatives from initial shaping through delivery, adoption, and iteration.</li> <li>Lead changes to Risk’s approach to leveraging data and AI to accurately identify and mitigate risk at scale.</li> <li>Partner deeply with engineering, data science, and ML leaders to shape architecture, data foundations, models, APIs, and product experiences.</li> <li>Help product teams across Stripe build on Risk’s capabilities quickly and effectively, while guiding Risk teams toward coherent, reusable infrastructure and product decisions.</li> <li>Partner with Risk leadership to define multi-year strategy, identify the organization’s most important bets, and make clear investment and sequencing decisions.</li> <li>Build alignment among teams with different goals and constraints, resolving difficult tradeoffs and driving progress without relying on formal authority.</li> <li>Coach and mentor PMs across Risk, helping them strengthen their product judgment, technical depth, strategic thinking, and execution.</li> <li>Advance the product management discipline across Stripe by raising the bar for how we define problems, develop strategy, partner with technical teams, and deliver complex cross-organizational work.</li> </ul> <h2 id="who-you-are">Who you are</h2> <p>We’re looking for an exceptional product leader who combines strong technical judgment with product insight, strategic range, and executional rigor. You identify important problems before they become obvious, bring clarity to deeply ambiguous spaces, and mobilize teams around solutions that work across products, organizations, and time horizons. You are deeply curious and stay at the forefront of advances in AI and technology, finding practical ways to apply them to our most challenging problems.</p> <p>You move fluently from defining multi-year strategy to driving the details of execution. You build alignment and lead transformational work across teams without direct management authority. You earn trust through the clarity of your thinking, your focus on users, and your hands-on engagement in the work. You raise the ambition and effectiveness of the teams and PMs around you without needing to manage them.</p> <h3 id="minimum-requirements">Minimum requirements</h3> <ul> <li>A track record of identifying and delivering high-impact, transformational product or technical initiatives that span multiple teams and organizations.</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to bring clarity to deeply ambiguous problems, set a compelling direction, and drive work through execution and adoption.</li> <li>Strong technical judgment across data, machine learning, AI, APIs, platforms, and system architecture.</li> <li>Experience partnering deeply with senior engineering, data science, and product leaders to shape both technical direction and product strategy.</li> <li>Strong product judgment across foundational infrastructure and user-facing experiences, with a focus on building capabilities that solve real user problems.</li> <li>Deep quantitative fluency and the ability to use data and causal reasoning to understand problems, evaluate tradeoffs, and measure outcomes.</li> <li>Proven ability to influence senior leaders, build alignment across organizational boundaries, and drive execution without direct management authority.</li> <li>Experience mentoring and developing PMs and raising the quality of product thinking and execution across teams.</li> <li>Exceptional written and verbal communication, with the ability to articulate compelling strategies, influence technical and executive audiences, and make complex topics clear.</li> <li>High agency, intellectual honesty, curiosity, and a low-ego, hands-on working style.</li> </ul> <h3 id="preferred-qualifications">Preferred qualifications</h3> <ul> <li>An engineering and preferably ML-based technical background.</li> <li>Experience applying AI and machine learning to complex, high-stakes problems at scale.</li> <li>Experience with fraud, credit, payments, financial services, trust and safety, or another domain involving complex decisions and asymmetric consequences.</li> <li>Experience working with globally distributed teams</li> </ul>

title: Social & Content Marketing, Stripe Crypto
description: <h2>About Privy</h2> <p>Our mission is to make privacy and user ownership the default online. To do so, we build simple, flexible APIs and tools for developers that make it easy to build new products on crypto rails.</p> <p>Privy owns the abstractions and infrastructure layer above wallets, integrating across chains, third-party providers, and Stripe products like Treasury and Link. We get to solve hard technical problems while leveraging Stripe's distribution to reach customers like Ramp, Klarna, Deel, Kraken, Hyperliquid, and Fomo — powering experiences for both mainstream users and crypto natives.</p> <p>Learn more about Privy: <a href="https://privy.io/blog/announcing-our-acquisition-by-stripe">Privy and Stripe: Bringing crypto to everyone</a></p> <h2>What you’ll do</h2> <p>We’re looking for an exceptional social and content marketer to help shape how some of the most important products in crypto show up on the internet.</p> <p>This is a hybrid role: part social lead, part writer and editor, part content strategist. You’ll own how Privy, Bridge, and Stripe Crypto show up across social, primarily on X and LinkedIn, while developing content that extends beyond the feed.</p> <p>You’ll turn product launches, customer stories, technical concepts, and industry conversations into sharp, compelling content across short- and long-form formats. You’ll work closely with the Head of Marketing and broader marketing team to find the stories worth telling, partnering with Product, Engineering, and other teams to bring them to life.</p> <p>This is Millions of companies—from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.</p> <h3>About the team</h3> <p>The Core Infrastructure team at Stripe is entrusted with developing and maintaining the infrastructure utilized by all product teams to create services that underpin all Stripe business operations. This includes defining and executing a vision that ensures industry-leading scale and availability, and actively balancing these concerns with efficiency, latency, and organizational health. We are committed to advancing new distributed services and scaling existing technologies across the industry, in close collaboration with various teams to support their current and future demands, and various external partners in the open source community.</p> <p>Our infrastructure supports businesses worldwide by processing payments, managing marketplaces, assisting entrepreneurs in launching internet businesses, and more. The Infrastructure organization comprises teams responsible for operating system components, databases, caching, high availability, disaster recovery, cloud infrastructure, Linux servers, container orchestration, mesh networking, service discovery, change management, and network edge infrastructure.</p> <h2>What you'll do</h2> <p>As a Software Engineer on the Infrastructure team, you will be part of a team that is in charge of building the core infrastructure used by product teams which support our business. Examples include control plane services responsible for managing our primary database and cache infrastructure as well as building automation around managing cloud components for compute, cache, and networking. You will also build a great customer experience for internal Stripe teams that build on your software to power all of our products, globally and at scale.</p> <h3>Responsibilities</h3> <ul> <li>Design, build, and maintain distributed cloud infrastructure and platform services</li> <li>Work on scaling, automation, reliability, and observability of infrastructure services</li> <li>Operate your service, debug issues, and support customers</li> <li>Participate in roadmap planning and prioritization</li> </ul> <h2>Who you are</h2> <p>We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.</p> <h3>Minimum requirements</h3> <ul> <li>5+ years of professional experience in a software development role</li> <li>Experience building, deploying, and managing infrastructure on a major cloud provider</li> <li>A strong engineering background in building platform services and/or distributed systems at scale, with a solid grasp of underlying operating system primitives</li> <li>Experience developing, maintaining, and debugging distributed systems, including diagnosing low-level resource constraints</li> <li>Experience with operational excellence and modern observability practices, including distributed tracing, structured logging, and system-level metrics</li> </ul> <h3>Preferred Qualifications</h3> <ul> <li>Experience with popular cloud technologies — AWS, Azure, GCP, or Oracle Cloud</li> <li>Experience with Go or other systems languages (e.g., Rust, C/C++)</li> <li>Experience with Linux OS internals, performance optimization, and kernel-level troubleshooting</li> <li>Experience working with Kubernetes clusters and low-level container mechanics</li> <li>Experience in networking and traffic systems at scale</li> <li>Experience handling critical incidents for production systems</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p>

You may work on a wide variety of critical business areas including</p> <ul> <li>Core Infrastructure—We're the home for Stripe's critical tier-0 infrastructure systems (Compute, Networking, DocumentDB, Distributed Caching, and High assurance engineering). We build the foundational platform for Stripe products and services to allow them to operate at scale.
