We work on enabling new technologies for product and platform teams, prioritizing business needs as well as building the tooling and controls that further enable self-serve, guaranteeing we maintain a high bar across all Stripe surfaces with security in-built into foundations.</li> <li>Application and Revenue Platform—We build the powerful and scalable infrastructure that powers the company's application offerings and supports the processing and management of global transaction volumes.</li> </ul> <p>Team Matching—exact team matching for one of the sub-teams within one of these organizations will begin during final stages. Please note we may also consider you for different organizations based on your experience, location, etc.</p> <h2>What you'll do</h2> <p>We're looking for software engineers who are interested in building software services and platforms that impact thousands of employees and millions of Stripe users, regardless of whether they're an end user, developer, or partner. You'll work on projects that span technologies, systems, and processes where you'll design, build, test, and ship great code every day.</p> <h3>Responsibilities</h3> <ul> <li>Build a great customer experience for internal and external Stripe teams using our infrastructure</li> <li>Participate in roadmap planning and prioritization</li> <li>Deliver value through a strong collaborative approach with multiple customers and stakeholders across Stripe</li> <li>Debug production issues across services and several levels of the stack</li> </ul> <h2>Who you are</h2> <p>We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.</p> <h3>Minimum requirements</h3> <ul> <li>7+ years of industry software engineering experience (does not include internships or co-ops)</li> <li>Ability to write well-factored algorithms and experience with commonly used data structures and algorithms</li> <li>Hands-on experience contributing to or building large-scale distributed systems</li> <li>Strong coding skills in any programming language (we understand engineers learn new languages on the job, so our interview process is language agnostic)</li> <li>Strong collaboration skills and the ability to work across workstreams within your team and contribute to your peers' success</li> <li>Ability to thrive on a high level of autonomy and responsibility, with an entrepreneurial mindset</li> <li>Interest in working as a generalist across varying technologies and stacks to solve problems and delight both internal and external users</li> </ul> <h3>Preferred qualifications</h3> <ul> <li>Experience optimizing the end-to-end performance of distributed systems</li> <li>Focus on the needs of our users, both internal and external</li> <li>Hold yourself and others to a high bar when working with production</li> </ul>

title: Software Engineer, Data Orchestration
description: <h2>Who we are</h2> <h3>About Stripe</h3> <p>Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.</p> <h3>About the team</h3> <p>The Big Data Infrastructure operates the critical infrastructure that powers the batch data processing at Stripe. The team supports a variety of use cases, including Payment, Ledger, ML, Fraud Detection, Product Analytics, Regulatory Reporting, Financial Data Reconciliation, and externally facing products like Radar and Sigma. As an example of the scale, the team's systems serve hundreds of teams, thousands of workflows, 100,000+ task executions, O(billion) transformations, and moving terabytes of data processing over 1 GB/second every day. Our users inside Stripe include other engineering teams, Data Scientists, Sales and Operations, Finance, etc.</p> <p>Data Orchestration builds and operates the time-based and event-based orchestration infrastructure that powers and accelerates batch data pipelines. The team operates on a wide range of tech stacks including Airflow, Spark, SQL, Kafka, Flink, Hive MetaStore, Trino, Pinot, Python, Java, Scala, S3, and Iceberg.</p> <h2>What you'll do</h2> <p>As a Software Engineer on this team, you'll design and build infrastructure that powers batch data processing at Stripe.</p> <h3>Responsibilities</h3> <ul> <li>Design, build, and maintain next-generation and first-generation versions of key Data Platform products, with an emphasis on usability, reliability, security, and efficiency.</li> <li>Design ergonomic APIs and abstractions that build a great customer experience for internal Stripes, that will in turn enhance the experience of millions of Stripe users.</li> <li>Ensure operational excellence and enable a highly available and reliable Data Orchestration platform across batch workloads.</li> <li>Collaborate with high-visibility teams and their stakeholders to support their key initiatives—while building a robust platform that benefits all of Stripe in the long term.</li> <li>Plan for the growth of Stripe infrastructure by unblocking, supporting, and communicating with internal partners to achieve results.</li> <li>Connect your work with improvements in the usability and reliability of open source software (OSS) like Apache Airflow, Iceberg, and Spark, and contribute back to the OSS community.</li> </ul> <h2>Who you are</h2> <p>We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.</p> <h3>Minimum requirements</h3> <ul> <li>8+ years of professional experience writing high-quality, production-level code or software programs and an interest in data infrastructure.</li> <li>Has experience operating or enabling large-scale, high-availability data pipelines from design to execution and safe change management. Expertise in Spark, Flink, Airflow, Python, Java, SQL, and API design is a plus.</li> <li>Has experience developing, maintaining, and debugging distributed systems built with open source tools.</li> <li>Has experience building infrastructure-as-a-product with a strong focus on user needs.</li> <li>Has strong collaboration and communication skills, and can interact with both technical and non-technical participants.</li> <li>Has the curiosity to learn about new technologies and business processes.</li> <li>Is energized by delivering effective, user-first solutions through creative problem-solving and collaboration.</li> </ul> <h3>Preferred qualifications</h3> <ul> <li>Has experience writing production-level code in Scala, Spark, Flink, Airflow, Python, Java, and SQL.</li> <li>Has experience designing APIs or building developer platforms.</li> <li>Has experience optimizing the end-to-end performance of distributed systems.</li> <li>Has experience scaling distributed systems in a fast-moving environment.</li> <li>Has experience working with Airflow infrastructure.</li> <li>Genuine enjoyment of innovation and an interest in understanding how things work.</li> </ul> <p>Office-assigned Stripes spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This hits a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility about how to do this in a way that makes sense for individuals and their teams.</p> <p>Office location—Bengaluru, KA, India</p>

title: Software Engineer, Early Career — Immediate Start
description: <h2><strong>This role is for applicants actively looking to start before December 1, 2026.</strong></h2> <h2><strong>Who we are</strong></h2> <h3><strong>About Stripe</strong></h3> <p>Stripe is a technology company focused on improving the conditions for economic growth and prosperity. We build programmable financial infrastructure, rethinking from first principles how financial services should work, to make it easier and cheaper for any business to start and scale. More than 10 million <a href="https://stripe.com/customers">businesses</a> build on Stripe, spanning the economic frontier—from solo founders to established enterprises—united by a practical focus on growth. The most ambitious companies in the world use Stripe as core infrastructure to grow faster. They process trillions of dollars a year on Stripe, equivalent to around 1.6% of global GDP. While economic growth makes everyone better off, open markets also enable greater variety. When any business can easily serve a global customer base, the quality and diversity of products in the world increase, and craft and creativity are unleashed into the smallest niches. Our own growth is wholly contingent on the success of the businesses building on Stripe. We therefore invest back into our technology at an unusual rate. We make <a href="https://stripe.com/roadmap">upgrades to our products</a> every single day to deliver compounding gains to our customers. We maintain some of the most <a href="https://status.stripe.com/">reliable APIs</a> on the internet. We build entirely new <a href="https://tempo.xyz/">pieces</a> of <a href="https://mpp.dev/">financial</a> <a href="https://joinopenstandard.com/">infrastructure</a> to enable new ideas. And our significant advances in <a href="https://stripe.com/radar">risk and fraud</a> infrastructure over many years are making the internet economy safer and more accessible.&nbsp;&nbsp;</p> <p>Though people at Stripe don’t tend to take themselves seriously, Stripe is a fairly serious place: our customers are depending on us for their livelihoods. We admire ambition, intensity, curiosity, humility, and rigor. The most effective people become knowledgeable about many domains besides their own. Any company is an applied exercise in understanding some aspect of society or the market. In working with so many (especially the new and innovative ones), we think that Stripe is one of the very best places to learn about how the world works.</p> <h2><strong>Your role</strong><strong><br></strong></h2> <p>Stripe is large enough that individual products and projects can be rapidly deployed to a meaningful fraction of the world’s businesses, but small enough that individual agency still has outsized impact. Small teams can impact how millions of businesses grow. Right now the global economy is replatforming around AI, creating new opportunities for growth. We’re at the center of this, and we think the best work is still in front of us.</p> <p>To meet this moment, we’re looking for people who move with urgency, like hard problems, and want their work to matter at a time of great change. If that’s you, there’s no better place to build your career.</p> <h2><strong>Who you are</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Ambitious builder: You’re energized by building solutions without clear precedent and solving problems with far-reaching consequences. Successful Stripes are deeply curious, and prefer the joy of discovery to the comfort of certainty.</li> <li>Rigorous thinker: You appreciate that things worth doing are rarely simple. You enjoy working on problems that have never been tackled before.&nbsp;</li> <li>Adaptable problem solver: You adapt quickly and treat obstacles as opportunities.&nbsp; At Stripe we embrace kindness while encouraging Stripes to take measured risks and act boldly, even in the absence of consensus.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Minimum requirements</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Must be available to start full-time before December 1, 2026</li> <li>A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in computer science or a directly related field, obtained by summer 2026, or equivalent work experience</li> <li>New grad candidates should have no more than 18 months of professional experience (excluding internship experience)</li> <li>Experience and familiarity with programming, either through side projects or classwork. We work mostly in Java, Ruby, JavaScript, Scala, and Go. We believe new programming languages can be learned if the fundamentals and general knowledge are present.</li> <li>Experience from either previous internships or working collaboratively on multi-person coding projects (in a university or professional setting).</li> <li>Ability to learn unfamiliar systems and form an understanding of those systems, through independent research and working with a mentor or subject matter experts.</li> <li>Clear written communication skills, with the ability to explain your work to stakeholders, team members, and other Stripes.</li> <li>Ability to leverage AI tools to accelerate development while applying rigorous critical thinking and professional judgement to review, refine, and validate all outputs.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Preferred qualifications</strong></h3> <ul> <li>One or more areas of specialized knowledge (frontend, backend, infrastructure or other technologies) balanced with general skills and knowledge.&nbsp;</li> <li>Experience in code review practices, and an understanding of how to safely update production systems.</li> <li>Familiarity with navigating and managing work in large code bases.</li> <li>Experience leading small projects independently, and contributing to larger projects alongside peers.</li> <li>Ability to operate with high agency in navigating complex technical obstacles independently, knowing precisely when to unblock oneself and when to ask for help.&nbsp;</li> </ul>

title: Software Engineer, Financial Business Insights
description: <h2>Who we are</h2> <h3>About Stripe</h3> <p>Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.</p> <h3>About the team</h3> <p>Our mission is to enable effective financial decisions through reliable data, increased efficiency, and automation. We support Marketing, Sales, Seller, Accounting, Tax, Finance and Strategy (F&amp;S), Finance Operations (FinOps), and Treasury functions across automation, data insights, and process improvements.</p> <p>You may work on a wide variety of critical business areas including</p> <p><strong>Seller Systems</strong>&nbsp;— Responsible for building the systems and tooling that make sellers and internal revenue teams at Stripe dramatically more productive and effective. We partner with Sales, Finance, Legal, and Product to deliver a single "plane of glass" selling experience that spans deal creation and modeling, negotiation and approvals, contracting, onboarding, and activation. The Seller Systems team composes first‑party, custom Stripe components with best‑in‑class third‑party business systems to deliver configurable, auditable, and globally scalable workflows. Engineers on Seller Systems build services, APIs, integrations, data pipelines, and internal UIs that power seller productivity, reduce time‑to‑activation, improve deal velocity, and enable AI‑driven assistive workflows. Use cases include deal modeling and pricing engines, approval and orchestration platforms, CLM/CPQ integrations, onboarding automation, seller analytics, and AI‑assisted seller tooling.</p> <p><strong>Finance Engineering</strong>&nbsp;— Responsible for building the robust and scalable infrastructure that powers the company's core financial operations, including payments processing, fund settlement, accounting, and business intelligence. The Finance Engineering team is at the core of Stripe to empower business-critical financial domains including Accounting, Finance operations, Finance and Strategy, and Treasury. Engineers on the Financial Engineering team build platforms, data pipelines, and financial products for the Finance team. The use cases include financial analytics and insights, accounting automation, auditing, financial planning and forecasting, and financial business intelligence.</p> <p><strong>Marketing and Sales Systems</strong>&nbsp;— Responsible for building the most measurable, cross-channel messaging capability possible, to attract and engage customers. We do this through scalable motions, with the most relevant messaging and increasing reach of our marketing motions. We are a cross-functional team of engineers, analysts, marketers, and product managers that deliver the insights, internal systems and tools that fuel growth at Stripe.</p> <p>As part of the Marketing Systems team, you own systems that power go-to-market motions productizing gathered insights and intelligence. This includes building tools that 1/ power better digital experiences, 2/ accelerate customer journey with intelligent orchestrations, 3/ drive smarter decisions with CDP, and 4/ improve marketer and seller productivity.</p> <h2>What you'll do</h2> <p>We're looking for Software Engineers who want to make an impact on managing money at a global scale with a passion for building ergonomic APIs. You'll play a key role in extending our balance management platform and in building out a new funds accessibility platform leveraged by enterprises and SMBs alike. Our team collaborates with many cross-functional teams — from Infrastructure to Product — at Stripe to deliver innovative solutions that address evolving user needs.</p> <h3>Responsibilities</h3> <ul> <li>Design, build, and maintain beautiful, robust, and high-performance APIs and services</li> <li>Ensure our infrastructure is extensible, scalable, reliable, and meets service-level agreements for both external and internal users&nbsp;</li> <li>Hide complexity from our users behind simple yet powerful abstractions&nbsp;</li> <li>Partner closely with other engineers, analysts, and scientists to build highly scalable systems, to deliver delightful developer experiences and comprehensive interfaces&nbsp;</li> <li>Build the APIs that power internal stakeholder-facing UI experiences, defining composable data models and durable interfaces&nbsp;</li> <li>Debug production issues across services and multiple levels of the stack with an eye towards improving maintainability over the long term&nbsp;</li> <li>Improve engineering standards, tooling, and processes</li> </ul> <h2>Who you are</h2> <p>We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.</p> <h3>Minimum requirements</h3> <ul> <li><strong>8+ years of experience</strong> designing, implementing, and operating large-scale, high-performance APIs and services&nbsp;</li> <li>You have implemented server-side APIs in dynamic languages like Ruby, working with document and relational datastores (especially Mongo and MySQL) and enjoy spelunking through new datasets (especially in systems like Redshift, Presto, or Trino).</li> <li>Empathetic, collaborative, and user-first mindset in everything you build and have excellent oral and written communication</li> <li>Experience proactively seeking feedback from users, teammates, and subject matter experts</li> <li>The skills to build holistically — from specs and documentation to implementation, testing, deployment, and measuring impact and ability to balance speed, complexity, and scope in service of user needs</li> </ul> <h3>Preferred qualifications</h3> <ul> <li>Experience with large-scale financial tracking systems&nbsp;</li> <li>Good understanding and practical knowledge in cloud-based services (e.g. gRPC, GraphQL, Docker and Kubernetes, cloud services such as AWS, etc.)&nbsp;</li> <li>Experience in marketing domain building products that contribute to marketing tech stack&nbsp;</li> <li>Experience with machine learning, recommender systems, product-led growth, or lifecycle marketing&nbsp;</li> <li>Prior experience building distributed systems or a microservices architecture</li> </ul>

title: Software Engineer, Intern
description: <h2><strong>Who we are</strong></h2> <h3><strong>About Stripe</strong></h3> <p>Stripe is a technology company focused on improving the conditions for economic growth and prosperity. We build programmable financial infrastructure, rethinking from first principles how financial services should work, to make it easier and cheaper for any business to start and scale. More than 10 million <a href="https://stripe.com/customers">businesses</a> build on Stripe, spanning the economic frontier—from solo founders to established enterprises—united by a practical focus on growth. The most ambitious companies in the world use Stripe as core infrastructure to grow faster. They process trillions of dollars a year on Stripe, equivalent to around 1.6% of global GDP. While economic growth makes everyone better off, open markets also enable greater variety. When any business can easily serve a global customer base, the quality and diversity of products in the world increase, and craft and creativity are unleashed into the smallest niches. Our own growth is wholly contingent on the success of the businesses building on Stripe. We therefore invest back into our technology at an unusual rate. We make <a href="https://stripe.com/roadmap">upgrades to our products</a> every single day to deliver compounding gains to our customers. We maintain some of the most <a href="https://status.stripe.com/">reliable APIs</a> on the internet. We build entirely new <a href="https://tempo.xyz/">pieces</a> of <a href="https://mpp.dev/">financial</a> <a href="https://joinopenstandard.com/">infrastructure</a> to enable new ideas. And our significant advances in <a href="https://stripe.com/radar">risk and fraud</a> infrastructure over many years are making the internet economy safer and more accessible.&nbsp;</p> <p>Though people at Stripe don’t tend to take themselves seriously, Stripe is a fairly serious place: our customers are depending on us for their livelihoods. We admire ambition, intensity, curiosity, humility, and rigor. The most effective people become knowledgeable about many domains besides their own. Any company is an applied exercise in understanding some aspect of society or the market. In working with so many (especially the new and innovative ones), we think that Stripe is one of the very best places to learn about how the world works.</p> <h2><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h2> <p>As an intern at Stripe you’ll work on projects across our stack that directly impact the way millions of businesses operate. You’ll own problems end to end with the support of your manager and teammates. It’s an opportunity to work alongside some of the most creative and technically rigorous engineers in the industry and learn how to ship high-quality work at scale. By contributing to Stripe’s codebase you’ll work across domains that give you insight into how the global economy works. Recent intern projects include expanding Stripe’s Payments Foundation Model capabilities to improve generalized anomaly detection, building more approachable fraud controls, creating safer payouts, and developing user-facing solutions that prevent costly pricing mistakes and make merchant checkout setup easier.</p> <p>Our internship program is competitive and the expectations are high.&nbsp;</p> <h3><strong>Responsibilities</strong></h3> <ul> <li> <p>Operate as a real member of the team you join; engage in team discussions, decisions, and the technical design process.</p> </li> <li> <p>Write software that will be used in production, and has meaningful impact to Stripe’s business and users.</p> </li> <li> <p>Give and receive technical feedback through code reviews or design discussions</p> </li> <li> <p>Collaborate with other engineers and cross-functional stakeholders to proactively seek and incorporate feedback.</p> </li> <li> <p>Learn quickly by asking great questions, working with your intern manager and teammates effectively, communicating the status of your work clearly, and building with the latest AI tooling.</p> </li> </ul> <h2><strong>Who you are</strong></h2> <ul> <li> <p>Ambitious builder: You’re energized by building solutions without clear precedent and solving problems with far-reaching consequences. Successful Stripes are deeply curious, and prefer the joy of discovery to the comfort of certainty.</p> </li> <li style="text-align: left;"> <p>Rigorous thinker: You appreciate that things worth doing are rarely simple. You enjoy working on problems that have never been tackled before.&nbsp;</p> </li> <li> <p>Adaptable problem solver: You adapt quickly and treat obstacles as opportunities. At Stripe we embrace kindness while encouraging Stripes to take measured risks and act boldly, even in the absence of consensus.</p> </li> </ul> <h3><strong>Minimum requirements</strong></h3> <ul> <li> <p>A strong fundamental understanding of computer science through pursuit of a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in computer science, math, or a related discipline.&nbsp;</p> </li> <li> <p>Experience and familiarity with programming, either through side projects or classwork. We work mostly in Ruby, Java, Javascript, Go, and Scala. We believe new programming languages can be learned if the fundamentals and general knowledge are present.</p> </li> <li> <p>Experience from previous internships or other multi-person projects, including open source contributions, that demonstrate evaluating and receiving feedback from mentors, peers, and stakeholders.</p> </li> <li> <p>Ability to learn unfamiliar systems and form an understanding of those systems, through independent research and working with a mentor or subject matter experts.&nbsp;</p> </li> <li> <p>Ability to leverage AI tools to accelerate development while applying rigorous critical thinking and professional judgement to review, refine, and validate all outputs.</p> </li> </ul> <h3><strong>Preferred qualifications</strong></h3> <ul> <li> <p>At least 1 year of university education, or equivalent work experience.</p> </li> <li> <p>One or more areas of specialized knowledge (frontend, backend, infrastructure or other technologies) balanced with general skills and knowledge.&nbsp;</p> </li> <li> <p>Experience writing high quality pull requests, with good test coverage, and working knowledge to complete projects with minimal defects.</p> </li> <li> <p>Familiarity with navigating and managing your work in new code bases, with multiple languages.</p> </li> <li> <p>Clear written communication skills, with the ability to write clearly to explain your work to stakeholders, team members, and other Stripes.</p> </li> </ul>

We decide how every engineer, service, and AI agent at Stripe gets access to what it needs, and nothing more.</p> <p>We're building the next generation of authorization at Stripe. It reasons about how people, services, and resources relate to each other, and it enforces policy consistently everywhere. We’re actively making the secure path the easiest one for every team at Stripe. Engineers here own big problems end to end and work closely with teams across the company.</p> <p>Internal Identity is largely a distributed team with a small presence in-person in Seattle.</p> <h3>What you'll do</h3> <p>We’re looking for an engineer who is passionate about addressing tough problems in the authorization space. We build programmable financial infrastructure, rethinking from first principles how financial services should work, to make it easier and cheaper for any business to start and scale. More than 10 million <a href="https://stripe.com/customers">businesses</a> build on Stripe, spanning the economic frontier—from solo founders to established enterprises—united by a practical focus on growth. The most ambitious companies in the world use Stripe as core infrastructure to grow faster. They process trillions of dollars a year on Stripe, equivalent to around 1.6% of global GDP. While economic growth makes everyone better off, open markets also enable greater variety. When any business can easily serve a global customer base, the quality and diversity of products in the world increase, and craft and creativity are unleashed into the smallest niches. Our own growth is wholly contingent on the success of the businesses building on Stripe. We therefore invest back into our technology at an unusual rate. We make <a href="https://stripe.com/roadmap">upgrades to our products</a> every single day to deliver compounding gains to our customers. We maintain some of the most <a href="https://status.stripe.com/">reliable APIs</a> on the internet. We build entirely new <a href="https://tempo.xyz/">pieces</a> of <a href="https://mpp.dev/">financial</a> <a href="https://joinopenstandard.com/">infrastructure</a> to enable new ideas. And our significant advances in <a href="https://stripe.com/radar">risk and fraud</a> infrastructure over many years are making the internet economy safer and more accessible.&nbsp;</p> <p>Though people at Stripe don’t tend to take themselves seriously, Stripe is a fairly serious place: our customers are depending on us for their livelihoods. We admire ambition, intensity, curiosity, humility, and rigor. The most effective people become knowledgeable about many domains besides their own. Any company is an applied exercise in understanding some aspect of society or the market. In working with so many (especially the new and innovative ones), we think that Stripe is one of the very best places to learn about how the world works.</p> <h2><strong>Your role</strong><strong><br></strong></h2> <p>Stripe is large enough that individual products and projects can be rapidly deployed to a meaningful fraction of the world’s businesses, but small enough that individual agency still has outsized impact. Small teams can impact how millions of businesses grow. Right now the global economy is replatforming around AI, creating new opportunities for growth. We’re at the center of this, and we think the best work is still in front of us.</p> <p>To meet this moment, we’re looking for people who move with urgency, like hard problems, and want their work to matter at a time of great change. If that’s you, there’s no better place to build your career.</p> <h2><strong>Who you are</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Ambitious builder: You’re energized by building solutions without clear precedent and solving problems with far-reaching consequences. Successful Stripes are deeply curious, and prefer the joy of discovery to the comfort of certainty.</li> <li>Rigorous thinker: You appreciate that things worth doing are rarely simple. You enjoy working on problems that have never been tackled before.&nbsp;</li> <li>Adaptable problem solver: You adapt quickly and treat obstacles as opportunities.&nbsp; At Stripe we embrace kindness while encouraging Stripes to take measured risks and act boldly, even in the absence of consensus.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Minimum requirements</strong></h3> <ul> <li>A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in computer science or a directly related field, obtained by summer 2027, or equivalent work experience; New grad candidates should have no more than 18 months of professional experience (excluding internship experience).</li> <li>Experience and familiarity with programming, either through side projects or classwork. We work mostly in Java, Ruby, JavaScript, Scala, and Go. We believe new programming languages can be learned if the fundamentals and general knowledge are present.</li> <li>Experience from either previous internships or working collaboratively on multi-person coding projects (in a university or professional setting).</li> <li>Ability to learn unfamiliar systems and form an understanding of those systems, through independent research and working with a mentor or subject matter experts.</li> <li>Clear written communication skills, with the ability to explain your work to stakeholders, team members, and other Stripes.</li> <li>Ability to leverage AI tools to accelerate development while applying rigorous critical thinking and professional judgement to review, refine, and validate all outputs.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Preferred qualifications</strong></h3> <ul> <li>One or more areas of specialized knowledge (frontend, backend, infrastructure or other technologies) balanced with general skills and knowledge.&nbsp;</li> <li>Experience in code review practices, and an understanding of how to safely update production systems.</li> <li>Familiarity with navigating and managing work in large code bases.</li> <li>Experience leading small projects independently, and contributing to larger projects alongside peers.</li> <li>Ability to operate with high agency in navigating complex technical obstacles independently, knowing precisely when to unblock oneself and when to ask for help.</li> </ul>

title: Solutions Architect, Metronome (AI Native)
description: <h2>About Us</h2> <p>Metronome is the leading usage-based billing platform built for modern software companies. With Metronome, now a Stripe product, companies can launch products faster, offer any pricing model, and streamline finance workflows without writing code.</p> <p>Our platform computes hundreds of millions of invoices per billing period and continues to scale rapidly to accommodate new customers. We save them days of development time and manual invoicing, enabling them to use their billing data to better serve their customers. Our customers love our product and approach, and we’re humbled to work with amazing companies like OpenAI, Anthropic, NVIDIA, TogetherAI, HuggingFace, and many others.</p> <p>You'll be joining an experienced team that includes founders who have successfully built and sold startups before. Our Stripes have direct experience building and scaling teams through massive growth at companies like Dropbox, Palantir, and MongoDB. You'll be joining Stripe and be part of the holistic Stripe platform approaching monetization.</p> <h2>About the Role</h2> <p>The Metronome AI Native Solutions team operates at the intersection of technical sales, implementation, and customer success, purpose-built for the velocity and unique needs of AI-first companies. Unlike traditional sales engineering roles, this position owns the large parts of if not all of the deal cycle - from first call through technical win - and gets hands-on with implementation to ensure customers go live quickly.</p> <p>As an AI Native Solutions Architect, you'll be the primary technical owner for fast-moving AI companies that may need to launch usage-based billing on tight timelines. This means:</p> <p><strong>Owning the technical win:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Taking qualified inbound leads and driving them through discovery, demo, POC, and technical win</li> <li>Using efficient discovery to quickly understand billing challenges, product launch timelines, and technical requirements</li> <li>Bringing energy and urgency to every engagement—proactively driving deals forward, identifying blockers early, and building relationships across the customer organization (engineering, finance, product) to create champions</li> <li>Running streamlined demos tailored to technical founders and product/engineering teams</li> </ul> <p><strong>Driving hands-on implementation:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Providing customers with clear, actionable implementation plans to implement their usage-based billing launches</li> <li>Writing code snippets, configuration examples, and integration guides to accelerate customer time-to-value</li> <li>Pair programming or working alongside customer teams during POCs and initial setup</li> <li>Designing up/downstream integrations into prospect systems with a bias toward pragmatic solutions that get them live quickly</li> </ul> <p><strong>Building deep AI market expertise:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Building relationships with technical founders, engineering leaders, product, and finance teams at AI companies</li> <li>Understanding the unique monetization challenges facing LLM providers, generative AI companies (image, video, audio), and AI tooling/wrapper companies and providing consultative guidance when prospects need direction on pricing and packaging strategy and implementation</li> <li>Staying current on AI industry trends, pricing models, and competitive dynamics</li> </ul> <p>This role is perfect for someone who thrives in high-velocity environments, loves solving technical problems in real-time, and wants to be on the front lines of how AI companies monetize their products. Metronome directly influences how the next generation of AI infrastructure gets built—and our AI Native Solutions team drives this influence with our fastest-growing customer segment.</p> <p>The Metronome team still operates very much like a startup. As such, there's a lot still to figure out and tremendous room for high-agency, curious individuals to impact our direction and strategy, build processes from zero to one, and generally make a difference. If this excites you as much as it excites us, let's talk.</p> <h2>Qualifications</h2> <p>This is roughly the set of things we’re looking for - if you’re interested in this role and don’t meet some of these on paper, err on the side of applying!</p> <ul> <li>3+ years of experience in technical, customer-facing roles involving SaaS products (for example, sales engineering, solutions architecture, technical account management, implementation consulting)</li> <li>1+ years of experience working with, at, or selling to AI companies - you understand how AI-first companies operate, their unique challenges, and the market landscape</li> <li>Proven ability to own and drive customer-facing engagements and relationships independently</li> <li>Strong technical aptitude with the ability to quickly learn new systems, write code snippets, and guide technical implementations</li> <li>Experience working in high-velocity environments where speed-to-value matters and customers need to launch quickly</li> <li>Excellent communication skills with technical buyers (engineers, product managers, technical founders)</li> </ul> <h3>Bonus Points</h3> <ul> <li>Deep knowledge of the quote-to-cash space, including integrating with or otherwise interacting with tools like Salesforce, NetSuite, CPQs, etc.</li> <li>Experience as a software engineer, product manager, or in other technical roles.</li> <li>Experience in a pure sales role, particularly selling to technical buyers in engineering and product organizations or selling as a founding or early salesperson at a startup.</li> <li>Familiarity and enthusiasm for AI developer tooling (Cursor, Lovable, Vercel, LangChain, etc.) and the broader AI infrastructure ecosystem</li> </ul>

You'll be joining Stripe and be part of the holistic Stripe platform approaching monetization.</p> <h2><strong>About the Role</strong></h2> <p>The Solutions Engineering team at Metronome is a technical group that sits at the intersection of everything Metronome does: sales, account management, product, R&amp;D, and operations. Bottom line, we own the technical side of the customer lifecycle from the very first discovery call through demos, POC, technical scoping, and handover to our post-sales groups. We act like a producer to get the show running with Metronome. This role will train you to grow across these vectors.</p> <p>As a member of the Solutions Engineering team, your first month will be:</p> <ul> <li>Learning to tell a clear value story about how and where Metronome solves challenges and creates opportunities in a modern monetization stack.</li> <li>Assisting in planning, building, and running customized demos of Metronome for buyers with many different personas (engineering, product management, operations, finance, etc).</li> </ul> <p>In your first 3 months, you can expect to:</p> <ul> <li>Become proficient in what discovery is and using it to understand what challenges our prospects face</li> <li>Travel to meet prospects in the field. Workshops, conferences, on-sites — we believe in meeting our customers in-person whenever possible. Anywhere in the world.</li> <li>Land deals for some of the most exciting names in software, from startups to enterprise SaaS.</li> </ul> <p>In 6 months you’ll be:</p> <ul> <li>Owning knowledge areas, projects, tools, and market segments in the Solutions Engineering team.</li> <li>Running tight Proofs of Concept with clearly-defined success criteria that get us to the technical win.</li> <li>Representing the Solutions Engineering group as a deal team member on your own.</li> <li>Handling detailed scoping to ensure that customers are set up for success post-sales.</li> </ul> <p>In your first year you’ll have:</p> <ul> <li>Built relationships with people at our prospect organizations, from day-to-day operators to C-Suite executives.</li> <li>Designed integrations of Metronome into prospect systems and acted as a pricing and packaging consultant, influencing the direction of our future customers.</li> </ul> <p>As a fast-moving unit within Stripe, there’s a lot still to figure out and tremendous room for high-agency people to have impact and <em>make a difference.</em> If this excites you as much as it excites us, let’s talk.</p> <h2><strong>Qualifications</strong></h2> <p>This is roughly the set of things we’re looking for - if you’re interested in this role and don’t meet some of these on paper, err on the side of applying!</p> <ul> <li>1-3 years of experience working in technical and/or customer-facing roles involving SaaS products (for example, roles like engineering, solutions, technical account management/consulting). Academic background in a technical area with high EQ is also sought after.</li> <li>Relentless passion for being a hand-raiser. Big challenges are exciting, small tasks are an opportunity for a win. From landing big clients to simply cleaning up an old dashboard you’re interested in learning and getting things done.</li> <li>Growth mindset is critical in being able to learn new things quickly, adapt on the fly, and operate in fast-moving startup environments that value high agency.</li> <li>Exceptional communication skills -- technical, go-to-market, and finance stakeholders should all feel like comfortable counterparts in conversing with you.</li> <li>Excitement for building and improving GTM playbooks and processes.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Bonus Points</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Knowledge of the quote-to-cash space, including integrating with or otherwise interacting with tools like Salesforce, NetSuite, CPQs, etc.</li> <li>Experience as a software engineer, product manager, or in other technical roles.</li> <li>Experience in a pure sales role, particularly selling to technical buyers in engineering and product organizations or selling as a founding or early salesperson at a startup.</li> <li>Experience with logs, metrics, billing, finance, or other infrastructure or financial tooling and concepts.</li> </ul>

You will architect business models with them so they can drive new monetization opportunities and growth for both the user and Stripe.&nbsp;</p> <h3><strong>Responsibilities</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Be a key member of the Platform account team with deep involvement in defining the customer strategy; identify and close new complex opportunities, and accelerate solution adoption.&nbsp;</li> <li>Understand and align with the customer’s product and business roadmap and uncover opportunities for Stripe to accelerate their progress on that roadmap.&nbsp;</li> <li>Drive thought leadership and be a trusted advisor for key business and technical stakeholders including CIO, CTO, COO, CRO, CDO, Head of Product Engineering and Head of Payments.&nbsp;</li> <li>Work to deeply understand the customer’s business objectives, and then design and apply Stripe’s solutions to their challenges.</li> <li>Conduct business analysis and background research on customers, industries, and competitors with a view to support growth for the user's business.&nbsp;</li> <li>Expand Stripe’s footprint within existing accounts to new global markets and business units by introducing new capabilities and local payment methods.</li> <li>Approximately 25% travel is anticipated to help you connect in-person in a meaningful way with users and collaborate internally.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Who you are</strong></h2> <p>You have achieved an experienced position as an enterprise architect, senior solution architect or principal solution engineer and have a successful track record advising enterprise-grade digital-native, SaaS, Platform or Marketplace companies, focused on identifying business priorities, formulating technology strategies and designing an end-to-end business solution. description: <h2><strong>Who we are</strong></h2> <h3><strong>About Stripe</strong></h3> <p>Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. REP builds the regionalization, validation, deploy-safety, and operator tooling needed to answer practical launch-readiness questions: can critical payment paths run from the new region, which services still depend on a remote control plane, what breaks under packet loss or failover, and what must be fixed before deploys, launches, traffic shifts, or failovers proceed. The team uses traffic replay, synthetics, failover drills, dependency analysis, CI/CD gates, and incident data to turn those findings into platform fixes, service-owner asks, and reusable readiness checks across networking, HADR, and service teams.</p> <p>This role is based in <strong>Bangalore</strong> and serves as a senior technical anchor for Core Infrastructure in India, with direct cross-region influence across AMER, EU, and APAC.</p> <h2><strong>What you'll do</strong></h2> <p>As a Staff Engineer on REP, you will play a key leadership role in enabling Stripe's infrastructure to power all of our products, globally and at scale. title: Staff Machine Learning Engineer, Radar
description: <h2><strong>Who we are</strong></h2> <h3><strong>About Stripe</strong></h3> <p>Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.</p> <h3><strong>About the team</strong></h3> <p>The Radar ML team builds the machine learning systems that power Stripe’s Radar fraud and abuse product suite. Our models make real-time decisions across a significant share of internet commerce - helping businesses stop fraud, increase authorization, and grow safely. By turning economy-scale datasets into compelling ML products, the team directly improves customer outcomes and drives meaningful revenue for Stripe.</p> <p>The team is growing, and expanding into multiple new areas. We are building abuse protections across the full customer life-cycle, adaptive and customizable fraud systems for enterprises, and risk intelligence for 50+ global payment methods.&nbsp;</p> <h2><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h2> <p>You will lead the machine learning strategy for abuse prevention across the full customer lifecycle. Abuse doesn't stop at the payment. Bad actors create fake and duplicate accounts, take over legitimate ones, farm free trials and promotions, resell access they obtained below cost, use services they never intend to pay for, and file bad-faith refunds and disputes. For AI companies, every abusive account burns real compute, and the same actors keep moving from one account, product, and access path to the next.</p> <p>Stripe is uniquely positioned to solve this. Our network sees consumers across millions of businesses, so we can recognize a bad actor at signup, at login, at payment, and long after. Radar has already shipped the first building blocks: account evaluations at signup and login, customer-level abuse risk, and APIs that let businesses report their own abuse outcomes. You will turn these building blocks into a unified abuse prevention layer that understands the consumer behind every event and helps businesses act consistently across all of that consumer's accounts. This is a large growth opportunity for Radar, and a strategic priority for Stripe.</p> <p>This is a fast-moving 0→1 area, built alongside some of the world's leading AI companies, and the attacks are real today. Labels are sparse, delayed, and differ by business. Much of the customer journey is only partly visible to us. Adversaries adapt as soon as we ship. You will set the technical direction, make the hard architecture calls, and personally build the hardest pieces.</p> <h3><strong>Responsibilities</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Set the technical strategy and multi-quarter roadmap for lifecycle abuse ML, with product and engineering leadership: which abuse vectors to take on, in what order, and with what approach.</li> <li>Design a persistent, continuously updated consumer risk profile that combines signals from signups, logins, payments, product usage, refunds, and disputes. Evolve it from explainable composite scores toward model-driven risk scores for each type of abuse.</li> <li>Lead development of models for abuse vectors such as multi-accounting, account takeover, bots, free-trial and promotion abuse, unauthorized resale, non-payment, refund abuse, and friendly fraud. Use graph, sequence, and LLM-based approaches over payment, account, and product-usage data.</li> <li>Solve the label problem by designing ways to learn from sparse, delayed, merchant-specific, and weak labels, including merchant-shared feedback, LLM-assisted labeling, and network-level signals.</li> <li>Define how we measure success: evaluation frameworks, impact and ROI estimates, and operating-point guidance that help businesses trade off abuse losses against growth and conversion.</li> <li>Turn detection into action by shaping the risk controls, interventions, and recommendations businesses can turn on at each step of the customer journey.</li> <li>Stay deeply hands-on: write substantial production code, prototype quickly, and personally land the most technically difficult components, with the reliability and latency standards of systems in Stripe's critical path.</li> <li>Break ambiguous problems into parallel workstreams, unblock other engineers, and raise the team's bar through design review, code review, and mentorship.</li> <li>Partner directly with leading Stripe users, fraud experts, product, and adjacent Stripe teams to ground the work in real user pain and change course quickly based on what you learn.</li> <li>Build AI-native tooling, agents, and workflows that let the team investigate attacks and build and operate models dramatically faster.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Who you are</strong></h2> <p>You are a hands-on technical leader who has built ML systems that matter, shipped them to production, and led others in doing the same. You thrive in ambiguity. You can take an open-ended problem with messy data and incomplete labels, find the highest-leverage path, get to user impact quickly, and change course when the data says so. You make the engineers around you better. You're as comfortable talking with a customer about the economics of their abuse problem as you are debugging a feature pipeline. You're excited to use frontier AI both in the systems you build and in how you build them.</p> <p>We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.</p> <h3><strong>Minimum requirements</strong></h3> <ul> <li>8+ years of experience developing, evaluating, and deploying machine learning models in a production environment.</li> <li>A track record of technically leading large, ambiguous ML initiatives from problem definition to production, with measurable business impact.</li> <li>Deep expertise in machine learning, statistics, model evaluation, and experiment design, including where labels are noisy, delayed, or scarce.</li> <li>Strong software-engineering skills, and you remain a hands-on contributor who regularly writes tested, maintainable production code.</li> <li>Experience designing and operating production ML systems at scale, including data and feature pipelines, real-time inference, deployment, and monitoring, and making architecture tradeoffs across them.</li> <li>Experience setting technical direction across multiple engineers or teams, and mentoring engineers to grow their scope.</li> <li>Ability to explain complex tradeoffs clearly to engineers, product leaders, and customers, and to build alignment across functions.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Preferred qualifications</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Experience applying ML to fraud, abuse, integrity, trust and safety, identity, or security, where adversaries actively adapt to your defenses.</li> <li>Experience with entity resolution, graph learning, or behavioral and sequence modeling of users, accounts, or devices (for example, detecting multi-accounting, account takeover, or bots).</li> <li>Experience productionizing modern deep learning or LLM-based approaches, including using LLMs for labeling, investigation, or detection.</li> <li>Experience building 0→1 ML products and working directly with customers to define what to build.</li> <li>Experience building shared ML platforms, representations, or foundation models used across multiple products or teams.</li> <li>Experience building AI-assisted tooling or agents that measurably increased a team's velocity.</li> </ul>

Finance teams spend significant time reconstructing what happened, determining the appropriate accounting treatment, reconciling results, and gathering evidence. Giving an agent access to the underlying data is not enough: it also needs the business context, accounting policies, approved judgments, and guardrails required to act reliably.</p> <p>Revenue Recognition is our first major proof point. Stripe has a unique opportunity to help Billing and Metronome users turn complex revenue activity—including usage-based pricing, minimum commitments, credits, and contract modifications—into accurate, explainable journal entries. Our ambition is for agents to take on the investigation, configuration, and repetitive work while accountants retain control over consequential judgments and approvals.</p> <p>Over time, we expect to expand into additional Office of the CFO workflows, and we are looking for a Staff Product Manager to help turn this vision into products that finance teams trust. This is a senior individual contributor role with significant ownership, autonomy, and influence across Product, Engineering, Design, Finance, Data Science, and Go-to-Market teams.</p> <h2>What you’ll do</h2> <p>You’ll own a significant product area within Accounting Products, setting its strategy, roadmap, and measures of success. You’ll translate the broader product vision into a focused plan, taking it from customer discovery and early prototypes through scaled adoption.</p> <p>You’ll help build the future of agentic accounting: products that help finance teams automate work, understand financial results, and resolve exceptions while retaining control. Your work will connect Stripe’s Revenue Suite with the external systems customers rely on to manage their accounting workflows.</p> <h3>Responsibilities</h3> <ul> <li>Define a focused product It gives platforms the infrastructure to represent the people and companies in their ecosystem, onboard and verify them, manage their accounts, accept payments, and pay them out - without building payments, compliance, or financial-services systems themselves. This is how businesses like Shopify can help entrepreneurs run and grow their businesses. It is also the kind of infrastructure that marketplaces such as DoorDash need to coordinate money movement across large networks of restaurants, merchants, and dashers.</p> <p>Connect has impact across industries. <a href="https://stripe.com/customers/shopify">Shopify</a> uses Stripe to embed financial services for merchants; <a href="https://stripe.com/customers/lugg">Lugg</a> streamlines worker onboarding and offers instant payouts; <a href="https://stripe.com/customers/doorloop">DoorLoop</a> reduces manual customer onboarding tasks by nearly 50% with Stripe; and <a href="https://stripe.com/customers/sharetribe">Sharetribe</a> helps entrepreneurs launch and run marketplaces on Stripe.</p> <p>AI is accelerating the emergence of entirely new business models: global networks of creators and experts, AI-native marketplaces, and agent-driven products that change how people discover, buy, sell, and deliver services. These businesses are more dynamic than traditional platforms: participants may operate across borders, take on different roles, and need new ways to establish trust, access financial capabilities, and get paid.</p> <p>The Connect Abstractions team owns the platform primitives that make these models possible. We are building the foundational abstractions for representing participants, onboarding them safely, configuring their capabilities, and managing their lifecycle on Stripe. Our work will determine how quickly the next generation of platforms can launch, how flexibly they can evolve, and how much of Stripe they can bring to the businesses and people they serve.</p> <h2><strong>Why this role</strong></h2> <p>This is a chance to define a foundational product area at Stripe. You will turn a fast-changing set of user and product needs into durable platform primitives that work across products, industries, and geographies.</p> <p>The role combines high-leverage strategy with hands-on product execution. You will work through ambiguous, consequential questions like: what should a platform be able to model? What should be simple by default but flexible when needed? How can Stripe make complex financial infrastructure feel effortless for a platform and its users?&nbsp;</p> <p>The outcome of your work will compound. The abstractions you help create will be reused across Connect and Stripe, shaping what new products platforms can build and how quickly they can bring them to market.</p> <h3>What you’ll do</h3> <p>We are looking for an entrepreneurial Product Manager to build the platform experiences behind Connect's next generation of users. You will own critical product primitives that platforms, including the fastest-growing AI companies, use to onboard, configure, and manage their users on Stripe. You will turn a clear strategic direction into products that solve hard user problems today while creating a coherent, extensible foundation for business models that are still being invented.</p> <p>This role is for someone who enjoys the depth of platform work but is uncompromising about product craft and solving real user needs - both the ones users have today and will have in the future. The work is not building infra for its own sake; you will build capabilities that help our users launch a new marketplace, enable a global network to pay its contributors, or give a business entirely new ways for their end users to earn.</p> <h3>Responsibilities</h3> <ul> <li>Bring the next generation of Connect accounts to life. Lead cross-functional work from discovery through launch, and hold yourself accountable for developer experience, platform adoption, user value, and business impact, not simply features shipped.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Who you are</strong></h2> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. We are now adding specialist advisors who bring differentiated expertise to the enterprise conversations where Stripe’s role must be understood not simply as a payments provider, but as an integrated financial backbone within a customer’s broader commerce and technology ecosystem.</p> <h2 id="about-the-role">About the role</h2> <p>As a <strong>Strategy &amp; Transformation Advisor, Enterprise Commerce Architecture</strong>, you will be the senior strategic advisor for complex enterprise commerce transformations, Stripe integration engagements &amp; pursuits across AMER. You will support and advise integration teams and our users on the most complex multi product Stripe integration engagements. Additionally, you will help customers develop a clear, prescriptive point of view on how Stripe should integrate into their future-state architecture — and what that means for their commerce platforms, order-management systems, ERP and finance estate, customer and loyalty systems, identity, data platforms, fulfillment operations, and engineering organization. You will partner with broader GTM, Solutions Architecture, and Product teams to increase customer confidence in Stripe’s ability to support consequential enterprise transformations. You will engage senior technical and business stakeholders, including CTOs, CIOs, Chief Architects, VP Engineering, and digital or commerce leaders, translating their strategic priorities into an enterprise commerce architecture, sequenced transformation roadmap, and clear implementation principles.&nbsp;</p> <p>You will have the opportunities to define the strategic architectural “what” and “why”: the target state, key design principles, trade-offs, dependencies, and path to value. You will also provide technical advisory support to Stripe’s Integration engineers, Solution Architects and Strategy &amp; Transformation Consultants on the most complex opportunities.</p> <h2 id="what-you-will-do">What you will do</h2> <h3><strong>Lead architecture advisory for complex enterprise Stripe deployments</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Serve as a senior post-sales architecture advisor to a portfolio of global enterprise users with complex, multi-product Stripe integrations, helping them evolve from an initial solution vision to durable target-state integration and architecture decisions, supported by transformation roadmaps.</li> <li>Partner with Integration Engineers, Implementation Consultants, Engagement Managers, Account Executives, and Strategy &amp; Transformation Consultants to shape post-sales architecture engagements and provide senior guidance, while detailed solution design and implementation delivery remain with the appropriate Stripe teams.</li> <li>Advise user technical teams on architecture-level decisions across the broader enterprise commerce, finance, and data landscape—including system-of-record boundaries, API and event design, data ownership, reconciliation, operational resilience, security and risk considerations, and organizational readiness.</li> <li>Act as an escalation and thought partner for complex enterprise architecture questions during implementation, expansion, and major evolution of Stripe integrations, translating technical trade-offs across Stripe products into clear decisions, dependencies, and business outcomes for customer and Stripe stakeholders.<br><br></li> </ul> <h3><strong>Shape enterprise commerce transformation strategy</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Lead executive discovery, strategy and infrastructure interact with commerce, order management, ERP and finance, CRM, loyalty, identity, data, fulfillment, and risk systems and develop a prescriptive future-state point of view for how transformation, cost optimization, improved authorization performance, or faster product development—into clear architecture and operating-model implications.</li> <li>Define the enterprise-level principles, system boundaries, ownership models, integration patterns, data flows, and migration considerations needed to support the target state.</li> <li>Create multi-phased, dependency-aware transformation roadmaps that connect Stripe capabilities to measurable business outcomes.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Increase confidence in strategic enterprise pursuits</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Partner with account teams, enterprise service managers, sales leaders, and senior solutions architects to identify pursuits where enterprise commerce architecture expertise will materially improve customer confidence or decision quality.</li> <li>Engage credibly with executive technical stakeholders as a strategic advisor and peer, not as a product vendor.</li> <li>Help customers understand the practical trade-offs between their current architecture and a future state that uses Stripe more deeply.</li> <li>Create clear executive narratives, architecture artifacts, transformation roadmaps, enterprise pursuits.</li> <li>Help define the path from initial architecture vision to implementation scope, while ensuring detailed solution design and delivery ownership remain with the appropriate Stripe teams.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Inform Stripe’s enterprise strategy and product direction</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Bring recurring customer architecture patterns, friction points, and unmet needs back to Product, Engineering, and GTM leadership.</li> <li>Identify emerging enterprise commerce trends—including AI-enabled commerce and financial operations, omnichannel experiences, embedded finance, platform business models, and global expansion—and translate them into relevant Stripe points of view.</li> <li>Contribute to Stripe’s differentiated perspective on enterprise commerce transformation through internal thought leadership and selective customer-facing content.</li> </ul> <h2 id="minimum-qualifications">Minimum qualifications</h2> <ul> <li>12+ years of experience in enterprise architecture, technology strategy, digital transformation, management consulting, or senior technical advisory roles.</li> <li>Significant experience advising large enterprises on complex technology transformation, ideally spanning commerce, payments, financial systems, or customer-facing platforms.</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to engage credibly with C-suite and VP-level business and technical leaders.</li> <li>Deep understanding of enterprise commerce architecture, including relevant systems such as commerce platforms, order management, ERP and finance, CRM, loyalty, identity, models.</li> <li>Working knowledge of payments and financial infrastructure, including acceptance, acquiring, settlement, reconciliation, fraud and risk, compliance, and multi-party payment models.</li> <li>Ability to connect architecture decisions to business outcomes such as revenue growth, conversion, authorization performance, operational efficiency, resilience, cost, and speed to market.</li> <li>Excellent written, verbal, and visual communication skills, including the ability to make complex architecture decisions understandable to executive audiences.</li> <li>Demonstrated experience leading ambiguous, cross-functional strategic engagements from initial discovery through a practical recommendation and roadmap</li> </ul> <h2 id="preferred-qualifications">Preferred roadmapping.</li> <li>Experience advising on data architecture, reconciliation, risk and fraud operations, AI-enabled financial operations, or commerce personalization.</li> <li>A track record of coaching senior technical practitioners and influencing cross-functional teams without direct reporting authority.</li> <li>External credibility through senior customer advisory work, industry speaking, publications, or contributions to enterprise technology or payments communities.</li> </ul>

DEeP focuses on providing a scalable developer experience that any developer can leverage to accelerate a customer's ability to create value from Stripe.</p> <p>Within DEeP, the Extensibility program is how Stripe expands its total addressable market, and increases customer retention. With extensibility, Stripe becomes programmable — customers and product teams can adapt Stripe to their needs on a common platform.</p> <p>Stripe has three interconnected extensibility primitives:</p> <ol> <li>Scripts — Secure, isolated TypeScript runtime allowing merchants and developers to customize Stripe product behavior (e.g., discount calculations, invoice logic, proration).</li> <li>Custom Objects — User-defined data models (e.g., Shipments, Locations, Warranties, Entitlements) with first-class APIs, SDKs, and Dashboard experiences.</li> <li>Workflows — A programmable orchestration layer (graduating to GA at Sessions) enabling no-code and pro-code business logic across Stripe, including custom actions, delays, smart retries, and 3P integrations.</li> </ol> <p>These primitives are deeply interdependent, involve 10+ cross-functional teams and culminate in a flagship product launch.</p> <h2><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h2> <p>We are seeking a product-focused Technical Program Manager to drive the Extensibility program across the Workflows, Custom Objects, and Scripts workstreams. This is a newly created, high-impact role at the intersection of platform engineering, product management, and cross-organizational program ownership.</p> <p>In this role, you will own one of the most strategically consequential programs in DEeP — driving the direction, health, and outcomes of Stripe's Extensibility platform across Scripts, Custom Objects, and Workflows. You will set the program strategy in partnership with DEeP leadership, holding organizations accountable to the success of the program.&nbsp;</p> <ul> <li>Drive cross-org decisions across DRIs in Script Platform, Custom Objects, Apps, SDK, Observability, DevEx, and Versioning — actively resolving the hard, ambiguous integration and ownership questions that fall between team boundaries.</li> <li>Own the critical path to major launches — proactively shaping scope, driving descope decisions, and negotiating trade-offs across teams so that launches reflect deliberate strategic choices.</li> <li>Influence and shape product and engineering roadmaps — bringing a program-level perspective to team planning cycles, pushing back where individual team roadmaps are misaligned with broader extensibility strategy, and advocating for cross-cutting investments that no single team will prioritize on their own.</li> <li>Support ProServ and Partnerships — Ensure ProServ and Partnerships requirements are surfaced into the roadmap with the same rigor as product requirements, and hold the bridge between what the platform delivers and what those teams need to close and serve complex customers.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Qualifications</strong></h2> <h3><strong>Minimum requirements</strong></h3> <ul> <li>5+ years of technical program management experience with demonstrated success in driving complex cross organizational programs.</li> <li>Strong product sense and ability to understand enterprise customer needs</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to communicate with precision and credibility across engineering, product, and executive audiences, translating complex technical trade-offs into strategic decisions, and driving alignment.</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to lead and align cross-functional teams — driving decisions, resolving conflict, and building consensus across organizations with competing priorities</li> <li>Proven track record of successful program delivery in complex technical environments</li> <li>Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Preferred </strong><strong>Qualifications</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Background in product management or product operations</li> <li>Experience with developer platforms, API products, or payment systems</li> </ul>

with the ability to drive exceptional workplace services and operational improvements</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Preferred qualifications:</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Proficiency in Google Suite, Slack and Jira</li> <li>A clear willingness to take a hands-on approach and dive into the details</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to influence cross-functional partners and translate enterprise strategy into effective local execution.</li> <li>Ability to operate independently, digging into problems to understand the root cause and delivering scalable solutions</li> <li>The ability to thrive in a operational improvements</li> </ul>

Our adversarial red teaming, model evaluations, and intelligence collection enable engineering, safety, and security teams to stay ahead of evolving threats and deploy AI systems safely.</p></div><p><strong>Location &amp; Travel Expectations</strong></p> <p>We are primarily seeking candidates based in the Washington, DC, New York City, San Francisco Bay Area, and Denver metropolitan areas. applications</li> <li>Familiarity with prompt injection, jailbreak techniques, or other AI attack methodologies</li> <li>Offensive security certifications such as PNPT, OSCP, CySA+, GCIH, or GPEN</li> title: Biosecurity & AI Safety Investigator
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About 10a Labs: </strong>10a Labs is the safety and threat-intelligence layer trusted by frontier AI labs, AI unicorns, Fortune 10 companies, and leading global technology platforms. Our adversarial red teaming, model evaluations, and intelligence collection enable engineering, safety, and security teams to stay ahead of evolving threats and deploy AI systems safely.</p></div><h2><strong>About the Role</strong></h2> <p>10a Labs is seeking Biology Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) to support a project at the intersection of biology, biosecurity, and AI safety.</p> <p>In this role, you will review and label exchanges involving biological topics against established policies and guidelines. The work supports both automated monitoring systems and human review processes designed to identify potentially harmful biological content while preserving legitimate scientific and research use cases.</p> <p>We're looking for people with enough technical depth in biology to recognize nuance—particularly when distinguishing legitimate scientific research from information that could present dual-use or misuse concerns.</p> <h2><strong>What You'll Do</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Review and label biological and biotechnology-related content according to defined policies and guidelines.</li> <li>Evaluate technically complex or ambiguous biological exchanges and make consistent risk determinations.</li> <li>Distinguish legitimate scientific and research use cases from potentially harmful or dual-use applications.</li> <li>Apply subject-matter expertise across areas such as pathogen research, microbiology, molecular biology, cancer biology, synthetic biology, or related disciplines.</li> <li>Identify ambiguous or challenging cases and clearly document the reasoning behind decisions.</li> <li>Help improve the consistency and quality of biological safety review processes.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What We're Looking For</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Strong academic or professional background in biology, microbiology, virology, molecular biology, cancer biology, biotechnology, synthetic biology, or a related field.</li> <li>Ability to understand technical biological research, terminology, methods, and experimental concepts.</li> <li>Strong analytical judgment and attention to detail.</li> <li>Ability to consistently apply written policies to complex and ambiguous scientific scenarios.</li> <li>Interest or experience in biosecurity, biodefense, biosafety, biorisk, dual-use biotechnology, or biological threat assessment.</li> <li>Strong written communication skills.</li> <li>Must be legally authorized to work in the United States.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Preferred Background</strong></h2> <p>We're open to a range of educational and professional backgrounds. A PhD is not required.</p> <p>Particularly relevant experience may include:</p> <ul> <li>Government, national security, or biodefense work involving biological threats.</li> <li>Biosecurity, biosafety, biorisk, or dual-use research.</li> <li>Pathogen, infectious disease, microbiology, or virology research.</li> <li>Cancer biology, molecular biology, genomics, or related biomedical research.</li> <li>Academic or industry research involving emerging biotechnology.</li> <li>Master's-level scientific training combined with government, biodefense, or biosecurity experience.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What You’ll Gain</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Opportunity to apply deep biological knowledge to emerging challenges at the intersection of biotechnology, safety, and AI.</li> <li>Exposure to frontier AI capabilities and risks in biology.&nbsp;</li> <li>Opportunity to meet and work with leading researchers.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Contract Details</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Duration:</strong> 11-12 months</li> <li><strong>Commitment:</strong> 40 hours per week</li> <li><strong>Location:</strong> Remote – United States</li> <li><strong>Employment Type:</strong> Contract</li> <li><strong>Compensation:</strong> $160,000–$200,000 depending on experience</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p>
