title: Delivery Capacity & Demand Manager (f/m/x)
description: <p><strong>About the role: What's in the Box</strong></p> <p>Every day, a defined set of rules decides what every new HelloFresh customer sees: a unique mix of delivery days, prices and recommended selections. Your job, should you choose to accept it, is to keep that rule-set correct in a constantly moving environment: configuring it, checking it daily, documenting it, and fixing exceptions before a misconfiguration reaches a customer or a warehouse.&nbsp;</p> <p>You'll join <strong>Demand Steering</strong>, the team within <strong>Network Operations Europe</strong> that shapes those offerings so they add up to a plan our warehouses and logistics partners can actually execute. That means balancing what customers want against the real constraints of the journey from click to delivery: every box still has to be produced in a shift at a production facility and delivered by a van on a route.</p> <p>Using our in-house demand steering tool, you'll configure the delivery offering customers see at checkout across your own set of European markets: which delivery days and time windows are offered, at what price, with which recommendation, and to which customer segment. As technical owner of that configuration, you'll balance demand against capacity: working with supply chain planners, local market teams and our tech partners to validate holiday shifts and peak periods, check daily that the offering behaved as intended, and catch misconfigurations before a customer or a warehouse feels them..</p> <p><strong>What you’ll do: The Recipe</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own the delivery proposition for your set of European markets: the delivery days, time windows, cut-offs, pricing nudges and recommendations customers see when they place or change an order.</li> <li>Configure and calibrate our in-house demand steering tool, so demand is guided towards the capacity we have rather than blocked outright when a production site or delivery route fills up.</li> <li>Monitor daily whether the offering ran as expected across your markets, and get to the bottom of it when it didn't: a data pipeline that stalled, a setting that's off, or a shift in how customers are behaving.</li> <li>Dig into the data with SQL and our monitoring dashboards to establish what actually happened,.</li> <li>Make it make sense to turn technical outcomes into a clear story for colleagues who don't live inside the tool.</li> <li>Partner with supply chain planners, logistics teams, local market colleagues and our tech partners to translate their constraints into configurations, and to flag early where a forecast and a delivery plan are heading for a collision.</li> <li>Lead the validation for holiday shifts and peak periods, giving a clear go/no-go recommendation backed by evidence rather than instinct.</li> <li>Shape where the tool goes next, improving the configurations, checks and documentation that keep demand steering reliable as we roll the model out across more markets.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What you’ll bring: The Ingredients</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience in logistics, supply chain, operations or a related field, where you've seen how a change to what you offer customers affects their journey</li> <li>Confidence with data: you write your own SQL queries, work comfortably in spreadsheets, and read a dashboard closely enough to tell a real signal from noise.</li> <li>A methodical way of working: you like things documented and done properly, and you stay effective while the system around you is still being built out.</li> <li>The ability to explain a technical problem to a non-technical colleague, and to make a recommendation land with evidence behind it.</li> <li>An appetite for ownership over the long haul: you'd rather take one system and develop true mastery in it than move from project to project.</li> <li>Fluent English, and you're based in Berlin or ready to move there.</li> </ul> <p>Above all, we are looking for people who will make HelloFresh better. There are many different ways of developing skills, and we love diverse experiences! So even if you don’t “tick all the boxes” but think you’d thrive in this role, we would really like to learn more about you.</p> <p><strong>What we offer: The Toppings</strong></p> <p>Elevate your lifestyle! Join one of Europe's fastest-growing tech powerhouses in a dynamic phase of expansion.</p> <ul> <li>Immerse yourself in a diverse global community of 90+ nationalities.</li> <li>Enjoy a competitive compensation package that goes beyond the norm, with perks like a HelloFresh- subsidized Pension Scheme, Berlin relocation support, and a Hybrid working model.</li> <li>Elevate your lifestyle with exclusive discounts on your weekly HelloFresh box and office meals.</li> <li>Invest in your growth with a German language learning budget, and access to the HelloFresh Academy.</li> <li>Plus, we've got your well-being covered with mental health support, transportation perks, and working-parent-friendly benefits. From our 24/7 gym access,wellbeing platforms like Headspace and Spill, to sabbatical leave options, HelloFresh is not just a workplace; it's a lifestyle of perks and possibilities!</li> </ul> <p><strong>Are you the missing ingredient? </strong>If this sounds like a tasty opportunity, we’d be excited to hear from you. title: Hub Manager – Last Mile Operations (v/m/x)
description: <p><strong>Over de rol: <em>What's in the Box</em></strong></p> <p>Elke week bezorgen onze chauffeurs verse maaltijdboxen bij duizenden klanten thuis. Als <strong>Hub Manager</strong> zorg je ervoor dat dit elke dag opnieuw vlekkeloos verloopt. Je bent eindverantwoordelijke en de spil van onze last mile operatie: je stuurt een divers team van teamleiders en chauffeurs aan, bewaakt de performance van de hub en bouwt mee aan de groei van HelloFresh in de Benelux.</p> <p>Dit is een rol met verantwoordelijkheid en zichtbare impact. Je combineert operationeel leiderschap met een scherp oog voor mensen: je motiveert waar je kan, stuurt bij waar het moet en gaat moeilijke gesprekken niet uit de weg. Tegelijkertijd verlies je het grotere plaatje nooit uit het oog. Jij zorgt niet alleen dat de hub vandaag goed draait, maar ook dat ze klaar is voor wat morgen komt. Met jouw aanpak maak je elke dag opnieuw het verschil voor je team, voor onze klanten én voor HelloFresh als geheel.</p> <p><strong>Wat je doet: <em>The Recipe</em></strong></p> <ul> <li>Je stuurt de dagelijkse operatie aan en zorgt voor een efficiënte, veilige en professionele werkomgeving voor teamleiders en chauffeurs;</li> <li>Je coacht, motiveert en ontwikkelt jouw team, en schrikt ook niet terug voor moeilijke gesprekken wanneer dat nodig is;</li> <li>Je bewaakt de performance van de hub via KPI's en rapporteert hierover aan je Area Manager, met een constante focus op verbetering;</li> <li>Je werkt nauw samen met aangrenzende teams en stakeholders om operationele uitdagingen pro-actief aan te pakken;</li> <li>Je beheert roosters, planningen en absenteïsme, en draagt zorg voor de ontwikkeling en beoordeling van je medewerkers;</li> <li>Je houdt toezicht op het wagenpark, de kosten en zorgt voor de naleving van welzijns- en milieuregelgeving.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Wat je meebrengt: <em>The Ingredients</em></strong></p> <ul> <li>Minimaal 3 jaar ervaring in de logistieke sector, inclusief aantoonbare ervaring in een leidinggevende rol;</li> <li>Sterke people skills: je weet mensen te verbinden en te motiveren, maar durft ook grenzen te stellen en het gesprek aan te gaan;</li> <li>Analytisch en procesmatig denkvermogen, met een hands-on instelling</li> <li>De flexibiliteit om ook in avonden en weekends beschikbaar te zijn;</li> <li>Uitstekende communicatieve vaardigheden in Nederlands én Engels.</li> </ul> <p>Bovenal zijn we op zoek naar mensen die HelloFresh beter maken. title: People Technology Integrations Manager (All genders)
description: <h2><strong>The Role</strong></h2> <p>We are looking for an experienced People Technology Engineering Manager to join the HelloFresh People Technology leadership team. This role leads the Engineering discipline within People Technology and is responsible for the architecture, capability and delivery of the technical solutions that connect, automate and increasingly enhance our employee technology landscape.</p> <p>Today, the squad’s primary focus is Workday integrations and connected enterprise systems. Over time, its remit will expand across workflow automation, low-code development, AI-enabled solutions and modern engineering capabilities. You will act as the engineering architect and design authority for People Technology, setting technical direction, shaping architecture and establishing standards that balance delivery speed, scalability, security, maintainability and long-term sustainability. This includes maintaining strong expertise in Workday integrations and emerging platform capabilities such as Workday Orchestrate and Extend / Build.</p> <p>You will also lead, develop and performance-manage a team of engineers, building capability across integrations, automation and AI engineering. You will create a high-performing environment grounded in technical quality, accountability and continuous learning, while ensuring the squad has the skills, capacity and ways of working needed to meet both current and future demand. While you may remain hands-on where appropriate, your primary focus will be technical leadership, people development, capability building and delivery oversight.</p> <p>As the senior business partner for engineering, you will represent the discipline across People Technology and work closely with the People function and stakeholders from across the Group. You will help shape roadmaps, influence prioritisation and investment decisions, and translate business needs into scalable engineering solutions. You will also play a central role in determining where AI, automation and intelligent workflows can create measurable value, both by enabling the squad to deliver faster and by building AI-enabled solutions for the wider People Technology organisation.</p> <p>Above all, we are looking for people who will make HelloFresh better. We value diverse experiences and recognise there are many paths into engineering leadership. Even if you do not meet every requirement, we would still like to hear from you if you believe you would thrive in this role.</p> <h2><strong>What You’ll Do</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Act as the engineering architect and design authority for People Technology, owning technical standards, patterns and architectural principles across Workday and connected enterprise systems.</li> <li>Shape the end-to-end engineering landscape and make architectural decisions that balance delivery speed, scalability, security, maintainability and long-term sustainability.</li> <li>Lead the evolution of the squad from a primarily integrations-focused team into a broader People Technology engineering capability.</li> <li>Drive adoption of modern Workday capabilities, including Workday Orchestrate, Extend, Build and future platform innovations.</li> <li>Establish AI engineering capability within the People Technology tribe and identify opportunities to apply AI, automation and intelligent workflows.</li> <li>Champion AI-assisted engineering practices that improve productivity, quality and delivery speed, while ensuring responsible security, privacy and governance.</li> <li>Lead, coach and performance-manage engineers, building capability across integrations, APIs, automation, low-code development and AI-enabled solutions.</li> <li>Plan and manage team capacity, resourcing and capability against current priorities and future demand.</li> <li>Act as the senior engineering business partner to People Technology leadership, Product Managers, Functional Leads and business stakeholders, shaping roadmaps, prioritisation and investment decisions.</li> <li>Translate business needs into scalable technical solutions, resolve complex engineering challenges and maintain oversight of technical debt, dependencies, risks and operational resilience.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What You’ll Bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Typically 8–12+ years of experience in integrations, systems engineering, software engineering or related technical roles.</li> <li>Deep hands-on experience with Workday integrations and the broader Workday technical ecosystem.</li> <li>Strong knowledge title: Localization Language Lead, Polish
description: <h4><strong>Who We Are</strong></h4> <p>Founded in 2005, 2K Games is a global video game company, publishing titles developed by some of the most influential game development studios in the world. Our studios responsible for developing 2K’s portfolio of world-class games across multiple platforms, include Visual Concepts, Firaxis, Hangar 13, CatDaddy, Cloud Chamber, and HB Studios. Our portfolio of titles is expanding due to our global strategic plan, building and acquiring exciting studios whose content continues to inspire all of us! 2K publishes titles in today’s most popular gaming genres, including sports, shooters, action, role-playing, strategy, casual, and family entertainment.</p> <p>Our team of engineers, marketers, artists, writers, data scientists, producers, thinkers and doers, are the professional publishing stewards of our growing library of critically-acclaimed franchises such as NBA 2K, Battleborn, BioShock, Borderlands, The Darkness, Mafia, Sid Meier’s Civilization, WWE 2K, and XCOM.</p> <p>At 2K, we pride ourselves on creating an inclusive work environment, which means encouraging our teams to Come as You Are and do your best work! We are dedicated to diversity and inclusion, and want our community of candidates to reflect this commitment. We encourage all qualified applicants to explore our global positions. 2K is headquartered in Novato, California and is a wholly owned label of Take-Two Interactive Software, Inc. (NASDAQ: TTWO).&nbsp;</p> <h4><strong>What We Need</strong></h4> <p>As part of our Global Loc 2.0 evolution, 2K is deepening its investment in language-specific leadership to improve the voice, cultural authenticity, and overall quality of our localized content. We are seeking a Game Localization Lead to own the linguistic direction and execution strategy for all Polish content across 2K’s game portfolio.</p> <p>This is an individual contributor role within the Content Localization (CLOC) team. You’ll serve as the key Polish language authority, working with minimal supervision across complex projects. You’ll apply deep linguistic and cultural expertise while partnering with developers, producers, QA, and publishing stakeholders to ensure language quality meets player expectations and platform-holder standards.</p> <p>As a Game Localization Lead, you will directly shape how our players in Polish-speaking regions experience our games. You’ll own language strategy, guide voice and tone across titles, and play a key role in 2K’s broader effort to deliver best-in-class localized content through a modern, embedded, and scalable localization model.</p> <h4><strong>What You’ll Do</strong></h4> <p><strong>Linguistic Strategy &amp; Quality Ownership</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own the localization strategy, quality bar, and final sign-off for Polish content across all 2K titles.</li> <li>Develop, maintain, and enforce glossaries, style guides, and cultural content policies for the Polish market.</li> <li>Act as the primary advisor for cultural risk mitigation, proactively identifying regional sensitivities and communicating potential brand impacts to relevant stakeholders.</li> <li>Issue Escalation &amp; Bug Triage: Serve as the main linguistic escalation point for tone disputes or QA challenges, and partner closely with the LQA team to investigate, triage, and resolve complex linguistic bugs.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Core Localization&nbsp;</strong></p> <ul> <li>Review and edit localized content (in-game text, UI, scripts, VO) for tone, clarity, fluency, and cultural relevance.</li> <li>Regularly review in-development and near-final builds to audit for tone, consistency, and cultural resonance.</li> <li>Lead VO casting, script review, and direct creative sessions during Polish voiceover production.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Cross-Functional Collaboration &amp; Compliance </strong></p> <ul> <li>Collaborate with cross-functional teams—localization producers, embedded LQA, marketing, publishing, and dev—to guide language decisions and ensure global alignment.</li> <li>Work alongside the Age Rating team, game studios, and content owners to ensure localized content strictly adheres to Polish age rating requirements and visual/language compliance.</li> <li>Advise on the selection of suitable, legible fonts for the target Polish, collaborating with technical and UI stakeholders to ensure any font-rendering or display issues are resolved in a timely manner.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Leadership, Mentorship, &amp; Continuous Improvement </strong></p> <ul> <li>Supervise and provide feedback to entry- and mid-level linguists or vendors working on Polish content.</li> <li>Recommend and help implement process improvements that improve quality, reduce error rates, or optimize turnaround time for Polish localization.</li> <li>Participate in Global Loc 2.0 initiatives, working with senior leadership to shape evolving localization standards, practices, and tooling.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>What Will Make You A Great Fit</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Professional localization experience in games, tech, or entertainment.</li> <li>Native fluency in Polish, with demonstrated mastery of tone, grammar, and regional nuance.</li> <li>Advanced English fluency (written and spoken); capable of representing language decisions across global teams.</li> <li>Maintain a deep, current understanding of the regional gaming landscape, pop culture zeitgeist, and evolving localization methodologies.</li> <li>Demonstrate a deep-rooted passion for the video game industry, paired with comprehensive knowledge of major gaming IPs, genres, and player culture.</li> <li>Proven ability to work independently on complex language projects, exercising judgment and creativity in ambiguous or conflicting situations.</li> <li>Strong working knowledge of platform-holder guidelines, naming conventions, and brand alignment principles.</li> <li>Comfortable overseeing or mentoring junior linguists and freelance vendors.</li> <li>Familiarity with localization tools (e.g., CAT tools, translation memory systems, XLOC, JIRA, CMS).</li> <li>Deep understanding of Polish culture, media, and the Polish-speaking gaming audience.</li> <li>Experience with VO scripting, dubbing production, and linguistic performance direction is a plus.</li> <li>Bachelor's degree in translation, linguistics, media, or related field preferred.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Core Competencies</strong></p> <ul> <li>Behavioral <ul> <li>A profound, innate understanding of the target market's cultural zeitgeist, allowing the individual to naturally flag sensitivities and adapt content for maximum regional resonance.</li> <li>The tact and authoritative presence required to successfully act as the main escalation point for complex linguistic disputes, resolving QA challenges and tone disagreements while maintaining strong team relationships.</li> <li>A highly detail-oriented mindset essential for successfully auditing in-development builds, spotting minute tone inconsistencies, and catching nuanced visual or linguistic compliance errors.</li> </ul> </li> <li>Technical <ul> <li>Exceptional proficiency in reviewing, editing, and polishing highly complex, multi-format content (UI, scripts, marketing) while strictly enforcing comprehensive glossaries and style guides.</li> <li>Specialized As an LQA Analyst I, you'll be among the first to experience our games in your native language and help shape how they resonate with players across the globe.</p> <p>This is an entry-level role perfect for linguistically sharp, detail-oriented professionals looking to break into games or localization. You’ll test pre-release content for linguistic accuracy, cultural relevance, and UI functionality—while learning the tools, systems, and collaboration models that bring 2K’s global experiences to life.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h3><strong>What You’ll Do</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Execute test passes on localized builds to verify linguistic, functional, and visual accuracy</li> <li>Identify and log localization bugs—ranging from translation issues to UI problems—using detailed, reproducible steps</li> <li>Ensure consistency in spelling, grammar, terminology, tone, variable usage, and cultural appropriateness</li> <li>Amend or propose edits and translations to objective linguistic issues directly in text management systems</li> <li>Analyze reported issues to identify potential root causes and flag patterns that may indicate systemic localization or i18n risks.</li> <li>Flag localization risks early in the development cycle, including potential issues with variables, UI constraints, or source text clarity</li> <li>Support glossary and style guide validation as part of broader quality review cycles</li> <li>Follow documented test plans and contribute to test case creation and improvement</li> <li>Evaluate localization quality against first-party standards, platform-holder terminology, and branding requirements</li> <li>Review localization tickets or player reports, helping reproduce and escalate verified issues</li> <li>Participate in LQA team standups, bug triage, and milestone QA reviews</li> <li>Stay current on key project terminology and serve as a resource for your native language(s)<br>&nbsp;</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What Will Make You A Great Fit</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Native fluency in your supported language Russian</li> <li>Strong written and verbal English communication skills</li> <li>Ideally experience in QA (functional QA, localization QA, or related testing roles), with demonstrated linguistic proficiency in the supported language.</li> <li>Experience with game consoles, mobile platforms, or game development terminology</li> <li>Familiarity with first-party certification standards (Sony, Nintendo, Microsoft)</li> <li>Familiarity with QA and localization workflows, including bug logging and test execution</li> <li>Knowledge of JIRA, bug tracking platforms, or text management systems</li> <li>Comfortable with Microsoft Office, Google Workspace, and version control platforms</li> <li>Proactive, detail-oriented, and organized, with a collaborative mindset</li> <li>Ability to work under deadlines, follow instructions, and ask questions when needed</li> <li>Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience required</li> <li>Passion for video games and cross-cultural storytelling&nbsp;</li> <li>Exposure to localization or CAT tools (e.g., Trados, MemoQ, XLOC)</li> <li>Experience working with or overseeing external QA partners or freelance reviewers</li> <li>ISTQB certification or equivalent QA accreditation</li> <li>Knowledge of <strong>regional age rating standards</strong>, particularly in supported territories</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h3><strong>WHY JOIN US?</strong></h3> <p>As an LQA <strong>Analyst I</strong>, you’ll title: Senior Associate, Experiences & Events
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><em><a href="https://www.1stdibs.com/" target="_blank" data-saferedirecturl="https://www.google.com/url?q=https://www.1stdibs.com/&amp;source=gmail&amp;ust=1729287324725000&amp;usg=AOvVaw3RKuu1oBLmh41YEi8wBeRj">1stDibs</a> is a one-of-a-kind online marketplace that connects design lovers to more than one million extraordinary pieces, from furniture and fine art to jewelry and fashion. As a leading global marketplace for design lovers, we enable shoppers to discover beautiful things and engage with top sellers from around the world. We encourage our shoppers to interact with sellers throughout all stages of the transaction, including item inquiries, price negotiations and customization requests.</em></p></div><p>At 1stDibs, we do what’s right for our community by connecting design lovers with the world's most extraordinary objects. Here, your work directly impacts the business. You’ll join a culture of trust and collaboration where good ideas win, and you are empowered to solve challenging problems. We don’t just host events; we continually evolve how our trade, seller, and consumer communities connect, learn, and engage with luxury design.</p> <h2><strong>The Impact You’ll Make</strong></h2> <p>1stDibs Experiences is building a new business around curated, high-touch events and programming for our trade, seller, and consumer communities. As our Sr Associate, Experiences &amp; Events, you will be the operational backbone of this initiative, ensuring strategic concepts become flawlessly executed, memorable experiences.</p> <ul> <li><strong>Deliver Results:</strong> Own day-to-day execution and production logistics for 2–4 flagship experiences per cycle, driving operational precision from vendor contracts to post-event reconciliation.</li> <li><strong>Collaborate Across Teams:</strong> Serve as the central operational point of contact across Sales, Marketing, Trade, and Operations to keep cross-functional stakeholders aligned and on schedule.</li> <li><strong>Act Like an Owner:</strong> Help shape the operational roadmap of a brand-new business unit from the ground up, proactively spotting bottlenecks and proposing creative solutions in a fast-paced environment.</li> <li><strong>Listen &amp; Learn:</strong> Support customer discovery interviews, synthesize competitive research, and track post-event attendee insights to continuously elevate future programming.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What You’ll Do</strong></h2> <h3><strong>Event Production &amp; Operational Excellence</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Own day-to-day coordination for flagship events across discovery, planning, and execution phases.</li> <li>Manage vendor relationships, including contract review, deliverables, timelines, and invoicing for venues, catering, A/V, and production partners.</li> <li>Build and track event budgets, manage vendor payments, and handle post-event financial reconciliations.</li> <li>Develop comprehensive run-of-show documents, production schedules, and brief materials for internal leaders and external partners.</li> <li>Oversee on-site event logistics, setup, registration, staffing, and live troubleshooting.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Research &amp; Attendee Insights</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Assist in organizing customer discovery interviews, including scheduling, note-taking, and synthesizing feedback.</li> <li>Track and organize post-event survey data and metrics in shared systems to measure success and inform future strategy.</li> <li>Maintain competitive research on experiential trends across the luxury and art/design sectors.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Cross-Functional Coordination</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Partner with the Experiences Program Manager on staffing allocations, resource planning, and timeline tracking.</li> <li>Coordinate activation details, asset delivery, and on-site execution for brand partners and sponsors.</li> <li>Collaborate with Marketing on post-event asset collection and content amplification logistics.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What You’ll Bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Experience:</strong> 3+ years of professional experience in event production, experiential marketing, program management, or partnership activation.</li> <li><strong>Operational Precision:</strong> Meticulous attention to detail with a track record of managing complex timelines, budgets, and vendor contracts without missing a beat.</li> <li><strong>Communication &amp; Collaboration:</strong> Excellent written and verbal communication skills; comfortable presenting to and coordinating across multi-disciplinary global teams.</li> <li><strong>Technical &amp; Organizational Stack:</strong> Proficiency with Google Workspace, project management platforms (Asana), and data/spreadsheet tracking tools.</li> <li><strong>Problem-Solving Instincts:</strong> High level of agility and comfort navigating ambiguity to keep projects moving forward seamlessly.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Nice to Haves</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Prior experience coordinating luxury, e-commerce, art, fashion, or interior design events.</li> <li>Familiarity with sponsorship activations, partnership logistics, or event analytics platforms.</li> </ul> <p>This position is based in NYC but has the potential to not require an in-office presence if you reside in one of the following states: CA, CO, CT, FL, IL, MD, MA, NJ, NY, NC, PA, RI, TX</p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p><em>Our overall compensation package</em><em>&nbsp;is made of several parts, base compensation being one of them. At 1stDibs we value and are proud of our culture, innovation, professional development and training workshops, trust and giving back to the community.&nbsp; Equity, a comprehensive benefits package, and incentive (IF APPLICABLE)&nbsp; are all are components of your total compensation package.&nbsp;</em><em>&nbsp;Ultimately, in determining your pay, we'll consider your location, experience, and other job-related factors.</em></p></div><div class="title">Tri-State Pay Range</div><div class="pay-range"><span>$82,000</span><span class="divider">&mdash;</span><span>$92,000 USD</span></div></div><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p><em>Remote home office-based employees outside of the tri-state area are eligible for the following salary range.</em></p></div><div class="title">Remote</div><div class="pay-range"><span>$74,000</span><span class="divider">&mdash;</span><span>$83,000 USD</span></div></div></div><div class="content-conclusion"><h4><strong><em>1stDibs is an Equal Opportunity Employer</em></strong></h4> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">The 1stDibs mission, to enrich lives with the extraordinary, can only be achieved when diversity, equity and inclusion are embedded into our values, culture and the way we do business. Enabling access to and celebrating unique and diverse perspectives is at the very core of what we do. We are committed to attracting and retaining the best talent in the industry, who are reflective of the diversity of our communities, and fostering an environment where every individual feels they belong, are valued and heard. </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">As a leading design marketplace, we leverage the power of our platform and brand to empowe</span><span style="font-weight: 400;">r historically underrepresented individuals, and the businesses they own, across the art and design industries.</span></p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Total Compensation Statement&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>1stDibs views the value of the employees’ compensation package in its totality. The package may comprise base salary, variable compensation (either equity or cash, where applicable), and health and work-life benefits, and is reviewed annually. Ultimately, we'll determine your pay based on your location, experience, and other job-related factors.&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Benefits (US based positions)</strong></p> <ul> <li>Competitive medical/dental/vision benefits, including a $0 single medical plan, with HSA employer contributions. Health plan includes gender affirmation and infertility care.</li> <li>We are flexible with our PTO. We generally expect employees take around 15 days/year.</li> <li>All employees enjoy ownership in 1stDibs in RSUs, through new hire grants, and/or annual refresh grants, if eligible.</li> <li>The choice to work in our New York headquarters, with monthly in-office meals and mixers, and happy hours, and/or the option to work completely remotely. We truly prioritize flexibility for all employees.</li> <li>Fully paid wellness benefits, including One Medical membership and WellHub.</li> <li>Fully paid parental leave, leave to care for a family member, and bereavement leave, including reproductive loss.</li> <li>Company match of donations to 501c3 charities, up to $250/year.</li> <li>Full benefits package includes FSA, life and disability insurance, EAP, commuter benefits, and more.</li> </ul></div>

title: Registered Veterinary Technician
description: <p><strong>Registered Veterinary Technician&nbsp;</strong></p> <p><strong>Salary:</strong> $30.00-$32.00 per hour dependent on skills and experience&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>What to Expect as an RVT at 5280 Veterinary Care</strong></p> <p>As a Registered Veterinary Technician at 5280 Veterinary Care, you'll be empowered to practice at the top of your license. We believe RVTs are the driving force behind exceptional patient care, outstanding client education, and a thriving medical team. Your knowledge, technical skills, and clinical judgment are respected here—and you'll have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact every single day.</p> <p>You'll work alongside a collaborative team that values your expertise while encouraging continued growth through mentorship, advanced medicine, and a wide variety of interesting cases. We also believe experienced RVTs have an invaluable role in developing those around them. From mentoring veterinary assistants to helping educate our client care team on medical concepts and patient advocacy, you'll help elevate the entire hospital through your knowledge and leadership.</p> <p><strong>To support your career, we offer:</strong></p> <ul> <li>License reimbursement</li> <li>Continuing education assistance and CE pay</li> <li>Professional development opportunities</li> <li>Uniform allowance</li> <li>401(k) with company matching</li> <li>Health insurance</li> <li>Vision insurance</li> <li>Dental insurance</li> <li>Paid time off and flex time for holidays</li> <li>Employee discount</li> <li>Employee Assistance Program (EAP)</li> </ul> <p>No two days look exactly the same here. You'll see a diverse caseload, work alongside experienced doctors, and have opportunities to continue expanding your technical skills while practicing high-quality, gold-standard medicine.</p> <p><strong>What We're Looking For</strong></p> <p>We're looking for an experienced RVT who is passionate about delivering exceptional patient care and takes pride in the details that make a difference. Although every RVT at 5280 Veterinary Care contributes across the hospital, this position has a strong emphasis on surgery and dentistry. We're looking for someone who enjoys the fast pace, technical precision, and teamwork that come with surgical nursing while still embracing the variety that general practice offers.</p> <p><strong>The ideal candidate will have:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Current Registered Veterinary Technician (RVT) license</li> <li>Recent, hands-on experience assisting with veterinary dentistry, including dental radiology, ultrasonic scaling, polishing, and anesthesia monitoring</li> <li>Strong technical nursing skills with confidence in anesthesia, surgery, dentistry, and patient care</li> <li>A passion for mentoring veterinary assistants and sharing knowledge with the medical team</li> <li>Exceptional attention to detail and a personal commitment to providing gold-standard medicine</li> <li>Outstanding communication skills with both clients and teammates</li> <li>A positive, collaborative attitude and a genuine desire to continue learning and growing</li> </ul> <p><strong>Schedule</strong></p> <ul> <li>Full-time</li> <li>Four 10-hour shifts</li> <li>One rotating late shift each week (9:30 AM–8:30 PM)</li> <li>Rotating Saturdays (every other week)</li> </ul> <p><strong>Why 5280 Veterinary Care?</strong></p> <p>Our culture is just as important as the medicine we practice. We've intentionally built a team where kindness, accountability, collaboration, and continuous learning are everyday expectations—not just buzzwords. We value longevity, and we're proud that many of our team members have been with us for years. That kind of retention doesn't happen by accident; it's the result of investing in our people, supporting professional growth, and creating an environment where team members genuinely enjoy coming to work.</p> <p>We believe exceptional medicine starts with exceptional communication. That's why client education is a cornerstone of everything we do—we take the time to explain the why behind our recommendations so pet owners can make informed decisions and become true partners in their pets' care.</p> <p>Our community has recognized that commitment by honoring us with Nextdoor Neighborhood Fave Awards every year from 2022–2025, a Top 3 Best of Mile High finish in 2024, and the 2025 Colorado Companies to Watch – Caring for Colorado Award.</p> <p>We're proud of what we've built, and we're looking for an RVT who wants to grow with a team that's committed to raising the standard of veterinary medicine every day.</p> <p><span data-ccp-props="{}"><span data-teams="true"><em>We are dedicated to establishing a culture that celebrates all forms of diversity and allows us to be an inclusive service provider in this community.</em></span></span></p> <p>&nbsp;</p>

title: Analyste en assurance qualité linguistique (LQA) arabe /  Localization Quality Assurance Analyst - LQA Arabic
description: <p><strong>ANALYSTE LQA</strong></p> <p><strong>TITRE : </strong>Analyste en assurance qualité linguistique (LQA) arabe</p> <p><strong>LIEU : </strong>Montréal</p> <p><strong>SERVICE : </strong>Localisation mondiale</p> <p><strong>ENTREPRISE : </strong>2K (Take-Two Interactive)</p> <p><strong>TYPE : </strong>Temps plein</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>Chez 2K, nous créons des jeux vidéo emblématiques qui façonnent la culture populaire, dont NBA® 2K, l'une des franchises les plus vendues au monde, ainsi que des titres légendaires comme BioShock®, Borderlands®, Mafia, Sid Meier’s Civilization® et XCOM®, sans oublier les favoris du public WWE® 2K, TopSpin® et PGA TOUR® 2K. Nous créons des expériences inoubliables en repoussant les limites de la créativité, de l'authenticité et de l'innovation dans tous les genres.</p> <p>Notre portefeuille est porté par certains des studios de développement les plus influents au monde. Visual Concepts, Firaxis Games, Hangar 13, Cat Daddy Games, 31st Union, Cloud Chamber, Gearbox, HB Studios et 2K SportsLab créent des expériences de classe mondiale sur toutes les plateformes.</p> <p>Mais ce qui fait vraiment la force de 2K, ce sont nos équipes.</p> <p>Nous croyons que les meilleures idées viennent d'équipes qui se sentent autonomes, soutenues et inspirées. En tant qu'employeur garantissant l'égalité d'accès à l'emploi, nous nous engageons à cultiver un milieu de travail diversifié et inclusif, où chacun·e est encouragé·e à venir tel·le qu'il·elle est et à se dépasser.</p> <p><strong>Ce dont nous avons besoin</strong></p> <p>Vous aimez les jeux vidéo? Vous aimez les langues? Dans le cadre de l'initiative Global Loc 2.0 de 2K, nous mettons en place une approche de la localisation plus intégrée et davantage centrée sur la qualité, et les analystes LQA en sont au cœur. En tant qu'analyste LQA I, vous serez parmi les premières personnes à découvrir nos jeux dans votre langue maternelle et à contribuer à la façon dont ils résonnent auprès des joueurs du monde entier.</p> <p>Il s'agit d'un poste de premier échelon, idéal pour des professionnel·le·s rigoureux·ses et doté·e·s d'une grande sensibilité linguistique qui souhaitent faire leurs premiers pas dans le jeu vidéo ou la localisation. Vous testerez des contenus en prélancement afin d'en vérifier l'exactitude linguistique, la pertinence culturelle et le bon fonctionnement de l'interface, tout en vous familiarisant avec les outils, les systèmes et les modes de collaboration qui donnent vie aux expériences mondiales de 2K.</p> <p><strong>Ce que vous ferez</strong></p> <ul> <li>Réaliser des passes de test sur les versions localisées afin de vérifier l'exactitude linguistique, fonctionnelle et visuelle.</li> <li>Identifier et consigner les bogues de localisation, des problèmes de traduction aux défauts d'interface, en fournissant des étapes détaillées et reproductibles.</li> <li>Veiller à la cohérence de l'orthographe, de la grammaire, de la terminologie, du ton, de l'utilisation des variables et de la pertinence culturelle.</li> <li>Corriger ou proposer des modifications et des traductions pour les problèmes linguistiques objectifs, directement dans les systèmes de gestion de texte.</li> <li>Analyser les problèmes signalés afin d'en déterminer les causes potentielles et de repérer les tendances révélatrices de risques systémiques de localisation ou d'internationalisation (i18n).</li> <li>Signaler les risques de localisation tôt dans le cycle de développement, y compris les problèmes potentiels liés aux variables, aux contraintes d'interface ou à la clarté du texte source.</li> <li>Contribuer à la validation des glossaires et des guides de style dans le cadre des cycles de révision qualité plus larges.</li> <li>Suivre les plans de test documentés et contribuer à la création et à l'amélioration des cas de test.</li> <li>Évaluer la qualité de la localisation au regard des normes de certification, de la terminologie des fabricants et des exigences de marque.</li> <li>Examiner les tickets de localisation et les signalements de joueurs, en aidant à reproduire et à faire remonter les problèmes confirmés.</li> <li>Participer aux réunions quotidiennes de l'équipe LQA, au tri des bogues et aux revues qualité de jalon.</li> <li>Se tenir à jour sur la terminologie clé des projets et servir de référence pour votre langue maternelle.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Ce qui fera de vous un bon candidat</strong></p> <ul> <li>Maîtrise parfaite de l'arabe, la langue prise en charge pour ce poste.</li> <li>Excellentes compétences en communication écrite et orale en anglais.</li> <li>1 à 3 ans d'expérience en assurance qualité (AQ fonctionnelle, AQ de localisation ou fonctions de test connexes), avec une maîtrise linguistique démontrée de la langue prise en charge.</li> <li>Expérience des consoles de jeu, des plateformes mobiles ou de la terminologie du développement de jeux.</li> <li>Connaissance des normes de certification des fabricants (Sony, Nintendo, Microsoft).</li> (NASDAQ : TTWO)</p> <p class="~xmsonormal~">Pour en savoir plus, visitez <a href="https://www.GearboxSoftware.com">www.GearboxSoftware.com</a>.</p> <p class="~xmsonormal~"><strong>Ce que nous recherchons</strong></p> <p class="~xmsonormal~">Nous sommes à la recherche d'un·e Artiste technique sénior·e UI pour rejoindre notre équipe. encore.</p> <p><strong>Responsabilit</strong><strong>é</strong><strong>s</strong></p> <ul> <li>Travailler avec les artistes UI et leur équipe pour créer les meilleures pratiques et des flux de travail (NASDAQ: TTWO).&nbsp;</p> <p>2K develops and publishes interactive entertainment globally for console systems, handheld gaming systems and personal computers, including smartphones and tablets, which are delivered through physical retail, digital download, online platforms, and cloud streaming services. 2K publishes titles in today’s most popular gaming genres, including shooters, action, role-playing, strategy, sports, casual, and family entertainment.</p> <p>Our vision at 2K is to create a diverse and inclusion environment to “Come as You are and Feel Equipped to do Your Best Work!” We are dedicated to promoting diversity, multiculturalism, and equality in all that we do. Engagement</p> <ul> <li>Provide high-quality, front-facing HR support to Sports BU employees and managers, providing support on HR inquiries, policy questions, and performance management process guidance.</li> <li>Actively contribute to enhancing the performance, culture, and engagement of the Sports BU through solution-oriented support to employees and managers.</li> <li>Win the hearts and minds of our employees by hosting listening groups, facilitate workshops, and promote our HR open door approach to bolster engagement and drive morale within the Sports BU.</li> <li>Support the Senior Manager, HRBP with employee relations issues by gathering documentation, scheduling meetings, and ensuring accurate note-taking.</li> </ul> <p>Administration &amp; Compliance</p> <ul> <li>Oversee the efficient administration of HR policies, processes, and procedures; making recommendations for improvements and changes and assisting in the development and implementation of policies across the Sports BU.</li> <li>Ensure end-to-end legal compliance is strictly adhered to for all supported populations, always displaying a high level of professionalism in dealing with confidential and sensitive issues.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Who We Think Will Be A Great Fit</strong></p> <p>We are looking for an action-oriented professional with a passion for HR business partnering, a solid understanding of HR administration, and the ability to manage priorities across a global and local scope.</p> <ul> <li>Minimum 2-4 years of HR experience in a fast-paced, global matrix organisation&nbsp;</li> <li>Be comfortable with ambiguity in an evolving, fast-paced environment.</li> <li>Proven ability to provide high-quality, front-line HR support and query resolution.</li> <li>A proactive and problem-solving approach, with the ability to tackle global complexity and call out challenges as they arise.</li> <li>Strong business acumen and a willingness to quickly learn and educate themselves on local legislation&nbsp;</li> <li>Advanced capability in using google sheets, slides &amp; Workday HRIS an asset</li> <li>Excellent written and verbal communication, negotiation, and presentation skills—essential for managing global and local stakeholders.</li> <li>Be a passionate team player with a drive to create a positive work environment.</li> <li>A person who understands the existing culture and is willing to ask questions and learn&nbsp;</li> <li>Awareness of own limitations and when to seek support/advice</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.<br><br>The pay range for this position in California at the start of employment is expected to be between $81,600 and $120,780 per Year. title: Graphics Engineer - NBA 2K
description: <p>At Visual Concepts, we believe great games are made by diverse and empowered teams with a shared passion for play. title: Lead Designer
description: <p style="text-align: center;"><strong>WE ARE GAME MAKERS</strong></p> <p><strong>Who We Are:</strong></p> <p>At 31st Union, we are a diverse team of developers driven by a passion for our art, united by our core values and inspired by a culture of inclusivity to build amazing games that thrill players everywhere. We pursue growth and innovation in an environment of safety and trust. Our culture is built on the belief that the more varied voices in our collective will strengthen our team and our games.&nbsp; We are looking for our next teammate who will raise our bar and make us better.</p> <p>For more information, visit our website at: <a href="https://thirtyfirstunion.com/">thirtyfirstunion.com</a></p> <p><strong>Who You Are:</strong></p> <p>We’re looking for a Lead Designer to join our team and help us shape the future of online multiplayer gaming. You have proven expertise in leading mechanics and systems-based teams and features, developing people and building buy-in through strong working relationships across disciplines to bring things into reality. Radiate changes across the organization</p> </li> <li> <p>Maintain and enforce good executional standards and practices for scripting and design execution - including in-engine and documentation</p> </li> </ul> <p><strong>What Will Make You a Great Fit:</strong></p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <ul> <li> <p>8+ years of professional game design experience, including at least 1 year managing, mentoring, and maintaining accountability for multiple designers within a feature team or area on a AAA development team.</p> </li> <li> <p>Background in shaping and building a live-service game or major live-service systems from development through launch.</p> </li> </ul> <ul> <li> <p>Proven experience designing and leading multiplayer features that touch multiple systems and need strong integration - such as game mode, characters, economy, progression, etc.</p> </li> </ul> <ul> <li> <p>Theory-crafting skillset &amp; past experience designing for depth and multiplayer gameplay.</p> </li> <li> <p>Deep understanding of the various components (UI, Art, Engineering, Audio, VFX, etc.) to ensure gameplay is cohesive and integrated</p> </li> <li> <p>Proactive approach that creates movement in the right direction</p> </li> <li> <p>Capable of rapidly filtering large volumes of feedback into concrete and useful improvements</p> </li> <li> <p>Adept at managing, articulating and advocating for effective tradeoffs&nbsp;</p> </li> <li> <p>Well-played in the multiplayer PvP / Competitive Space and able to deconstruct what works and why.</p> </li> <li> <p>Capability to abstract designs outside of single solutions into patterns and models of player behavior; providing options and flexible design solutions&nbsp;</p> </li> <li> <p>Strong experience with Unreal Engine and Blueprint visual scripting; programming experience (C++, C#, etc.) is a plus.</p> </li> </ul> <hr> <p>The pay range for this position in California at the start of employment is expected to be between $127,500 and $190,000 per year. description: <h4><strong>Who We Are</strong></h4> <p>Founded in 2005, 2K Games is a global video game company, publishing titles developed by some of the most influential game development studios in the world. Our studios responsible for developing 2K’s portfolio of world-class games across multiple platforms, include Visual Concepts, Firaxis, Hangar 13, CatDaddy, Cloud Chamber, and HB Studios. Our portfolio of titles is expanding due to our global strategic plan, building and acquiring exciting studios whose content continues to inspire all of us! 2K publishes titles in today’s most popular gaming genres, including sports, shooters, action, role-playing, strategy, casual, and family entertainment.</p> <p>Our team of engineers, marketers, artists, writers, data scientists, producers, thinkers and doers, are the professional publishing stewards of our growing library of critically-acclaimed franchises such as NBA 2K, Battleborn, BioShock, Borderlands, The Darkness, Mafia, Sid Meier’s Civilization, WWE 2K, and XCOM.</p> <p>At 2K, we pride ourselves on creating an inclusive work environment, which means encouraging our teams to Come as You Are and do your best work! We are dedicated to diversity and inclusion, and want our community of candidates to reflect this commitment. We encourage all qualified applicants to explore our global positions. 2K is headquartered in Novato, California and is a wholly owned label of Take-Two Interactive Software, Inc. (NASDAQ: TTWO).&nbsp;</p> <h4><strong>What We Need</strong></h4> <p>As part of our Global Loc 2.0 evolution, 2K is deepening its investment in language-specific leadership to improve the voice, cultural authenticity, and overall quality of our localized content. We are seeking a Game Localization Lead to own the linguistic direction and execution strategy for all Polish content across 2K’s game portfolio.</p> <p>This is an individual contributor role within the Content Localization (CLOC) team. You’ll serve as the key Polish language authority, working with minimal supervision across complex projects. You’ll apply deep linguistic and cultural expertise while partnering with developers, producers, QA, and publishing stakeholders to ensure language quality meets player expectations and platform-holder standards.</p> <p>As a Game Localization Lead, you will directly shape how our players in Polish-speaking regions experience our games. You’ll own language strategy, guide voice and tone across titles, and play a key role in 2K’s broader effort to deliver best-in-class localized content through a modern, embedded, and scalable localization model.</p> <h4><strong>What You’ll Do</strong></h4> <p><strong>Linguistic Strategy &amp; Quality Ownership</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own the localization strategy, quality bar, and final sign-off for Polish content across all 2K titles.</li> <li>Develop, maintain, and enforce glossaries, style guides, and cultural content policies for the Polish market.</li> <li>Act as the primary advisor for cultural risk mitigation, proactively identifying regional sensitivities and communicating potential brand impacts to relevant stakeholders.</li> <li>Issue Escalation &amp; Bug Triage: Serve as the main linguistic escalation point for tone disputes or QA challenges, and partner closely with the LQA team to investigate, triage, and resolve complex linguistic bugs.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Core Localization&nbsp;</strong></p> <ul> <li>Review and edit localized content (in-game text, UI, scripts, VO) for tone, clarity, fluency, and cultural relevance.</li> <li>Regularly review in-development and near-final builds to audit for tone, consistency, and cultural resonance.</li> <li>Lead VO casting, script review, and direct creative sessions during Polish voiceover production.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Cross-Functional Collaboration &amp; Compliance </strong></p> <ul> <li>Collaborate with cross-functional teams—localization producers, embedded LQA, marketing, publishing, and dev—to guide language decisions and ensure global alignment.</li> <li>Work alongside the Age Rating team, game studios, and content owners to ensure localized content strictly adheres to Polish age rating requirements and visual/language compliance.</li> <li>Advise on the selection of suitable, legible fonts for the target Polish, collaborating with technical and UI stakeholders to ensure any font-rendering or display issues are resolved in a timely manner.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Leadership, Mentorship, &amp; Continuous Improvement </strong></p> <ul> <li>Supervise and provide feedback to entry- and mid-level linguists or vendors working on Polish content.</li> <li>Recommend and help implement process improvements that improve quality, reduce error rates, or optimize turnaround time for Polish localization.</li> <li>Participate in Global Loc 2.0 initiatives, working with senior leadership to shape evolving localization standards, practices, and tooling.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>What Will Make You A Great Fit</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Professional localization experience in games, tech, or entertainment.</li> <li>Native fluency in Polish, with demonstrated mastery of tone, grammar, and regional nuance.</li> <li>Advanced English fluency (written and spoken); capable of representing language decisions across global teams.</li> <li>Maintain a deep, current understanding of the regional gaming landscape, pop culture zeitgeist, and evolving localization methodologies.</li> <li>Demonstrate a deep-rooted passion for the video game industry, paired with comprehensive knowledge of major gaming IPs, genres, and player culture.</li> <li>Proven ability to work independently on complex language projects, exercising judgment and creativity in ambiguous or conflicting situations.</li> <li>Strong working knowledge of platform-holder guidelines, naming conventions, and brand alignment principles.</li> <li>Comfortable overseeing or mentoring junior linguists and freelance vendors.</li> <li>Familiarity with localization tools (e.g., CAT tools, translation memory systems, XLOC, JIRA, CMS).</li> <li>Deep understanding of Polish culture, media, and the Polish-speaking gaming audience.</li> <li>Experience with VO scripting, dubbing production, and linguistic performance direction is a plus.</li> <li>Bachelor's degree in translation, linguistics, media, or related field preferred.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Core Competencies</strong></p> <ul> <li>Behavioral <ul> <li>A profound, innate understanding of the target market's cultural zeitgeist, allowing the individual to naturally flag sensitivities and adapt content for maximum regional resonance.</li> <li>The tact and authoritative presence required to successfully act as the main escalation point for complex linguistic disputes, resolving QA challenges and tone disagreements while maintaining strong team relationships.</li> <li>A highly detail-oriented mindset essential for successfully auditing in-development builds, spotting minute tone inconsistencies, and catching nuanced visual or linguistic compliance errors.</li> </ul> </li> <li>Technical <ul> <li>Exceptional proficiency in reviewing, editing, and polishing highly complex, multi-format content (UI, scripts, marketing) while strictly enforcing comprehensive glossaries and style guides.</li> <li>Specialized technical and creative expertise required to successfully lead VO casting, conduct rigorous script reviews, and directly manage live creative sessions during voiceover production.</li> <li>The technical capability to actively troubleshoot and advise on UI rendering, specifically regarding the selection and implementation of legible, aesthetically suitable fonts for the target language.</li> </ul> </li> <li>Leadership <ul> <li>The absolute accountability and leadership confidence to own the overarching localization strategy, quality bar, and final sign-off for all assigned titles.</li> <li>A strong dedication to elevating the regional team by actively supervising, coaching, and providing actionable feedback to entry- and mid-level linguists and external vendors.</li> <li>The ability to seamlessly lead collaborative efforts across diverse disciplines (LQA, Production, Marketing, Dev), ensuring all stakeholders are aligned on language decisions and bug triage.</li> </ul> </li> Dans le cadre de l'initiative Global Loc 2.0 de 2K, nous mettons en place une approche de la localisation plus intégrée et davantage centrée sur la qualité, et les analystes LQA en sont au cœur. En tant qu'analyste LQA I, vous serez parmi les premières personnes à découvrir nos jeux dans votre langue maternelle et à contribuer à la façon dont ils résonnent auprès des joueurs du monde entier.<br>Il s'agit d'un poste de premier échelon, idéal pour des professionnel·le·s rigoureux·ses et doté·e·s d'une grande sensibilité linguistique qui souhaitent faire leurs premiers pas dans le jeu vidéo ou la localisation. Vous testerez des contenus en prélancement afin d'en vérifier l'exactitude linguistique, la pertinence culturelle et le bon fonctionnement de l'interface, tout en vous familiarisant avec les outils, les systèmes et les modes de collaboration qui donnent vie aux expériences mondiales de 2K.</p> <p><strong><em>&nbsp;</em></strong></p> <p><strong>Ce que vous ferez</strong></p> <ul> <li>Réaliser des passes de test sur les versions localisées afin de vérifier l'exactitude linguistique,<br>fonctionnelle et visuelle.</li> <li>Identifier et consigner les bogues de localisation, des problèmes de traduction aux défauts d'interface, en fournissant des étapes détaillées et reproductibles.</li> <li>Veiller à la cohérence de l'orthographe, de la grammaire, de la terminologie, du ton, de l'utilisation des variables et de la pertinence culturelle</li> <li>Corriger ou proposer des modifications et des traductions pour les problèmes linguistiques objectifs, directement dans les systèmes de gestion de texte.</li> <li>Analyser les problèmes signalés afin d'en déterminer les causes potentielles et de repérer les tendances révélatrices de risques systémiques de localisation ou d'internationalisation (i18n).</li> <li>Signaler les risques de localisation tôt dans le cycle de développement, y compris les problèmes potentiels liés aux variables, aux contraintes d'interface ou à la clarté du texte source.</li> <li>Contribuer à la validation des glossaires et des guides de style dans le cadre des cycles de révision qualité plus larges.</li> <li>Suivre les plans de test documentés et contribuer à la création et à l'amélioration des cas de test.</li> <li>Évaluer la qualité de la localisation au regard des normes des éditeurs propriétaires, de la terminologie des détenteurs de plateformes et des exigences de marque.</li> <li>Examiner les tickets de localisation et les signalements de joueurs, en aidant à reproduire et à faire remonter les problèmes confirmés.</li> <li>Participer aux réunions quotidiennes de l'équipe LQA, au tri des bogues et aux revues qualité de jalon.</li> <li>Se tenir à jour sur la terminologie clé des projets et servir de référence pour votre langue maternelle.<strong><em><br><br></em></strong></li> </ul> <p><strong>Ce dont nous avons besoin</strong></p> <ul> <li>Maîtrise parfaite du portugais brésilien, la langue prise en charge pour ce poste.</li> <li>Excellentes compétences en communication écrite et orale en anglais.</li> <li>1 à 3 ans d'expérience en assurance qualité (AQ fonctionnelle, AQ de localisation ou fonctions de test connexes), avec une maîtrise linguistique démontrée de la langue prise en charge.</li> <li>Expérience des consoles de jeu, des plateformes mobiles ou de la terminologie du développement de jeux.</li> <li>Connaissance des normes de certification des détenteurs de plateformes (Sony, Nintendo, Microsoft).</li> <li>Connaissance des flux de travail d'AQ et de localisation, notamment la consignation des bogues et l'exécution des tests.</li> <li>Connaissance de JIRA, des plateformes de suivi de bogues ou des systèmes de gestion de texte.</li> <li>Aisance avec Microsoft Office, Google Workspace et les plateformes de gestion de versions.</li> <li>Proactivité, rigueur, sens de l'organisation et esprit collaboratif.</li> <li>Capacité à travailler dans le respect des délais, à suivre les consignes et à poser des questions au besoin.</li> <li>Diplôme universitaire de premier cycle ou expérience équivalente requis.</li> <li>Passion pour les jeux vidéo et la narration interculturelle.</li> </ul> <p><strong><em><br></em>Ce qui fera de vous un bon candidat</strong></p> <ul> <li>Première expérience des outils de localisation ou de TAO (par exemple : Trados, MemoQ, XLOC).</li> <li>Expérience de collaboration avec des partenaires d'AQ externes ou des réviseur·se·s indépendant·e·s, ou de supervision de ceux-ci.</li> <li>Certification ISTQB ou accréditation équivalente en AQ.</li> <li>Connaissance des normes régionales de classification par âge, en particulier sur les territoires pris en</li> </ul> <p><strong><em><br></em></strong><strong>POURQUOI NOUS REJOINDRE?<br></strong>En tant qu'analyste LQA I, vous entamerez votre parcours au cœur des efforts de localisation de 2K, en<br>contribuant à rendre nos jeux clairs, culturellement pertinents et agréables pour les joueurs du monde entier. Vous<br>développerez des compétences fondamentales en assurance qualité linguistique dans un environnement<br>collaboratif et multilingue, tout en acquérant une expérience pratique des outils, des processus et des flux de<br>travail qui soutiennent le développement de jeux à l'échelle mondiale.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>TITLE:&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; Localization Quality Assurance Analyst </strong></p> <p><strong>LOCATION:&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;Montreal</strong></p> <p><strong>DEPT:&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; Global Localization</strong></p> <p><strong>COMPANY:&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;2K (Take-Two Interactive)</strong></p> <p><strong>TYPE:&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; Full-Time</strong></p> <p><strong>&nbsp;</strong></p> <p><strong>&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>At 2K, we create some of the most iconic and culture-shaping video games in entertainment, including <em>NBA® 2K</em>, one of the top-selling franchises in the world, and legendary titles like <em>BioShock®, Borderlands®, Mafia, Sid Meier’s Civilization</em>®, and<em> XCOM®</em>, as well as fan favorites <em>WWE® 2K, TopSpin®</em>, and <em>PGA TOUR® 2K.</em> We build unforgettable experiences by pushing the boundaries of creativity, authenticity and innovation across every genre.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>Our portfolio is brought to life by some of the most influential game development studios in the world. Visual Concepts, Firaxis Games, Hangar 13, Cat Daddy Games, 31st Union, Cloud Chamber, Gearbox, HB Studios, and 2K SportsLab create world-class experiences across platforms.</p> <p>But what truly powers 2K is our people.</p> <p>We believe the best ideas come from teams that feel empowered, supported, and inspired. As an equal opportunity employer, we are committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive workplace where people are encouraged to come as they are and do their best work.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>About The Role</strong></p> <p>Love games? Love languages? As part of 2K’s Global Loc 2.0 initiative, we’re building a more embedded and quality-focused approach to localization—and LQA Analysts are at the heart of it. As an LQA Analyst I, you'll be among the first to experience our games in your native language and help shape how they resonate with players across the globe.</p> <p>This is an entry-level role perfect for linguistically sharp, detail-oriented professionals looking to break into games or localization. You’ll test pre-release content for linguistic accuracy, cultural relevance, and UI functionality—while learning the tools, systems, and collaboration models that bring 2K’s global experiences to life.</p> <p><strong>&nbsp;</strong></p> <p><strong>What You’ll Do</strong></p> <ul> <li>Execute test passes on localized builds to verify linguistic, functional, and visual accuracy</li> <li>Identify and log localization bugs—ranging from translation issues to UI problems—using detailed, reproducible steps</li> <li>Ensure consistency in spelling, grammar, terminology, tone, variable usage, and cultural appropriateness</li> <li>Amend or propose edits and translations to objective linguistic issues directly in text management systems</li> <li>Analyze reported issues to identify potential root causes and flag patterns that may indicate systemic localization or i18n risks.</li> <li>Flag localization risks early in the development cycle, including potential issues with variables, UI constraints, or source text clarity</li> <li>Support glossary and style guide validation as part of broader quality review cycles</li> <li>Follow documented test plans and contribute to test case creation and improvement</li> <li>Evaluate localization quality against first-party standards, platform-holder terminology, and branding requirements</li> <li>Review localization tickets or player reports, helping reproduce and escalate verified issues</li> <li>Participate in LQA team standups, bug triage, and milestone QA reviews</li> <li>Stay current on key project terminology and serve as a resource for your native language Brazilian Portuguese</li> </ul> <p><strong>&nbsp;</strong></p> <p><strong>What We Need</strong></p> <ul> <li>Native level fluency in your supported language Brazilian Portuguese</li> <li>Strong written and verbal English communication skills</li> <li>1–3 years of experience in QA (functional QA, localization QA, or related testing roles), with demonstrated linguistic proficiency in the supported language.</li> <li>Experience with game consoles, mobile platforms, or game development terminology</li> <li>Familiarity with first-party certification standards (Sony, Nintendo, Microsoft)</li> <li>Familiarity with QA and localization workflows, including bug logging and test execution</li> <li>Knowledge of JIRA, bug tracking platforms, or text management systems</li> <li>Comfortable with Microsoft Office, Google Workspace, and version control platforms</li> <li>Proactive, detail-oriented, and organized, with a collaborative mindset</li> <li>Ability to work under deadlines, follow instructions, and ask questions when needed</li> <li>Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience required</li> <li>Passion for video games and cross-cultural storytelling</li> </ul> <p><strong>&nbsp;</strong></p> <p><strong>What Will Make You A Great Fit</strong></p> <ul> <li>Exposure to localization or CAT tools (e.g., Trados, MemoQ, XLOC)</li> <li>Experience working with or overseeing external QA partners or freelance reviewers</li> <li>ISTQB certification or equivalent QA accreditation</li> <li>Knowledge of <strong>regional age rating standards</strong>, particularly in supported territories</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>WHY JOIN US?</strong></p> <p>As an LQA <strong>Analyst</strong>, you’ll begin your journey at the heart of 2K’s localization efforts—helping ensure our games are clear, culturally relevant, and enjoyable for players around the world. You’ll build foundational skills in linguistic QA within a collaborative, multilingual environment, while gaining hands-on experience with the tools, processes, and workflows that support global game development.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong><em><span lang="~EN-US~">Please note that 2K Games and its studios never uses instant messaging apps or personal email accounts to contact prospective employees or conduct interviews and when emailing, only use 2K.com accounts.</span></em></strong></p> <p class="~xmsonormal~">#LI-Onsite&nbsp;<br><br></p> <p><br><br></p> <p>&nbsp;</p>
