title: Manager, Commercial Strategy
description: <h2><strong>Who We Are</strong></h2> <p>2K is headquartered in Novato, California and is a wholly owned label of Take-Two Interactive Software, Inc. (NASDAQ: TTWO). Founded in 2005, 2K Games is a global video game company, publishing titles developed by some of the most influential game development studios in the world. Our studios responsible for developing 2K’s portfolio of world-class games across multiple platforms, include Visual Concepts, Firaxis, Hangar 13, CatDaddy, Cloud Chamber, 31st Union, and HB Studios. Our portfolio of titles is expanding due to our global strategic plan, building and acquiring exciting studios whose content continues to inspire all of us! 2K publishes titles in today’s most popular gaming genres, including sports, shooters, action, role-playing, strategy, casual, and family entertainment.</p> <p>Our team of engineers, marketers, artists, writers, data scientists, producers, thinkers and doers, are the professional publishing stewards of our growing library of critically-acclaimed franchises such as NBA 2K, 2K PGA, Battleborn, BioShock, Borderlands, The Quarry, The Darkness, Mafia, Sid Meier’s Civilization, Marvel’s Midnight Suns, WWE 2K, and XCOM.</p> <p>At 2K, we pride ourselves on creating an inclusive work environment, which means encouraging our teams to <em><strong>Come as You Are</strong></em> &nbsp;and do your best work! We encourage ALL applicants to explore our global positions, even if they don’t meet every requirement for the role. If you're interested in the job and think you have what it takes to work at 2K, we encourage you to apply!</p> <h1><strong>What We Need</strong></h1> <p>We’re looking for a highly analytical and strategic thinker to join our team as a Manager, Commercial Strategy. In this role, you’ll help define the strategy behind how our games are launched, monetized, and supported over time. This is a 0-to-1 role. You won't be inheriting a mature P&amp;L and tuning it at the margins, instead you'll be defining the commercial model from the ground up: designing the monetization framework, building the forecasting models, standing up the KPIs and dashboards, and partnering closely with product and design as we move between development milestones toward a global launch and ongoing live operations. If you’re the kind of person who enjoys diving into data, building business cases, and translating insights into clear, actionable plans, then this is a great opportunity!</p> <p>You'll sit at the intersection of product, design, marketing, data analytics, and finance, and you'll be the person who connects the dots between "what's good for the player" to "what's good for the business."</p> <h1><strong>What You Will Do</strong></h1> <ul> <li>Modeling &amp; Business Case Development: Build and maintain Excel-based financial and strategic models to support business cases, investment decisions, and scenario planning</li> <li>KPI Frameworks &amp; Forecasting: Create and deliver forecast and reporting packages, showcasing key business metrics and financial results, to the broader Business Unit leadership teams</li> <li>Continuously refine the free-to-play monetization framework, including virtual currency, battle/season pass, cosmetics, bundles, offers, etc.</li> <li>Define and maintain the monetization roadmap in partnership with product and design, always balancing revenue against player experience, fairness, and long-term retention</li> <li>Stand up commercial reporting and dashboards in partnership with the data / analytics team so the business has a single source of truth</li> <li>Live Services P&amp;L Support: Develop a clear understanding of the drivers behind a live services P&amp;L. Interpret weekly business performance, identifying trends and levers that can be pulled to optimize player engagement and profitability</li> <li>Market &amp; Competitive Analysis: Maintain a clear view of the F2P / live-service competitive landscape, including benchmarks, market sizing, and emerging trends. Translate findings into actionable recommendations to inform leadership and support strategic planning</li> <li>Partner with the Product, Marketing &amp; Analytics teams to design and prioritize strategic projects that provide deep commercial insight and inform product and marketing decisions</li> </ul> <h1><strong>What Will Make You a Great Fit</strong></h1> <ul> <li>4-6+ years of experience in a strategy, finance, consulting, or analytics role, ideally within gaming, entertainment, or a digital consumer business</li> <li>Advanced Excel / financial modeling skills; comfortable building models from scratch</li> <li>Strong understanding of live service game economics and the gaming market landscape</li> <li>Ability to distill complex data into clear narratives and recommendations for senior stakeholders</li> <li>Experience collaborating with data teams and familiarity with data tools (e.g., SQL, Tableau, Looker) is a plus</li> <li>You’re intellectually curious: you enjoy asking why, digging into the details, and connecting dots others might miss.</li> <li>You’re comfortable working in gray areas: ambiguity doesn’t throw you off; in fact, you enjoy bringing structure to messy or open-ended problems.</li> <li>You know how to manage up: you’re proactive in keeping stakeholders informed, setting expectations, and getting buy-in from senior leaders.</li> </ul> <p>As an equal opportunity employer, we are committed to ensuring that qualified individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, perform their essential job functions, and receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us if you need a reasonable accommodation.</p> <p><strong>Please note that 2K Games and its studios never use instant messaging apps or personal email accounts to contact prospective employees or conduct interviews and when emailing, only use 2K.com accounts.</strong></p> <p><br>The pay range for this position in California at the start of employment is expected to be between $108,900 and $161,160 per Year. However, base pay offered is based on market location, and may vary further depending on individualized factors for job candidates, such as job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and other objective business considerations. Subject to those same considerations, the total compensation package for employees in regular roles may also include other elements, including a bonus and/or equity awards, in addition to a full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits, provided that temporary or intern roles will not be eligible for many of these payments or benefits. Details of participation in compensation and benefit plans (if applicable) will be provided if an employee receives an offer of employment.If hired, employee will be in an ~at-will position~ and the company reserves the right to modify base salary (as well as any other discretionary payment or compensation or benefit program) at any time, including for reasons related to individual performance, company or individual department/team performance, and market factors.</p>

title: Manager, Global Brand Marketing
description: <h3><strong>WHO WE ARE</strong></h3> <p>The Gearbox Entertainment Company is home to a world-class team that entertains the world with award-winning and genre-defining video games. Our games are entrenched with rich universes that are expanded upon via transmedia storytelling, live experiences, and consumer products. Gearbox Entertainment has become widely known for developing successful game franchises such as Borderlands, Tiny Tina’s Wonderlands, and Brothers in Arms, as well for continued development of acquired properties including Duke Nukem, Risk of Rain, and Homeworld.</p> <p>The company was founded as Gearbox Software in 1999 by a team of industry veterans and is headquartered in Frisco, Texas. The Gearbox Entertainment Company is proud to be part of 2K, a publishing label of Take-Two Interactive Software, Inc. (NASDAQ: TTWO).</p> <p>For more information, visit<a href="https://www.google.com/search?q=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.GearboxSoftware.com"> www.GearboxSoftware.com</a>.</p> <h3><strong>WHAT WE NEED</strong></h3> <p>2K is looking for a Manager, Global Brand Marketing to join the Strategy Games Franchise Group, supporting the Gearbox Software business (Borderlands, Risk of Rain, Wonderlands). Reporting to the Director of Brand Marketing, this role will help lead the strategic development, execution, and performance of global marketing campaigns for some of 2K’s most beloved gaming franchises.</p> <p>The ideal candidate is a creative and strategic marketer with experience developing and executing global, multi-channel campaigns for entertainment or gaming brands. You bring a balance of creativity and analytical thinking, thrive in a collaborative environment, and are passionate about building marketing programs that connect with players worldwide. Blending art and science, you will help create innovative campaigns that deliver measurable results and bring the franchise vision to life.</p> <p>Success in this role depends on exceptional organization, communication, and collaboration skills. You can distill complex ideas into clear, actionable plans and work effectively across teams to keep projects on track. Equally comfortable supporting strategic planning or driving day-to-day execution, you foster alignment, accountability, and teamwork across disciplines and time zones.</p> <h3><strong>WHAT YOU'LL DO</strong></h3> <h4><strong>GLOBAL CAMPAIGN &amp; BRAND STRATEGY</strong></h4> <ul> <li>​Support the development and presentation of the global marketing strategy for the Gearbox Software franchise group, including audience definition, product positioning, messaging, and content strategy.</li> <li>Assist in building global go-to-market plans, coordinating with cross-functional teams to align creative direction and campaign cadence with studio milestones and publishing priorities.</li> <li>Collaborate with game development leads to ensure marketing reflects the franchise’s creative vision while supporting commercial objectives.</li> <li>Contribute to annual business planning and campaign retrospectives, helping identify opportunities for growth and creative innovation.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>CAMPAIGN EXECUTION &amp; CROSS-FUNCTIONAL COLLABORATION</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Drive end-to-end campaign execution, collaborating with PR, Social, Community, Influencer, Paid Media, Partnerships, Web, and other teams to deliver fully integrated global campaigns.</li> <li>Partner with regional marketing leads to ensure alignment with brand strategy and creative vision while adapting campaigns for cultural and market relevance.</li> <li>Manage campaign timelines, creative briefs, approvals, and agency coordination to ensure assets are delivered on time, on brand, and within budget.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>INSIGHTS, DATA &amp; OPTIMIZATION</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Leverage audience research, market insights, and player telemetry to inform campaign strategy and creative execution.</li> <li>Establish KPIs and performance benchmarks, analyze campaign results, develop campaign reports, and apply learnings to optimize future marketing efforts.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>FINANCIAL &amp; OPERATIONAL MANAGEMENT</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Manage budget trackers, PO processing, and expense tracking, ensuring accuracy, timely reporting, and effective resource allocation.</li> <li>Maintain campaign documentation, asset trackers, and delivery schedules to ensure smooth coordination across teams.</li> <li>Support process improvements that strengthen organization, communication, and execution efficiency.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>WHAT WILL MAKE YOU A GREAT FIT</strong></h4> <p>If you’re a creative, strategic, and collaborative marketer who’s passionate about storytelling and delivering world-class campaigns, you’ll feel right at home on 2K’s team of award-winning marketers. You’ll love turning audience insights into impactful global marketing programs that bring 2K’s portfolio of strategy franchises to life and engage players around the world. You’ll thrive on collaboration across creative, studio, and regional teams, driving organized, data-informed, and high-quality execution from strategy through delivery.</p> <h3><strong>MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Bachelor’s Degree.</li> <li>Minimum of 3-5 years of marketing or product management experience in gaming or entertainment.</li> <li>Obsessed with understanding and serving the player.</li> <li>Highly organized, with the ability to manage a busy campaign schedule while helping structure and align key partners.</li> <li>Proven experience contributing to the planning and execution of creative marketing programs for major entertainment or gaming brands.</li> <li>A true team player who loves collaborating to generate creative ideas and solutions.</li> <li>Comfortable in a fast-paced environment where teams must act, adapt, and learn quickly.</li> <li>Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to influence and build strong relationships across departments and geographies.</li> <li>A proactive project owner, critical thinker, and problem solver who champions clear goals and drives the team to deliver cohesive, timely results.</li> </ul> <p><strong>NICE TO HAVES</strong></p> <ul> <li>For this role, a strong interest in history and aptitude for evaluating historical authenticity would be welcome.</li> </ul> <p>The pay range for this position in California at the start of employment is expected to be between $103,700 and $140,000 per Year. However, base pay offered is based on market location, and may vary further depending on individualized factors for job candidates, such as job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and other objective business considerations.</p> <p>Subject to those same considerations, the total compensation package for employees in regular roles may also include other elements, including a bonus and/or equity awards, in addition to a full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits, provided that temporary or intern roles will not be eligible for many of these payments or benefits. title: Manager, Product Marketing
description: <p><strong>Who We Are</strong></p> <p>2K is headquartered in Novato, California and is a wholly owned label of Take-Two Interactive Software, Inc. (NASDAQ: TTWO). Founded in 2005, 2K Games is a global video game company, publishing titles developed by some of the most influential game development studios in the world. Our studios responsible for developing 2K’s portfolio of world-class games across multiple platforms, include Visual Concepts, Firaxis, Hangar 13, CatDaddy, Cloud Chamber, 31st Union, HB Studios, and 2K SportsLab. Our portfolio of titles is expanding due to our global strategic plan, building and acquiring exciting studios whose content continues to inspire all of us! 2K publishes titles in today’s most popular gaming genres, including sports, shooters, action, role-playing, strategy, casual, and family entertainment.</p> <p>Our team of engineers, marketers, artists, writers, data scientists, producers, thinkers and doers, are the professional publishing stewards of 2K’s portfolio currently includes several AAA, sports and entertainment brands, including global powerhouse NBA®️ 2K,&nbsp; renowned BioShock®️, Borderlands®️, Mafia, Sid Meier’s Civilization®️ and XCOM®️ brands; popular WWE®️ 2K and WWE®️ SuperCard franchises, TopSpin 2K25, as well as the critically and commercially acclaimed PGA TOUR®️ 2K.</p> <p>At 2K, we pride ourselves on creating an inclusive work environment, which means encouraging our teams to Come as You Are and do your best work! We encourage ALL applicants to explore our global positions, even if they don’t meet every requirement for the role.&nbsp; If you're interested in the job and think you have what it takes to work at 2K, we encourage you to apply!</p> <p><strong>What We Need</strong></p> <p>The PGA TOUR 2K Integrated Marketing team is looking for a Manager, Product Marketing. We are responsible for building data-driven marketing strategies that reach and engage fans with value-rich experiences that drive revenue growth, brand health, and loyalty. We aim to connect fans around the world to the most engaging golf platform: our franchise.&nbsp;</p> <p>As a Manager, Product Marketing, you will be responsible for helping deliver full-funnel marketing campaigns, in partnership with internal and external partners, to drive player satisfaction and commercial success. From Seasonal Live-Service executions, to multi-faceted partnership campaigns, to targeted in-game promotions, you will ideate on product feature messaging and strategies, lead in-game creative development, oversee tactical execution plans, and leverage new and emerging technologies to best serve our players. This is a role that never stands still, and where no two days are the same.&nbsp;</p> <p>To be successful in this role, you will need to be a true product marketing expert that understands every facet of our game and how they serve our current and prospective players. Within the integrated marketing team, it is your responsibility to be the product’s source of truth to help inform go-to-market strategies through a strong, collaborative mindset and data-driven insight. An existing passion for, or a willingness to learn about, the sport of golf is key: the PGA TOUR 2K franchise is the most authentic representation of the sport, and success in this role is determined by our ability to demonstrate that to our players.&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>What You Will Do</strong></p> <ul> <li>Manage comprehensive end-to-end marketing campaigns across our full live-services machine. From title-level level marketing planning, to Seasonal creative executions, to Free-to-Play activations, to real-life sporting event tie-ins. You will often manage multiple campaigns concurrently.</li> <li>Authentically represent player needs by knowing our game in and out, through a deep understanding and appreciation for player insights and analytics, as well as time spent in the game testing out features and flows to best represent ways we highlight product value and live services content.&nbsp;</li> <li>Own our in-game lifecycle strategy: architecting messaging and offer constructs that move our players through the optimal player experience. Leverage campaign learnings and insights to optimize evergreen messaging and intervention timings.&nbsp;</li> <li>Lead and execute high-profile brand partnerships, influencer tie-ins, and promotional activations; you will work with internal Partnerships and Product teams to help establish how our licensed partners come to life in-game, then build marketing campaigns to drive awareness and engagement with their branded content.&nbsp;&nbsp;</li> <li>Build and maintain high-trust relationships across our Business Unit and our shared service teams to ensure zero friction in the execution of integrated global campaigns.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p><strong>What Will Make You A Great Fit</strong></p> <p><strong>Product Passion &amp; Literacy:</strong> You're as comfortable in a product roadmap conversation as a campaign brief kick off call. You know how to establish, define and represent marketing priorities to influence product decisions and create content that authentically resonates with our players.&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Operational Rigor:</strong> You can hold multiple campaigns, live and upcoming, in harmony without losing precision on any one of them—meeting internal and external deadlines to execute flawlessly.&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Content &amp; Channel Fluency:</strong> You can partner with multiple cross-functional teams to orchestrate a multi-touchpoint tactical execution, understanding the nuance between owned, earned and paid channels to maximise acquisition and engagement.</p> <p><strong>Partnership &amp; Licensing Acumen:</strong> You know how to run activations that integrate licenses, licensors and/or talent from concept through to legal sign-off, balancing creative ambition with third-party and IP priorities and obligations.</p> <p><strong>Cross-Functional Influence:</strong> You build trust quickly with key stakeholders across the Business Unit, shared services teams, and our development studio. You will operate as the connective tissue that keeps teams moving in the same direction towards execution.</p> <p>Qualifications</p> <ul> <li>Proven experience in product marketing, live-service campaign management, or lifecycle marketing experience within gaming or digital entertainment.</li> <li>Extensive knowledge or interest in sports verticals, ideally golf.</li> <li>Passion to deliver thoughtfully integrated campaigns players can resonate with, that showcase the product as a means to drive awareness, acquisition and retention.</li> <li>Deep understanding of how to measure and report on marketing performance across owned and operated, earned, and paid channels.</li> <li>Strong ability to interpret data and learnings to influence real-time decision making.</li> <li>Familiarity with PC &amp; console gaming marketing (PlayStation, Xbox. Steam) a plus.</li> </ul> <p>As an equal opportunity employer, we are committed to ensuring that qualified individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform their essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us if you need reasonable accommodation.</p> <p>Please note that 2K Games and its studios never uses instant messaging apps or personal email accounts to contact prospective employees or conduct interviews and when emailing, only use 2K.com accounts.</p> <p class="~xmsonormal~"><br>#LI-Hybrid</p> <p>&nbsp;</p>

description: <h2><strong>Who We Are</strong></h2> <p>Founded in 2005, 2K Games is a global video game company, publishing titles developed by some of the most influential game development studios in the world. Our studios responsible for developing 2K’s portfolio of world-class games across multiple platforms, include Visual Concepts, Firaxis, Hangar 13, CatDaddy, Cloud Chamber, 31st Union, and HB Studios. Our portfolio of titles is expanding due to our global strategic plan, building and acquiring exciting studios whose content continues to inspire all of us! 2K publishes titles in today’s most popular gaming genres, including sports, shooters, action, role-playing, strategy, casual, and family entertainment.</p> <p>Our team of engineers, marketers, artists, writers, data scientists, producers, problem solvers and doers, are the professional publishing stewards of our growing library of critically acclaimed franchises such as NBA 2K, 2K PGA, BioShock, Borderlands, The Quarry, The Darkness, Mafia, Sid Meier’s Civilization, Marvel’s Midnight Suns, WWE 2K, and XCOM.</p> <p>At 2K, we pride ourselves on creating an inclusive work environment, which means encouraging our teams to Come as You Are and do your best work! We are dedicated to diversity and inclusion, and want our community of candidates to reflect this commitment. We encourage all qualified applicants to explore our global positions.</p> <p>2K is headquartered in Novato, California and is a wholly owned label of Take-Two Interactive Software, Inc. (NASDAQ: TTWO).</p> <h2><strong>What We Need</strong></h2> <p>We’re looking for an experienced Principal Product Manager to ensure 2K Technology delivers the physical and cloud infrastructure capabilities critical to our next generation of titles.</p> <p>2K’s studios and Publishing teams rely on 2K Technology infrastructure to perform consistently, reliably, globally, and cost-effectively at scale – whether they use solutions built and managed internally, provided by a partner, or supplied via vendor. Likewise, our central technology teams require robust, shared infrastructure to maximize the value they too deliver to the rest of 2K. The strategy you lead will ensure the success of all these endeavors.</p> <h2><strong>What You Will Do</strong></h2> <p>●&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; Champion the vision and strategy for 2K Technology’s practices in cloud infrastructure, physical infrastructure, and developer tools. You will develop and execute these strategies in close coordination with stakeholders and peer leaders. You will ensure that our internal teams deeply understand and anticipate the diverse needs of our studio and Publishing customers while moving 2K toward a consistent, efficient, and robust technology foundation.</p> <p>●&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; Lead through influence to align stakeholders, partners, and teams to the vision. Through strong communication and reliable delivery, you will inspire trust and confidence in 2K Technology’s ability to solve on behalf of its customers. You will advocate proactively on behalf of your customers, your teams, and the rest of our central technology organization.</p> <p>●&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; Form productive, positive partnerships with leaders across our Infrastructure organization, including SRE and Technical Operations. Through these relationships, you will execute on shared opportunities to extend our capabilities, improve operational discipline, and advance our central tech strategy.</p> <p>●&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; Work closely with peers in engineering and program management to plan effectively, validate assumptions, and deliver high-quality outcomes for customers. You will contribute to our shared understanding of what good looks like across multiple dimensions of product and technical quality.</p> <p>●&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; Requirements capture, definition, and validation; roadmapping; competitive analyses; customer interviews; strategic planning; KPI development and reporting.</p> <h2><strong>Who We Think Will Be A Great Fit</strong></h2> <p>●&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; 7-10+ years in product or project management, developing and delivering technical software products.</p> <p>●&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; Background in physical and cloud infrastructure as a product, project, or engineering leader. You have opinions on how to deliver scalable, fault-tolerant, and observable production systems to a global organization, and on how best to productize development and delivery best practices. You have experience aligning others to the vision and accelerating the great ideas of others.</p> <p>●&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; Strong oral and written communication skills, with keen attention to detail. You have experience presenting to senior management and key stakeholders to drive decisions and win buy-in for your ideas. At the same time, you are diplomatic, empathetic, and appreciative of differing perspectives: peers enjoy productive partnership with you even in times of disagreement.</p> <p>●&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; Enthusiastic about building products, organizations, and culture. You thrive in unstructured but are excited about creating the structures we require to succeed. You remain composed and effective under pressure and navigate high-velocity change with stability and focus. title: Principal Technical Animator
description: <table> <thead> <tr> <th style="text-align: left;"> <p>Job Title</p> </th> <th style="text-align: left;"> <p>Principal Technical Animator (Gameplay)</p> </th> </tr> </thead> <tbody> <tr> <td> <p><strong>Department</strong></p> </td> <td> <p><strong>Technical Art</strong></p> </td> </tr> <tr> <td> <p><strong>Location(s)&nbsp;</strong></p> </td> <td> <p><strong>Brighton, Prague, Brno</strong></p> </td> </tr> <tr> <td> <p><strong>Reports To&nbsp;</strong></p> </td> <td> <p><strong>Associate Director Technical Animation</strong></p> </td> </tr> <tr> <td> <p><strong>Job Type (Permanent, fixed term, internship)&nbsp;</strong></p> </td> <td> <p><strong>Permanent</strong></p> </td> </tr> </tbody> </table> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Job Summary&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>The Principal Technical Animator (Gameplay) will help define the technical vision, architectural framework, and long-term strategy for character animation integration across the studio. In this highly influential role, you will champion innovation, driving the adoption of cutting-edge technologies to ensure our games achieve world-class animation quality and responsiveness. You will serve as a technical authority on gameplay animation, solving the studio’s complex R&amp;D challenges while collaborating with design, animation and engineering to establish future-proof pipelines. While not a people manager, you will inspire, mentor, and elevate the technical capabilities of the entire animation department.&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Duties and Responsibilities&nbsp;&nbsp;</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Architect and oversee</strong> the high-level design of gameplay animation systems, ensuring scalability, performance, and seamless integration across complex real-time systems.</li> <li><strong>Drive R&amp;D initiatives</strong> to evaluate and implement cutting-edge animation technologies (e.g., advanced Motion Matching, machine learning/AI animation, next-gen physics).</li> <li><strong>Partner with Engineering and Tech Animation leadership</strong> to implement project-wide animation roadmaps and toolsets.&nbsp;</li> <li><strong>Solve deep, complex runtime bugs</strong> and drive animation optimisation efforts to meet strict performance and memory budgets.</li> <li><strong>Define and document</strong> technical standards, best practices, and pipeline workflows for the wider technical animation team.</li> <li><strong>Collaborate closely with Design and Animation leads</strong> to heavily iterate on and perfect 3C mechanics (character, camera, controls), maximizing game feel.</li> <li><strong>Actively mentor and upskill</strong> senior and mid-level technical animators through code/blueprint reviews and hands-on guidance.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Essential Skills, Attributes and Experience</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Extensive proven experience</strong> architecting and integrating gameplay animation systems for AAA titles using Unreal Engine.</li> <li><strong>Master-level expertise</strong> in Unreal Engine’s animation suite (Anim Blueprints, Motion Matching, Control Rig, State Machines,&nbsp; description: <p><strong>Who We Are</strong></p> <p>2K is headquartered in Novato, California and is a wholly owned label of Take-Two Interactive Software, Inc. (NASDAQ: TTWO). We’re looking for someone who can translate product &amp; business knowledge into deep analysis and, in turn, translate to actionable insights for cross functional business stakeholders. As you deliver valuable insights to stakeholders, you will aim to build strong relationships, become a trusted partner among business functions, and scale out team efforts from one team to the next. Our mission is to enable our partners to be more proactive, productive &amp; successful by providing best in class, end-to-end and scalable data solutions.</p> <p>&nbsp;<strong>What You Will Do</strong></p> <ul> <li>Leverage a deep understanding of how our titles’ game features &amp; mechanics work and our business priorities to deliver actionable, business-impacting insights</li> <li>Support business narratives and develop business cases with effective data storytelling. Focus on using data and hypothesis-driven decision-making to drive future growth and customer lifetime value</li> <li>Learn different business teams’ and stakeholders’ ways of working and preferences for understanding data, and be a bridge between the data team and business teams (Product, Marketing, Commercial) to translate complex business needs into data-related projects</li> <li>Tailor the output to match stakeholder needs, including reports, visualizations, charts, and tables</li> <li>Gain an understanding of internal titles outside of our portfolio (NBA 2K, Borderlands, other 2K titles) to provide strong benchmarking and comparison points for business performance</li> <li>Drive the exploration of creative new ways of measurement to identify patterns and causal relationships</li> <li>Empower teams to track and analyze activity/productivity and support their research projects, leading the efforts towards building scalable self-service tools</li> <li>Support analysts and other data-users to improve their capabilities, and contribute to both the team and wider business understanding of our players</li> <li>Data doesn't just appear overnight, we work with our stakeholders to understand what data matters most to their business and strategy. In addition to delivering insights on what is available to us, this role will be responsible for liaising with stakeholders to proactively identify what data we need to begin to record for future initiatives that drive value</li> </ul> <p><strong>Who We Think Will Be a Great Fit</strong></p> <p>The ideal candidate for this role has the ability to see the underlying story in the data, know how to ask the right questions and relate output back to measurable player or business outcomes. A solution-oriented and creative problem solver. A self-starter with the passion and enthusiasm to join a growing insights team to get results for meaningful change.</p> <p><strong>Qualifications:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Track record of successfully leading the delivery of insights and analysis across business functions (Product, Commercial, Marketing)</li> <li>Proven ability to produce impactful insights that resulted in tangible enhancements to product or business outcomes</li> <li>Profound knowledge in SQL&nbsp;</li> <li>Great communication skills and a clear understanding of how to make insights understandable and actionable for the business</li> <li>High degree of proactivity and curiosity to understand, measure, and improve our understanding of our players and their behaviour</li> <li>Ability to lead the delivery of complex projects and manage changing priorities</li> <li>Understanding internal customer satisfaction as one of your key success factors</li> <li>Profound experience in data modeling (strong nice to have: data science language, such as Python or R)</li> <li>Experience in data visualization tools, such as Tableau</li> <li>Video games experience &amp; passion - particularly in sports titles</li> </ul> <p>As an equal opportunity employer, we are committed to ensuring that qualified individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform their essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Predictive Modeling: Define requirements for and lead the creation, monitoring, and iterative improvement of key statistical models and AI solutions used for marketing spend optimization, product growth, and player engagement.</li> <li>Executive Communication &amp; Narrative: Design clear, unambiguous narratives and visualizations to communicate complex data initiatives to broad, non-technical audiences up to the executive level.</li> <li>Collaboration &amp; Cross-Functional Partnership: Work closely with peers across the broader data and analytics organization toward shared goals — aligning on data sources, standards, and priorities early, and sharing knowledge so the whole team's work compounds rather than duplicates.</li> <li>Technical Consultation: Reason effectively about the strengths and weaknesses of different modeling approaches, selecting and iterating on combinations that suit specific business contexts.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Core Competencies</strong></p> <ul> <li>Behavioral: Solution-oriented, creative problem solver, and self-starter; advanced SQL “data carpentry” skills across modern data warehouse environments; able to independently implement advanced predictive models.</li> <li>Strategic Influence: Strong understanding of the business and the context surrounding business asks; ability to bridge technical and business needs and influence product, marketing, and commercial strategy through data-backed evidence at all levels of the organization.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Required Qualifications, Knowledge, and Job-Related Skills</strong></p> <ul> <li>Education: BSc, MSc, or PhD in Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, or another quantitative field.</li> <li>Experience: 3–5 years of professional experience in data science or machine learning, building models with complex datasets, with a consistent track record of business impact.</li> <li>Data Systems: Proven experience in relational databases and SQL; Other tasks and duties may be assigned or reassigned as needed.</p> <p>Please note that 2K Games and its studios never uses instant messaging apps or personal email accounts to contact prospective employees or conduct interviews and when emailing, only use 2K.com accounts.&nbsp;</p>

title: Senior Engineer, Server – NBA 2K
description: <p>At Visual Concepts, we believe great games are made by diverse and empowered teams with a shared passion for play. As one of the world’s top game development studios, we have shipped over 100 multi-sku titles to critical acclaim and commercial success. Our teams are independent and entrepreneurial. Our studios in Novato, Irvine, Budapest, Shanghai, Austin, Boise, Seoul, and Parksville, Canada are committed to artistry and technical innovation, offering top candidates the opportunity to learn and grow with some of the smartest and most creative minds in the industry.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h2><strong>What We Need:</strong></h2> <p>We’re seeking a Senior Engineer with a passion for server-side development to join the NBA 2K team! In this role, you’ll take ownership across a broad technical landscape- working in distributed systems, large-scale computing, and efficient databases to build high-performance backend services. Your work will play a key role in delivering world-class online experiences that power one of the most popular sports game franchises in the world. This role reports into Lead Director of Programming.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h2><strong>What You Will Do:</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Work in the backend architecture and services that support NBA 2K’s online features</li> <li>Design and optimize distributed systems to ensure scalability, reliability, and fault tolerance</li> <li>Build and maintain large-scale computing solutions that handle millions of concurrent players</li> <li>Develop efficient database structures and queries to support high-volume, real-time transactions</li> <li>Deliver high-performance backend services with a focus on low latency and stability</li> <li>Partner with engineering and design teams to enable seamless online gameplay experiences.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h2><strong>Who Will Be A Great Fit:</strong></h2> <ul> <li>5+ years of professional software development experience, with a strong focus on backend and server-side systems</li> <li>Strong proficiency in C++ with a solid understanding of object-oriented programming principles</li> <li>Proficiency in one or more scripting languages such as Python, PHP, Perl, or Ruby, with a strong preference for Python</li> <li>Understanding of distributed and scalable systems</li> <li>Proven experience with multithreaded programming, driving efficiency and stability across large-scale, real-time environments</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to research, evaluate, and integrate emerging technologies and trends to enhance team capabilities, platform performance, and product innovation</li> <li>BS in Computer Science or equivalent experience in large-scale software development</li> <li>Experience developing secure transaction systems, including virtual currency and account-based features, a strong plus</li> <li>Skilled in database optimization, including connection management and query performance tuning</li> <li>Familiarity with online gaming architectures and service design for live, connected player experiences</li> <li>Working knowledge of SQL databases such as MySQL, Microsoft SQL Server, or similar systems</li> <li>Video game console development experience is highly beneficial</li> <li>Love for video games (not just ours!)</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>This is a fully remote role that may be based anywhere in the United States. Ontario only: The use of Artificial Intelligence is not being used to screen candidates. title: Senior External Development Manager
description: <p style="text-align: center;"><strong>WE ARE GAME MAKERS</strong></p> <p><strong>Who We Are:</strong></p> <p>We are a diverse team of developers driven by a passion for our art, united by our core values and inspired by a culture of inclusivity to build amazing games that thrill players everywhere. We pursue growth and innovation in an environment of safety and trust. Our culture is built on the belief that the more varied voices in our collective will strengthen our team and our games. We are looking for our next teammate who will raise our bar and make us better.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>What We Need:</strong></p> <p>We are seeking a senior external development leader to own how 31st Union works with external partners: what we send out, who we send it to, how it comes back, and how good it is when it does. You will set our external development strategy in partnership with the Head of Operations and studio leadership, and then build the thing you designed, including the pipelines, trackers, briefs, review loops, and onboarding paths that our partnerships actually run on.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>This role combines strategy ownership with hands-on production ownership</strong>. You are the person in the room when we decide what is viable to outsource on our AAA project. You are also the person who writes the tracker, fixes the brief template, and chases the access ticket. You will partner closely with Production to work out how we resource and schedule external work, and with Art Direction and our discipline leads to make sure the feedback reaching a vendor's team is specific, consistent, and actionable. This is a first-in-seat role. There is no external development team to inherit, and building one as our slate grows is part of the job.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>What You'll Do:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>External Development Strategy:</strong> Partner with Head of Operations and studio leadership to set and evolve our external development strategy: which disciplines are viable to send out, which partnership model fits each (asset vendor, embedded team, full co-development), and what we deliberately keep in house. Draft the internal-versus-external business cases behind those calls rather than presenting them as instinct.</li> <li><strong>Pipeline &amp; Workflow Ownership:</strong> Design, implement, and maintain the tools, systems, workflows, and operational policies that external development runs on in partnership with our domain leaders, including brief and outsourcing pack templates, asset trackers, review protocols, acceptance criteria, onboarding documentation, and the reporting standards behind all of it.&nbsp;</li> <li><strong>Partner Sourcing &amp; Commercial Management:</strong> Lead the RFP process, vendor outreach, portfolio and evaluation, as well as partner selection. Negotiate scope, capacity, cost, and delivery expectations against project goals and budget. Own the lifecycle of each partnership in collaboration with internal stakeholders: contracts and amendments with Legal and Procurement, invoices, renewals and expirations, offboarding, and onboarding, including driving IT and information security escalations to resolution so partners are productive quickly and safely.</li> <li><strong>Budget &amp; Forecasting:</strong> Manage the studio's external development budget and forecast process in partnership with the Operations team. Model cost against capacity, identify where spend is buying us the most, review deliverables against contractual criteria before milestone payments release, and bring cost-efficiency options to leadership before you are asked for them.</li> <li><strong>Production Partnership:</strong> Work with Production and discipline leads to determine how we actually produce external development: where the capacity gaps are, how external work is sequenced against internal milestones, and how workload is balanced across our internal teams and our external partners. Make sure external schedules and internal plans are aligned.</li> <li><strong>Creative Partnership &amp; Quality Oversight:</strong> Partner with Art Direction, craft owners, and discipline leads to define creative briefs, style guides, benchmark assets, and quality bars before production starts. Build and run the review cadence that gets vendor work in front of the right internal eyes on time, and make sure what goes back out is actionable direction. Protect our Art Directors' review time by establishing a technical and visual pre-screen process, and keep the loop tight enough that a partner's team improves over the course of an engagement.</li> <li><strong>Delivery Oversight, Risk &amp; Reporting:</strong> Build and manage vendor production schedules, monitor milestone health across the full slate of partnerships, and proactively mitigate risk from schedule, budget, or scope drift, bringing problems forward early with options attached rather than warnings. Own our external development database and reporting standards, and report vendor KPIs, capacity, spend, and delivery trends to studio leadership and publisher stakeholders in terms they can act on.</li> <li><strong>Building The Function &amp; The Bench:</strong> Grow external development from a function of one into a team as our slate requires it, including headcount recommendations, structure, and career pathing. Mentor and calibrate the team members managing our external engagements across our disciplines, whether or not they report to you.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Who You Are:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>A Strategist Who Still Builds:</strong> You can hold a multi-year view of our partner portfolio and open a spreadsheet the same afternoon. You are not looking for a role where the work arrives pre-scoped, and you are not looking for one where you only build other people's plans. You want both, and you know the difference between the two modes.</li> <li><strong>An Operator With Commercial Teeth:</strong> You have run RFPs, negotiated SOWs and rates, and owned a budget rather than reported on one. You are comfortable saying no to a partner, and comfortable explaining to a lead why the cheaper bid is the more expensive decision.</li> <li><strong>Grounded In The Craft:</strong> You may not be an artist, but you can tell the difference between a vendor skill gap, a brief gap, and a process gap, and you know which one you are looking at before you write the feedback. You understand what a style guide and a benchmark asset are for, and why a technical constraint agreed in week one saves a month in week twelve.</li> <li><strong>A Collaborator, A Diplomat, And A Developer Of People:</strong> You are the bridge between internal leads who want it perfect, production who wants it on the date, and a partner team eleven time zones away who wants a clear answer. You convey complex creative feedback clearly and diplomatically, often to non-native English speakers, and you manage communication windows rather than complaining about them. You articulate not just the "what" but the "why," to your own team and to our partners, and you treat a vendor as capability to be grown rather than capacity to be bought.</li> <li><strong>Comfortable In The "Gray" Areas:</strong> You are joining a function that does not fully exist yet. You are comfortable shaping new processes and adjusting them as the department evolves, and you would rather establish the standard than wait for one.</li> <li><strong>Tooling:</strong> Strong working knowledge of Jira and ShotGrid/Flow, and enough spreadsheet and data fluency to build the reporting yourself. Familiarity with Perforce or equivalent source control, and with how assets get integrated into a live engine build.</li> <li><strong>Level of Experience:</strong> 6 to 8+ years of external development or production experience in the video game industry, with a track record of running external development across multiple projects or a full franchise and real budget ownership.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Bonus Points:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience standing up an external development or outsourcing function from scratch.</li> <li>Experience with global partners across multiple time zones and cultures, including studios in Eastern Europe, South America, or Asia.</li> <li>Familiarity with publisher-side production and cross-studio coordination.</li> <li>Hands-on background in one of the disciplines we outsource, whether art, animation, audio, engineering, or QA.</li> </ul> <p><br>The pay range for this position in California at the start of employment is expected to be between $127,500 and $188,700&nbsp;per Year. However, base pay offered is based on market location, and may vary further depending on individualized factors for job candidates, such as job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and other objective business considerations. Subject to those same considerations, the total compensation package for employees in regular roles may also include other elements, including a bonus and/or equity awards, in addition to a full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits, provided that temporary or intern roles will not be eligible for many of these payments or benefits. Details of participation in compensation and benefit plans (if applicable) will be provided if an employee receives an offer of employment. If hired, employee will be in an ~at-will position~ and the company reserves the right to modify base salary (as well as any other discretionary payment or compensation or benefit program) at any time, including for reasons related to individual performance, company or individual department/team performance, and market factors.</p>

title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
description: <p>At 2K, we create some of the most iconic and culture-shaping video games in entertainment, including <strong><em>NBA® 2K</em></strong>, one of the top-selling franchises in the world, and legendary titles like <strong><em>BioShock®</em></strong><em>, </em><strong><em>Borderlands®</em></strong><em>, </em><strong><em>Mafia</em></strong><em>, </em><strong><em>Sid Meier’s Civilization</em></strong><strong>®</strong>, and<em> </em><strong><em>XCOM®</em></strong>, as well as fan favorites <strong><em>WWE® 2K</em></strong><em>, </em><strong><em>TopSpin®</em></strong>, and <strong><em>PGA TOUR® 2K</em></strong><em>.</em> We build unforgettable experiences by pushing the boundaries of creativity, authenticity and innovation across every genre.</p> <p>Our portfolio is brought to life by some of the most influential game development studios in the world. <strong>Visual Concepts, Firaxis Games, Hangar 13, Cat Daddy Games, 31st Union, Cloud Chamber, Gearbox, HB Studios, </strong>and <strong>2K SportsLab</strong> create world-class experiences across platforms.</p> <p>But what truly powers 2K is our people.</p> <p>We believe the best ideas come from teams that feel empowered, supported, and inspired. As an equal opportunity employer, we are committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive workplace where people are encouraged to <strong>come as they are</strong> and do their best work.&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>What We Need</strong></p> <p>You are an exceptional software engineer with a strong track record of deploying and operating ML models in production, particularly as low-latency, high-availability prediction services. You can deploy ML models as real-time, near-real-time, or batch services depending on the requirements of the use case. You bring deep, hands-on machine learning experience with a working command of ML algorithm types and tasks, the end-to-end ML lifecycle, and modern modeling and serving frameworks.</p> <p>You operate with autonomy and judgment. You're a solution-oriented, creative problem solver and a self-starter who drives initiatives end-to-end: scoping ambiguous problems, making sound architectural choices across multi-component systems, and shipping to deadline. As a senior engineer, you raise the bar around you by setting technical direction, mentoring others, and championing engineering standards across the team and wider ML community.<strong><em><span lang="~EN-US~"><br></span></em></strong></p> <p><strong>What You Will Do</strong></p> <ul> <li>Partner with ML scientists, data engineers, central tech, and game studios to deploy ML models as production-grade decision services and integrate them into larger systems and live products.&nbsp;</li> <li>Own and mature Machine Learning Ops practice: CI/CD for models, model registry and feature stores, real-time inference at scale, monitoring, drift detection, and reproducibility. Advocate for engineering best practices across the community.&nbsp;</li> <li>Design and rapidly prototype ML-powered products for applications including recommenders, matchmaking, cheat/toxicity intervention, and economy balancing.&nbsp;</li> <li>Work closely with studio devs and central tech to plan and execute the integration of ML applications into games on launch timelines.&nbsp;</li> <li>Identify, evaluate, and pilot opportunities to apply&nbsp; GenAI/LLM to enable new use cases, and translate promising concepts into secure, scalable, and measurable solutions.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What Will Make You A Great Fit</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer/Electrical Engineering, or a related STEM field and 4+ years in software development/engineering, including substantial experience deploying ML in production, or Master's degree with 2-4 years of relevant experience.</li> <li>Strong programming skills, proficient in Python. Familiarity with a high-performance systems language (C, C++, Java, Rust, …) is a plus. Comfortable across object-oriented and functional paradigms, and quick to pick up new languages as needed.</li> <li>Solid grounding in common ML tasks (supervised and unsupervised; reinforcement learning a plus) and commonly used algorithms across traditional ML and deep learning, with the ability to learn new approaches quickly.&nbsp;</li> <li>Hands-on with modern ML frameworks such asPyTorch, TensorFlow, scikit-learn, or Spark ML.&nbsp;</li> <li>Production experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, or Azure), containers and orchestration (e.g. Kubernetes), serverless, and microservice architecture.&nbsp;</li> <li>Hands-on with MLOps and CI/CD tooling including model registries, feature stores, pipeline orchestration (e.g. Airflow, Kubeflow, or MLflow), and automated training, deployment, and monitoring.&nbsp;</li> <li>Experience with modern data technologies such as relational and NoSQL databases, and lakehouse/big-data tooling such as Apache Spark or Databricks/Delta.&nbsp;</li> <li>Flexibility to start and end late to offer a couple of hours overlap with our US HQ (core hours approximately 10:00–18:30 local) to enable close collaboration.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Nice To Have</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience with recommender systems, search algorithms, matchmaking, or reinforcement learning technologies.&nbsp;</li> <li>Experience with infrastructure-as-code and infrastructure automation tools,&nbsp; such as Terraform, or AWS CloudFormation.&nbsp;</li> <li>Experience with managed ML platforms such as Amazon SageMaker or Databricks.</li> <li>Familiarity with stream processing tools such as Apache Kafka, Kinesis, or Spark Streaming.&nbsp;</li> <li>Familiarity with&nbsp; GenAI and LLM application patterns and technologies,&nbsp; including RAG, evaluation and guardrails, agentic workflows, or vector databases.&nbsp;</li> <li>Major game engines such as Unreal or Unity.</li> </ul> <p>As an equal opportunity employer, we are committed to ensuring that qualified individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform their essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us if you need reasonable accommodation.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong><em><span lang="~EN-US~">Please note that 2K Games and its studios never uses instant messaging apps or personal email accounts to contact prospective employees or conduct interviews and when emailing, only use 2K.com accounts.</span></em></strong></p> <p>#LI-Hybrid</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>&nbsp;</p>

title: Senior Manager, Asia Marketing
description: <p><strong><strong>Who We Are:&nbsp;</strong></strong></p> <p>Founded in 2005, 2K develops and publishes interactive entertainment globally for console systems, handheld gaming systems and personal computers, including smartphones and tablets, which are delivered through physical retail, digital download, online platforms and cloud streaming services. 2K publishes titles in today’s most popular gaming genres, including shooters, action, role-playing, strategy, sports, casual, and family entertainment.</p> <p>The 2K label has some of the most talented development studios in the world today, including Firaxis Games, Visual Concepts, Hangar 13 and Cat Daddy Games. 2K’s stable of high-quality titles includes the critically acclaimed BioShock®, Borderlands™ and XCOM® franchises, the beloved Sid Meier’s Civilization series, the popular WWE 2K franchise and NBA 2K, the #1 rated and #1 selling basketball franchise*. 2K is headquartered in Novato, California and is a wholly owned label of Take-Two Interactive Software, Inc. (NASDAQ: TTWO). For more information, please visit www.2K.com.</p> <p><strong><strong>Summary:</strong></strong></p> <p>The primary objective of this role is to manage and operate 2K Korea’s social media channels in close, cross-functional collaboration with the 2K Asia marketing team to expand brand reach and ensure global "Big Beats" resonate within the local market.</p> <p>This position is a high-stakes, execution-oriented position responsible for brand equity and growth of brand awareness for 2K’s AAA blockbuster PC and Console franchises—including NBA 2K, Sid Meier’s Civilization, and Borderlands.</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities:</strong></p> <p><strong>Social Media &amp; emphasis on close collaboration with the studio and navigating geographical boundaries within publishing.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Team Leadership</strong></p> <ul> <li>Line Management: Oversee the Analytics, and our Development partners at Visual Concepts and HB Studios to champion the needs and wants of our players and improve our game experiences.</li> <li>Own the feedback loop for both title communities, and find ways to cross-leverage learnings between WWE 2K, PGA TOUR 2K, and the wider 2K sports portfolio.</li> <li>Use analytics and social listening tools to identify and quantify player needs, and turn them into regular, decision-ready reporting for marketing, studio, and executive stakeholders.</li> <li>Guide the marketing, social, and communications teams in coordinating and executing community-facing requests of the development teams, including patch and season communications, roster and course update messaging, and live issue response.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Social Marketing</strong></p> <ul> <li>Serve as the social marketing expert for both franchises, collaborating with cross-functional teams to prioritize and streamline efforts while managing expectations, timelines, and team needs to execute social workstreams and campaigns.</li> <li>Develop platform-specific global social marketing strategies in collaboration with Global Social Marketing, increasing our presence across channels and building cultural relevance for our games and brands.</li> <li>Develop and execute social marketing campaigns built from audience insights and aligned to our identified target audiences, from annual launches through live seasons.</li> <li>Steer creative ideation and social content development needed to launch best-in-class campaigns, bringing good taste in content and a clear eye for which approaches will move the needle.</li> <li>Ensure community insight feeds social creative and social performance feeds community strategy, so the two disciplines compound rather than run in parallel.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Community &amp; If you're interested in the job and think you have what it takes to work at 2K, we encourage you to apply!</p> <p><strong>What We Need</strong></p> <p>We are looking for a <strong>Senior Product Manager </strong>to join the 2K Product team to work on a new IP. You will work closely with studios and product leadership to develop, guide, implement, and optimize the Live Services strategies supporting our new IPs' creative vision.</p> <p><strong>What You Will Do</strong></p> <p>Closely partner with development and publishing teams to drive, define and deliver product &amp; business strategy for unannounced projects, including:</p> <ul> <li>Collaborate with studio and publishing teams to build Product Needs for in-game features and core gameplay, focused on player engagement, interest, satisfaction and how those relate to business outcomes. Effectively partner with studio and publishing teams to guide and support prioritization, tradeoffs and value.&nbsp;</li> <li>Use data, insights (research), and user testing to build a deep understanding of player behaviors, engagement patterns, content preferences, and player trust.</li> <li>Partner with Monetization and Commercial to connect player satisfaction and business value to create win-win scenarios for both</li> <li>Define Product imperatives and needs, market fit and testable hypothesis for a both successful game and Live Service updates.</li> <li>Team up with marketing landscape, trends, competitor products, and recommendations that help us grow and evolve our thinking.</li> <li>Be the Product Champion – Share insights, processes, and lessons learned with other studio &amp; publishing teams.</li> <li>Be the Player Advocate – Deeply understand and advocate for the player’s perspective; be their advocate in the room who understands them and speaks up for them to make sure we’re authentically serving our players.</li> </ul> <p><strong>&nbsp;What Will Make You a Great Fit&nbsp;&nbsp;</strong></p> <ul> <li>5+ years of experience, including product management, production, live ops, game design, or other related fields within Live Service / Competitive games</li> <li>Deep understanding of and passion for competitive games, player motivations, and market With studios in Brighton (UK), Brno, and Prague (CZ), we work as one team to bring to life narrative-rich games that keep players immersed. Each of our locations provides the opportunity to work with some of the most talented developers in the industry, on creatively challenging and exciting projects, in a diverse and welcoming environment.</p> <h2><strong>Job Summary</strong></h2> <p>Hangar 13 is looking for a seasoned Senior Rendering Engineer who enjoys a collaborative and creative work environment and is looking to push the boundaries of cutting-edge 3D graphics. In this role, you will bridge the gap between stock Unreal Engine 5 capabilities and the high-performance, photorealistic visual demands of our current AAA projects. Working in a globally distributed team alongside our Tech Art, Lighting, and Environment teams, you will research, implement, and optimize custom rendering techniques that empower artists to deliver their vision stably and performantly. This is an ideal position for an engineer who thrives on navigating large codebases, solving complex technical pipeline overlaps, and making bold engine-level changes to advance game technology.</p> <h2><strong>Duties and Responsibilities</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Advance, modify, and optimize Unreal Engine 5's stock rendering pipeline to meet strict performance and artistic demands.</li> <li>Partner closely with the Lighting Team, Environment Art teams, and Tech Art/Shaders departments to bridge team overlaps, eliminate pipeline bottlenecks, and bring the creative vision of our games to life.</li> <li>Research, develop, implement, and debug high-end, photorealistic graphics techniques applicable to characters and large-scale environments.</li> <li>Efficiently draft and deliver clear technical designs to different audiences, skillfully filtering out unnecessary detail for non-technical stakeholders.</li> <li>Identify technical and developmental risks/obstacles within the rendering pipeline and proactively generate solutions to overcome them.</li> <li>Navigate, maintain, and safely improve within a massive, multi-platform codebase using advanced C++ and modern graphics APIs.</li> <li>Collaborate closely across multiple studio locations, ensuring close alignment with the Render Lead and local engineering anchors between studio locations.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Essential Skills, Attributes and Experience</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Industry Experience:</strong> Significant experience in computer games engineering, specifically focused on real-time computer graphics, shaders, and engine development.</li> <li><strong>Technical Mastery:</strong> Advanced knowledge of C++ and multi-threaded programming techniques.</li> <li><strong>Graphics:</strong> Strong knowledge of modern Real-Time Rendering techniques, 3D math, and linear algebra.</li> <li><strong>Language &amp; Communication:</strong> English proficiency with exceptional communication and collaboration skills.</li> <li><strong>Work Style:</strong> Demonstrated ability to work both collaboratively within a highly integrated global team and self-sufficiently as an outcome-oriented problem solver.</li> <li><strong>Qualifications:</strong> Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent professional work experience.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Highly Desirable</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Shipped Titles:</strong> Shipped one or more AAA game titles on multiple platforms.&nbsp;</li> <li><strong>Engine Specifics:</strong> Deep multi-platform development experience utilizing Unreal Engine 5 or highly customized proprietary engines.</li> <li><strong>Console Debugging:</strong> Hands-on familiarity with console profiling and debugging tools (e.g., RenderDoc, PIX, etc.).</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>Hangar 13&nbsp; prides itself on the diversity of its team members, partners, and communities.&nbsp; For this reason, we remain committed to providing equal employment opportunity in all aspects of the employment relationship, from recruitment and hiring through compensation, benefits, discipline and termination.&nbsp;&nbsp;</p> <p>As an equal opportunity employer, we are also committed to ensuring that qualified individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation(s) to participate in the job application and/or interview process, to perform their essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment.&nbsp; Please contact us if you need to request reasonable accommodation.</p> <p><strong>SECURITY NOTICE -&nbsp;&nbsp;</strong>We have recently been made aware of increasing occurrences of bad actors posing as company HR personnel to gain information from "potential candidates", in the form of job interviews and offers. These scams can be quite sophisticated and appear legitimate.</p> <p>Please know that Hangar 13 and 2K never use instant messaging apps to contact prospective employees or to conduct interviews.</p> <p>If you believe you have been a victim of such a scam, you may fill out a complaint form at&nbsp;<a href="https://complaint.ic3.gov/">https://complaint.ic3.gov/</a>&nbsp;and&nbsp;<a href="https://reportfraud.ftc.gov/">https://reportfraud.ftc.gov/</a>&nbsp;detailing as much as possible. description: <p style="text-align: center;"><strong>WE ARE GAME MAKERS</strong></p> <p><strong>Who We Are:</strong></p> <p>We are a diverse team of developers driven by a passion for our art, united by our core values and inspired by a culture of inclusivity to build amazing games that thrill players everywhere. We pursue growth and innovation in an environment of safety and trust. Our culture is built on the belief that the more varied voices in our collective will strengthen our team and our games.&nbsp; We are looking for our next teammate who will raise our bar and make us better.</p> <p><strong>What We Need:</strong></p> <p>We’re seeking a Senior Shader Technical Artist to leverage their technical skills and artistic understanding to help develop and maintain a strong shader pipeline that will serve teams across multiple disciplines. Your passion, knowledge, and experience will be integral to the look and style of a new generation of player-driven experiences, stemming from your ability to create high-quality shaders and technology that bring life to the worlds we build.</p> <p><strong>What You'll Do:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Utilize extensive experience in Unreal Engine to meticulously craft and optimize shader/master constraints.</li> <li>Drive the development of innovative approaches to address complex technical and creative challenges, participating in the creation of shaders, shading validation tools, and <p><strong>What Will Make You a Great Fit:</strong></p> <ul> <li>7+ years of experience or at least one shipped title in a Technical Art role, with proficiency in creating stylized and PBR shaders As an equal opportunity employer, we are committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive workplace where people are encouraged to come as they are and do their best work</span><span data-path-to-node="3,4">.</span></p> <p data-path-to-node="4"><strong data-path-to-node="4" data-index-in-node="0">What We Need</strong></p> <p data-path-to-node="4">The 2K SRE team owns the infrastructure behind every player connection. The infrastructure keeps millions of players connected, and the team takes that seriously.</p> <p data-path-to-node="5">The Senior SRE at 2K is a hands-on technical leader. You'll shape production infrastructure across AWS and on-premises VMware environments, working with network engineers, database administrators, systems architects and game studio developers. This is an ownership role. You'll set technical direction, improve reliability from architecture review through production, and close the gap between what engineering ships and what players experience.</p> <p data-path-to-node="6"><strong data-path-to-node="6" data-index-in-node="0">Duties</strong></p> <p data-path-to-node="7">Platform &amp; Infrastructure</p> <ul data-path-to-node="8"> <li> <p data-path-to-node="8,0,0">Design, build and operate scalable hybrid infrastructure across AWS and VMware vSphere, using Terraform for provisioning and Puppet for configuration management.</p> </li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="8,1,0">Own the full lifecycle of EC2 fleets and VMware clusters (ESXi, vCenter, vSAN, NSX): capacity planning, patching, image pipelines (Packer, AMIs, VM templates) and autoscaling.</p> </li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="8,2,0">Architect secure, resilient AWS networking: VPCs, Transit Gateway, Direct Connect, Route 53, ALB/NLB and CloudFront.</p> </li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="8,3,0">Operate and automate F5 BIG-IP load balancers and firewalls (LTM, AFM, DNS/GTM): virtual servers, pools, health monitors, iRules, SSL offload and global traffic management across data centers and AWS.</p> </li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="8,4,0">Use blue/green and canary releases for game service deployments, with tools like CodeDeploy, weighted target groups, F5 pool weighting and DNS-based traffic shifting.</p> </li> </ul> <p data-path-to-node="9">Databases (MySQL &amp; PostgreSQL)</p> <ul data-path-to-node="10"> <li> <p data-path-to-node="10,0,0">Operate MySQL and PostgreSQL at production scale, both self-managed on VMware and EC2 and managed on Amazon RDS and Aurora.</p> </li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="10,1,0">Own replication topologies, failover, backup and point-in-time recovery, and disaster recovery testing.</p> </li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="10,2,0">Lead major-version upgrades, schema migration tooling and zero-downtime maintenance procedures.</p> </li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="10,3,0">Tune query performance, connection pooling (ProxySQL, PgBouncer) and resource sizing for high-concurrency game workloads.</p> </li> </ul> <p data-path-to-node="11">Observability &amp; Reliability</p> <ul data-path-to-node="12"> <li> <p data-path-to-node="12,0,0">Build and run the full observability stack: Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog and OpenTelemetry, including database, VMware and F5 telemetry.</p> </li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="12,1,0">Define SLI/SLO/error budget policies and build alerting that cuts through the noise.</p> </li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="12,2,0">Lead chaos engineering and failover exercises (for example, AWS Fault Injection Service, F5 HA failover and database failover drills) to find failure modes before description: <p style="text-align: center;"><strong>WE ARE GAME MAKERS</strong></p> <p><strong>Who We Are:</strong></p> <p>We are a diverse team of developers driven by a passion for our art, united by our core values and inspired by a culture of inclusivity to build amazing games that thrill players everywhere. In this role, you’ll be a key feature driver, partnering with various cross functional teams to shape how players grow, are rewarded, and evolve over time! You have proven expertise in game economy design, reward systems, and the intentional design work needed to balance the complex relationship between them. You can both communicate and document design features, intent and specs clearly and work in-engine to bring those experiences to reality. You seamlessly form strong working relationships among peers of different disciplines, bring others with you towards a shared vision, and proactively work with production &amp; game leadership to make it a reality. We’re a studio that values autonomy and self-drive in developers who are empowered to do the best work of their careers. If this is you, let’s talk!</p> <p><strong>What You'll Do:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Drive a small portfolio of complex features through initial creative input, stakeholder buy-in and alignment, consistent design reviews, and day-to-day execution.&nbsp;</li> <li>Respond quickly to feedback with stable in-engine updates and iterate rapidly.</li> <li>Provide design leadership within your feature area while contributing to broader game quality by mentoring others and sharing insights.</li> <li>Reliably source ideas from around the studio, combining with own proposals and references to other products, in order to quickly solve and innovate within design challenges.</li> <li>Work cross-functionally within and outside of your team to communicate and align on the work, tradeoffs and dependencies. Radiate changes across the organization; set and mobilize against feature goals; and provide forward-looking direction aligned with greater design philosophy.&nbsp;</li> <li>Share best practices and techniques with peers to improve the overall experience</li> </ul> <p><strong>What Will Make You A Great Fit:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Strong experience with Unreal Engine and Blueprint visual scripting; programming experience (C++, C#, etc.) is a plus.</li> <li>Proven experience designing and implementing gameplay features in released multiplayer games, with a strong focus on reward loops, systemic content integration, and player-driven optionality.</li> <li>Theory-crafting skillset &amp; past experience designing for depth and multiplayer gameplay.</li> <li>Quantitative and analytical, with past experience building and interrogating economy models and simulations to validate and align design decisions.</li> <li>Deep understanding of the various components (UI, Art, Engineering, Audio, VFX, etc.) that come together to achieve an unparalleled player experience.</li> <li>A self-starter who can align with the team's goals but isn't hesitant to create solutions of their own.</li> <li>Capable of rapidly filtering large volumes of feedback into concrete and useful improvements.</li> <li>Ability to flexibly design, implement, and iterate under tight deadlines &amp; production constraints.&nbsp;</li> <li>Well-played in the multiplayer PvP / Competitive Space and able to deconstruct what works and why.</li> <li>Capability to abstract designs outside of single solutions into patterns and models of player behavior; providing options and flexible design solutions&nbsp;</li> </ul> <hr> <p>The pay range for this position in California at the start of employment is expected to be between $112,700 and $166,820 per Year. However, base pay offered is based on market location, and may vary further depending on individualized factors for job candidates, such as job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and other objective business considerations.</p> <p data-path-to-node="13">Subject to those same considerations, the total compensation package for this position may also include other elements, including a bonus and/or equity awards and eligibility to participate in our 401(K) plan and Employee Stock Purchase Program.</p> <p data-path-to-node="14">Regular, full-time employees are also eligible for a range of benefits at the Company, including: medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance coverage; 14 paid holidays per calendar year; paid vacation time per calendar year (ranging from 15 to 25 days) or eligibility to participate in the Company’s discretionary time off program; up to 10 paid sick days per calendar year; paid parental and compassionate leave; wellbeing programs for mental health and other wellness support; family planning support through Maven; commuter benefits; and reimbursements for fitness-related expenses. Ontario only: The use of Artificial Intelligence is not being used to screen candidates. The position is for an existing vacancy.</p> <p>#LI-Onsite <br>#LI-Hybrid</p>
