title: Senior Technical Program Manager
description: <h3>Who We Are</h3> <p>Founded in 2005, 2K Games is a global video game company, publishing titles developed by some of the most influential game development studios in the world. Our studios responsible for developing 2K's portfolio of world-class games across multiple platforms, include Visual Concepts, Firaxis, Hangar 13, CatDaddy, Cloud Chamber, and HB Studios. Our portfolio of titles is expanding due to our global strategic plan, building and acquiring exciting studios whose content continues to inspire all of us! 2K publishes titles in today's most popular gaming genres, including sports, shooters, action, role-playing, strategy, casual, and family entertainment.</p> <p>Our team of engineers, marketers, artists, writers, data scientists, producers, thinkers and doers, are the professional publishing stewards of our growing library of critically-acclaimed franchises such as NBA 2K, Battleborn, BioShock, Borderlands, The Darkness, Mafia, Sid Meier's Civilization, WWE 2K, and XCOM.</p> <p>At 2K, we pride ourselves on creating an inclusive work environment, which means encouraging our teams to Come as You Are and do your best work! We are dedicated to diversity and inclusion, and want our community of candidates to reflect this commitment. We encourage all qualified applicants to explore our global positions.</p> <p>2K is headquartered in Novato, California and is a wholly owned label of Take-Two Interactive Software, Inc. (NASDAQ: TTWO).</p> <h3>What We Need:</h3> <p>2K Publishing Tech delivers innovative solutions to our studios and supports all of their technology needs to ensure they can focus on building incredible games. The Senior Technical Program Manager will need to apply their experience and skillset across a variety of roles including project and program management, change management, process documentation and improvement, business requirements definition, tracking schedules, action items, forging strong relationships across the business and most importantly, is experienced with influencing and driving consensus with stakeholders and other team members. They need the interpersonal and organizational skills to navigate our complex and fast-paced environment and have an absolute passion for getting things done.</p> <h3>What You Will Do:</h3> <ul> <li>Lead Technology engagement with selected 2K studios to Facilitate adoption of Technology shared services and platforms</li> <li>Advocate on behalf of studios for new features and capabilities</li> <li>Communicate updates related to requested features integration</li> <li>Liaise between multiple 2K departments including Studios, Analytics, Global Services, Commercial, and Marketing to ensure requirements are met holistically</li> <li>Establish, maintain, and drive delivery against multiple program and project schedules</li> <li>Tracking all project/program in your purview</li> <li>Partner with team to establish a development timeline</li> <li>Assist with forecasting and scoping tasks</li> <li>Delegate work to Scrum Masters, other Technical Program Managers, and Technical Project Coordinators as needed</li> <li>Partner with IT leads to identify, document, and communicate project / program scope, schedule, risks, and issues</li> <li>Establish and drive successful studio deployments by reviewing test plans and scheduling demos as necessary</li> <li>Proactively identify, track and drive resolution of blocking issues and non-engineering action items</li> <li>Establish, maintain and drive consumption of a high-level project status dashboards and reporting for each Studio assigned</li> <li>Establish and lead regular partner syncs</li> <li>Transition projects into run state and handoff to appropriate team</li> </ul> <h3>Who We Believe Will Be A Phenomenal Fit:</h3> <p>You are passionate about technology and you are excited about bringing cutting-edge capabilities to empower studios to make incredible game experiences for consumers. You understand what it means to bring organization in a fast-paced environment that is minimally disruptive. You are interested in exploring opportunities to apply technology to address opportunities in the area of video game backend services, digital sales, marketing, and distribution. You consider excellence in communication to be one of, if not your strongest asset across all mediums.</p> <ul> <li>5+ years in technical program management, technical production, or engineering leadership, ideally including game development and live-service operations</li> <li>Hands-on infrastructure experience across on-premise and cloud environments</li> <li>Video game development knowledge; shipped one or two AAA titles a plus</li> <li>Demonstrated end-to-end program ownership, inception through launch to run-state</li> <li>Proven ability to influence department leaders and drive consensus up, down, and across organizational lines</li> <li>Agile experience a plus</li> <li>Experience with Jira, Confluence, Google Suite</li> </ul> <p>As an equal opportunity employer, we are committed to ensuring that qualified individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform their essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us if you need reasonable accommodation.</p> <p>Please note that 2K Games and its studios never uses instant messaging apps or personal email accounts to contact prospective employees or conduct interviews and when emailing, only use 2K.com accounts.<br><br><span data-path-to-node="16,0">Please note that 2K is unable to provide visa sponsorship or assistance for this position. All candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States without requiring current or future employer sponsorship.</span></p> <p>#LI-Hybrid</p>

title: Senior UI Tech Artist
description: <p><strong>Who We Are</strong></p> <p>The Gearbox Entertainment Company is home to a world-class team that entertains the world with award-winning and genre-defining video games. Our games are entrenched with rich universes that are expanded upon via transmedia storytelling, live experiences, and consumer products. Gearbox Entertainment has become widely known for developing successful game franchises such as Borderlands, Tiny Tina’s Wonderlands, and Brothers in Arms, as well for continued development of acquired properties including Duke Nukem, Risk of Rain, and Homeworld.</p> <p>The company was founded as Gearbox Software in 1999 by a team of industry veterans and is headquartered in Frisco, Texas. The Gearbox Entertainment Company is proud to be part of 2K, a publishing label of Take-Two Interactive Software, Inc. (NASDAQ: TTWO). &nbsp;</p> <p>For more information, visit www.GearboxSoftware.com.&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>What We Are Looking For</strong></p> <p>We’re looking for a Senior Technical UI Artist to join our team. You’ll set the standard for building the fundamental UI systems that will take us into that future. You’ll own and drive the implementation of key UI materials, working closely with designers, artists, producers, programmers and more.</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li>Work with UI artists and team to create best practices and optimal workflows.</li> <li> <p>Communicate and work closely with UI programmers to develop new engine features.</p> </li> <li> <p>Analyze memory and performance throughout a project's development.</p> </li> <li> <p>Create efficient and user friendly shaders for use in game.</p> </li> <li> <p>Analyze and communicate the technical challenges for UI art and UX design concepts.</p> </li> <li> <p>Research and develop prototypes for art pipelines and help bring your coworkers’ ideas to life.</p> </li> </ul> <p><strong>Qualifications</strong></p> <ul> <li>6+ Years of industry experience.</li> <li> <p>Expert knowledge of Unreal Engine 5, specifically the material editor and UMG.</p> </li> <li> <p>Able to collaborate and work well with teams from various disciplines.</p> </li> <li> <p>Take ownership of shippable quality content/systems that are memory efficient and performant.</p> </li> <li> <p>Ability to think out-of-the-box to overcome technical challenges.</p> </li> <li> <p>Ability to self-direct, and be autonomous when it is required.</p> </li> </ul> <p><strong>Nice-to-Haves</strong></p> <ul> <li>Working knowledge of HLSL or GLSL.</li> <li> <p>Working knowledge of Python scripting or another programming language.</p> </li> <li> <p>Good knowledge of a 3D modeling application and an image editor.</p> </li> <li> <p>Experience with current generation platforms (Xbox Series X/S, PlayStation 5).</p> </li> <li> <p>Experience with other popular or proprietary engines (Unity, etc).</p> </li> <li> <p>Strong balance of creative/visual aesthetics and technical skills</p> </li> </ul> <p><strong>Our Commitment to Equal Opportunity&nbsp;</strong></p> <p><em>Gearbox Entertainment is committed to ensuring that all team age, disability, or genetic information, or any other status protected by applicable law.&nbsp;</em></p> <p><em>Gearbox Entertainment is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals to participate in the job application process, to perform the essential functions of a job, and to enjoy the benefits and privileges of employment equal to those enjoyed by individuals without disabilities.&nbsp; If you need a reasonable accommodation at any point during the job application process, please contact us for more information.&nbsp;</em></p> <p><em>Please note that 2K Games and its studios never uses instant messaging apps or personal email accounts to contact prospective employees or conduct interviews and when emailing, only use 2K.com accounts.</em></p> <p><em>#LI-Remote</em></p>

title: Senior UI/UX Designer
description: <p><strong>Who We Are</strong></p> <p>Founded in 2023, Small Axe Studios is 2K’s newest stand-alone studio, built to push the boundaries of game development and bring 2K’s next groundbreaking sports franchise to life. Headquartered in Burnaby, we are assembling a world-class team of visionaries, builders, and passionate gamers who thrive on creative collaboration, technical excellence, and bold ideas. At Small Axe Studios, we believe big things start with sharp focus—and we’re crafting an exceptional, player-first experience from the ground up. If you’re ready to tackle unique challenges, leave your mark on a brand-new IP, and help shape the future of interactive sports entertainment, we want you on our team!</p> <p><strong>What We Need</strong></p> <ul> <li>Do you see UI as more than menus and icons—as a core part of a game’s identity and experience</li> <li>Do you see UI as more than menus and icons — as the connective tissue between player intent and player experience?&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p><strong>What You’ll Do</strong></p> <p><strong>Design</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own and maintain the atomic design system based in Figma.&nbsp;&nbsp;</li> <li>Design and refine player flows, wireframes, interaction patterns, and information hierarchies that improve clarity, usability, and comprehension.</li> <li>Translate complex player needs and gameplay systems into intuitive, elegant UX solutions.</li> <li>Iterate on designs and solutions that enhance usability, clarity, and emotional impact.</li> <li>Guide adaptation of core gameplay, controls, and menu experiences across multiple platforms and input methods, ensuring parity and quality across all environments.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Visual &amp; Art</strong></p> <ul> <li>Help define the game's UI visual style in partnership with the Art Director and Design team.</li> <li>Translate wireframes and UX systems into refined, visually cohesive interfaces.</li> <li>Build final assets, iconography, motion graphics, and mockups that balance form and function.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Collaboration</strong></p> <ul> <li>Collaborate across Design, Art, and Engineering disciplines to bring ideas from concept to shippable feature.</li> <li>Provide feedback in reviews and help maintain visual and UX consistency across the product.</li> <li>Stay current on trends in games, apps, and visual design to bring fresh thinking to the team.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What Will Make You A Great Fit</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience shipping at least one AAA game or equivalent project.</li> <li>Strong portfolio showing a range of UI Art work and or UX Design work.</li> <li>Skilled in Figma using components for Atomic Design structures.</li> <li>Skilled in Photoshop, Illustrator, and After Effects (or equivalent) for UI asset creation and motion design.</li> <li>Comfortable working across teams - Design, Art, Engineering -to bring ideas to life.</li> <li>Strong communicator who gives and receives feedback with clarity and respect.</li> <li>Deep curiosity about games and a thoughtful approach to how UI supports the player experience.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Beneficial Qualifications</strong></p> <ul> <li>Background in graphic design, layout, and gestalt principles.</li> <li>Familiarity with implementing UI in Unreal Engine (UMG), including Blueprints, animations, and materials.</li> <li>Experience with UI shaders/materials and 2D FX for game engines.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>The pay range for this position in British Columbia at the start of employment is expected to be between CAD $78,400 and CAD $116,020 per Year. However, base pay offered is based on market location, and may vary further depending on individualized factors for job candidates, such as job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and other objective business considerations. Subject to those same considerations, the total compensation package for this position may also include other elements, including a bonus and/or equity awards, in addition to a full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits. Details of participation in these benefit plans will be provided if an employee receives an offer of employment. If hired, employee will be in an 'at-will position' and the company reserves the right to modify base salary (as well as any other discretionary payment or compensation or benefit program) at any time, including for reasons related to individual performance, company or individual department/team performance, and market factors.</p> <p>As an equal opportunity employer, we are committed to ensuring that qualified individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform their essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us if you need reasonable accommodation.</p> <p>Please note that 2K Games and its studios never uses instant messaging apps or personal email accounts to contact prospective employees or conduct interviews, and when emailing, we only use 2K.com accounts.</p> <p><br>#LI-Hybrid</p>

Headquartered in Burnaby, we are assembling a world-class team of visionaries, builders, and passionate gamers who thrive on creative collaboration, technical excellence, and bold ideas. At Small Axe Studios, we believe big things start with sharp focus—and we’re crafting an exceptional, player-first experience from the ground up. If you’re ready to tackle unique challenges, leave your mark on a brand-new IP, and help shape the future of interactive sports entertainment, we want you on our team!</p> <p><strong>What We Need</strong></p> <p>We’re looking for an experienced and versatile Technical Designer to help drive the implementation and iteration of our gameplay systems and features. You will play a key role in bridging the gap between design and engineering—prototyping features, building robust content workflows, and ensuring technical feasibility for our sports-focused core fantasy experience.</p> <p>As a Technical Designer, you’ll work across disciplines to bring features to life—from paper design to implementation—and guide the team in crafting flexible, scalable systems. You’ll be instrumental in building our toolsets, scripting gameplay behaviors, and helping define the future of how we build and iterate on gameplay content.</p> <p>This role reports to the Lead Technical Designer and collaborates with engineering, design, and production leadership to deliver compelling, player-driven experiences.</p> <p><strong>What You’ll Do</strong></p> <p><strong>Prototype and Implement Gameplay Systems</strong></p> <ul> <li>Design and build functional prototypes in collaboration with engineers and gameplay designers</li> <li>Implement and iterate on gameplay mechanics, core loops, and systemic features using visual scripting or other proprietary tools</li> <li>Ensure technical feasibility of design solutions while maintaining creative goals</li> </ul> <p><strong>Own Technical Implementation of Features</strong></p> <ul> <li>Collaborate with designers to translate high-level concepts into robust in-game behaviors and systems</li> <li>Script game logic, define system flows, and integrate features into live builds</li> </ul> <p><strong>Optimize Workflows and Tool Usage</strong></p> <ul> <li>Partner with tools engineers to improve designer workflows and content pipelines</li> <li>Develop best practices and reusable templates for design teams to improve iteration speed and reduce bugs</li> </ul> <p><strong>Support Other Designers</strong></p> <ul> <li>Provide technical guidance to other designers and help raise the team’s scripting and tool proficiency</li> <li>Review and troubleshoot design implementations and help resolve blockers across features</li> <li>Champion technical documentation and help maintain a healthy tech design culture</li> </ul> <p><strong>Collaborate Across Disciplines</strong></p> <ul> <li>Work hand-in-hand with engineering to ensure designs are performant, scalable, and shippable</li> <li>Partner with animators, audio, and UI/UX teams to deliver features with high-quality execution</li> </ul> <p><strong>Champion the Core Fantasy Vision</strong></p> <ul> <li> <ul> <li>Ensure technical design solutions reinforce the overall player experience goals</li> <li>Help prototype and validate systemic interactions that create emergent or player-driven outcomes</li> <li>Contribute to creative problem-solving that enables new gameplay opportunities</li> </ul> </li> </ul> <p><strong>What Will Make You A Great Fit</strong></p> <ul> <li>3+ years experience in technical design or related gameplay implementation roles</li> <li>Deep expertise with scripting systems (e.g., Unreal Blueprint)</li> <li>Proven ability to implement gameplay systems from prototype through ship</li> <li>Good understanding of game systems, mechanics, and their interactions</li> <li>Experience working in collaboration with engineers, especially on feature integrations</li> <li>Excellent problem-solving, debugging, and optimization skills</li> <li>Strong documentation habits and ability to explain technical solutions to non-technical teammates</li> <li>A proactive, collaborative attitude and a passion for empowering creative teams</li> </ul> <p><strong>Beneficial Qualifications</strong></p> <ul> <li>Familiarity with content pipelines, modular design approaches, or data-driven systems</li> <li>Experience with tool development or technical design documentation</li> <li>Experience in performance profiling and optimization on console/PC</li> <li>Background in programming or computer science is a plus</li> </ul> <p>The pay range for this position in British Columbia at the start of employment is expected to be between CAD $73,900 and $109,360 per Year. However, base pay offered is based on market location, and may vary further depending on individualized factors for job candidates, such as job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and other objective business considerations. Subject to those same considerations, the total compensation package for employees in regular roles may also include other elements, including a bonus and/or equity awards, in addition to a full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits, provided that temporary or intern roles will not be eligible for many of these payments or benefits. Details of participation in compensation and benefit plans (if applicable) will be provided if an employee receives an offer of employment.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>As an equal opportunity employer, we are committed to ensuring that qualified individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform their essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us if you need reasonable accommodation.</p> <p>Please note that 2K Games and its studios never uses instant messaging apps or personal email accounts to contact prospective employees or conduct interviews, and when emailing, we only use 2K.com accounts.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>#LI-Hybrid</p>

title: Technical Game Designer
description: <p>&nbsp;</p> <p id="p-rc_81ac4985cf5d6549-25" data-path-to-node="0"><span data-path-to-node="0,0">2K’s Cat Daddy studio, based in Kirkland, Washington, was started 25+ years ago by industry veterans and is now a wholly owned subsidiary of Take-Two Interactive within the 2K Label</span><span data-path-to-node="0,2">. The studio is a fun, dedicated family of incredibly hardworking game developers</span><span data-path-to-node="0,4">. We have shipped games on almost every genre and platform, with a current focus on mobile games</span><span data-path-to-node="0,6">.</span></p> <p data-path-to-node="1"><strong>What We Need:</strong></p> <p data-path-to-node="1">Cat Daddy is seeking a Technical Designer to join our team of artists, engineers, and product managers to design, prototype, and ship features for free-to-play mobile games. This role sits between design and engineering. You will carry a feature from the first pitch through to the live build: writing the spec, standing up the prototype in Unity, wiring it into the services that run our games, and tuning it once players are inside it. The ideal candidate has shipped multiple F2P mobile games in a design or technical design role.</p> <p data-path-to-node="2">This is an in-office position, located in Kirkland, WA. Must be able to work onsite 4 days a week.&nbsp;</p> <p data-path-to-node="3"><strong>What You Will Do:</strong></p> <ul data-path-to-node="4"> <li> <p data-path-to-node="4,0,0">Design new gameplay experiences including limited-time events, complete game modes, and mini-games that add variety and excitement to the core game loop.</p> </li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="4,1,0">Own features end to end, from the pitch through a working prototype, the shipped build, and the live tuning pass that follows.</p> </li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="4,2,0">Write specs that hold up as executable instructions: clear intent, explicit constraints, acceptance criteria, edge cases, and the failure states that separate a good build from a plausible one.</p> </li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="4,3,0">Build, orchestrate, and refine agentic workflows across the design pipeline, covering research, competitive teardowns, spec drafting, prototype scaffolding, balance sweeps, content authoring, and telemetry analysis.</p> </li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="4,4,0">Prototype directly in Unity so a concept can be played, and validated against live service systems.</p> </li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="4,5,0">Collaborate with cross-functional teams to balance fun, difficulty, and monetization across your designs.</p> </li> </ul> <p data-path-to-node="5"><strong>Who We Think Will Be A Great Fit:</strong></p> <ul data-path-to-node="6"> <li> <p data-path-to-node="6,0,0">5+ years of game design experience, with a focus on free-to-play mobile games, plus a Bachelor's degree in a related field and/or comparable, relevant work experience.</p> </li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="6,1,0">Deep, hands-on practice with agentic tooling and workflows, used daily rather than demoed occasionally.</p> </li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="6,2,0">Fluency in the craft that makes those workflows work: context and prompt construction, task decomposition, tool and permission design, checkpointing, evaluation harnesses, and honest measurement of quality over time.</p> </li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="6,3,0">Production experience in Unity building mobile games.</p> </li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="6,4,0">Expert-level understanding of the mobile game market from a game design perspective, including game economies, data analysis, back-end environments, and live infrastructure.</p> </li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="6,5,0">Practical understanding of game development pipelines end to end.</p> </li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="6,6,0">World-class communication skills, with proven ability to produce effective design documentation, and a great teammate who can collaborate with engineers and artists on game development.</p> </li> </ul> <p data-path-to-node="7">The pay range for this position in Kirkland, WA at the start of employment is expected to be between $88,700 and $131,300 per year. However, base pay offered is based on market location, and may vary further depending on individualized factors for job candidates, such as job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and other objective business considerations.</p> <p data-path-to-node="8">Subject to those same considerations, the total compensation package for this position may also include other elements, including a bonus and/or equity awards and eligibility to participate in our 401(K) plan and Employee Stock Purchase Program.</p> <p data-path-to-node="9">Regular, full-time employees are also eligible for a range of benefits at the Company, including: medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance coverage; 14 paid holidays per calendar year; paid vacation time per calendar year (ranging from 15 to 25 days) or eligibility to participate in the Company’s discretionary time off program; up to 10 paid sick days per calendar year; paid parental and compassionate leave; wellbeing programs for mental health and other wellness support; family planning support through Maven; commuter benefits; and reimbursements for fitness-related expenses.</p> <p data-path-to-node="10">If hired, employee will be in an "at-will position" and the company reserves the right to modify base salary (as well as any other discretionary payment or compensation or benefit program) at any time, including for reasons related to individual performance, company or individual department/team performance, and market factors.</p> <p id="p-rc_81ac4985cf5d6549-26" data-path-to-node="11"><span data-path-to-node="11,0">At Cat Daddy, we believe diversity of experience is fundamental to crafting accessible and fun gaming experiences for <em data-path-to-node="11,0" data-index-in-node="118">all</em> of our players</span><span data-path-to-node="11,2">. We encourage everyone to consider being a part of our team</span><span data-path-to-node="11,4">.</span></p> <p id="p-rc_81ac4985cf5d6549-27" data-path-to-node="12"><span data-path-to-node="12,0">We are an equal opportunity employer</span><span data-path-to-node="12,2">. Please contact us to request accommodation</span><span data-path-to-node="12,8">.</span></p> <p data-path-to-node="13">Please note that Cat Daddy is unable to provide visa sponsorship or assistance for this position. All candidates must be legally authorized to work in United States without requiring current or future employer sponsorship.</p> <p id="p-rc_81ac4985cf5d6549-28" data-path-to-node="14"><span data-path-to-node="14,0">By clicking on the link below, you consent to the processing of your personal information by 2K Games, Inc. and its affiliate Take-Two Interactive Software, Inc. in accordance with the Privacy Notice for Job Applicants (the “Privacy Notice”), available at <a class="ng-star-inserted" href="https://www.google.com/search?q=https://www.2k.com/applicantprivacypolicy/&amp;utm_source=gemini" target="_blank">https://www.2k.com/applicantprivacypolicy/</a></span><span data-path-to-node="14,2">. title: Endeavour Women in Tech 2026 Scholarship Application (High School)
description: <p>The <strong>EWIT Scholarship</strong> is funded by the <strong>Endeavour Women in Tech (EWIT)</strong> group, a network of women across Endeavour and its subsidiaries who are passionate about advancing opportunities for women in technology. Through mentorship, education, and career development initiatives, EWIT is committed to challenging the status quo and fostering the next generation of female leaders in STEM.</p> <p><strong>About Endeavour</strong><br>Endeavour is a modern infrastructure company transforming how data centers are built and operated to meet the demands of a sustainable, digital future. Our culture is rooted in innovation, inclusion, and integrity as we create lasting value for our partners, employees, and communities.</p> <p><strong>Application Requirements:<br><br></strong><strong>Essay:<br></strong>Why should you be selected to receive an E-WIT Scholarship?<br>Please attach your completed essay.</p> <p><br><strong>Important: </strong>Please submit a 2–3 page essay in a Word document addressing the following:</p> <ul> <li>Tell us about yourself and your background.</li> <li>Describe your life mission and why you chose your major or area of study.</li> <li>Explain how you intend to use your degree to make an impact on the world.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Transcript:</strong></p> <p>Please attach your full high school academic transcript.&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Letters of Recommendation:</strong></p> <ul> <li>2 professional recommendation letters</li> <li>1 personal recommendation letter (not from immediate family).</li> </ul>

title: Clinical Trial Manager (Contract)
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>Attention recruitment agencies:</em></strong><em> All agency inquiries are vetted through 4DMT’s internal Talent Acquisition team. No unsolicited resumes will be accepted. The 4DMT Talent Acquisition team must expressly engage agencies on any requisition. Agencies contacting hiring managers directly will not be tolerated, and doing so may impact your ability to work with 4DMT in the future.</em></p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>4DMT is a leading late-stage biotechnology company advancing durable and disease-targeted therapeutics with potential to transform treatment paradigms and provide unprecedented benefits to patients. The Company’s lead product candidate 4D-150 is designed to be a backbone therapy forming the foundation of treatment of blinding retinal vascular diseases by providing multi-year sustained delivery of anti-VEGF biologics (aflibercept and anti-VEGF-C) with a single intravitreal injection, which substantially reduces the treatment burden associated with current bolus injections. The Company’s lead indication for 4D-150 is wet age-related macular degeneration and the second indication is diabetic macular edema, which are both in Phase 3 development. The Company’s second product candidate is 4D-710, which is the first known genetic medicine to demonstrate successful delivery and expression of the CFTR transgene in the lungs of people with cystic fibrosis after aerosol delivery.</p> <p>We are taking genetic medicine to new heights and into new disease areas to overcome challenges not addressed by existing medicines. This incredible challenge drives our relentless and talented team. Our people are the essence of our inspiring, innovative and collaborative environment that encourages individual contributions and provides opportunities for career development. We seek the best in the industry who identify with our mission and our bold and innovative results-driven approach. Our Core Values drive the way we work together:</p> <ul> <li>Dare to Cure</li> <li>Break Boundaries</li> <li>Beyond Yourself</li> <li>Prepare &amp; Execute Relentlessly</li> </ul> <p>Join us in creating the future of genetic medicine.</p></div><p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>GENERAL SUMMARY</strong></span></p> <p>The Clinical Trial Manager will support the Company's clinical trial activities.&nbsp; This position reports to the Director of Clinical Operations.&nbsp; This will be responsible for management of the day to day operations of one or more phase 1-3 clinical trials including trial start up, conduct and close out activities.&nbsp;&nbsp;<br><br><strong><u>MAJOR DUTIES &amp; </u></strong><strong><u>RESPONSIBILITIES:</u></strong></p> <p><u>Trial Management: </u></p> <ul> <li>Serve as the primary contact for managing protocol execution, including oversight of the CRO, other study service providers, and consultants that are involved in a clinical trial</li> <li>Lead cross-functional study execution team in support of study deliverables</li> <li>Support establishment of study milestones and ensure accurate tracking and reporting of study metrics and timelines to leadership</li> <li>Ensure clinical trials are managed and executed in accordance with ICH GCP, regulations, the protocol, and company-specific SOPs</li> <li>Assist in preparation and review of clinical trial documentation such as; protocol, informed consent, Investigator Brochure, Clinical Monitoring Plan, Project Plan, Case Report Forms, Statistical Analysis Plan, Clinical Study Reports, and other study level documents</li> <li>Ensure that the Trial Master File (TMF) is set up and maintained appropriately throughout the trial, including periodic reviews</li> <li>Participate and coordinate resolution of audit finding and ensures audit-ready condition of clinical trial documentation including central clinical files</li> <li>Participates in service provider selection process as a part of outsourcing activities</li> <li>Proactively identifies, with the support and guidance from Senior Clinical Operations staff, and supports development of plans and resolution of project issues and participates in process improvement initiatives as required</li> <li>Supports&nbsp;assessing operational feasibility, recommending study execution plan and site selection under the Director of Clinical Operations</li> <li>Responsible for the selection and study specific training of CRO study staff, monitors, investigational sites, and service providers</li> <li>In conjunction with legal &nbsp;group, &nbsp;facilitate &nbsp;the &nbsp;development &nbsp;of &nbsp;clinical &nbsp;trial agreements and other relevant documents</li> <li>Manage clinical trial budgets, providing ongoing financial reporting and projections</li> <li>Negotiate and finalize site contracts and budgets</li> <li>Perform and manage data review process on an ongoing basis</li> <li>Perform site visits including site qualification, initiation, monitoring and close-out visits, as needed</li> <li>Oversee outsourced monitoring by reviewing, monitoring reports to ensure quality and resolution of site-related issues</li> <li>Ensures tracking and review of protocol deviations and assesses impact on study data</li> <li>Develops and manages study budget and maintain within financial goals; Reviews and approves clinical invoices against approved budget</li> <li>Provides oversight for forecasting of clinical supplies, including study drug and supplies</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;<u>Department Management: </u></p> <ul> <li>May manage and/or oversee work of junior Clinical Operations staff</li> <li>May support development and review of Clinical SOPs and other department initiatives</li> <li>Travel as needed to sites, conferences, industry meetings</li> <li>Other duties as may be assigned</li> </ul> <p><strong>QUALIFICATIONS:</strong></p> <p>Education:</p> <ul> <li>B.A./B.S. degree in Science&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p>Experience:</p> <ul> <li>6+ years of clinical research experience within the Biotech or similar industry, with at least 2 years directly supporting a retina clinical trial&nbsp;</li> <li>Global APAC experience desired</li> </ul> <p>Other Qualifications/Skills:</p> <p><u>(non-technical and technical skills)</u></p> <ul> <li>Knowledge of GCP, ICH guidelines and regulatory requirements for clinical trial management; Strong clinical study management skills</li> <li>Understanding of, and experience with, regulatory framework applicable to interactions with HCPs, payers, advocacy and other business partners</li> <li>Proven clinical operational skills to direct protocol execution to ensure timeline, budget and quality metrics are met</li> <li>Excellent communication skills to effectively disseminate information to project team and outside parties</li> <li>Experience reviewing trial plans including developing creative strategies for site monitoring, risk mitigation, trial budgets, site selection, and clinical supplies management</li> <li>Clinical research knowledge and cross-functional understanding of clinical trial methodology</li> <li>Excellent organizational, conflict resolution, prioritization and negotiation skills &nbsp;</li> <li>Proven ability in creative problem-solving and exercising sound judgment</li> <li>Team oriented and ability to effectively collaborate with study team, cross-functional team members, and external partners</li> <li>Ability to handle a high volume of highly complex tasks within a given timeline</li> <li>Ability to develop Therapeutic Areas knowledge and expertise through internal training and external conference attendance</li> <li>Proficient computer skills, specifically with Microsoft Office Suite that include Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook</li> <li>Working knowledge of MS Project for development and update of clinical study timelines</li> </ul> <p>Travel: 5%</p> <p>Physical Requirements and Working Conditions:</p> <ul> <li>Physical Activity - Repetitive motions: Making substantial movements (motions) of the wrists, hands, and/or fingers. Fingering: Picking, pinching, typing or otherwise working, primarily with fingers rather than with whole hand or arm as in handling. Talking: Expressing or exchanging ideas by means of the spoken word.</li> <li>Physical Requirements - Sedentary work: Exerting up to 10 pounds of force occasionally and/or a negligible amount of force frequently or constantly to lift, carry, push, pull or otherwise move objects, including the human body. Sedentary work involves sitting most of the time. Jobs are sedentary if walking and standing are required only occasionally, and all other sedentary criteria are met.</li> <li>Working Conditions - The worker is not substantially exposed to adverse environmental conditions (as in typical office or administrative work).</li> </ul> <p>Hourly compensation range: $66.00 - $75.00 / HOUR</p> <p>Please note, the base salary compensation range and actual salary offered to the final candidate depends on various factors: candidate’s geographical location, relevant work experience, skills, and years of experience.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><div>4DMT provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, status as a covered veteran, and any other category protected under applicable federal, state, provincial and local laws.</div> <div>&nbsp;</div> <div>Equal Opportunity Employer/Protected Veterans/Individuals with Disabilities</div></div>

The Company’s second product candidate is 4D-710, which is the first known genetic medicine to demonstrate successful delivery and expression of the CFTR transgene in the lungs of people with cystic fibrosis after aerosol delivery.</p> <p>We are taking genetic medicine to new heights and into new disease areas to overcome challenges not addressed by existing medicines. delivery of assigned roadmap commitments on schedule &amp; within budget; inspection, submission, manufacturing, supply &amp; launch readiness; availability, adoption &amp; validated-state performance of assigned platforms; effective risk, vendor &amp; financial management; &amp; measurable business value from compliant data, analytics, automation &amp; AI.</p> <p><strong><u>MAJOR DUTIES &amp; RESPONSIBILITIES:</u></strong></p> <ul> <li>Serve as a broad deputy to the Sr. Director, IT Business Partner, R&amp;D, helping execute the integrated R&amp;D technology strategy &amp; operational-resilience objectives, translating approved direction into executable plans.</li> <li>Represent IT for assigned systems &amp; workstreams in GxP inspections, regulatory audits &amp; internal quality reviews, ensuring system ownership, validation evidence, access controls, audit trails, vendor oversight &amp; chain of custody.</li> <li>Support execution of the TechOps &amp; Supply Management technology roadmap through assigned manufacturing, materials, inventory, planning, supplier, cold-chain, serialization, warehouse, logistics, external partner &amp; product traceability initiatives integrated with enterprise, quality, laboratory &amp; financial platforms.</li> <li>Support execution of the Quality technology roadmap through assigned quality &amp; document management, training, deviations, CAPA, change control, complaints, supplier quality, audits &amp; inspection-management initiatives.</li> <li>Partner with Facilities &amp; Engineering on assigned technology supporting building management, environmental monitoring, maintenance management (CMMS), calibration, metrology, asset management, physical access, alarms &amp; critical facility operations.</li> <li>Help implement the unified R&amp;D data strategy across clinical, scientific, manufacturing &amp; quality data, including data governance, metadata, master data, FAIR principles, retention, archival &amp; manufacturing workflows, applying the approved risk-scaled framework with model validation, human review &amp; traceability.</li> <li>Manage assigned R&amp;D technology vendors &amp; managed service providers, including contracts, budgets, forecasts, service levels, performance metrics, escalation, validation obligations, security, data protection, business continuity, exit planning &amp; recovery, role-based security, user provisioning, audit trails, data transfer &amp; archival meet 21 CFR Part 11, Annex 11 &amp; applicable 4DMT procedures for assigned platforms.</li> <li>Provide assigned technology support for Medical Affairs field &amp; launch-readiness capabilities, including medical content management &amp; Medical, Legal &amp; Regulatory review through Veeva PromoMats, until ownership transitions to the Sr. Director, Commercial IT Business Partner.</li> <li>Maintain operational excellence &amp; drive continuous improvement for assigned services, staying current on clinical technology, laboratory informatics, manufacturing, supply chain, quality, data management, AI &amp; life sciences best practices.</li> </ul> <p><strong><u>QUALIFICATIONS:&nbsp;</u></strong></p> <p>Education:</p> <ul> <li>BS/BA required, with a technical, scientific, engineering, information systems or computer science major preferred</li> <li>MS/MA preferred</li> <li>Veeva Vault Platform Administrator or relevant laboratory informatics, quality, supply chain or project-management certification a plus</li> </ul> <p>Experience:</p> <ul> <li>13+ years of progressive experience in IT, digital, clinical technology, laboratory informatics or manufacturing/quality technology roles in biotechnology, pharmaceutical or another regulated life sciences environment, including 8+ years leading R&amp;D applications, business partnerships &amp; GxP technology operations.</li> <li>3+ years leading vendors, contractors, technical contributors &amp; cross-functional project teams across multiple R&amp;D functions.</li> <li>Experience supporting R&amp;D systems &amp; data through at least one Phase 3 clinical trial, one regulatory inspection, multiple regulatory submissions &amp; a technology transfer or other major regulated operational milestone.</li> <li>Deep experience applying risk-based system assurance, SDLC, change control, access management, supplier oversight, cybersecurity &amp; data-integrity practices, with working knowledge of 21 CFR Part 11, EU Annex 11, ICH E6(R3), GAMP 5, cGMP, ALCOA+ &amp; relevant data standards such as IDMP.</li> </ul> <p>Key Qualifications/Skills:&nbsp;</p> <ul> <li>Deep understanding of Research/PreClinical, Clinical, Regulatory Affairs, Pharmacovigilance, TechOps, Supply Management, Quality &amp; Facilities business processes across the research-to-commercial lifecycle.</li> <li>Strong working knowledge of regulated R&amp;D platforms, including CTMS, EDC, eTMF, eCOA/ePRO, IRT, statistical computing, RIM, safety, ELN, LIMS, scientific data, ERP, planning, warehouse, quality management, document &amp; Jobs are sedentary if walking and standing are required only occasionally, and all other sedentary criteria are met.</li> <li>Working Conditions - The worker is not substantially exposed to adverse environmental conditions (as in typical office or administrative work).</li> </ul> <p>Base salary compensation range: <strong>$208,000 - $242,000</strong></p> <p>Please note, the base salary compensation range and actual salary offered to the final candidate depends on various factors: candidate’s geographical location, relevant work experience, skills, and years of experience.&nbsp;</p> <p>&nbsp;</p><div class="content-conclusion"><div>4DMT provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, status as a covered veteran, and any other category protected under applicable federal, state, provincial and local laws.</div> <div>&nbsp;</div> <div>Equal Opportunity Employer/Protected Veterans/Individuals with Disabilities</div></div>

title: Senior Director, Clinical Quality  Assurance (CQA)
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>Attention recruitment agencies:</em></strong><em> All agency inquiries are vetted through 4DMT’s internal Talent Acquisition team. No unsolicited resumes will be accepted. The 4DMT Talent Acquisition team must expressly engage agencies on any requisition. Agencies contacting hiring managers directly will not be tolerated, and doing so may impact your ability to work with 4DMT in the future.</em></p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>4DMT is a leading late-stage biotechnology company advancing durable and disease-targeted therapeutics with potential to transform treatment paradigms and provide unprecedented benefits to patients. The Company’s lead product candidate 4D-150 is designed to be a backbone therapy forming the foundation of treatment of blinding retinal vascular diseases by providing multi-year sustained delivery of anti-VEGF biologics (aflibercept and anti-VEGF-C) with a single intravitreal injection, which substantially reduces the treatment burden associated with current bolus injections. The Company’s lead indication for 4D-150 is wet age-related macular degeneration and the second indication is diabetic macular edema, which are both in Phase 3 development. The Company’s second product candidate is 4D-710, which is the first known genetic medicine to demonstrate successful delivery and expression of the CFTR transgene in the lungs of people with cystic fibrosis after aerosol delivery.</p> <p>We are taking genetic medicine to new heights and into new disease areas to overcome challenges not addressed by existing medicines. This incredible challenge drives our relentless and talented team. Our people are the essence of our inspiring, innovative and collaborative environment that encourages individual contributions and provides opportunities for career development. We seek the best in the industry who identify with our mission and our bold and innovative results-driven approach. Our Core Values drive the way we work together:</p> <ul> <li>Dare to Cure</li> <li>Break Boundaries</li> <li>Beyond Yourself</li> <li>Prepare &amp; Execute Relentlessly</li> </ul> <p>Join us in creating the future of genetic medicine.</p></div><p><strong><u>GENERAL SUMMARY</u></strong></p> <p>The Senior Director of Clinical Quality Assurance (CQA) will provide strategic and operational Quality Assurance leadership and oversight for multiple, registrational, global 4DMT-sponsored clinical trials, ensuring trials are executed in compliance with applicable international regulatory requirements for Good Clinical Practice (GCP).</p> <p>This position reports to the Executive Director, Quality Assurance and is accountable for advancing the CQA mission, objectives, and strategic plan through proactive quality strategy, risk-based oversight, inspection readiness, and continuous improvement of clinical quality systems.</p> <p><strong><u>MAJOR DUTIES &amp; </u></strong><strong><u>RESPONSIBILITIES:</u></strong></p> <p><strong>Provide strategic Quality leadership and oversight for multiple 4DMT Clinical Studies, including the following</strong> <strong>study-specific activities:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Serve as a senior Quality partner to clinical study teams and leadership, providing guidance on GCP, ICH E6, and related regulations and guidance,, decision support, and escalation recommendations, including via attendance at Study team meetings, quality governance forums, and escalation discussions related to Clinical Study Quality Events.</li> <li>Lead the development, implementation, and governance of Clinical Study Quality Plans for specific 4DMT clinical studies, with accountability for protecting subject safety/rights, data integrity, and GCP compliance across assigned studies and associated vendors.</li> <li>Manage, mentor, and develop Clinical QA staff and consultants; establish clear goals, development plans, and succession depth.</li> <li>Define, plan, perform, and/or oversee risk-based GCP Compliance audits of high-risk clinical vendors/sites, including clinical investigator sites</li> <li>Ensure audit findings, quality risks, and CAPA commitments are communicated to senior stakeholders and collaborate with auditees and vendors to track, review, approve, assess the adequacy of CAPAs, and ensure timely escalation of unresolved or recurring issues</li> <li>Provide senior Quality review and strategic input on Clinical documents, ensuring quality, accuracy, completeness, and inspection readiness of key clinical and regulatory documents, including as applicable Clinical Protocols, IBs, DSURs, Module 2.6 and 2.7 Tabulated and Written Summaries, and Integrated Summaries.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Lead and/or provide oversight for investigation and management of significant Clinical Study Quality Events:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Identify, communicate, and escalate significant incidents of GCP non-compliance, quality risks, and inspection-readiness concerns, and drive timely resolution, ensuring appropriate executive visibility, escalation, and risk-based decision-making.</li> <li>Provide QA oversight for formal corrective and preventive actions (CAPAs), ensuring actions are risk-based, effective, timely, and appropriately escalated to address identified Clinical Study Quality Events, including potential serious breaches of GCP.</li> <li>Partner with CMC Quality, Clinical Operations, and senior cross-functional stakeholders to facilitate the investigation, escalation, and resolution of clinical supply quality issues such as temperature excursions, product complaints, and deviations reported from clinical sites, ensuring appropriate risk assessment, stakeholder communication, and CAPA linkage when applicable.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Champion and advance a culture of quality that fosters learning, respect, open communication, collaboration, integration, and teamwork:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Oversee and provide strategic direction for development of GCP compliance training materials and delivery of training to strengthen clinical quality culture and inspection readiness.</li> <li>Partner with Clinical Operations, Clinical Development, Biometrics, Data Management, Medical Affairs, and Regulatory Affairs to embed proactive quality and risk management into study design and conduct.</li> <li>Lead the development and continuous improvement of the Clinical Quality Management system through the development / refinement of Clinical QA processes</li> </ul> <p><strong>Lead preparedness / readiness / management of BIMO / GCP inspections:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Define and lead GCP inspection readiness strategy, plans, and cross-functional readiness activities, including readiness governance, mock inspection support, inspection logistics, and issue escalation</li> <li>Host, lead, and/or provide senior Quality support for GCP-related inspections</li> </ul> <p><strong><u>QUALIFICATIONS:</u></strong></p> <p><strong>Education: </strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor's degree in a life science, nursing, pharmacy, or related field; advanced degree (MS, PharmD, PhD) preferred.</li> <li>Experience in Ophthalmology is highly desired&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p><strong>Experience:</strong></p> <ul> <li>12+ years of experience or advanced degree with 10+ years of experience within a regulated environment such as Regulatory, Quality, Pharmacovigilance or Clinical Development / Operations within the Biotech or similar Industry</li> <li>Proven experience leading Clinical quality strategy, quality governance, and senior-level quality oversight of global clinical trials and associated vendors</li> <li>Minimum of 7 years of significant experience in clinical quality assurance, including experience leading, performing, and/or providing senior oversight of GCP audits and global clinical trials.</li> <li>Experience hosting, leading, and supporting health authority inspections, including inspection readiness preparation, front-room/back-room support, response coordination, and follow-up commitment management</li> <li>Extensive practical experience and understanding of clinical quality assurance applied throughout the clinical development life-cycle</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to influence senior cross-functional stakeholders, lead complex clinical quality initiatives, and provide mentorship or functional leadership within Clinical QA</li> </ul> <p><strong>Other Qualifications/Skills:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Expert understanding of GCP requirements for investigational products and the ability to interpret and apply requirements strategically across clinical programs</li> <li>Executive-level communication skills, both oral and written, with ability to present quality risks, recommendations, and inspection-readiness status to senior stakeholders</li> <li>Strong leadership, influencing, and interpersonal skills, with a collaborative approach to driving alignment across Clinical, Quality, Regulatory, and external vendor stakeholders</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to operate independently in a fast-paced small company environment, prioritize complex workstreams, make risk-based decisions with minimal direction, and adjust quickly to changing business priorities</li> </ul> <p><strong>Travel:</strong> %5</p> <p><strong>Physical Requirements and Working Conditions:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Physical Activity - Repetitive motions: Making substantial movements (motions) of the wrists, hands, and/or fingers. Fingering: Picking, pinching, typing or otherwise working, primarily with fingers rather than with whole hand or arm as in handling. Talking: Expressing or exchanging ideas by means of the spoken word.</li> <li>Physical Requirements - Sedentary work: Exerting up to 10 pounds of force occasionally and/or a negligible amount of force frequently or constantly to lift, carry, push, pull or otherwise move objects, including the human body. Sedentary work involves sitting most of the time. Jobs are sedentary if walking and standing are required only occasionally, and all other sedentary criteria are met.</li> <li>Working Conditions - The worker is not substantially exposed to adverse environmental conditions (as in typical office or administrative work).</li> </ul> <p>Base salary compensation range:&nbsp;<strong>$245,000 - 286,000</strong></p> <p>Please note, the base salary compensation range and actual salary offered to the final candidate depends on various factors: candidate’s geographical location, relevant work experience, skills, and years of experience.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><div>4DMT provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, status as a covered veteran, and any other category protected under applicable federal, state, provincial and local laws.</div> <div>&nbsp;</div> <div>Equal Opportunity Employer/Protected Veterans/Individuals with Disabilities</div></div>

description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>Attention recruitment agencies:</em></strong><em> All agency inquiries are vetted through 4DMT’s internal Talent Acquisition team. No unsolicited resumes will be accepted. The 4DMT Talent Acquisition team must expressly engage agencies on any requisition. Agencies contacting hiring managers directly will not be tolerated, and doing so may impact your ability to work with 4DMT in the future.</em></p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>4DMT is a leading late-stage biotechnology company advancing durable and disease-targeted therapeutics with potential to transform treatment paradigms and provide unprecedented benefits to patients. The Company’s lead product candidate 4D-150 is designed to be a backbone therapy forming the foundation of treatment of blinding retinal vascular diseases by providing multi-year sustained delivery of anti-VEGF biologics (aflibercept and anti-VEGF-C) with a single intravitreal injection, which substantially reduces the treatment burden associated with current bolus injections. The Company’s lead indication for 4D-150 is wet age-related macular degeneration and the second indication is diabetic macular edema, which are both in Phase 3 development. The Company’s second product candidate is 4D-710, which is the first known genetic medicine to demonstrate successful delivery and expression of the CFTR transgene in the lungs of people with cystic fibrosis after aerosol delivery.</p> <p>We are taking genetic medicine to new heights and into new disease areas to overcome challenges not addressed by existing medicines. This incredible challenge drives our relentless and talented team. Our people are the essence of our inspiring, innovative and collaborative environment that encourages individual contributions and provides opportunities for career development. We seek the best in the industry who identify with our mission and our bold and innovative results-driven approach. Our Core Values drive the way we work together:</p> <ul> <li>Dare to Cure</li> <li>Break Boundaries</li> <li>Beyond Yourself</li> <li>Prepare &amp; Execute Relentlessly</li> </ul> <p>Join us in creating the future of genetic medicine.</p></div><p><strong><span data-contrast="auto">GENERAL SUMMARY:</span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;134233117&quot;:true,&quot;134233118&quot;:true,&quot;201341983&quot;:0,&quot;335559740&quot;:240}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">The Senior Recruiter is responsible for driving full-cycle recruitment across 4DMT, partnering closely with the internal TA team, hiring managers, and the Associate Director, Talent Acquisition to deliver high-quality talent aligned with the company’s growth objectives. This role supports execution of the Talent Acquisition strategy, manages external recruiting partners, and helps ensure a consistent, efficient, and high-caliber hiring process. title: Vice President, Clinical Development
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>Attention recruitment agencies:</em></strong><em> All agency inquiries are vetted through 4DMT’s internal Talent Acquisition team. No unsolicited resumes will be accepted. The 4DMT Talent Acquisition team must expressly engage agencies on any requisition. Agencies contacting hiring managers directly will not be tolerated, and doing so may impact your ability to work with 4DMT in the future.</em></p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>4DMT is a leading late-stage biotechnology company advancing durable and disease-targeted therapeutics with potential to transform treatment paradigms and provide unprecedented benefits to patients. The Company’s lead product candidate 4D-150 is designed to be a backbone therapy forming the foundation of treatment of blinding retinal vascular diseases by providing multi-year sustained delivery of anti-VEGF biologics (aflibercept and anti-VEGF-C) with a single intravitreal injection, which substantially reduces the treatment burden associated with current bolus injections. The Company’s lead indication for 4D-150 is wet age-related macular degeneration and the second indication is diabetic macular edema, which are both in Phase 3 development. The Company’s second product candidate is 4D-710, which is the first known genetic medicine to demonstrate successful delivery and expression of the CFTR transgene in the lungs of people with cystic fibrosis after aerosol delivery.</p> <p>We are taking genetic medicine to new heights and into new disease areas to overcome challenges not addressed by existing medicines. This incredible challenge drives our relentless and talented team. Our people are the essence of our inspiring, innovative and collaborative environment that encourages individual contributions and provides opportunities for career development. We seek the best in the industry who identify with our mission and our bold and innovative results-driven approach. Our Core Values drive the way we work together:</p> <ul> <li>Dare to Cure</li> <li>Break Boundaries</li> <li>Beyond Yourself</li> <li>Prepare &amp; Execute Relentlessly</li> </ul> <p>Join us in creating the future of genetic medicine.</p></div><p><strong><u>GENERAL SUMMARY</u></strong></p> <p>Reporting to the Chief Medical Officer, the VP Clinical Development, Ophthalmology provides strategic and operational leadership for the global development of ophthalmic genetic medicines in Drug Development.</p> <p>We seek an experienced physician to play a critical role at 4DMT as we spearhead the introduction of intravitreally delivered genetic medicines for the treatment of the most common causes of irreversible blindness. The VP, Clinical Development will be a primary point person for medical oversight of clinical studies, with responsibilities including medical monitoring, review and interpretation of clinical trial data, clinical trial design, protocol development, and drafting of key clinical documents such as protocols, CSRs, briefing packages, INDs, NDAs, BLAs, MAAs, and other regulatory documents. This role will be responsible for timely execution of deliverables in close collaboration with relevant internal and external partners.</p> <p><strong><u>RESPONSIBILITIES:</u></strong></p> <ul> <li>Serve as the primary medical monitor for multiple ophthalmology clinical trials, providing expert oversight of patient safety, data integrity, and protocol adherence throughout study execution.</li> <li>Direct and mentor a team of medical monitors, ensuring high standards of medical oversight and data review, while maintaining accountability for real-time monitoring activities and timely delivery of critical clinical trial outputs.</li> <li>Provide medical leadership for cross-functional internal workstreams including pharmacovigilance, biostatistics, clinical operations, regulatory affairs, etc.</li> <li>Provide oversight and lead teams responsible for development plans, study protocols, amendments, ICFs, IBs, INDs, annual reports, CSRs, regulatory response documents, and other regulatory submissions or documents as appropriate.</li> <li>Collaborate closely with Clinical Operations and be accountable for clinical trial conduct and timelines for associated key deliverables.</li> <li>Keep up to date with compliance, SOPs and adhere to ICH, GCP, and relevant regulatory guidelines.</li> <li>Provide medical leadership for internal audits and regulatory inspections.</li> <li>Assist in preparation of materials for Advisory Board meetings, BOD meetings, etc</li> <li>Represent 4DMT and lead interactions and collaborations with potential partners.</li> <li>Represent the Ophthalmology Therapeutic Area with key external stakeholders, including patients and patient advocacy groups, external experts, investors, and the ophthalmic and biotech business communities</li> <li>Travel domestically and internationally as required, approximately 20%. Other duties as assigned; nothing in this job description restricts management’s right to assign or reassign duties and responsibilities to this job at any time.</li> </ul> <p><strong><u>QUALIFICATIONS:&nbsp;</u></strong></p> <p>Education:&nbsp;</p> <ul> <li>MD Degree</li> <li>Clinical training in Ophthalmology preferred</li> <li>Retina fellowship training a plus</li> <li>Board Certification (or equivalent) preferred</li> </ul> <p>Experience:&nbsp;</p> <ul> <li>Minimum of 8 years of biopharma industry experience in drug development.</li> <li>Phase 3 ophthalmology experience; retinal disease highly preferred.</li> <li>Experience with NDA, BLA or MAA submission(s). Drug approval(s) a plus.</li> <li>Experience with gene therapy, other areas of Drug Development and commercialization is a plus.</li> </ul> <p><strong><u>Skills:</u></strong></p> <ul> <li>Strong interpersonal skills and high emotional coefficient</li> <li>Highly effective written and verbal communication skills</li> <li>Excellent analytical, problem-solving and strategic planning skills.</li> <li>Up to date understanding of the ophthalmic competitive landscape with a focus on retina</li> <li>Prior clinical trial experience in retina highly preferred.</li> <li>Ability to understand and translate complex data to key messages</li> <li>Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment.</li> <li>Proven ability to prioritize effectively</li> <li>Proven ability to plan and conduct clinical trials ensuring high-quality trial execution and results within established timelines; demonstrated track record working effectively in cross-functional teams and workstreams including pharmacovigilance, biostatistics, clinical operations, and regulatory affairs.</li> <li>Experience in successfully presenting and interacting with the Ophthalmic Retina Community and regulatory authorities in US, EU and APAC</li> <li>Integrated understanding of FDA, EMA, ICH, and GCP guidelines. Prior interactions with FDA and EMA regulatory agencies is desirable.</li> <li>Track record of thinking strategically and executing to strategy</li> <li>Demonstrated success in influencing colleagues and senior leaders in various departments.</li> <li>Experience building and leading teams and driving engagement in a matrixed environment.&nbsp;</li> <li>Attention to detail, internal drive to generate high-quality work, and sense of passion and urgency to achieve team and program goals.</li> <li>Track record of developing talent</li> <li>Demonstrates high integrity.</li> </ul> <p>Physical Requirements and Working Conditions:</p> <ul> <li>Physical Activity - Repetitive motions: Making substantial movements (motions) of the wrists, hands, and/or fingers. Fingering: Picking, pinching, typing or otherwise working, primarily with fingers rather than with whole hand or arm as in handling. Talking: Expressing or exchanging ideas by means of the spoken word.</li> <li>Physical Requirements - Sedentary work: Exerting up to 10 pounds of force occasionally and/or a negligible amount of force frequently or constantly to lift, carry, push, pull or otherwise move objects, including the human body. Sedentary work involves sitting most of the time. Jobs are sedentary if walking and standing are required only occasionally and all other sedentary criteria are met.</li> <li>Working Conditions - The worker is not substantially exposed to adverse environmental conditions (as in typical office or administrative work).</li> </ul> <p><strong>Base salary compensation range: $350,000 - $430,000</strong></p> <p>Please note, the base salary compensation range and actual salary offered to the final candidate depends on various factors: candidate’s geographical location, relevant work experience, skills, and years of experience.&nbsp;</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>&nbsp;</p><div class="content-conclusion"><div>4DMT provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, status as a covered veteran, and any other category protected under applicable federal, state, provincial and local laws.</div> <div>&nbsp;</div> <div>Equal Opportunity Employer/Protected Veterans/Individuals with Disabilities</div></div>

The Vice President, Regulatory Affairs Strategy, reporting to the Chief Regulatory and Quality Officer, is the company’s senior global regulatory strategist, accountable for designing and executing integrated US, EU, and international regulatory strategies that take 4DMT’s programs from IND through BLA/MAA and approval in major markets. The role sets regulatory direction on program and executive teams, leads the company’s most consequential interactions with FDA, EMA, and other health authorities, and leads the Regulatory Strategy team.</p> <p><strong><u>MAJOR DUTIES &amp; </u></strong><strong><u>RESPONSIBILITIES:</u></strong></p> <ul> <li>Develops and leads integrated global regulatory strategies (US, EU, UK, Japan, and other key markets) for 4DMT’s AAV gene therapy programs from IND through BLA/MAA and approval, aligned with corporate objectives and supported by risk assessments, probability-of-success analyses, and contingency plans.</li> <li>Designs global development and submission sequencing, including CTA timing, BLA and MAA filing strategy, and use of FDA–EMA parallel scientific advice and other collaborative review mechanisms.</li> <li>Builds regulatory evidence strategies for novel endpoints and trial designs, including surrogate or intermediate endpoints, external controls, and real-world evidence where appropriate, consistent with FDA and EMA expectations for gene therapy.</li> <li>Serves as the regulatory lead on program and governance teams, translating regulatory requirements and precedent into development plans, target product profiles, and evidence-generation strategies.</li> <li>Identifies and pursues expedited and special regulatory pathways in each region, including Fast Track, RMAT, Breakthrough Therapy, Priority Review, Accelerated Approval, the Commissioner’s National Priority Voucher program, PRIME, ILAP, SAKIGAKE, and orphan designations.</li> <li>Plans and leads health authority interactions, including pre-IND, INTERACT, Type A/B/C, End-of-Phase 2, and pre-BLA meetings, EMA scientific advice, and PMDA consultations; directs briefing document strategy and preparation, prepares project teams, and serves as a primary company contact with FDA (CBER/OTP), EMA, and other agencies.</li> <li>Leads regulatory strategy for, and oversees preparation of, major submissions, including INDs/CTAs and amendments, annual reports, DSURs, orphan and expedited program designation requests, pediatric plans (iPSP/PIP), and BLA/MAA, ensuring filings are accurate, high quality, and submitted on time.</li> <li>Partners with clinical, nonclinical, CMC, biostatistics, safety/pharmacovigilance, and medical affairs to define submission content and to ensure development plans are acceptable to regulators.</li> <li>In partnership with Regulatory CMC and Technical Operations, ensures regulatory strategy accounts for AAV-specific CMC topics, including potency assays, comparability, and manufacturing process changes.</li> <li>Shapes target product profiles and target labeling strategy across regions in partnership with Medical Affairs and Commercial.</li> <li>Provides regulatory strategy input to life cycle plans, including indication expansion, new populations, and post-approval commitments, in partnership with the Life Cycle Management team.</li> <li>Partners with Regulatory Operations on submission planning and timelines for global filings.</li> <li>Leads ex-US regulatory strategy and execution, adapting global plans to regional requirements (EMA/CAT, MHRA, PMDA, Health Canada, and others) and directing regional partners, CROs, and consultants.</li> <li>Partners with Quality to support Pre-Approval Inspection and BIMO readiness, ensuring submitted content is consistent with actual processes and data.</li> <li>Builds, leads, and develops the Regulatory Strategy team, including global regulatory leads, with responsibility for goal setting, budget, resourcing, and talent development.</li> <li>Educates and trains company employees on regulatory requirements, processes, and health authority expectations.</li> <li>Communicates regulatory strategies, risks, and probability of success to executive leadership, the Board as needed, cross-functional teams, and partners/collaborators; supports business development due diligence.</li> <li>Maintains current knowledge of the global regulatory environment for gene therapy (including FDA CBER/OTP and EMA CAT/ATMP frameworks), regulatory precedent, and the competitive landscape, and communicates implications to program teams and senior management.</li> <li>Shapes the external regulatory environment through engagement with industry groups, health authority workshops, and comments on draft guidance relevant to gene therapy.</li> <li>Proactively identifies regulatory risks and proposes solutions that keep development plans on time while maintaining the highest standards of quality and compliance.</li> </ul> <p><strong><u>QUALIFICATIONS:&nbsp;</u></strong></p> <p>Education:</p> <ul> <li>S. degree in the life sciences or a related discipline required</li> <li>Advanced degree (Ph.D., J.D., PharmD, MBA, and/or M.S.) in the life sciences preferred</li> </ul> <p>Experience:</p> <ul> <li>S. with 18+ years of experience in the biopharmaceutical or biotechnology industries, or 14+ years with an M.S. degree, or 10+ years with a PhD or PharmD, with the majority in Regulatory Affairs.</li> <li>8+ years of people management experience leading regulatory strategy teams. An equivalent mix of education and experience will be considered.</li> <li>Experience within the viral vector gene therapy field required; AAV highly desirable. Direct experience with FDA CBER/OTP required.</li> <li>Senior responsibility for at least one successful BLA or MAA (gene therapy, cell therapy, or biologic preferred), including direct ownership of global (US and EU) regulatory strategy through approval.</li> <li>Demonstrated success negotiating novel development plans, endpoints, or expedited pathways with FDA CBER/OTP and EMA.</li> <li>Track record leading EU regulatory strategy, including EMA scientific advice, PRIME or CAT interactions, and centralized MAA procedures; Japan or other international experience preferred.</li> <li>Experience obtaining expedited program designations (e.g., RMAT, Breakthrough Therapy, Fast Track, PRIME, orphan).</li> <li>Ophthalmology or pulmonology experience a plus.</li> </ul> <p><span class="TextRun SCXW96258262 BCX0" lang="EN-US" data-contrast="none"><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW96258262 BCX0">Qualifications/Skills</span></span>:</p> <ul> <li>Expert knowledge of global regulations and guidance (FDA, EMA, ICH, MHRA, PMDA) and how they shape an integrated global regulatory strategy.</li> <li>Proven ability to develop and execute global regulatory strategies that deliver approvals.</li> <li>Strong track record of collaborative working relationships with FDA, EMA, and other health authorities that have led to successful outcomes for the business.</li> <li>Ability to work within a team environment, report on projects and drive them to conclusions.</li> <li>Self-starter who works with a sense of urgency and acts as a good team player working with other disciplines.</li> <li>Adaptability, flexibility, independence and resourcefulness to roll-up-sleeves and multi-task to thrive in small company environment.</li> <li>Ability to proactively identify challenges, possess strategic foresight and implement appropriate course of action</li> <li>Must have thorough knowledge of drug development and regulatory submission processes.</li> <li>Excellent scientific and regulatory writing skills, including briefing documents and responses to health authority questions.</li> <li>Demonstrated experience preparing and filing FDA and EMA submissions, including a BLA or MAA, required.</li> <li>Excellent organizational, communication and time management skills are required</li> <li>Must be able to innovate, analyze and solve problems with minimal supervision and strong attention to detail.</li> </ul> <p>Travel: 15-25%, including international travel. title: Senior Manager, Corporate FP&A
description: <p class="p1">At 2U, we are all in on purpose.
