title: Senior External Development Manager
description: <p><strong>WE ARE GAME MAKERS</strong></p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Who We Are:</strong></p> <p>We are a diverse team of developers driven by a passion for our art, united by our core values and inspired by a culture of inclusivity to build amazing games that thrill players everywhere. We pursue growth and innovation in an environment of safety and trust. Our culture is built on the belief that the more varied voices in our collective will strengthen our team and our games. We are looking for our next teammate who will raise our bar and make us better.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>What We Need:</strong></p> <p>We are seeking a senior external development leader to own how 31st Union works with external partners: what we send out, who we send it to, how it comes back, and how good it is when it does. You will set our external development strategy in partnership with the Head of Operations and studio leadership, and then build the thing you designed, including the pipelines, trackers, briefs, review loops, and onboarding paths that our partnerships actually run on.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>This role combines strategy ownership with hands-on production ownership</strong>. You are the person in the room when we decide what is viable to outsource on our AAA project. You are also the person who writes the tracker, fixes the brief template, and chases the access ticket. You will partner closely with Production to work out how we resource and schedule external work, and with Art Direction and our discipline leads to make sure the feedback reaching a vendor's team is specific, consistent, and actionable. This is a first-in-seat role. There is no external development team to inherit, and building one as our slate grows is part of the job.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>What You'll Do:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>External Development Strategy:</strong> Partner with Head of Operations and studio leadership to set and evolve our external development strategy: which disciplines are viable to send out, which partnership model fits each (asset vendor, embedded team, full co-development), and what we deliberately keep in house. Draft the internal-versus-external business cases behind those calls rather than presenting them as instinct.</li> <li><strong>Pipeline &amp; Workflow Ownership:</strong> Design, implement, and maintain the tools, systems, workflows, and operational policies that external development runs on in partnership with our domain leaders, including brief and outsourcing pack templates, asset trackers, review protocols, acceptance criteria, onboarding documentation, and the reporting standards behind all of it.&nbsp;</li> <li><strong>Partner Sourcing &amp; Commercial Management:</strong> Lead the RFP process, vendor outreach, portfolio and evaluation, as well as partner selection. Negotiate scope, capacity, cost, and delivery expectations against project goals and budget. Own the lifecycle of each partnership in collaboration with internal stakeholders: contracts and amendments with Legal and Procurement, invoices, renewals and expirations, offboarding, and onboarding, including driving IT and information security escalations to resolution so partners are productive quickly and safely.</li> <li><strong>Budget &amp; Forecasting:</strong> Manage the studio's external development budget and forecast process in partnership with the Operations team. Model cost against capacity, identify where spend is buying us the most, review deliverables against contractual criteria before milestone payments release, and bring cost-efficiency options to leadership before you are asked for them.</li> <li><strong>Production Partnership:</strong> Work with Production and discipline leads to determine how we actually produce external development: where the capacity gaps are, how external work is sequenced against internal milestones, and how workload is balanced across our internal teams and our external partners. Make sure external schedules and internal plans are aligned.</li> <li><strong>Creative Partnership &amp; Quality Oversight:</strong> Partner with Art Direction, craft owners, and discipline leads to define creative briefs, style guides, benchmark assets, and quality bars before production starts. Build and run the review cadence that gets vendor work in front of the right internal eyes on time, and make sure what goes back out is actionable direction. Protect our Art Directors' review time by establishing a technical and visual pre-screen process, and keep the loop tight enough that a partner's team improves over the course of an engagement.</li> <li><strong>Delivery Oversight, Risk &amp; Reporting:</strong> Build and manage vendor production schedules, monitor milestone health across the full slate of partnerships, and proactively mitigate risk from schedule, budget, or scope drift, bringing problems forward early with options attached rather than warnings. Own our external development database and reporting standards, and report vendor KPIs, capacity, spend, and delivery trends to studio leadership and publisher stakeholders in terms they can act on.</li> <li><strong>Building The Function &amp; The Bench:</strong> Grow external development from a function of one into a team as our slate requires it, including headcount recommendations, structure, and career pathing. Mentor and calibrate the team members managing our external engagements across our disciplines, whether or not they report to you.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Who You Are:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>A Strategist Who Still Builds:</strong> You can hold a multi-year view of our partner portfolio and open a spreadsheet the same afternoon. You are not looking for a role where the work arrives pre-scoped, and you are not looking for one where you only build other people's plans. You want both, and you know the difference between the two modes.</li> <li><strong>An Operator With Commercial Teeth:</strong> You have run RFPs, negotiated SOWs and rates, and owned a budget rather than reported on one. You are comfortable saying no to a partner, and comfortable explaining to a lead why the cheaper bid is the more expensive decision.</li> <li><strong>Grounded In The Craft:</strong> You may not be an artist, but you can tell the difference between a vendor skill gap, a brief gap, and a process gap, and you know which one you are looking at before you write the feedback. You understand what a style guide and a benchmark asset are for, and why a technical constraint agreed in week one saves a month in week twelve.</li> <li><strong>A Collaborator, A Diplomat, And A Developer Of People:</strong> You are the bridge between internal leads who want it perfect, production who wants it on the date, and a partner team eleven time zones away who wants a clear answer. You convey complex creative feedback clearly and diplomatically, often to non-native English speakers, and you manage communication windows rather than complaining about them. You articulate not just the "what" but the "why," to your own team and to our partners, and you treat a vendor as capability to be grown rather than capacity to be bought.</li> <li><strong>Comfortable In The "Gray" Areas:</strong> You are joining a function that does not fully exist yet. You are comfortable shaping new processes and adjusting them as the department evolves, and you would rather establish the standard than wait for one.</li> <li><strong>Tooling:</strong> Strong working knowledge of Jira and ShotGrid/Flow, and enough spreadsheet and data fluency to build the reporting yourself. Familiarity with Perforce or equivalent source control, and with how assets get integrated into a live engine build.</li> <li><strong>Level of Experience:</strong> 6 to 8+ years of external development or production experience in the video game industry, with a track record of running external development across multiple projects or a full franchise and real budget ownership.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Bonus Points:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience standing up an external development or outsourcing function from scratch.</li> <li>Experience with global partners across multiple time zones and cultures, including studios in Eastern Europe, South America, or Asia.</li> <li>Familiarity with publisher-side production and cross-studio coordination.</li> <li>Hands-on background in one of the disciplines we outsource, whether art, animation, audio, engineering, or QA.</li> </ul> <p><br>The pay range for this position in California at the start of employment is expected to be between $127,500 and $188,700 per Year. title: Associate Creative Director, Copywriter
description: <div class="content-intro"><table> <tbody> <tr> <td> <p><strong>About Lume and Mando&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>Founded in 2017, Lume is a transformative personal care brand on a mission to normalize body odor beyond pits and provide people with outrageously effective solutions so they don’t have to think twice about odor. We are pioneers of the whole body deodorant category, with a portfolio of odor-blocking products including anti-perspirants, aluminum-free deodorants, body washes, body creams, cleansing bars and laundry sprays. Lume products are OB/GYN developed, made with skin-safe ingredients that are gentle enough for the most sensitive parts and often referred to as “life-changing” by our customers. In late 2022, we launched a men’s line called Mando, bringing our expertise to the men’s personal care category. From whole body deodorants to body washes, our product offerings arm men with the confidence to show up as their best selves as they move about their busy day.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>Lume and Mando are part of Mammoth Brands, the modern CPG company behind category-leading brands Harry’s, Flamingo, Lume, Mando, and Coterie. Driven by a mission to “Create Things People Like More,”&nbsp; the company is creating a new model—and home—for brands, founders, and talent looking to solve unmet needs, improve peoples’ lives and ultimately change the status quo. Even as we grow, we take extra care to maintain the small, scrappy, entrepreneurial culture that helped to get us where we are today: a company that people like more, that better serves its customers, employees, and community. Mammoth Brands is committed to making a positive impact and donated over $20 million through our network of nonprofit partners to date.&nbsp;</p> <p>We build brands that move fast and think big — and we hire people who are curious about AI, willing to experiment with it in their day-to-day work, and excited to accelerate what's possible. We prioritize giving our team the tools, training, and space to build real fluency, so you grow alongside the technology and help shape how we use it.</p> </td> </tr> </tbody> </table></div><h3><strong>About the Team</strong></h3> <p>The Creative team at Lumē and Mando is small, ambitious, and building something real. We work across both brands — two whole body deodorants that do something the rest of the industry doesn't: stop the bacteria that causes B.O. anywhere on the body. It's a genuinely better product solving a problem people have always been too embarrassed to talk about. Our job is to change that. We make campaigns, content, packaging, and activations that help people understand why these products are different — and why they should care. We're in the middle of a major brand transformation, and the work we're doing right now will define what these brands look and feel like for years to come.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h3><strong>About the Role</strong></h3> <p>We're looking for an ACD, Copywriter who leads with concepts and executes with craft. You'll be the voice partner to the ACD Art Director, design team, and content creation team — concepting campaigns together, pushing ideas to unexpected places, and making sure the work says something as interesting as it looks. This isn't a job where you're handed a brief and told to fill in the tagline. You're in the room when the ideas are forming, shaping both what we say and how we say it.</p> <p>Neither brand is finished. Both have room to grow, tighten, and get more interesting — and we're looking for someone who sees that as the opportunity, not the problem. If you're drawn to building and evolving rather than maintaining what's already there, this is the right role.</p> <p>This is a player-coach position. You'll manage two Senior Copywriters and be deeply accountable for their growth — while staying close enough to the work that your own instincts stay sharp. The work spans social, digital, packaging, in-store, and activations across two brands with different audiences. That range is the job.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h3><strong>A Day in the Life</strong></h3> <p>No two days look the same, but here's a taste of what this role actually feels like:</p> <ul> <li>Sitting in on a brief kickoff with the Brand and Marketing leads for Lumē's next campaign — asking the questions that reframe the strategy before a single line gets written.</li> <li>Running a concepting session with the ACD Art Director, building off each other's thinking until an idea emerges that neither of you would have landed on alone.</li> <li>Reviewing a batch of social copy from one of your Senior Copywriters — giving feedback that's specific enough to actually improve the work, not just your version of it.</li> <li>Partnering with the Social team on a platform-native content series, working together early enough to shape both the idea and how it lives on each channel.</li> <li>Writing three headline directions for a Lumē product launch yourself, killing two because the third is actually right — then briefing your team on how to extend it.</li> <li>Pushing back (with evidence) on a brief from Marketing that's asking for something technically accurate but doesn't sound like a human being wrote it.</li> <li>Sitting in a packaging review and being the person in the room who asks: does this actually sound like us?</li> <li>Ending the day with a clear sense of what your team needs tomorrow — which decisions are yours to make, which ones you need to unblock, and where the work needs to move faster.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h3><strong>What You Will Accomplish</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Concept original campaign ideas across social, digital, in-store, and activations in close partnership with the ACD Art Director — bringing strong copy thinking and voice strategy to every brief.</li> <li>Own the copywriting across all consumer-facing touchpoints: packaging, retail, digital, social, and campaign — with a consistent, evolving brand voice for each brand.</li> <li>Manage and develop two Senior Copywriters through structured feedback, regular crits, and documented growth goals that raise the overall level of craft on the team.</li> <li>Help define and document the copy voice for both Lumē and Mando as the brands continue to evolve — building guidelines the broader team can use independently.</li> <li>Write for and direct video and content production — not as an editor, but as the creative lead ensuring the copy and concept land correctly through production partners.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h3><strong>This Should Describe You</strong></h3> <ul> <li>You think in campaigns, not lines. Capabilities built by this team will meaningfully impact the business through marketing optimization, channel strategy, site optimization, selling stories, thought leadership, innovation, and overall consumer/shopper experience.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>About the Role</strong></p> <p>As the Analytics Manager for DTC, you'll build and drive the reporting and diagnostic analytics that advance our strategy - and turn that analysis into a point of view. You'll design and report on DTC KPIs and analyses spanning the user journey from acquisition through conversion, post-purchase engagement and retention, subscriptions, distribution, and site experimentation. When a stakeholder brings you a question, they should walk away with a recommendation, not just a chart or data point - that means connecting the dots across data sources, business priorities, and customer signal, and knowing which questions are worth chasing and which aren't. We need someone with strong business acumen, excellent storytelling skills, a passion for consumer empathy, a robust technical toolkit, and the confidence to share a strong point of view, even with people more senior than you. You'll work with key decision-makers throughout the DTC organization, and share your insights and recommendations - and defend them - with all levels of the business.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Here's what you'll accomplish:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Synthesizing data on a regular basis to provide the DTC team with brand-level insights on business health - and a clear recommendation on what to do about it, not just the numbers</li> <ul> <li>Leverage our BI tool Omni to build, maintain, and own dashboards that empower the business to interpret and act quickly. (e.g., track inventory issues across retailers and build actionable alerting.)&nbsp;</li> <li>Become an expert on existing DTC reporting and drive towards improvement</li> </ul> <li>Plan, design, and implement reports that highlight key performance indicators</li> <ul> <li>Enhance our A/B testing reporting suite&nbsp;</li> <li>Track new feature launches by Product &amp; Engagement teams and build/manage the reporting for how they perform</li> </ul> <li>Work closely with the teams in our DTC Org to drive value for the business</li> <ul> <li>Gain a strong understanding of their data problems and use our Analytics toolkit to find a solution (What data do we need, how can we get it, and how can we automate reporting?)</li> <li>Driving deep analysis of the whats and whys of key drivers to surface hypotheses for action</li> </ul> <li>Be a strong, trusted voice and thought leader for the brands you support - bringing a well-reasoned point of view to the table, and comfortable sharing it with stakeholders at all levels</li> <ul> <li>Enable your stakeholders and leaders to get sharper and smarter on the data, the business, and how we tackle our biggest questions just by working alongside you</li> <li>Bring a strong, well-reasoned point of view and advocate for the brands you support, comfortable doing so with people more senior than you</li> <li>Your impact and influence comes from how much smarter you make the people around you and your strong perspective</li> </ul> <li>Help define how we measure and report out on performance on ecommerce across key KPIs, set up dashboarding capability, and regularly track and share the overall performance of the business to drive strategic planning</li> <li>Identify analytics pain points and inefficiencies, and develop new tools and automated processes to optimize and streamline. AI is integral to the work, not an afterthought.&nbsp;</li> <li>Be a data-evangelist and sparring partner across the organization, sharing best practices and insights and willing to challenge the status quo with cross-functional teams and stakeholders at every level&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h3><strong>This may describe you:</strong></h3> <ul> <li>5+ years in data analytics or a similarly analytical field, using data to drive decision-making and narrative development in a fast-moving, cross-functional environment, with a strong understanding of the role analytics plays in a cross-disciplinary digital product development lifecycle.</li> <li>Proficient Technical Skill – Fluent in SQL (Python or R a plus), with the ability to query, manipulate, and analyze data end-to-end to accelerate the business.</li> <li>BI Tool Fluency – Hands-on experience building and maintaining dashboards and models in a modern BI platform. From whole body deodorants to body washes, our product offerings arm men with the confidence to show up as their best selves as they move about their busy day.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>Lume and Mando are part of Mammoth Brands, the modern CPG company behind category-leading brands Harry’s, Flamingo, Lume, Mando, and Coterie. Driven by a mission to “Create Things People Like More,”&nbsp; the company is creating a new model—and home—for brands, founders, and talent looking to solve unmet needs, improve peoples’ lives and ultimately change the status quo. Even as we grow, we take extra care to maintain the small, scrappy, entrepreneurial culture that helped to get us where we are today: a company that people like more, that better serves its customers, employees, and community. Mammoth Brands is committed to making a positive impact and donated over $20 million through our network of nonprofit partners to date.&nbsp;</p> <p>We build brands that move fast and think big — and we hire people who are curious about AI, willing to experiment with it in their day-to-day work, and excited to accelerate what's possible. We prioritize giving our team the tools, training, and space to build real fluency, so you grow alongside the technology and help shape how we use it.</p> </td> </tr> </tbody> </table></div><h4>About the Team</h4> <p>The Centralized Insights &amp; Analytics (CIA) team is a critical function that drives proactive insights to action across the business. CIA unites capabilities across data science, analytics, insights, demand planning, and category management into an integrated function - solving both the everyday decisions and the complex business questions that shape our strategy. Capabilities built by this team meaningfully impact the business through channel strategy, assortment and selling stories, marketing optimization, thought leadership, innovation, and the overall consumer and shopper experience.</p> <p>This role sits within Omnichannel Analytics, the CIA function covering DTC, Amazon, and Retail.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h4>About the Role</h4> <p>The Retail Analytics Sr. Manager, Walmart is the analytics owner for one of our largest retail customers. This is a senior individual contributor role - with your impact coming from analytical depth on the account, the quality of your thinking, and your ability to influence and shape our strategy across Sales, Brand, Digital, and our external Walmart partners.</p> <p>You will own the Walmart analytics and insights roadmap end-to-end: the recurring reporting that keeps the business honest, the strategic analyses that unlock growth, and the data partnerships that make both possible - bridging retail (syndicated/POS) performance with Walmart's fast-growing digital and marketplace business (WMT.com, 3P Marketplace, retail media) to tell one connected, omnichannel Walmart story. You will also serve as the internal expert on our Walmart data capabilities and own the Scintilla vendor relationship on behalf of the company.</p> <p>For this role we are seeking someone with a passion for storytelling through data who asks "what else can we do?" - a natural collaborator with a continuous improvement mindset who enjoys bringing others along.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h4>Your Core Responsibilities:</h4> <ul> <li>Provide the primary customer and internal analytic support for our Walmart business across personal care categories, inclusive of category, market, shopper, and assortment, and digital/marketplace performance analysis</li> <li>Develop and own the Walmart analytics and insights roadmap and vision to support channel strategy, and be the go-to for ad hoc retail reporting and analysis</li> <li>Bridge retail and digital into one omnichannel read. Connect POS/syndicated performance with WMT.com and 3P Marketplace - reading digital penetration against store trend, distribution (store count/%ACV), and channel mix (STH vs. Pickup) to tell whether digital growth is incremental or just store demand shifting online.</li> <li>Serve as the analytics bridge between Walmart's retail and digital businesses, connecting brick-and-mortar performance with WMT.com, Marketplace (3P), and retail media metrics to build one cohesive, omnichannel view of the Walmart business as Walmart's digital business scales rapidly&nbsp;</li> <li>Own the Scintilla contract and relationship: scope capability needs, manage the commercial relationship, and partner with Omnichannel Analytics leadership on budgeting and contracting decisions for Walmart-specific data capabilities</li> <li>Serve as the internal expert on Scintilla, driving adoption and depth of usage across Brand and Sales so the capability is fully leveraged, not just licensed</li> <li>Serve as the sales managers' most collaborative and strategic thought partner - they walk away from each interaction knowing that the work, decision, and tactic got stronger because of Retail Analytics input</li> <li>Be an "always-on storyteller" - interpret the data, identify the "so what" and the "why" behind the headlines, build compelling data-driven presentations, diagnose impact to channel P&amp;L, across both retail and digital, and drive action through weekly and monthly scorecards</li> <li>Independently lead high-impact strategic analyses that uncover new revenue opportunities, drawing on category trends, competitive dynamics, shopper behaviors, and purchase drivers, and digital/marketplace performance trends</li> <li>Own the omni-channel, SKU-level scorecard,&nbsp; blending Scintilla (organic + omni) and Walmart Connect/Skai (paid) performance, and use it to hold retail media partners accountable to sub-category and item-level insights</li> <li>Serve as a Retail &amp; CPG leader and data expert to peers, cross-functional teams, and external partners</li> <li>Build sustainability and efficiency through repeatable processes, tools, and ways of working - and proactively find opportunities to scale what works at Walmart across other channels</li> <li>Contribute to the team's shared analytical toolkit, including our use of AI and automation to maximize our team’s impact</li> <li>Mentor and coach analysts across the Retail Analytics team, raising the bar on analytical rigor and storytelling</li> <li>Create and maintain best-in-class cross-functional relationships with internal and external partners through understanding interdependencies, proactive communication, and project management<br><br></li> </ul> <h4>Experience and Qualifications:</h4> <ul> <li>Bachelor's degree and/or 7+ years in an analytical and strategic data-driven role. Experience in CPG and/or Retail is a plus</li> <li>Experience with syndicated data (Circana / Nielsen) is a necessity; experience with Walmart Scintilla Charter and Walmart's digital/marketplace ecosystem (WMT.com, 3P Marketplace, WMC) is strongly preferred</li> <li>Passion to work with data and the ability to synthesize complex data from various sources - eager to proactively identify and execute against the analytical needs of the business</li> <li>Fluency in core digital-shelf and retail-media metrics is a necessity, with direct Scintilla digital landscape and paid/organic funnel experience preferred (e.g., glance views, sessions, CVR, CTR, ROAS, TACoS, and NTB)&nbsp;</li> <li>Excellent communicator and storyteller with strong written, verbal, and presentation skills</li> <li>Takes ownership and responsibility for the work and desires to be seen as a proactive analytics leader and problem solver, not just a report generator</li> <li>Insatiably curious and always looking to learn something new, seeking to improve yourself, your team, and the world around you</li> <li>Professional and enthusiastic teammate with a passion to work collaboratively across teams and aim for results</li> <li>Proficient in Microsoft Office Business Suite, including PowerPoint and Excel, and Google Workspace; comfort with modern BI tooling (Omni/Looker or similar) preferred<br><br></li> </ul> <h4>Who You'll Work With:</h4> <ul> <li>You will report to the Senior Director, Omnichannel Analytics within Centralized Insights &amp; Analytics (CIA)</li> <li>Internally: You work closely with the Mammoth Care Retail Sales team, Category Analytics, Insights, Demand Planning, BI Enablement, and the Harry's, Flamingo, Lume &amp; Mando Brand teams</li> <li>Externally: Walmart merchant partners and our data partners, including Circana, Scintilla and WMC</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Benefits and perks</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Medical, dental, and vision coverage</strong></li> <li><strong>401k match</strong></li> <li><strong>Equity in Mammoth Brands&nbsp;</strong></li> <li><strong>Flexible time off and working hours</strong></li> <li><strong>L&amp;D stipend</strong></li> <li><strong>4 weeks sabbatical after 5 years, 6 weeks after 10 years, and 8 weeks after 15 years&nbsp;</strong></li> <li style="font-weight: bold;"><strong>20 fully paid weeks off for parents who give birth, or 16 fully paid weeks off for all other paths to parenthood</strong></li> <li><strong>Fun IRL and virtual events including happy hours, team building events, and parties on our rooftop</strong></li> <li><strong>Free products from our family of brands</strong></li> </ul> <p><em><span style="font-weight: 400;">The Mammoth Brands' working model is in-office Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday. The base salary hiring range for this position is </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">$118,000-$150,000</span><span style="font-weight: 400;">, but the final compensation offer will ultimately be based on the candidate’s location, skill level and experience.&nbsp;&nbsp;</span></p><div class="content-conclusion"><p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Mammoth Brands is committed to bringing together individuals from different backgrounds and perspectives. description: <div class="content-intro"><table> <tbody> <tr> <td> <p><strong>About Lume and Mando&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>Founded in 2017, Lume is a transformative personal care brand on a mission to normalize body odor beyond pits and provide people with outrageously effective solutions so they don’t have to think twice about odor. We prioritize giving our team the tools, training, and space to build real fluency, so you grow alongside the technology and help shape how we use it.</p> </td> </tr> </tbody> </table></div><h2><strong>About the team</strong></h2> <p>The Lume &amp; Mando technology team builds and runs the digital commerce experience for two of the fastest-growing brands in the Mammoth portfolio. We own the headless Shopify storefronts end to end — the React Router/Hydrogen applications our customers shop on, the subscription and loyalty experiences that keep them coming back, and the edge infrastructure that serves it all.</p> <p>We are a small, high-leverage team operating in a long-tail SaaS ecosystem: rather than building everything ourselves, we integrate best-in-class platforms and write the code that makes them work as one coherent experience. That means the engineering here is genuinely full-stack and genuinely commercial — the work you ship shows up in conversion, retention, and revenue within days, not quarters.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h2><strong>About the role</strong></h2> <p>We’re looking for a Software Engineer to join the Lume storefront team as a senior member. This is a hands-on, senior individual contributor role for an engineer who is sought out as a domain expert, structures and breaks down project work, and delivers end-to-end solutions on a small team.</p> <p>You’ll own moderately complex problem areas across our headless Shopify architecture — storefront performance, subscription flows, loyalty, experimentation, and the integrations that tie them together. You’ll set the technical direction in those areas, raise the quality bar for everyone working in them, and translate business needs into what we build. This role reports to the Lume Head of Technology and partners daily with Product, Growth, Retention, Creative, and Analytics.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h2><strong>What you will accomplish</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Lead projects end to end.</strong> Structure and break down work on storefront initiatives, define the technical tasks needed to hit team objectives, and deliver solutions.</li> <li><strong>Own the quality bar.</strong> Deliver secure, testable, maintainable, low-defect, efficient work that is well designed and well documented.</li> <li><strong>Drive technical decisions in a complex domain.</strong> Weigh other engineers' points of view against business requirements and synthesize the best solution, not the loudest one.</li> <li><strong>Build consensus.</strong> Harmonize discordant technical views and lead the resolution of contentious issues — across engineering and with cross-functional partners.</li> <li><strong>Create the things that make others faster.</strong> Produce exemplars, frameworks, shared components, runbooks, and technical documentation that raise the ceiling for everyone working in the codebase.</li> <li><strong>Debug across the stack.</strong> Identify and correct defects—not just your own—across multiple technologies, from the Remix application and edge layer through third-party platform integrations.</li> <li><strong>Communicate to align.</strong> Structure technical communication and documentation that achieves alignment on decisions of broad scope across codebases, projects, and business functions.</li> <li><strong>Map business needs to technology.</strong> Influence the business processes and product decisions within the Lume domain, not just the code that implements them.</li> <li><strong>Grow the people around you.</strong> Actively share knowledge, create the structures and processes that make sharing routine, and coach less experienced engineers.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h2><strong>This should describe you</strong></h2> <p><strong>Required</strong></p> <ul> <li>Substantial professional experience building and operating production e-commerce applications, with a track record of independently delivering projects on time in a live, revenue-generating environment.</li> <li><strong>Headless Shopify on React Router.</strong> Deep, hands-on experience is a must — Storefront API, Remix data loading and routing patterns, caching strategy, and the realities of running a headless storefront at scale. <strong>Shopify Hydrogen experience is important.</strong></li> <li>Strong JavaScript/TypeScript, modern React, and front-end performance fundamentals (Core Web Vitals, rendering strategy, bundle discipline).</li> <li>Experience integrating third-party SaaS platforms via APIs and webhooks — including the unglamorous parts: idempotency, retries, rate limits, data reconciliation, and graceful degradation when a vendor is down.</li> <li>Fluency in the practices that keep a storefront stable: testing, code review, observability, incident response, and releasing to production without impacting performance or reliability.</li> <li>The ability to communicate a clear technical point of view in a group, understand the views of others, and commit to the team’s decision.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Preferred</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Custom Shopify Apps: </strong>Experience designing, building, and maintaining custom or private Shopify apps — Admin and Storefront GraphQL APIs, OAuth and webhook handling, app extensions, Shopify Functions and checkout extensibility — plus the operational side of keeping an app healthy as Shopify's API versions turn over. description: <table> <thead> <tr> <th style="text-align: left;"> <p>Job Title</p> </th> <th style="text-align: left;"> <p>Principal Technical Animator (Gameplay)</p> </th> </tr> </thead> <tbody> <tr> <td> <p><strong>Department</strong></p> </td> <td> <p><strong>Technical Art</strong></p> </td> </tr> <tr> <td> <p><strong>Location(s)&nbsp;</strong></p> </td> <td> <p><strong>Brighton, Prague, Brno</strong></p> </td> </tr> <tr> <td> <p><strong>Reports To&nbsp;</strong></p> </td> <td> <p><strong>Associate Director Technical Animation</strong></p> </td> </tr> <tr> <td> <p><strong>Job Type (Permanent, fixed term, internship)&nbsp;</strong></p> </td> <td> <p><strong>Permanent</strong></p> </td> </tr> </tbody> </table> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Job Summary&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>The Principal Technical Animator (Gameplay) will help define the technical vision, architectural framework, and long-term strategy for character animation integration across the studio. In this highly influential role, you will champion innovation, driving the adoption of cutting-edge technologies to ensure our games achieve world-class animation quality and responsiveness. You will serve as a technical authority on gameplay animation, solving the studio’s complex R&amp;D challenges while collaborating with design, animation and engineering to establish future-proof pipelines. While not a people manager, you will inspire, mentor, and elevate the technical capabilities of the entire animation department.&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Duties and Responsibilities&nbsp;&nbsp;</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Architect and oversee</strong> the high-level design of gameplay animation systems, ensuring scalability, performance, and seamless integration across complex real-time systems.</li> <li><strong>Drive R&amp;D initiatives</strong> to evaluate and implement cutting-edge animation technologies (e.g., advanced Motion Matching, machine learning/AI animation, next-gen physics).</li> <li><strong>Partner with Engineering and Tech Animation leadership</strong> to implement project-wide animation roadmaps and toolsets.&nbsp;</li> <li><strong>Solve deep, complex runtime bugs</strong> and drive animation optimisation efforts to meet strict performance and memory budgets.</li> <li><strong>Define and document</strong> technical standards, best practices, and pipeline workflows for the wider technical animation team.</li> <li><strong>Collaborate closely with Design and Animation leads</strong> to heavily iterate on and perfect 3C mechanics (character, camera, controls), maximizing game feel.</li> <li><strong>Actively mentor and upskill</strong> senior and mid-level technical animators through code/blueprint reviews and hands-on guidance.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Essential Skills, Attributes and Experience</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Extensive proven experience</strong> architecting and integrating gameplay animation systems for AAA titles using Unreal Engine.</li> <li><strong>Master-level expertise</strong> in Unreal Engine’s animation suite (Anim Blueprints, Motion Matching, Control Rig, State Machines,&nbsp; and Sequencer).</li> <li><strong>Deep technical understanding</strong> of low-level animation concepts, including runtime optimisation, memory management, and threading for animation.</li> <li><strong>Exceptional cross-discipline communication skills</strong>, with a proven track record of aligning Art, Design, and Engineering directors on complex technical visions.</li> <li><strong>Expertise in feature breakdown</strong> and scoping, with the ability to translate abstract creative pillars into robust, production-ready plans..</li> <li><strong>A profound understanding of gameplay mechanics</strong>, game feel, and the mathematical principles behind smooth character movement and physics.</li> <li><strong>A portfolio or reel</strong> demonstrating a history of solving highly complex, innovative technical animation challenges in shipped titles.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Highly Desirable&nbsp;</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Strong proficiency in C++</strong> for extending Unreal Engine’s animation system, alongside Python for pipeline tool automation.</li> <li><strong>Experience contributing to proprietary engine tools</strong> or custom modifications to Unreal's core animation code.</li> <li><strong>Production experience with advanced DCC tools</strong>, including Maya API, MotionBuilder, or Houdini for runtime or pipeline integration.</li> <li><strong>Background in traditional animation or motion capture</strong> data manipulation to better bridge the gap between art and code.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <hr> <p>Hangar 13&nbsp; prides itself on the diversity of its team members, partners, and communities.&nbsp; For this reason, we remain committed to providing equal employment opportunity in all aspects of the employment relationship, from recruitment and hiring through compensation, benefits, discipline and termination.&nbsp;&nbsp;</p> <p>As an equal opportunity employer, we are also committed to ensuring that qualified individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation(s) to participate in the job application and/or interview process, to perform their essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment.&nbsp; Please contact us if you need to request reasonable accommodation.</p> <p><strong>SECURITY NOTICE -&nbsp; </strong>We have recently been made aware of increasing occurrences of bad actors posing as company HR personnel to gain information from "potential candidates", in the form of job interviews and offers. These scams can be quite sophisticated and appear legitimate.</p> <p>Please know that Hangar 13 and 2K never use instant messaging apps to contact prospective employees or to conduct interviews.</p> <p>If you believe you have been a victim of such a scam, you may fill out a complaint form at <a href="https://complaint.ic3.gov/">https://complaint.ic3.gov/</a> and <a href="https://reportfraud.ftc.gov/">https://reportfraud.ftc.gov/</a> detailing as much as possible. We are taking these matters very seriously and apologize for any inconvenience.</p> <p>#LI-Hybrid</p> <p>#LI-JF1</p> <p>&nbsp;</p>

With studios in Brighton (UK), Brno, and Prague (CZ), we work as one team to bring to life narrative-rich games that keep players immersed. Each of our locations provides the opportunity to work with some of the most talented developers in the industry, on creatively challenging and exciting projects, in a diverse and welcoming environment.</p> <h2><strong>Job Summary</strong></h2> <p>Hangar 13 is looking for a seasoned Senior Rendering Engineer who enjoys a collaborative and creative work environment and is looking to push the boundaries of cutting-edge 3D graphics. In this role, you will bridge the gap between stock Unreal Engine 5 capabilities and the high-performance, photorealistic visual demands of our current AAA projects. Working in a globally distributed team alongside our Tech Art, Lighting, and Environment teams, you will research, implement, and optimize custom rendering techniques that empower artists to deliver their vision stably and performantly. This is an ideal position for an engineer who thrives on navigating large codebases, solving complex technical pipeline overlaps, and making bold engine-level changes to advance game technology.</p> <h2><strong>Duties and Responsibilities</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Advance, modify, and optimize Unreal Engine 5's stock rendering pipeline to meet strict performance and artistic demands.</li> <li>Partner closely with the Lighting Team, Environment Art teams, and Tech Art/Shaders departments to bridge team overlaps, eliminate pipeline bottlenecks, and bring the creative vision of our games to life.</li> <li>Research, develop, implement, and debug high-end, photorealistic graphics techniques applicable to characters and large-scale environments.</li> <li>Efficiently draft and deliver clear technical designs to different audiences, skillfully filtering out unnecessary detail for non-technical stakeholders.</li> <li>Identify technical and developmental risks/obstacles within the rendering pipeline and proactively generate solutions to overcome them.</li> <li>Navigate, maintain, and safely improve within a massive, multi-platform codebase using advanced C++ and modern graphics APIs.</li> <li>Collaborate closely across multiple studio locations, ensuring close alignment with the Render Lead and local engineering anchors between studio locations.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Essential Skills, Attributes and Experience</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Industry Experience:</strong> Significant experience in computer games engineering, specifically focused on real-time computer graphics, shaders, and engine development.</li> <li><strong>Technical Mastery:</strong> Advanced knowledge of C++ and multi-threaded programming techniques.</li> <li><strong>Graphics:</strong> Strong knowledge of modern Real-Time Rendering techniques, 3D math, and linear algebra.</li> <li><strong>Language &amp; Communication:</strong> English proficiency with exceptional communication and collaboration skills.</li> <li><strong>Work Style:</strong> Demonstrated ability to work both collaboratively within a highly integrated global team and self-sufficiently as an outcome-oriented problem solver.</li> <li><strong>Qualifications:</strong> Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent professional work experience.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Highly Desirable</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Shipped Titles:</strong> Shipped one or more AAA game titles on multiple platforms.&nbsp;</li> <li><strong>Engine Specifics:</strong> Deep multi-platform development experience utilizing Unreal Engine 5 or highly customized proprietary engines.</li> <li><strong>Console Debugging:</strong> Hands-on familiarity with console profiling and debugging tools (e.g., RenderDoc, PIX, etc.).</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>Hangar 13&nbsp; Our design and product teams are already exploring the systems and experiences that can make that possible, and AI is core to how we're getting there.</p> <p>The CX Incubator exists to rapidly build and test new concepts for our mobile app before larger investments are made. We're looking for a hands-on Full Stack Engineer focused on AI prototyping who combines strong software engineering, deep frontend experience, strong applied AI experience, and product and design instincts to turn ambitious customer experience ideas into functional, testable prototypes.</p> <p>You'll work alongside a marketer and designer to take concepts from ideation to realistic, testable simulations and prototypes. You'll also help build and evolve our React/Next.js prototyping platform, which enables non-technical partners to rapidly create and experiment with app experiences.</p> <p>A key part of this role is determining how AI should be applied to a customer problem—not simply integrating a predefined solution. You'll evaluate different AI models, services, and technical approaches and determine how to apply them to experiences involving conversational AI, content decisioning, recommendations, personalization, generative experiences, voice interactions, and other emerging capabilities.</p> <p>You'll use AI-native development tools and workflows to move quickly from idea to working simulations and prototypes. loosely defined concepts into working POCs.</p> <p>The goal is to prove out both the customer experience and the technology behind it—not to build the final production-ready solution.</p> <p>This is a role for an experienced builder who is comfortable with ambiguity, can independently determine technical approaches, enjoys creating working solutions quickly, and learns through experimentation.</p> content libraries, AI SDKs, APIs, data sources, and staging systems.</li> <li>Explore AI-forward design systems and guardrails that help generated experiences and agents stay within defined UX, brand, content, and interaction guidelines.</li> <li>Use AI-native development workflows with tools like Cursor, Claude, Copilot, and similar technologies.</li> <li>Help define practical guardrails for safe, reliable, and brand-appropriate customer-facing AI experiences.</li> <li>Use feedback from customer and user testing to rapidly iterate on prototypes and explore different approaches.</li> </ul> within applications, prototypes, or customer-facing experiences.</li> <li>Experience working with applied AI capabilities such as LLMs, conversational AI, recommendation or decisioning systems, personalization, retrieval/grounding, agents/tool calling, or generative AI.</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to evaluate different AI approaches for a use case, understand their tradeoffs, and and design instincts and an appreciation for great customer experiences.</li> <li>Comfort with ambiguity, rapid experimentation, and building enough to test and learn without over-engineering.</li> title: DVM Student Externship/Preceptorship Program — 30th Street Animal Hospital
description: <p><strong>We're making an investment in the next generation of veterinary doctors!</strong></p> <p>As part of the professional veterinary curriculum, colleges encourage off-campus educational experiences in practices outside of the teaching hospital. Practical experience in a well-run and contemporary practice can be a valuable component of your veterinary education, preparing you to deliver better care after graduation. Our program is dedicated to contributing to your practice-readiness and to help you hit the ground running after graduation.</p> <p><strong>Our program structure:</strong></p> <p>Our externships are flexible—they can range from two to eight weeks during the year, according to your college curriculum – but are typically two or three weeks in length. Your schedule will include days, evenings and weekends.&nbsp;</p> <p>Our externship rotations are designed to allow students, under veterinary supervision, to practice the problem-solving, technical and communication skills that they have acquired during their clinical preparation. Externs are given the opportunity to work alongside our veterinary team and are encouraged to participate in all aspects of patient care. A stipend of $250 per week will be provided.</p> <p><strong>What you'll be doing:</strong></p> <p>Externs experience the typical caseload of a small animal practice. Under the supervision of your mentor doctor you will gather histories, perform physical examinations, develop diagnostic and therapeutic plans, scrub in to surgery, assist in the management of medical cases, provide wellness care, develop your client communication skills, polish your technical skills and produce appropriate medical records (SOAPs) within the time limits of daily practice.</p> <p><strong>Who we're looking for:</strong></p> <p>Extern students are expected to be enthusiastic and effective participants in our patient care activities, upholding the professional and ethical standards of our practice. Students participating in the externship program are suggested to review the Veterinary Practice Act in regard to the scope of duties that may be performed, and to be familiar with the type and degree of veterinary supervision that is required. These should be followed carefully in order to protect both yourself and our practice.</p> <p>As a veterinary student extern, we expect you to dress and behave in a professional manner and to meet the expectations that we have of all team members as outlined in our employee handbook.</p> <p><strong>Requirements:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Be enrolled in an accredited DVM program.</li> <li>You are authorized to work in the United States.</li> <li>You must carry professional liability insurance. AVMA PLIT liability insurance is free for all student members of the AVMA. You may apply for this coverage on their <a href="http://www.avmaplit.com/products/student-liability/">website</a>. Please check to make sure your coverage is current and submit a certificate of coverage with your application.</li> </ul> <p><strong>About us:</strong></p> <p>As sponsors of the Veterinary Externship Program, we see ourselves to be part of your educational team, providing instruction, mentoring and evaluation of the students who participate. You will be assigned a mentor and work on the learning objectives as defined by your college program or to meet your specific goals. At the end of the externship your mentor will provide a written evaluation of your performance as required by your college program.</p> <p>We look forward to working with you!</p>

title: Veterinarian
description: <p><strong><u>Associate Veterinarian | New Graduates &amp; Experienced DVMs Welcome!</u></strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Salary:</strong> $140,000–$170,000 + production, with earning potential of $230K+. <strong>No negative accrual.</strong> Flexible compensation models: base-only, production-only, or base + production.</li> <li><strong>Bonus:</strong> Up to $30,000 Sign-On Bonus, Student Loan Repayment, and Relocation Assistance</li> <li><strong>Schedule:</strong> 4-day workweek with rotating half-day Saturdays. <strong>No on-call!</strong></li> <li><strong>Location:</strong> 8120 E. 21st St., Indianapolis, IN 46219</li> <li><strong>Hours of Operation:</strong> Monday–Friday: 8:00 AM–6:00 PM; Saturday: 8:00 AM–12:00 PM</li> </ul> <p><strong>30th Street Animal Hospital is welcoming experienced veterinarians and new graduates, including the Class of 2027, to join our collaborative small-animal practice in Indianapolis, Indiana!</strong></p> <p>Whether you're preparing to begin your veterinary career or looking for a hospital where you can continue practicing great medicine, enjoy a supportive team, and grow professionally, we'd love to meet you.</p> <p>We're a progressive, relationship-centered general practice with a long-standing reputation for compassionate care, comprehensive medicine, and genuine teamwork. Our veterinarians enjoy a modern, well-equipped facility, experienced support staff, a diverse medical and surgical caseload, and the flexibility to practice high-quality medicine while meeting clients where they are.</p> <p><strong>For new graduates, we offer a structured, hands-on mentorship program designed to build clinical confidence and independence. For experienced veterinarians, we offer clinical autonomy, opportunities to pursue professional interests, and potential leadership or partnership opportunities.</strong></p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong><u>What to Expect</u></strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>A schedule that respects your time.</strong> Enjoy a 4-day workweek, rotating half-day Saturdays, no on-call responsibilities, and no major holiday coverage. Our appointment-based schedule includes 30-minute doctor visits and a dedicated midday block for lunch, medical records, callbacks, procedures, and collaboration.</li> <li><strong>A team that makes your day easier.</strong> Our approximately 2:1 technician-to-doctor ratio, experienced support staff, and dedicated floater help keep appointments, treatments, and daily workflows moving smoothly. Technicians manage their own appointments and many routine callbacks, allowing our veterinarians to focus on medicine.</li> <li><strong>A modern, 6,000-square-foot hospital.</strong> Practice in a beautifully remodeled facility featuring six exam rooms, a spacious two-table surgical suite, separate canine and feline treatment areas, a dedicated isolation ward, and designated surgical recovery space.</li> <li><strong>Technology that supports excellent medicine.</strong> You'll have access to IDEXX in-house diagnostics, digital radiography, digital dental radiography, ultrasound, EKG, therapeutic laser, advanced anesthesia monitoring, electrocautery, and active surgical suction. We also utilize EzyVet, Weave, and ScribbleVet AI to simplify documentation and communication.</li> <li><strong>A diverse medical, surgical, and dental caseload.</strong> From wellness and internal medicine to dermatology, dentistry, ultrasound, and soft tissue surgery, you'll have opportunities to practice a broad range of medicine. Our team performs procedures including spays/neuters, mass removals, cystotomies, pyometras, foreign body surgeries, and more, with strong specialty and emergency referral relationships when needed.</li> <li><strong>Structured mentorship and hands-on clinical development.</strong> New graduates benefit from a personalized onboarding plan with extended appointment times, side-by-side clinical training, supervised surgical and dental experience, regular mentor meetings, and progressive milestones throughout their first year.</li> <li><strong>A genuinely collaborative culture.</strong> Our doctors share a workspace, discuss cases regularly, and participate in weekly DVM meetings. We encourage questions, value different perspectives, and believe learning opportunities should build confidence rather than create unnecessary pressure.</li> <li><strong>Benefits that support your life outside the hospital.</strong> Medical, dental, and vision insurance; 401(k); paid holidays; PTO; paid CE days and allowance; student loan repayment opportunities; pet discounts; uniform allowance; Employee Assistance Program (EAP); and coverage for professional dues, licensing fees, and AVMA-PLIT.</li> <li><strong>Opportunities for long-term growth and ownership.</strong> Through Veterinary Practice Partners (VPP), you'll have access to professional development, leadership resources, and potential practice partnership opportunities, supported by experienced operations, marketing, and finance teams.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong><u>Requirements</u></strong></p> <ul> <li>Doctor of Veterinary Medicine (DVM) or VMD degree from an accredited institution.</li> <li>Current Indiana veterinary license or eligibility to obtain licensure before starting.</li> <li><strong>New graduates, including the Class of 2027, are encouraged to apply!</strong></li> <li>Experienced veterinarians with a passion for small-animal general practice are equally welcome.</li> <li>A collaborative, compassionate approach to patient care and client communication.</li> <li>An interest in practicing high-quality medicine, continuing to learn, and contributing to a supportive team environment.</li> </ul> <p><strong>&nbsp;</strong></p> <p><strong><u>About 30th Street Animal Hospital</u></strong></p> <p>30th Street Animal Hospital is a well-established, progressive small-animal general practice that has proudly served the East Indianapolis and Lawrence communities for decades. With a 4.8-star reputation and a Neighborhood Clinic Choice Award, we've built lasting relationships with generations of pet owners who trust us with their companions.</p> <p>Our philosophy is simple: <strong>Provide gold-standard medical recommendations while recognizing that every pet and family has different needs.</strong> We believe in open communication, individualized treatment plans, and helping clients make informed decisions that balance medical recommendations with practical financial considerations.</p> <p>Our hospital combines the personal feel of a community veterinary practice with the equipment and resources of a modern medical facility. Our approximately 6,000-square-foot hospital features six exam rooms, a large surgical suite, separate canine and feline treatment areas, and dedicated spaces for diagnostics, isolation, and recovery.</p> <p><strong>Our medical capabilities include:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Preventive medicine, wellness care, and chronic disease management</li> <li>Internal medicine, dermatology, and endocrine disease management</li> <li>Comprehensive dentistry, including digital dental radiography and extractions</li> <li>Soft tissue surgery, including spays/neuters, mass removals, foreign body procedures, pyometras, and cystotomies</li> <li>Digital radiography, abdominal ultrasound, and in-house IDEXX diagnostics</li> <li>Therapeutic laser, EKG, and advanced anesthesia monitoring</li> <li>Visiting cardiology services for echocardiograms twice monthly</li> <li>Daytime urgent care and sick-patient management</li> </ul> <p>We maintain strong relationships with nearby emergency and specialty hospitals, including IndyVet and NOAHS, ensuring patients have access to additional care when needed.</p> <p>Our doctors typically see approximately 15 patients daily in 30-minute appointments, with a dedicated midday block from 12:00–2:00 PM for lunch, callbacks, charting, ultrasounds, minor procedures, and other clinical responsibilities. This structure creates opportunities for thoughtful medicine, case discussions, and continued learning throughout the day.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong><u>Culture, Team &amp; Fit</u></strong></p> <p><strong>What truly makes 30th Street Animal Hospital special isn't just our facility or equipment. It's the people who make up our team.</strong></p> <p>We're a close-knit, compassionate group that genuinely cares about our patients, our clients, and one another. We believe exceptional veterinary medicine starts with strong relationships, open communication, and a willingness to work together.</p> <p>Our doctors collaborate on cases, share ideas, and support each other's professional development. With daily team huddles, weekly doctor meetings, and regular all-staff discussions, communication and teamwork are part of our everyday culture.</p> <p>We also believe the little things matter. Our team follows up with clients after their pets' visits, sends thoughtful sympathy and support cards during difficult times, and works hard to make every client feel heard, respected, and cared for.</p> <p>We celebrate team accomplishments, recognize individual contributions, and make time for staff appreciation events and activities. Most importantly, we strive to create an environment where everyone feels comfortable asking questions, offering ideas, and learning from one another.</p> <p><strong>We're looking for someone who values teamwork, enjoys building lasting client relationships, and believes that great medicine and genuine compassion go hand in hand.</strong></p> <p>Whether you're a new graduate looking for guidance or an experienced veterinarian hoping to share your expertise while continuing to grow, you'll find a team that wants you to succeed.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong><u>Mentorship &amp; Growth</u></strong></p> <p><strong>For New Graduates: Real Mentorship, a Clear Plan, and a Team Invested in Your Success</strong></p> <p>Starting your veterinary career should be exciting, not overwhelming. At 30th Street Animal Hospital, we understand that developing clinical confidence takes time, experience, and the right support.</p> <p>That's why we've developed a <strong>structured, individualized first-year mentorship program</strong> designed to help new graduates transition into practice at a comfortable, progressive pace.</p> <p>You'll work alongside experienced veterinarians, including Dr. Sam Smith and Dr. Claudia Samland, who are committed to helping you strengthen your medical knowledge, develop surgical skills, and build confidence in your clinical decisions.</p> <p><strong>Your mentorship experience includes:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>A gradual introduction to appointments.</strong> Begin by shadowing experienced doctors and seeing straightforward wellness and sick-patient appointments. You'll start with extended appointment times, typically around 60 minutes, before gradually transitioning to 45- and 30-minute visits as your confidence and efficiency develop.</li> <li><strong>Hands-on medical mentorship.</strong> Work alongside experienced veterinarians to discuss cases, interpret diagnostics, formulate treatment plans, and strengthen your clinical decision-making skills.</li> <li><strong>Side-by-side surgical and dental training.</strong> Begin by observing and assisting with procedures before progressing to hands-on experience with direct supervision. Build confidence in spays, neuters, mass removals, dental procedures, and other surgeries based on your experience and interests.</li> <li><strong>Regular mentorship meetings and feedback.</strong> Participate in dedicated mentor check-ins, case reviews, and formal 30-, 60-, and 90-day progress evaluations to celebrate accomplishments, identify learning opportunities, and establish goals.</li> <li><strong>Progressive clinical independence.</strong> Gradually expand your appointment schedule, medical caseload, and procedural responsibilities with experienced doctors available to provide guidance and assistance.</li> <li><strong>Opportunities to develop advanced skills.</strong> Gain exposure to abdominal ultrasound, diagnostic imaging, cytology, dental extractions, anesthesia, and more as you continue building your clinical foundation.</li> <li><strong>Ongoing education and collaboration.</strong> Participate in weekly DVM case discussions, lunch-and-learns, continuing education opportunities, VPP Academy, and veterinary peer groups.</li> <li><strong>Support beyond your first 90 days.</strong> Mentorship continues throughout your first year, with ongoing clinical discussions, professional development opportunities, and a personalized growth plan.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Our goal isn't to rush you into independence. It's to give you the tools, experience, guidance, and confidence to become the veterinarian you want to be.</strong></p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong><u>For Experienced Veterinarians: Autonomy, Collaboration &amp; Career Growth</u></strong></p> <p>If you're an experienced DVM, we recognize the expertise and perspective you bring to the table.</p> <p>You'll have the opportunity to practice with clinical autonomy while working alongside colleagues who enjoy sharing ideas and discussing cases. Whether your interests are in surgery, dentistry, internal medicine, diagnostics, or another area of general practice, we want to support the work you enjoy most.</p> <p>Experienced veterinarians can also help shape hospital protocols, contribute to clinical discussions, mentor newer doctors if interested, and explore future leadership or partnership opportunities.</p> <p>Through VPP, you'll have access to additional professional development and leadership resources while remaining part of a hospital that values individualized medicine and local decision-making.</p> <p><strong>Whether you're beginning your career or looking for your next long-term professional home, we're committed to helping you grow on your own terms.</strong></p> <p><strong>&nbsp;</strong></p> <p><strong><u>Life in Indianapolis</u></strong></p> <p>Indianapolis offers a fantastic combination of big-city amenities, welcoming communities, and Midwestern affordability.</p> <p>From professional sports, concerts, restaurants, and festivals to the nationally recognized Children's Museum, Indianapolis Zoo, and Newfields arts campus, there's always something to explore.</p> <p>Outdoor enthusiasts can enjoy nearby parks, hiking, camping, and trails, while convenient access to Indianapolis International Airport makes weekend getaways and travel easy.</p> <p>With a variety of neighborhoods, housing options, schools, and entertainment, Indianapolis is a great place to build both your career and your life outside veterinary medicine.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong><u>Ready to Find Your Place at 30th Street Animal Hospital?</u></strong></p> <p>Whether you're a 2027 graduate looking for meaningful mentorship or an experienced veterinarian seeking clinical autonomy, professional growth, and a genuinely supportive team, we'd love to connect!</p> <p><strong>Apply today and discover what makes 30th Street Animal Hospital a great place to practice veterinary medicine.</strong></p> <p>&nbsp;</p> title: Data Engineer
description: <p>540 is looking for a Data Engineer to develop data transformation and workflow solutions supporting an impactful U.S. Army modernization initiative. You will help deploy and operate a cloud-based replacement for a legacy financial system while developing innovative, cloud-first solutions that strengthen the Army's data management ecosystem.</p> <p>In this role, you'll design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines and cloud-native data solutions, with a focus on data reliability, security, governance, and performance. You'll work with large, complex datasets, contribute to technical design decisions, and collaborate across engineering teams to transform business and mission requirements into working software.</p> <p><strong>Location</strong>: Remote within the continental United States, East Coast working hours with some flexibility afforded. Occasional travel may be required (3-4x annually)<br><strong>Citizenship &amp; Clearance Requirement</strong>: per client requirements, must be a U.S. Citizen with the ability to obtain a DoW Secret clearance<br><strong>Education Requirement: </strong>Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science or related engineering field (preferred)<br><strong>540 Internal Thrive Level: </strong>Data Engineer II</p> <p><strong>WHY 540?</strong></p> <p>540 is a forward-thinking company that the government turns to in order to #GetShitDone. We do more than talk about it, we break down barriers to innovation and build impactful tech. We’re looking for someone with big ideas, who thrives on innovation and is a self-starter. If you love to learn about and work with new technologies, we want to talk to you.</p> <p><strong>HOW YOU’LL DRIVE IMPACT</strong></p> <ul> <li>Design, build, maintain, and troubleshoot reliable data pipelines throughout the software development lifecycle, supporting the modernization of legacy U.S. Army financial systems and migration to AWS cloud environments</li> <li>Develop Python-based workflows to ingest, transform, validate, and deliver structured and semi-structured data</li> <li>Build and support cloud-native data solutions using AWS services such as Glue, Lambda, S3, and CloudWatch</li> <li>Integrate data from multiple systems and sources, including APIs and various file formats, while supporting data accuracy, consistency, and reliability</li> <li>Work with large datasets, identify performance bottlenecks, and help improve pipeline efficiency and scalability</li> <li>Participate in technical design discussions and contribute to decisions around data integration, storage, performance, and scalability</li> <li>Implement automated testing, logging, monitoring, and error handling to support data quality and reliable system performance</li> <li>Write clean, reusable, and maintainable code while following established software engineering and DataOps practices</li> <li>Collaborate with engineers, architects, and stakeholders to translate business and technical requirements into working software</li> <li>Support secure data management practices, including access controls, data governance, and compliance with DoW requirements</li> <li>Participate in code reviews and Agile development activities, sharing ideas and contributing to engineering improvements</li> <li>Document data transformations, pipeline processes, and technical decisions to support maintainability and downstream users</li> <li>Identify opportunities to improve existing workflows, reduce manual processes, and strengthen the reliability of the Army's data ecosystem</li> </ul> <p><strong>REQUIRED SKILLS &amp; EXPERIENCE</strong></p> <ul> <li>2+ years of related experience in data engineering, software development, data integration, or a closely related field</li> <li>Experience developing Python-based data transformations, scripts, or workflow automation</li> <li>Hands-on experience building, maintaining, or troubleshooting data pipelines and ETL/ELT processes</li> <li>Experience consuming data from APIs and working with file formats such as X12, JSON, flat files, or fixed-width files</li> <li>Experience working with AWS cloud services, particularly AWS Glue, AWS Lambda, Amazon S3, and CloudWatch Logs</li> <li>Familiarity with working with large datasets, including identifying and troubleshooting data processing or performance issues</li> <li>Understanding of data structures, data modeling concepts, and common approaches to organizing and transforming data</li> <li>Experience writing and maintaining automated tests using Pytest or similar testing frameworks</li> <li>Familiarity with data validation, error handling, logging, and debugging practices</li> <li>Understanding of data security, access controls, and data quality principles</li> <li>Experience using GitLab for version control and collaborative development</li> <li>Comfortable working through the terminal or command-line interface</li> <li>Experience using Jira and Confluence in an Agile development environment</li> <li>Ability to interpret ambiguous requirements, file specifications, and JSON structures to develop functional data solutions</li> <li>Strong problem-solving skills and ability to collaborate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders</li> <li>Must currently possess or have the ability to obtain an AWS Cloud Practitioner certification (or higher) within 30 days of hire</li> <li>Must currently possess or have the ability to obtain a CompTIA Security+ certification (or higher) within 30 days of hire</li> </ul> <p><strong>NICE TO HAVE</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience working with DoW systems, data, or other regulated environments</li> <li>Familiarity with X12/MILS processing</li> <li>Experience with decisions, schema design, or pipeline performance optimization</li> <li>Familiarity with database performance optimization, indexing, or partitioning strategies</li> <li>Experience with data lineage, title: Data Engineer
