title: Director, Contracts
description: <p><strong>About 14 Technology Holdings&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>14 Technology Holding’s (“14TH”) portfolio includes Data Analytics firms in multiple spaces and employs over 100 people. Our team of analysts, scientists, engineers, and strategists hail from diverse backgrounds yet share a passion for using data to solve the world’s greatest social and analytical challenges. Since our inception we’ve worked with more than 400 organizations ranging across the world. We service an ever-expanding portfolio of commercial clients in the automotive, travel, CPG, entertainment, healthcare, media, and telecom industries. Along the way, we’ve developed some of the most innovative tools available in analytics, media optimization, reporting, and influencer outreach.</p> <p><strong>About the team&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>The Operations and People team supports the staff of 14 Technology Holdings and its subsidiaries, their work, and their clients. The Ops and People Division includes People Operations: supporting recruitment, onboarding, and the employee experience; Financial Operations: executing payroll, book-keeping, and financial planning; Legal Operations: reviewing contracts, compliance, and insurance; and broader Operational Logistics support: facilities, travel, employee experience, and IT.</p> <p><strong>About the role:</strong></p> <p>The Director, Contracts will own the end-to-end management of contracts for 14TH and its portfolio companies. This role includes reviewing, drafting, and negotiating agreements with public and private sector clients, managing vendor contracts, NDAs, and statements of work, while collaborating with external legal counsel to ensure compliance and mitigate risk. The Director will also lead corporate compliance initiatives, oversee privacy policies, and streamline internal legal operations processes. The ideal candidate is highly organized, detail-oriented, and brings a critical, analytical approach to contracts and the contract management process.</p> <p><strong>In this position you will:</strong></p> <p><strong>Contracts &amp; Contract Management</strong></p> <ul> <li>Review, draft, and negotiate client contracts, vendor agreements, NDAs, SOWs, license agreements, and ad hoc agreements across business units.</li> <li>Ensure all agreements are reviewed for risk mitigation, compliance with state, national, and occasionally international regulations, and alignment with company objectives.</li> <li>Advise internal teams, including senior leadership, on contractual terms that may impact project execution, including intellectual property, staffing restrictions, non-compete clauses, and data governance.</li> <li>Oversee the entire contract lifecycle: generation, negotiation, execution, storage, and retrieval.</li> <li>Own the contract management system (LinkSquares), including system governance, data integrity, reporting, and ongoing optimization.</li> <li>Maintain organized contract records and implement processes to ensure efficiency, consistency, and accuracy.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Compliance &amp; Risk Mitigation</strong></p> <ul> <li>Support internal leadership with legal and compliance guidance across multiple disciplines, including government contracts, professional services, product agreements, and polling/vendor agreements.</li> <li>Collaborate with senior leadership to develop and implement frameworks for monitoring legal requirements and data privacy compliance across the organization.</li> <li>Oversee corporate privacy initiatives, including policy enforcement, risk assessments, stakeholder coordination, and consumer rights request processing.</li> <li>Manage corporate insurance portfolio, including renewals, claims, and vendor relationships.</li> <li>Build and implement operational policies, procedures, and best practices to enhance the efficiency, effectiveness, and quality of legal operations.</li> <li>Track metrics to identify opportunities for process improvement and optimization.</li> <li>Provide training to internal stakeholders on contract processes, legal terminology, and compliance obligations.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Collaboration &amp; Management</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own and manage day-to-day operations of contracts and legal operations functions.</li> <li>Collaborate cross-functionally with business teams to resolve contractual, operational, or compliance issues.</li> </ul> <p>Other tasks and duties as assigned and directed.</p> <p><strong>What we are seeking:</strong></p> <ul> <li>8+ years of progressive experience in contract review, drafting, and negotiation. Professional services experience is a plus.</li> <li>Proven experience managing contracts and legal operations in both public and private sector contexts.</li> <li>Strong understanding of legal terminology, compliance requirements, and risk management.</li> <li>Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate complex legal concepts for business audiences.</li> <li>Exceptional organizational skills and attention to detail, with ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.</li> <li>Experience collaborating with external counsel and internal stakeholders.</li> <li>Prior experience overseeing legal operations processes, compliance programs, or contract management systems preferred.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p><strong>What We Offer:</strong></p> <p>14TH offers a friendly work environment and competitive compensation and benefits package including:</p> <ul> <li>Salary: $140,000-$160,000</li> <li>Premier health, dental, and vision insurance plans</li> <li>401K matching</li> <li>Unlimited paid time off</li> <li>Paid personal and volunteer leave</li> <li>14 paid holidays + winter break</li> <li>15 weeks paid parental leave</li> <li>Professional development stipend &amp; tuition reimbursement</li> <li>Macbook Pro laptop &amp; tech accessories</li> <li>Bring Your Own Device (BYOD) stipend for mobile device</li> <li>Employee Assistance Program (EAP)</li> <li>Supportive &amp; collaborative culture&nbsp;</li> <li>Flexible working hours</li> <li>Remote friendly (within the U.S.)</li> <li>Pre-tax transportation options for commuting to our office in Washington, DC</li> <li>Lunches and snacks</li> <li>And more!&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p>The salary range for candidates who meet the minimum posted qualifications reflects the Company’s good faith understanding and belief as to the wage range, and is accurate as of the date of this job posting.</p> <p>At 14TH, we celebrate, support and thrive on differences. Not only do they benefit our services, products, and community, but most importantly, they are to the benefit of our team. Qualified people of all races, ethnicities, ages, sex, genders, sexual orientations, national origins, gender identities, marital status, religions, veterans statuses, disabilities and any other protected classes are strongly encouraged to apply. 14TH endeavors to make reasonable accommodations for qualified applicants with a disability unless the accommodation would impose an undue hardship on the operation of our business. If an applicant believes they require such assistance to complete the application or to participate in an interview, or has any questions or concerns, they should contact the Director, People Operations. 14TH participates in E-verify.&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Collection of Personal Information Notice:</strong></p> <p>As you are likely aware, by submitting your job application, you are submitting personal information to our company. We collect various categories of personal information, including identifiers, protected classifications, professional or employment related information and sensitive personal information. We may retain and use this information for up to three years, in order to come to a decision on whether or not you are a good fit for our company. We may also retain or use some of this information to comply with any requirements under law, or for purposes of defending ourselves in any litigation. We do not use this information for any other purpose, or share it with third parties, unless you become an employee. To learn more, or to see our full Notice to Job Applicants, please <a href="https://bluelabs.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/02/bl-notice-to-job-applicants.pdf">click here.</a></p>

title: Account Director, Corporate
description: <p class="font-claude-response-body break-words whitespace-normal"><strong>Account Director, Corporate</strong></p> <p class="font-claude-response-body break-words whitespace-normal">5W is seeking a dynamic Account Director to support our growing Corporate practice. This is a high-impact role for a seasoned agency professional who can hit the ground running.</p> <p class="font-claude-response-body break-words whitespace-normal">The ideal candidate brings agency experience with corporate clients — spanning financial services, technology, sustainability/ESG, and beyond — along with sharp media instincts, expert pitching skills, and superior account and time management. You'll thrive here if you're driven, entrepreneurial, and committed to exceeding expectations: at 5W, that's the recipe for success.</p> <p class="font-claude-response-body break-words whitespace-normal"><em>This is a hybrid role based in our Miami or Tampa office, with 3 days per week in office.</em></p> <p><strong>Here’s what you’ll be doing:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Act as primary contact to clients, continually fostering client-agency relationship to build trust and become a valuable resource and counselor to clients.</li> <li>Overseeing and implementing strategic communications programming</li> <li>Executive creative campaigns and brand partnerships</li> <li>Manage and delegate responsibilities of daily workflow of multiple accounts.</li> <li>Communicate account status to agency management regularly.</li> <li>Demonstrate proficiency in writing and editing materials particularly presentations, program plans and media strategies.</li> <li>Provide strategic guidance to clients and team members on an ongoing basis; anticipate and address clients’ needs.</li> <li>Troubleshoot media, team, or strategy problems as they arise; seek senior management input when appropriate.</li> <li>Motivate team members by promptly reviewing work and providing constructive feedback.</li> <li>Strive to develop the best communication and presentation skills possible to effectively articulate ideas to clients, colleagues and others.</li> <li>Conduct and lead monthly conference calls and meetings with clients</li> <li>Provide guidance and leadership to team members on effective pitching, team issues, account workflow and general account issues.</li> <li>Participate in the development of materials for new business opportunities including timelines, proposals, business decks and case studies; assist in generating new business leads.</li> <li>Participate in brainstorming sessions to develop strategic/creative thinking for clients.</li> <li>Misc. research, duties and projects as required.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Here’s what you have:</strong></p> <ul> <li>S/B.A in Public Relations or related field</li> <li>At least 6 years of PR agency experience, specifically working with corporate clients</li> <li>Excellent written, verbal and interpersonal skills</li> <li>Strong leadership and motivation skills</li> <li>Proven client relations, management and supervisory skills</li> <li>Creative and energetic personality</li> </ul> <p><strong>Why you'll love working here:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Competitive salary with comprehensive benefits &amp; wellness programs including partnership with ClassPass!</li> <li>Flexible PTO</li> <li>Summer Fridays and Winter, Spring, and Fall Fridays too!</li> <li>Hybrid work model offering flexibility and work-life balance</li> <li>Expanded parental leave and family planning support</li> <li>Continuous learning through “5W University” and development initiatives</li> <li>Student Loan Reimbursement</li> <li>Professional Development Support</li> <li>Exclusive access to season tickets for pro sports teams along with Broadway shows, and more!</li> <li>Charitable giving, including matching donations</li> </ul> <p>#LI-Hybrid</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>&nbsp;</p>

title: Human Resources Coordinator (Temp-to-Perm)
description: <p><strong>Human Resources Associate (temp to perm)</strong></p> <p><em><strong>This is a part-time Human Resources Associate position. The role is designed as a part-time opportunity, and the title of Human Resources Coordinator would apply only if the position transitions to a full-time role in the future. While there may be an opportunity to convert to full-time, this is not guaranteed.</strong></em></p> <p><strong><em>Compensation: </em></strong><em>$20–$25 per hour, depending on experience.</em><strong><em><br>Location:</em></strong><em> Hybrid. This role is based in our Tampa or Miami office, with three days per week on-site.</em></p> <p>5W Public Relations is looking to add a dynamic professional to join our growing People and Talent Acquisition team.</p> <p>Day-to-day tasks include critical support work, such as scheduling candidates, answering employee inquiries, all while providing excellent customer service to our employees and leaders. Additionally, you will have the opportunity to support teammates on assorted people-related projects.po</p> <p>We’re looking for a passionate individual, ready to hit the ground running! A true administrative partner to the business in a fast-paced, ever-changing, and growing environment.</p> <p><strong>Here’s what you’ll be doing:</strong></p> <p><strong>Recruiting:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Support recruitment team by scheduling candidate phone screens and interviews through our ATS system, Greenhouse.</li> <li>Create a seamless experience for our candidates and hiring managers</li> <li>Liaise with business to collect feedback and identify next steps for candidates</li> <li>Maintain and track candidate pipelines in a web-based applicant tracking system, Greenhouse</li> <li>Work with talent team to post position ads to various websites</li> <li>Assist with pre and post-employment requirements</li> <li>Additional projects as needed</li> </ul> <p><strong>People Operations:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Maintain accurate and up-to-date employee filing systems and ensure changes are entered appropriately in HRIS system</li> <li>Provide timely and accurate administrative assistance to the team when necessary including, but not limited to, expense reports, tracker updates, and internal communications</li> <li>Provide periodic information throughout the year to employees on relevant updates</li> <li>Support the People Operations team on ongoing projects</li> <li>Assist with onboarding and offboarding processes, including communications, HR documentation, employee records, surveys, and HRIS updates</li> <li>HR Recurring Processes - Provide support to HR team on Performance Management, Benefits Administration, employment verifications (including I-9s), Interns/Mentorship programs, Learning &amp; Development, Diversity &amp; Inclusion initiatives and more as necessary</li> </ul> <p><strong>Here’s what you have:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Prior internship or full-time experience in a professional environment; experience in Human Resources, Recruiting, or People Operations preferred.</li> <li>Strong written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills.</li> <li>Highly organized and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.</li> <li>Ability to work independently while also collaborating effectively as part of a team.</li> <li>Sound judgment and discretion when handling sensitive and confidential information.</li> <li>Proficiency with Microsoft Office and Outlook; experience with HRIS/ATS platforms such as HiBob and Greenhouse is a plus.</li> <li>Experience with NetSuite or similar expense management systems is a plus.</li> <li>Intellectual curiosity and a willingness to learn, ask questions, and continuously improve processes.</li> <li>Comfortable using AI and emerging technology as tools to work efficiently, problem-solve, and support day-to-day responsibilities.</li> <li>Proactive, adaptable, and eager to take ownership of new tasks and responsibilities.</li> </ul> <p>#LI-Hybrid</p> <p>&nbsp;</p>

title: New Business Manager
description: <p></p> <p><strong>New Business Manager (PR Agency)</strong><br><em>Tampa or Miami, FL · Hybrid (3 days in office)</em></p> <p>We’re a fast-growing PR agency, and more new business opportunities are coming our way than ever before. We need someone to keep that growth organized. As our New Business Manager, you’ll make sure no pitch, proposal or deadline falls through the cracks. You’ll run the system behind every new client win: tracking outreach, keeping proposals on schedule and getting our executives ready for every first conversation.</p> <p>This role is ideal for someone with a mix of executive assistant and project management experience: someone who is comfortable supporting senior leaders and who also likes owning a process, managing timelines and keeping a team on track. You’ll work directly with agency leadership and play a central part in how we grow.</p> <p><strong>What you’ll do</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own the new business process from first outreach through proposal submission, including the tracking system, templates and handoffs, and improve it as our pitch volume grows</li> <li>Track every outreach email: who sent it, who received it, when it went out, whether there was a reply, and make sure every follow-up happens</li> <li>Keep a single up-to-date tracker of every proposal and RFP, showing what’s due, when it’s due and who owns it, and assign owners where needed</li> <li>Confirm that every proposal is submitted on time and received, and flag or escalate anything at risk of slipping</li> <li>Schedule first calls with prospective clients by coordinating calendars on both sides, and brief our executives beforehand with the background they need</li> <li>Send leadership a weekly report on what went out, what’s due, what’s waiting on a response, and where deadlines or capacity are at risk</li> <li>Keep contacts, proposal versions and call notes organized so anyone on the team can find what they need</li> </ul> <p><strong>What we’re looking for</strong></p> <ul> <li>4+ years of experience combining executive support and project management, such as an executive assistant who has managed projects, or a project coordinator or manager who has supported senior leaders. New business, proposal or agency experience is a strong plus</li> <li>Experience building or running a tracking process that leaders relied on</li> <li>Strong organization and follow-through. You set priorities across competing deadlines without waiting to be asked</li> <li>Polished, confident written communication with senior executives and prospective clients</li> <li>Experience scheduling across multiple executive calendars</li> <li>Comfortable with spreadsheets or a CRM, plus Outlook or Google Workspace</li> <li>Discretion with confidential client and business information</li> </ul> <p><strong>Details</strong></p> <ul> <li>Full-time, temp-to-perm: a 60-day initial period with the intent to convert to a permanent role</li> <li>Hybrid: Tampa or Miami, FL, 3 days a week in office</li> <li>Start date: As soon as possible. We’re ready to move quickly for the right person</li> </ul><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p></p> <p><em>Where an employee or prospective employee is paid within this range will depend on, among other factors, actual ranges for current/former employees in the subject position; market considerations; budgetary considerations; tenure and standing with the company (applicable to current employees); as well as the employee’s/applicant’s background, pertinent experience, and qualifications</em></p> <p></p></div><div class="title">Florida Salary Range</div><div class="pay-range"><span>$80,000</span><span class="divider">&mdash;</span><span>$90,000 USD</span></div></div></div>

title: Proposal Strategist, Creative Strategy
description: <p><strong>Proposal Strategist, Creative Strategy</strong></p> <p><strong>Overview:</strong><br>We’re seeking a detail-oriented, strategic <strong>proposal and program strategist</strong> to support our Creative Strategy team across PR, digital, and omnichannel opportunities. This is an<strong> executional role</strong> focused on translating team thinking into polished proposals and timelines—an ideal fit for someone who understands the building blocks of integrated communications programs, and has a knack for tightening copy, organizing decks, and managing deliverable timelines under deadlines.</p> <p>We’re looking for someone who can bring clarity, logic, and structure to the proposal process—supporting big ideas without needing to concept them from scratch. The ideal candidate would have experience across multiple verticals, from Corporate &amp; Tech (B2B Tech, B2C Tech, Corporate Communications, Crisis) to Consumer Lifestyle, Beauty, Health &amp; Wellness, CPG and beyond as this will be a hybrid role supporting our Corporate and Consumer divisions.</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Write, edit, and organize proposals, new business decks, case studies, and capabilities decks and PR and digital clients across a range of sectors.</li> <li>Collaborate with account and digital teams to bring proposals to life from outline to final format.</li> <li>Maintain ownership of timelines and project milestones during proposal development.</li> <li>Refine and rewrite copy to match client tone, business objectives, and pitch goals.</li> <li>Translate strategy and tactics into clear, compelling slides and supporting copy.</li> <li>Monitor proposal performance (win/loss), and help update proposal templates, capabilities decks, and case studies.</li> <li>Ensure digital asset drives are kept up-to-date and organized.</li> <li>Research relevant trends, competitors, or category benchmarks to support proposals when needed.</li> <li>Ensure proposals are buttoned-up, grammatically sound, visually organized, and on deadline.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Qualifications:</strong></p> <ul> <li>3-5 years of experience in public relations, creative strategy, marketing, or digital communications; exposure to agency new business or strategy teams is a plus.</li> <li>Strong writing, editing, and deck-building skills.</li> <li>Understanding of PR and digital tactics, including influencer marketing, social campaigns, and integrated brand strategy.</li> <li>Experience collaborating cross-functionally and juggling multiple deadlines.</li> <li>Comfort with project management tools or practices (e.g., Slack, Monday, etc.)</li> <li>Proficiency in deck building, AI, and research platforms like Google Slides, Claude/ChatGPT, Resonate, Profound, etc.</li> <li>Highly organized, deadline-driven, and detail-obsessed.</li> </ul> <p><strong>This Role Is For You If You:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Can take a messy brainstorm and turn it into a polished proposal.</li> <li>Enjoy being the “glue” that connects teams and keeps work on track.</li> <li>Want exposure to a range of industries and programs in both PR and digital marketing.</li> <li>Love refining copy and building decks that communicate strategy clearly.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Why you'll love working here:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Competitive salary with comprehensive benefits &amp; wellness programs including partnership with ClassPass!</li> <li>Flexible PTO</li> <li>Summer Fridays and Winter, Spring, and Fall Fridays too!</li> <li>Hybrid work model offering flexibility and work-life balance</li> <li>Expanded parental leave and family planning support</li> <li>Continuous learning through "5W University" and development initiatives</li> <li>Student Loan Reimbursement</li> <li>Professional Development Support</li> <li>Exclusive access to season tickets for pro sports teams along with Broadway shows, and more!</li> <li>Charitable giving, including matching donations</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>#LI-Hybrid</p> <p>&nbsp;</p>

The ideal candidate would have experience across multiple verticals, from Corporate &amp; Tech (B2B Tech, B2C Tech, Corporate Communications, Crisis) to Consumer Lifestyle, Beauty, Health &amp; Wellness, CPG and beyond as this will be a hybrid role supporting our Corporate and Consumer divisions.</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Write, edit, and organize proposals, new business decks, case studies, and capabilities decks and PR and digital clients across a range of sectors.</li> <li>Collaborate with account and digital teams to bring proposals to life from outline to final format.</li> <li>Maintain ownership of timelines and project milestones during proposal development.</li> <li>Refine and rewrite copy to match client tone, business objectives, and pitch goals.</li> <li>Translate strategy and tactics into clear, compelling slides and supporting copy.</li> <li>Monitor proposal performance (win/loss), and help update proposal templates, capabilities decks, and case studies.</li> <li>Ensure digital asset drives are kept up-to-date and organized.</li> <li>Research relevant trends, competitors, or category benchmarks to support proposals when needed.</li> <li>Ensure proposals are buttoned-up, grammatically sound, visually organized, and on deadline.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Qualifications:</strong></p> <ul> <li>3-5 years of experience in public relations, creative strategy, marketing, or digital communications; exposure to agency new business or strategy teams is a plus.</li> <li>Strong writing, editing, and deck-building skills.</li> <li>Understanding of PR and digital tactics, including influencer marketing, social campaigns, and integrated brand strategy.</li> <li>Experience collaborating cross-functionally and juggling multiple deadlines.</li> <li>Comfort with project management tools or practices (e.g., Slack, Monday, etc.)</li> <li>Proficiency in deck building, AI, and research platforms like Google Slides, Claude/ChatGPT, Resonate, Profound, etc.</li> <li>Highly organized, deadline-driven, and detail-obsessed.</li> </ul> <p><strong>This Role Is For You If You:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Can take a messy brainstorm and turn it into a polished proposal.</li> <li>Enjoy being the “glue” that connects teams and keeps work on track.</li> <li>Want exposure to a range of industries and programs in both PR and digital marketing.</li> <li>Love refining copy and building decks that communicate strategy clearly.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Why you'll love working here:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Competitive salary with comprehensive benefits &amp; title: Sr. Salesforce Developer - Canada
description: <h3><strong>Senior Salesforce Developer</strong></h3> <h3>Who We Are&nbsp;</h3> <p>At Orion Global Solutions, we’re not your typical tech consultancy. As a Salesforce Summit Partner (the highest tier!) and one of the fastest-growing Salesforce partners in the New York Metro area, we bring innovation, speed, and genuine collaboration to every client interaction. But what truly sets us apart?&nbsp;&nbsp;</p> <p>We’re a fast-growing, people-first U.S. company that believes in building thoughtful, user-friendly systems to support our employees and customers. As we expand, we’re looking for talented&nbsp;<strong>Sr. Salesforce Developers</strong>&nbsp;in Canada, who bring both technical know-how and strong collaboration skills.&nbsp;</p> <p>We are committed to a&nbsp;remote-first culture&nbsp;that enables you to thrive in your role—no need to relocate.&nbsp;</p> <h3>The Role&nbsp;</h3> <p>As a <strong>Senior Salesforce Developer</strong>, you’ll help design, build, and maintain Salesforce solutions that support our internal teams and business growth. You'll collaborate with cross-functional teams, contribute to scalable architecture, and be part of a company where your impact is visible and valued.&nbsp;</p> <h3>What&nbsp;You’ll&nbsp;Be Doing&nbsp;</h3> <ul> <li>Customize and configure Salesforce using Apex, Lightning Web Components, and declarative tools.&nbsp;</li> <li>Translate business needs into technical solutions within Sales Cloud and Service Cloud.&nbsp;</li> <li>Integrate Salesforce with third-party tools and internal systems (APIs, middleware, etc.).&nbsp;</li> <li>Maintain clean, scalable code and contribute to peer reviews and architecture discussions.&nbsp;</li> <li>Participate in Agile sprints, support QA/UAT testing, and help drive technical best practices.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <h3>What You Bring&nbsp;</h3> <ul> <li>5+ years of Salesforce development experience&nbsp;</li> <li>Strong proficiency in Apex, SOQL, and Lightning Web Components (LWC)&nbsp;</li> <li>Familiarity with declarative tools like Flow, Process Builder, and Validation Rules</li> <li>Experience with integrations (REST/SOAP APIs, middleware like MuleSoft or similar)</li> <li>Solid understanding of Salesforce security, deployment, and version control tools (Gearset, Copado, etc.)</li> <li>Salesforce certifications (Platform Developer I/II, Admin, App Builder, etc.)</li> <li>Previous experience working with U.S. teams or companies&nbsp;</li> <li>Good written and spoken English (B2+ level or higher)</li> <li>Reliable home office setup with a stable internet connection&nbsp;</li> <li>Eligible to work in the U.S.</li> <li><strong>Required to have a Canadian passport or a valid US visitor visa to enter the US and attend meetings.</strong></li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h3>Why&nbsp;You’ll&nbsp;Love Working Here&nbsp;</h3> <p>We take care of our people. Our benefits are designed to help you live well—inside and outside of work:&nbsp;</p> <ul> <li>Competitive health coverage (medical, dental, vision)&nbsp;</li> <li>Generous paid time off&nbsp;</li> <li>Wellness programs and work-life flexibility&nbsp;</li> <li>Community involvement + volunteer opportunities</li> <li>Employee recognition and career development support</li> <li>A vibrant, supportive culture where we work hard, learn constantly, and celebrate often&nbsp;</li> </ul> <h3>Let’s Make an Impact Together</h3> <p>If you're passionate about delivering exceptional client experiences, leading dynamic teams, and being part of a company that values innovation and heart—you’ll feel right at home at Orion.</p> <p>Ready to grow with us? <strong>Apply now. Let’s build something great together.</strong></p>

Experience can be from any public cloud.</li> <li>1+ years implementing and supporting Microsoft Azure infrastructure and topologies (or demonstrated experience form with AWS or GCP)</li> <li>Understanding of cloud ecosystem and leading-edge cloud emerging technologies.</li> <li>Performance analysis, troubleshooting and remediation techniques.</li> <li>Strong analytical problem-solving ability.</li> <li>Strong presentation, written and verbal communication skills.</li> <li>Self-starter with the ability to work independently or as part of a virtual project team.</li> <li>Microsoft Certification a plus.</li> </ul> <p><strong><span class="TextRun SCXO74738315 BCX0" lang="EN-US" data-contrast="auto"><span class="NormalTextRun SCXO74738315 BCX0">This Job Posting will expire on Monday, November 16th, 2026.</span></span><span class="EOP SCXO74738315 BCX0">&nbsp;</span></strong></p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><hr> <p><strong>3Cloud Total Rewards Highlights Include:</strong> &nbsp;</p> <ul> <li>Flexible work location with a virtual first approach to work! </li> <li>401(K) with match up to 50% of your 6% contributions of eligible pay </li> <li>Generous PTO providing a minimum of 15 days in addition to 9 paid company holidays and 2 floating personal days &nbsp;</li> <li>Two medical plan options to allow you the choice to elect what works best for you!</li> <li>Option for vision and dental coverage </li> <li>100% employer paid coverage for life and disability insurance</li> <li>Paid leave for birth parents and non-birth parents </li> <li>Option for Healthcare FSA, HSA, and Dependent Care FSA</li> <li>$67.00 monthly tech and home office allowance</li> <li>Utilization and/or discretionary bonus eligibility based on role </li> <li>Employee Assistance Program to help with everyday challenges</li> </ul> <p>3Cloud offers competitive compensation. In addition to base pay employees are eligible to receive an annual discretionary/utilization bonus. title: Database Administrator - Cloud Platform / Infrastructure
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>Are you looking for a role that motivates and challenges you? Are you ready for an opportunity for growth? Do you want to work on teams where people roll up their sleeves to take on tough problems together, and regularly blow the doors off our clients with their outstanding teamwork? If you answered yes to those questions, 3Cloud might just be for you!</p> <p>At 3Cloud, we hire people who aren’t afraid to experiment or fail. We hire people who are willing to give direct and candid feedback to their managers, leaders, and team members. We hire people who jump at those opportunities because they care about our collective growth and success. We hire people who challenge and hold each other accountable for living 3Cloud’s core values because they know that it will result in amazing experiences and solutions for our clients and each other.</p></div><p>3Cloud is looking for an experienced Database Administrator who is comfortable managing multiple deadlines and varied customer requests. A strong OS background is preferred due to the many migration assessments and implementations required by the position. Experience with Azure is a must, along with flexible and creative analytical skills to fit the solution to the customer needs.</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li>Work as a DBA for multiple customers, helping with Database Migrations, High Availability and Disaster Recovery solutions, SQL and Windows Clustering solutions, Monitoring, Backup/Recovery solutions, and Performance title: Senior Director - Cloud Security
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>Are you looking for a role that motivates and challenges you? Are you ready for an opportunity for growth? Do you want to work on teams where people roll up their sleeves to take on tough problems together, and regularly blow the doors off our clients with their outstanding teamwork? If you answered yes to those questions, 3Cloud might just be for you!</p> <p>At 3Cloud, we hire people who aren’t afraid to experiment or fail. We hire people who are willing to give direct and candid feedback to their managers, leaders, and team members. We hire people who jump at those opportunities because they care about our collective growth and success. We hire people who challenge and hold each other accountable for living 3Cloud’s core values because they know that it will result in amazing experiences and solutions for our clients and each other.</p></div><p><strong>Senior Director - Cloud Security</strong></p> <p>The Senior Director, Cloud Security will lead the growth, development, and delivery of 3Cloud’s cloud security capabilities. This leader will be responsible for building a differentiated portfolio of Microsoft Azure infrastructure, cloud foundation, platform engineering, identity, networking, resiliency, and security services that enable enterprise cloud, data, application, and AI transformation.</p> <p>The Senior Director will operate as both a market-facing practice leader and a senior client advisor. The role will work closely with 3Cloud sales and service-line leaders, Microsoft, and Cognizant account and delivery teams to identify demand, shape opportunities, develop solutions, and convert pipeline into bookings and revenue.</p> <p>This individual will be accountable for capability strategy, go-to-market execution, solution quality, delivery oversight, talent development, financial performance, and cross-service-line pull-through. The successful candidate will combine strong commercial instincts, executive consulting presence, Microsoft Azure expertise, and the ability to build and scale a high-performing team. This role reports to the 3Cloud CTI (Cloud Technology Insights) leader.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities</strong></p> <p><strong>Growth and Market Development</strong></p> <p>· Define and execute the growth strategy for the Cloud Security practice.</p> <p>· Build a qualified pipeline that supports bookings, revenue, margin, and pull-through objectives.</p> <p>· Develop trusted relationships with Microsoft, Cognizant, strategic clients, and executive stakeholders.</p> <p>· Lead executive discussions with CIOs, CISOs, CTOs, and infrastructure leaders on cloud security strategy and transformation.</p> <p>· Position Cloud Security as a foundational capability supporting enterprise cloud, AI, data, and application modernization initiatives.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Offering and Solution Leadership</strong></p> <p>· Develop and evolve a portfolio of repeatable Cloud Security offerings, methodologies, accelerators, and reference architectures.</p> <p>· Lead complex solutioning efforts, including discovery, architecture, estimation, proposals, pricing, and executive presentations.</p> <p>· Ensure solutions are technically sound, commercially viable, appropriately governed, and aligned with client outcomes.</p> <p>· Translate Microsoft roadmap investments, emerging technologies, and market trends into new services and growth opportunities.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Delivery and Client Success</strong></p> <p>· Provide executive oversight for strategic and high-risk engagements.</p> <p>· Establish standards for architecture governance, delivery quality, security, resiliency, compliance, and operational readiness.</p> <p>· Partner with delivery leadership to ensure projects achieve client outcomes, financial objectives, and contractual commitments.</p> <p>· Capture reusable delivery assets, reference architectures, and client success stories that improve future engagements.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Practice and Talent Leadership</strong></p> <p>· Build, develop, and lead a high-performing team of architects, consultants, engineers, and technical leaders.</p> <p>· Define organizational structure, competencies, career paths, and succession plans.</p> <p>· Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, technical excellence, and client-centric consulting.</p> <p>· Partner across all 3Cloud service lines to deliver integrated client solutions and eliminate siloed capabilities.</p> <p>· Balance onshore, offshore, partner, and managed delivery capacity to support scalable growth.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Financial and Operational Accountability</strong></p> <p>· Own pipeline, bookings, revenue, gross margin, utilization, and capability performance.</p> <p>· Develop annual operating plans, investment priorities, hiring strategies, and capacity forecasts.</p> <p>· Monitor business performance, market demand, offering profitability, and delivery health.</p> <p>· Provide executive reporting and strategic recommendations to senior leadership.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Requirements</strong></p> <p>· 15+ years of experience in cloud infrastructure, cybersecurity, consulting, systems integration, or related fields.</p> <p>· 8+ years in formal, progressive leadership roles in consulting, architecture, engineering, or professional services organizations.</p> <p>· Demonstrated success building or scaling cloud security, infrastructure, or platform engineering capabilities.</p> <p>· Deep expertise in Microsoft Azure, cloud security, identity, networking, governance, automation, and platform operations.</p> <p>· Experience leading enterprise cloud transformation, migration, or modernization programs.</p> <p>· Proven success developing and selling consulting services while owning or influencing pipeline, bookings, and revenue.</p> <p>· Strong executive communication and client advisory skills.</p> <p>· Experience leading multidisciplinary consulting teams within a matrixed organization.</p> <p>· Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience.</p> <p>· Travel up to 50%.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Preferred Qualifications</strong></p> <p>· Experience working within the Microsoft partner ecosystem.</p> <p>· Experience partnering with a global systems integrator or large enterprise account organization.</p> <p>· Knowledge of Microsoft security capabilities, including Entra, Defender, Sentinel, Purview, and Azure Policy.</p> <p>· Familiarity with Kubernetes, Azure Arc, infrastructure as code, DevSecOps, and platform engineering.</p> <p>· Relevant Microsoft, cloud architecture, or cybersecurity certifications.</p> <p>· Experience developing managed cloud, security, or platform operations services.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>Don’t meet every single requirement? At 3Cloud we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway.</p> <p>At this time, we cannot sponsor applicants for work visas.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>This Job Posting will expire on <span class="TextRun SCXO74738315 BCX0" lang="EN-US" data-contrast="auto"><span class="NormalTextRun SCXO74738315 BCX0"><span class="EOP SCXO74738315 BCX0">Monday, November 16th, 2026.</span></span></span></strong></p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><hr> <p><strong>3Cloud Total Rewards Highlights Include:</strong> &nbsp;</p> <ul> <li>Flexible work location with a virtual first approach to work! </li> <li>401(K) with match up to 50% of your 6% contributions of eligible pay </li> <li>Generous PTO providing a minimum of 15 days in addition to 9 paid company holidays and 2 floating personal days &nbsp;</li> <li>Two medical plan options to allow you the choice to elect what works best for you!</li> <li>Option for vision and dental coverage </li> <li>100% employer paid coverage for life and disability insurance</li> <li>Paid leave for birth parents and non-birth parents </li> <li>Option for Healthcare FSA, HSA, and Dependent Care FSA</li> <li>$67.00 monthly tech and home office allowance</li> <li>Utilization and/or discretionary bonus eligibility based on role </li> <li>Employee Assistance Program to help with everyday challenges</li> </ul> <p>3Cloud offers competitive compensation. In addition to base pay employees are eligible to receive an annual discretionary/utilization bonus. If you are hired at 3Cloud your final base salary is based on factors such as skills, education, experience and/or geographic location. Please keep in mind that the range mentioned above includes the full base salary range for the role. It is not typical for offers to be made at or near the top of the range.</p></div><div class="title">Base Salary Range</div><div class="pay-range"><span>$183,400</span><span class="divider">&mdash;</span><span>$229,300 USD</span></div></div></div><div class="content-conclusion"><p>Don’t meet every single requirement?&nbsp;At 3Cloud we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway.</p> <p><strong>At this time, we cannot sponsor applicants for work visas.</strong></p></div>

description: <div class="content-intro"><p>Are you looking for a role that motivates and challenges you? Are you ready for an opportunity for growth? You define and lead architecture strategy and delivery frameworks across multiple technology domains, shaping modernization roadmaps and large-scale transformation initiatives. Your focus is on driving delivery excellence at enterprise scale while guiding modernization strategy, engaging executive stakeholders, and fostering collaboration across App Innovation, Cloud Platform, and Data &amp; AI practices. You lead through influence, connecting business outcomes with technology strategy to deliver measurable transformation success.</p> <p>This role represents the pinnacle of architectural leadership, balancing technical mastery, cross-domain integration, and business alignment to accelerate modernization outcomes for clients and partners.</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities</strong><br>• Define and lead enterprise-level architecture strategies and delivery frameworks that align modernization programs to business and technology outcomes.&nbsp;<br>• Shape cross-domain modernization roadmaps, integrating App Innovation, Cloud Platform, and Data &amp; AI strategies into cohesive delivery models.&nbsp;<br>• Mentor senior architects and technical leaders to strengthen design quality, reusability, and scalability across complex delivery environments.&nbsp;<br>• Drive cross-practice collaboration by developing reusable assets, frameworks, and patterns that enable consistency across programs and industries.&nbsp;<br>• Partner with executive stakeholders to align modernization investments with measurable business outcomes and enterprise transformation goals.&nbsp;<br>• Represent translating innovation into scalable frameworks that enhance delivery maturity and client value.&nbsp;<br>• Contribute to presales and solution strategy, collaborating with business development and delivery teams on high-value proposals and modernization initiatives.&nbsp;<br>• Champion mentorship and capability growth within architecture and delivery teams to ensure sustainable, high-quality execution.&nbsp;<br>• Balance strategic impact and delivery execution, managing commitments to achieve both client success and organizational growth.</p> <p><strong>Requirements</strong><br>• Proven experience leading enterprise-scale architecture strategy and delivery programs across large portfolios or transformation initiatives.<br>• Demonstrated ability to define and guide modernization Skilled at mentoring senior architects and technical leaders to elevate delivery quality, solution consistency, and reusability.<br>• Strong background shaping long-term modernization roadmaps, capability frameworks, and investment strategies that align to business outcomes.<br>• Deep expertise in Azure architecture with a strong understanding of enterprise-scale cloud adoption, governance, and integration models.<br>• Azure Solutions Architect Expert certification (or equivalent).<br>• Experience working with hybrid or multi-cloud environments and enterprise modernization programs.<br>• Excellent communication skills, with the ability to translate complex architecture concepts into clear business impact.<br>• Willingness to travel up to 25% for client engagements as need</p> <p><strong>Expertise</strong><br>At this level, architects demonstrate fluency across multiple technology domains while maintaining deep expertise in at least one. Candidates should bring significant experience defining and leading modernization strategies that span application, cloud, and data ecosystems.</p> <p><strong>Application Innovation</strong><br>• Lead modernization of complex enterprise application portfolios across .NET, Java, Node.js, and Python.&nbsp;<br>• Define and oversee modernization roadmaps that align business objectives with scalable application architectures.&nbsp;<br>• Design and guide event-driven, API-first, and microservices-based systems that support enterprise agility.&nbsp;<br>• Shape DevOps adoption strategies, CI/CD governance, and container platforms such as Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) and Azure Container Apps.&nbsp;<br>• Influence development best practices across delivery teams to ensure quality, reusability, and maintainability at scale.&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Cloud Platform</strong><br>• Define and govern enterprise-scale landing zones, hybrid architectures, and multi-cloud strategies.&nbsp;<br>• Lead cloud platform strategy, governance, and operational frameworks for security, compliance, and cost optimization.&nbsp;<br>• Drive adoption of Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Bicep, ARM templates) and automation for consistent, scalable delivery.&nbsp;<br>• Integrate identity, networking, and platform operations into cohesive delivery models that enable modernization across domains.&nbsp;<br>• Shape platform engineering standards that support modernization programs and enterprise transformation.&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Data &amp; AI</strong><br>• Define enterprise data and AI strategies that enable advanced analytics and business insight at scale.&nbsp;<br>• Architect modern data platforms using Azure Synapse, Databricks, Data Lake, and related technologies.&nbsp;<br>• Guide the integration of AI and machine learning into modernization programs using Azure Machine Learning and Cognitive Services.&nbsp;<br>• Establish data governance, integration, and quality frameworks that ensure consistency across complex enterprise data ecosystems.&nbsp;<br>• Enable decision intelligence through scalable, reusable data architectures aligned to enterprise transformation goals</p> <p><strong>Certification Requirements</strong><br><strong>Core Requirement:</strong><br>• AZ-900: Microsoft Certified: Azure Fundamentals<br>• AZ-104: Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate<br>• AZ-305: Solutions Architect Expert<br>• AI-102: Azure AI Engineer Associate<br>• SC-900: Security, Compliance, and Identity Fundamentals</p> <p>Don’t meet every single requirement? title: Senior Manager, Corporate FP&A
description: <p class="p1">At 2U, we are all in on purpose. We are motivated by our mission – to make learning limitless– and connected by our shared passion to deliver world-class higher education at scale. As the parent company of edX, a leading online learning platform, 2U powers thousands of &nbsp;higher education offerings – from free courses to full degrees. Together with our college, university, and corporate partners, we are helping accelerate careers and transform lives.&nbsp;</p> <p class="p2"><strong>What We’re Looking For:</strong></p> <p>The Finance team at 2U provides strategic financial leadership and analytical support to stakeholders across the organization. We support decision-making and operational effectiveness through financial planning, analysis, and cross-functional collaboration, all in service of 2U’s mission to expand access to high-quality education.</p> <p>As a Senior Manager, FP&amp;A, you will serve as 2U’s lead Workday Adaptive Planning superuser and financial model builder, owning the backend planning infrastructure that powers our corporate forecasting. In this role, you will play a critical, hands-on role supporting high-impact initiatives across the business—building dynamic three-statement models, evaluating new initiatives, supporting business case development, driving financial modeling, and surfacing insights that inform company-wide decisions. You’ll work closely with Finance leadership and cross-functional teams to drive clarity around priorities, risks, and opportunities.</p> <p>This is an ideal role for a highly analytical and proactive individual with strong business acumen and a desire to work in a mission-driven and fast-paced environment.</p> <p class="p2"><strong>Responsibilities Include, But Are Not Limited To:</strong></p> <p class="p2"><span style="text-decoration: underline;">Financial Planning, Forecasting &amp; Strategic Analysis</span></p> <ul> <li>Help lead the annual operating plan, monthly forecasting, and long-range planning processes across the organization.</li> <li>Own the consolidation of enterprise financial forecasts, budgets, and long-range plans across all business units, ensuring completeness, accuracy, and consistency of financial assumptions.</li> <li>Develop and maintain integrated three-statement financial models (income statement, balance sheet, and cash flow) to support planning, liquidity management, and executive decision-making.</li> <li>Build scenario analyses, business cases, and financial models to evaluate strategic initiatives, investments, and operational decisions.</li> <li>Partner with executive leadership to identify risks, opportunities, and actionable recommendations that support company objectives.</li> </ul> <p class="p2"><span style="text-decoration: underline;">Business Partnership &amp; Performance Management</span></p> <ul> <li>Partner with business leaders to evaluate financial performance, operational trends, and resource allocation.</li> <li>Analyze monthly financial results, identify key performance drivers, and communicate actionable insights to leadership.</li> <li>Develop scalable reporting, dashboards, and KPIs to monitor business performance and improve decision-making.</li> <li>Support cross-functional initiatives by providing financial analysis and decision support.</li> </ul> <p class="p2"><span style="text-decoration: underline;">FP&amp;A Systems, Reporting &amp; Process Improvement</span></p> <ul> <li>Lead continuous improvements to FP&amp;A processes, reporting, and planning capabilities through automation and standardization.</li> <li>Maintain and enhance financial planning models and reporting within Adaptive Planning, ensuring data integrity, forecasting accuracy, and efficient planning processes.</li> <li>Improve financial reporting infrastructure and documentation to increase transparency and scalability.</li> <li>Prepare executive, Board, and management reporting materials that clearly communicate financial performance and outlook.</li> </ul> <p class="p2"><span style="text-decoration: underline;">Strategic Initiatives &amp; Partner Finance Support</span></p> <ul> <li>Lead or support enterprise strategic initiatives requiring cross-functional financial evaluation and coordination.</li> <li>Support Degree partner cash collection initiatives through financial analysis, reporting, forecasting, and collaboration with business partners to improve working capital and cash flow.</li> <li>Provide ad hoc financial analyses to support evolving business priorities during the company's transformation.</li> </ul> <p class="p2"><span style="text-decoration: underline;">Leadership &amp; title: Senior Manager, Demand Generation
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>12twenty is the leading platform for employers to connect with elite early career professionals.</strong><span style="font-weight: 400;"> Our community includes millions of students, recent graduates, and alumni from top business schools, law schools, and universities around the world. We take pride connecting our community of candidates with recruiters from top companies across industries. Come join our fast growing organization! </span></p></div><p>&nbsp;</p> <h2><strong>About 12twenty</strong></h2> <p>12twenty connects employers, universities, students, and alumni through a trusted talent network designed to create better career and hiring outcomes.</p> <p>The future of hiring will be built on trust, not volume. As technology changes how people find jobs and how companies find talent, there is an opportunity to rethink some of the assumptions the market has operated on for years.</p> <p>12twenty is growing, its go-to-market motion is evolving, and Marketing has an important role to play in that growth.</p> <p>That is where this role comes in.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h2><strong>The role</strong></h2> <p>The Senior Manager of Demand Generation will own demand generation at 12twenty and help build a growth engine that is predictable, measurable, and capable of scaling with the business.</p> <p>This is a highly strategic and hands-on role for someone who can start with a business goal, understand the audience and the problem to solve, look at the data, and develop a clear point of view on the best path forward.</p> <p>The role will own programs across paid media, ABM, webinars and events, lifecycle marketing, content-driven demand, and other channels. Knowing how to run those channels is important, but the larger opportunity is understanding how they work together and where time and investment can create the greatest impact.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>12twenty also serves two distinct audiences: employers and universities. Each has different buyers, sales cycles, challenges, and reasons for choosing 12twenty. Strong demand generation here requires strategies built around those differences rather than a single playbook applied across both markets.</p> <p>Leads and engagement matter, but they are not the finish line. Success is ultimately measured through qualified opportunities, pipeline, conversion, velocity, revenue, and Marketing’s contribution to company growth.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h2><strong>What this role will own</strong></h2> <p>These are the essential responsibilities of the role:</p> <ul> <li>Build and manage 12twenty’s demand generation strategy in support of company pipeline and revenue goals.</li> <li>Translate quarterly and annual growth priorities into integrated campaigns with clear audiences, offers, conversion paths, budgets, and success measures.</li> <li>Own paid demand strategy, including planning, budgeting, testing, optimization, and performance across relevant paid channels.</li> <li>Expand and optimize our account-based and audience-specific programs for priority segments and accounts.</li> <li>Build campaigns that bring together paid media, content, webinars and events, nurture, retargeting, product marketing, and sales follow-up based on the objective and audience.</li> <li>Partner closely with Marketing Operations and Sales to understand lead quality, opportunity progression, objections, market feedback, and what happens after Marketing creates engagement.</li> <li>Work with Marketing Operations and Revenue Operations to improve scoring, routing, attribution, funnel visibility, nurture, conversion, and reporting.</li> <li>Partner with Product Marketing and Content to turn product launches, customer proof, research, market insights, and strong points of view into demand.</li> <li>Establish a disciplined testing approach that improves campaign performance and informs future investment decisions.</li> <li>Own demand generation reporting and communicate performance, insights, risks, and recommendations clearly to Marketing and company leadership.</li> <li>Manage demand generation budgets responsibly and make recommendations about where to increase, reduce, or reallocate investment based on results.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h2><strong>What success looks like</strong></h2> <p>The goal is to make the demand engine better, not simply busier.</p> <p>Over time, this role should create a clearer understanding of where the funnel is performing well, where opportunities are being lost, what is driving those outcomes, and what actions should follow.</p> <p>Strong programs should become repeatable. Programs that are not producing meaningful results should evolve or make room for better opportunities.</p> <p>The team should have greater visibility into which audiences, messages, offers, and channels are creating qualified pipeline.</p> <p>Marketing and Sales should have a strong feedback loop around what is converting, what is not, and what the market is telling the business.</p> <p>Ultimately, the demand generation function should become increasingly effective at answering a simple but important question: if the business invests here, what is it likely to get back?</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h2><strong>What will make someone successful in this role</strong></h2> <p>Strong candidates will have experience building and running demand generation programs in a B2B SaaS environment and will be comfortable connecting campaign performance to pipeline and revenue.</p> <p>The right person will understand the economics of the funnel. Pipeline, conversion rates, acquisition costs, velocity, attribution, channel performance, and return on investment should all be familiar territory.</p> <p>Paid media experience is important, but the role requires a broader view of demand generation than paid acquisition alone.</p> <p>Experience bringing multiple channels together into integrated programs is valuable, along with a strong understanding of how the buyer journey continues after someone fills out a form.</p> <p>Comfort working with the systems behind the work is also important. Experience with platforms such as HubSpot, Salesforce, Dreamdata is helpful, but understanding how marketing and revenue systems work together matters more than expertise in any one tool.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>The strongest candidates will be analytical without becoming overly dependent on perfect data. Some decisions will be based on clear evidence. Others will require a well-informed hypothesis and the ability to test it thoughtfully.</p> <p>This role also requires comfort moving between strategy and execution. It may involve shaping quarterly investment strategy one day and diagnosing a conversion issue the next.</p> <p>Clear communication and strong judgment are essential. The team values people who can form a point of view, explain the reasoning behind it, and recommend a path forward when something is not working as expected.</p> <p>Most importantly, this role requires ownership. The Senior Manager of Demand Generation will be expected to take business goals and turn them into thoughtful plans, strong execution, and measurable results.</p> <p>Experience in talent acquisition, HR technology, higher education, or another complex B2B market could help accelerate ramp time, but it is not required.</p> <p>12twenty values demonstrated ability and relevant experience over a particular career path or academic credential.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h2><strong>How the team works</strong></h2> <p>This role reports directly to the Head of Marketing and will work closely with Marketing leadership as the demand generation function continues to grow and mature. Everyone is hands on and the right person for the role should welcome deep dives into their process and data.</p> <p>The team has high standards for the work, but does not believe that more process automatically creates better marketing. Clear goals, good judgment, thoughtful execution, and accountability are valued over unnecessary complexity.</p> <p>The team moves quickly, but speed is not the goal on its own. The goal is to learn, improve, and make better decisions with each program.</p> <p>There is a meaningful amount to build in this role, from campaign strategy and measurement to cross-functional operating rhythms and future investment decisions. For someone who enjoys creating structure, improving systems, and seeing the impact of the work on the business, that is a significant part of the opportunity.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>Annual compensation range: $80k - $150k&nbsp;</p><div class="content-conclusion"><div class="p-rich_text_section"> <p><em>The annual compensation range for this position is listed above. Employees in this position are also eligible to participate in the Company’s standard benefit programs, which currently include the following: medical, dental, and vision benefits, 401(k), and paid time off.</em></p> </div> <div class="p-rich_text_section">&nbsp;</div> <div class="p-rich_text_section"><strong data-stringify-type="bold">Benefits &amp; Perks:</strong></div> <ul class="p-rich_text_list p-rich_text_list__bullet" data-stringify-type="unordered-list" data-indent="0" data-border="0"> <li data-stringify-indent="0" data-stringify-border="0">Competitive salary</li> <li data-stringify-indent="0" data-stringify-border="0">Generous PTO policy</li> <li data-stringify-indent="0" data-stringify-border="0">Full benefits, including 401(k)</li> <li data-stringify-indent="0" data-stringify-border="0">Regular team happy hours and activities</li> <li data-stringify-indent="0" data-stringify-border="0">Remote work flexibility</li> </ul> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">12twenty is an enterprise level talent acquisition platform connecting the world’s largest employers with students and alumni from top business schools and other graduate level institutions. understand where conversations stall and what would help buyers move forward.</p> </li> <li> <p>Deliver training that helps teams confidently explain product value, demonstrate relevant capabilities, title: Senior DevOps Engineer
description: 15Five is the AI-powered performance management platform built for business impact. 15Five’s AI-powered all-in-one people management system is easy to use, delivers effortless insights, and enables managers to lead with impact so that companies and their people can thrive. Within the flow of work, HR leaders are empowered with data-driven insights and recommendations while managers are transformed into change-makers, accelerating engagement, performance, and retention. 15Five combines generative AI, custom analytics, and human-centered principles within a complete platform, including 360° performance reviews, engagement surveys, goal tracking, manager coaching and training, and ongoing feedback tools like guided 1-on-1s and check-ins. A career at 15Five is the chance to have high impact in a fast paced, remote startup environment that operates with focus, urgency, and accountability. Every role and every hire meaningfully impacts our trajectory. We’re a high-performance, high-purpose team that gives you the chance to Build the Future of Work. We run on High Standards and High Support — holding a high bar for results, ownership, clarity, and disciplined execution, while investing in manager enablement, skill development, and whole-person care. We are committed to a No B.S. environment, meaning we anchor ourselves in truth, course-correct in real time, and expect people to lean into direct conversations. We are focused on ensuring every 15Fiver can Work in the Future and that starts with proactively using AI across all aspects of your role to increase leverage, speed, and impact. If you're energized by a fast pace, high standards, and high accountability for yourself and others, you'll thrive here and we encourage you to apply.

title: Account Executive - Mid-Market
description: As an Account Executive on the North American Mid-Market team, you are responsible for driving revenue in North America with a focus on the mid-market segment (250 - 5,000 employees). You are committed to learning and executing our proven sales methodologies to hit your quota and grow your sales skills. From your future coach: “I'm thrilled to lead a group of dynamic professionals who are not only passionate about sales but also dedicated to fostering genuine connections with our clients. Here, we thrive on the pulse of innovation and collaboration, fueling our relentless pursuit of excellence. With a firm belief in work-life balance, transparency, and a culture that embraces challenges, every day presents an opportunity for growth and achievement. So buckle up, because with our team, the journey is just as exhilarating as the destination. Let's rock the world of Mid-Market Sales together!” - Graham Knowles, https://www.linkedin.com/in/knowlesg/

title: Account Executive Mid-Market France
description: As an Account Executive, you will be responsible for signing new logos within the French market. You will be part of a team of 5 Account Executives who are achieving their ambitious objectives in 2026. The position involves leading opportunities from demo to closing, taking an active part in our responses to requests for proposals, growing your network with HR & training decision-makers and developing the best sales strategies to close deals.360 Learning is committed to providing fulfilling career paths; this role will offer you the opportunity to move into other roles within the organization after 2 or 3 years of continuous success. Hear from our AE Mid Coach : My core objective for the Mid Market team is to continue to expand our leadership in France. I strive for collaboration, working within a good team dynamic is essential; we only progress if everyone brings their expertise and shares their feedback along the way. Our sales experts have the unique opportunity to grow their careers through our defined career paths and learn how the sales playbook of a market-leading LMS.

title: Analytics Engineer
description: The Data team builds and evolves the data platform that powers critical product features and helps every team make smarter, faster decisions. Our data ecosystem supports hundreds of pipelines, dashboards, and tools, providing the foundation for both day-to-day operations and strategic decision-making. What makes our team unique is our central role across the company: we sit at the intersection of Product, Operations, Customer Success, Sales, and Engineering. As our first Analytics Engineer, you’ll bridge the gap between our data platform and business teams by building trusted datasets, meaningful KPIs, and self-service analytics capabilities. You’ll work closely with our Senior Data Analyst and Data Engineers to improve data models and documentation, strengthen the reliability and efficiency of our warehouse, and help teams become increasingly autonomous with Snowflake, Looker/Metabase, and AI-powered analytics. You’ll then contribute to our broader mission of making data more accessible and actionable across 360Learning.

title: Business Development Representative
description: 360Learning is looking for a Business Development Representative (BDR) to join our French mid-market team. Your role will consist of generating opportunities from 360Learning top priority, highest potential accounts. As the owner of these accounts, you will be in charge of developing personalized outreach strategies to connect with target personas and transform intent signals into a sales pipeline. More specifically, you will be in charge of your territory to create and qualify cold outbound leads and contact potential customers through cold-calls, email, and LinkedIn. Throughout your conversations, you will detect customer pain points, understand their context, and how we can help. You will evangelize collaborative learning in the market, and pitch the 360Learning value proposition. Working in close collaboration with your coach, marketing operations, demand generation, and sales, you will benefit from thorough onboarding and continuous learning & coaching opportunities as you grow.

title: Client Success Partner - Enterprise
description: As a Client Success Partner (CSP) within the Enterprise team, you will support our largest clients in their digital training strategy through the 360Learning platform. Your mission is to build a strong relationship with the HR executives (CHRO, Chief Learning Officer & Digital Learning Manager) of our clients to develop the usage, adoption & impact of our solution. Given the complexity of Enterprise clients, you will act as a true facilitator to ensure the renewal of the clients by : - coordinating the different 360Learning resources (technical, pedagogical,...) - empowering the client with the Enterprise positioning and vision provided by our solution Ultimately, you will ensure the renewal or signing of new contracts for accounts listed in your portfolio.

title: Employee Experience Specialist
description: As People Experience Specialist, you will drive the operational execution of our global Learning & Development, Employee Engagement, Facilities, and CSR initiatives. You will manage daily L&D workflows, maintain our 360Learning course catalog, support engagement survey logistics, coordinate learning events, handle day-to-day office facilities requests, and compile regulatory HR/CSE training reports. Reporting to the People Experience Lead and collaborating closely with HROps and HRBP, you will ensure our training processes, office facilities operations, onboarding workflows, and administrative compliance run efficiently, accurately, and smoothly.

title: Enterprise Account Executive
description: Introduction to the Team & Role This is a rare opportunity to join our North American team as an Enterprise Account Executive, where you will be instrumental in fueling revenue growth by engaging the largest and most strategic organizations (5,000+ employees). We are seeking a strategic hunter energized by the challenge of winning executive mindshare against established incumbents. This role requires flawlessly executing complex, consultative sales cycles and aggressively multi-threading high-value accounts. As a remote-first organization, your success will also involve an exciting and challenging requirement for regular travel (up to 25%) to key customer sites for executive meetings and strategic deal checkpoints. This is a chance for a driven professional to showcase strategic thinking, keen business acumen, and unwavering ownership, making a direct impact on company growth alongside a high-performing and ambitious team.

title: Enterprise Account Executive (m/f/d)
description: As the first Enterprise Account Executive for DACH, you will lead 360Learning’s expansion into one of Europe’s most strategic markets. Joining a team of 9 Enterprise AEs across France and the UK, you will bring our proven enterprise sales motion to DACH and build the foundations for long-term growth. You won’t be starting from scratch. You’ll join an established German commercial organization serving the Mid-Market segment, giving you access to local expertise, customer references, brand recognition, and a strong partner ecosystem, including our strategic alliance with SAP SuccessFactors. Your mission will be to win new enterprise customers (10,000+ employees), build a high-quality pipeline, and close complex, multi-stakeholder deals with some of Germany’s largest organizations. Combining strategic territory development with hands-on execution, you will play a key role in establishing 360Learning as a trusted Learning & Development partner across the DACH region. While this is a highly entrepreneurial role, you will be supported by dedicated Solution Engineers, Alliances, Professional Services, Customer Success, Marketing teams, and the broader German commercial organization. Reporting to the VP of Enterprise Sales EMEA, you can work remotely from anywhere in Germany while helping shape the future of 360Learning’s Enterprise business in DACH.

title: Global VP Marketing
description: 360Learning is entering its next phase of growth. Today, more than 2,500 organizations worldwide use 360Learning to turn internal expertise into business performance. As AI fundamentally reshapes how companies build skills, share knowledge and develop their people, we are evolving our platform, bringing together Collaborative Learning, AI and enterprise-grade learning infrastructure to redefine what modern L&D can deliver. We are now looking for a Global VP Marketing to help shape and accelerate this next chapter. Reporting directly to Benjamin Marchal, our CEO, you will own our global Marketing strategy and organization. Your mandate will go beyond generating demand: you will sharpen our positioning in a rapidly changing market, strengthen our brand and category leadership, and build a high-performing Marketing engine that translates market opportunity into sustainable revenue growth. You will partner closely with Sales, Product and Customer teams to strengthen our go-to-market strategy across our key markets, with a particular focus on accelerating growth in North America. You will bring together Product Marketing, Brand & Content and Demand Generation around clear priorities and shared business outcomes, from market awareness and positioning to pipeline creation, conversion and revenue impact. We are looking for an outstanding B2B SaaS marketing leader who combines strategic depth with strong execution and has already led significant Marketing scope in a high-growth environment. This is an opportunity for a proven VP/SVP-level leader ready to step into full global ownership, work directly with the CEO and progressively grow into a broader CMO-level mandate as the company and the role evolve. The role can be based in the USA, Canada, UK or France.

description: Introduction to the Team & Role What if your team was the one that got to build the future of how a company runs — and tried it on itself first? GTM Systems owns the tech stack behind 360Learning's commercial engine — Salesforce, Marketo, data enrichment and AI tooling across sales, marketing, customer success and services. Our mission is to be a force multiplier for the business: making go-to-market faster, smarter and more effective. We already have a high-performing team, mature systems, extensive documentation, and an ambitious AI vision. Now we need someone to build on that foundation and take it to the next level. You'll work closely with GTM leaders, operators, data teams and engineering to turn ambiguous business problems into reliable, scalable products. You'll partner with each team to define the target state — where AI can take work off their plate, and where the human touch matters — then build the systems and agents that get them there. This is a high-impact role for someone who loves working at the intersection of product, systems, AI and go-to-market strategy. Key Responsibility Areas Own the internal AI operating model for GTM — the library of skills, agent evals, cost, adoption and ROI — in partnership with Data and Enablement. Keep the team a step ahead as customer zero for AI, turning what works into patterns other functions adopt. Own the long-term design of the GTM stack — CRM, marketing automation, CS tooling — deciding what to build vs. buy. Help the company prioritize by identifying the best solution to each business problem and sizing its cost and feasibility. Lead and coach five senior ICs across Salesforce, marketing/BDR, CS systems and web ops. Set a high bar for documentation, testing and deployment — and hold it without slowing the team down. Run vendor management end to end: evaluations, the quarterly keep-or-kill review, and renewals. Partner as a peer to the leaders of Data, Enablement, Security, Finance and every commercial function. Drive adoption and change management for new GTM capabilities across distributed teams.
