title: Key Account Manager Mid Market
description: As a Key Account Manager (KAM), you play a decisive role in the growth of 360Learning's business and you will join a team of 5 KAMs (Mid-market). You will be in charge of around 100 accounts (existing customers from 100 to 2,500 employees). At 360Learning, the KAM role is 80% sales oriented and your goal is to develop your portfolio and generate growth. But, you will not work alone! Client Success Partners and internal experts (digital pedagogy, platform structuring, IT) are in charge of the client’s project monitoring and execution. Collaborating with these teams will be instrumental to succeed in your upsell actions. We are eager to retain the best talent in our teams, and we will encourage internal moves after 2-3 years of continuous success to build together fulfilling career paths. This KAM Mid-role offers the possibility of moving to a KAM Large position (existing customers from 2,500 to 10,000+ employees).

title: Key Account Manager Mid-Market - Pool
description: As a Key Account Manager Pool (KAM Pool), you play a strategic role in scaling 360Learning’s customer growth and retention engine. You will join a team focused on maximizing renewal and upsell opportunities across a large portfolio of existing customers through automation, data-driven prioritization, and scalable account management strategies. You will manage a high-volume portfolio of customers ranging from 100 to 2,500 employees, with a focus on identifying growth opportunities, driving renewals, and increasing customer engagement at scale through automatization actions. At 360Learning, the KAM Pool role is a unique opportunity to also shape the overall KAM team. It combines account management, revenue generation, and operational excellence. Your mission is to build scalable motions that accelerate expansion opportunities while ensuring customers continue to realize value from the platform. Therefore, your successful automatization processes will also help shape globally the entire KAM team. As a transversal role, you will work closely with Client Success Partners, Revenue Operations, Marketing, and internal experts (digital pedagogy, platform structuring, IT) to deploy automated engagement strategies, optimize renewal processes, and generate upsell opportunities efficiently across your portfolio. We are eager to retain the best talent in our teams, and we encourage internal mobility after 2–3 years of continuous success to build fulfilling career paths. This role offers strong growth opportunities toward strategic account management, revenue operations, or large account ownership positions.

title: Product Manager
description: Our Product team comprises Group Product Managers and Product Managers. Within a Product Squad, the Product Manager works with a Product Designer and 4 to 6 Software Engineers on an ambitious roadmap. Product Managers are committed to maintaining our lead in Collaborative Learning. To secure the delivery of our new features and solutions, we are recruiting a Product Manager who will own the functional and technical scope of the squads. They will identify problems, define solutions and manage delivery. They make sure their roadmap is aligned with the Product vision.

title: Revenue Strategy & Operations Manager
description: In this role, you'll play a critical part in boosting the commercial performance of our Revenue engine — improving hit ratio, deal size and sales velocity across the funnel. Your primary scope is our global Sales team and BDRs. To do this, you'll work hand in hand with our Global Chief Sales Officer, VP of Sales, Sales Coaches, the Global Director of Business Development & Partnerships, and the Enablement team. You'll join the Operations team: an international team of 14 results-driven professionals with consulting and B2B SaaS backgrounds. Our mission is to ensure 360Learning's efficient growth and healthy business. We design and execute strategic growth, transformation and value-creation initiatives across Sales, Customer Success, Product, Marketing and Partnerships — identifying improvement levers, benchmarking, and implementing best practices so every team exceeds its targets. You'll partner with senior leaders across the Revenue organization to turn priorities into action, improve performance on the metrics that matter, and make sure our teams, offerings and ways of working are set up to deliver long-term value. Your core activities will include: Strategic Partnership & Stakeholder Management Act as the trusted business partner to Sales and BDR leadership, and progressively to Alliances & Partnerships. Key stakeholders include the Chief Sales Officer, VP Sales and CROs, the Global Director of Business Development & Partnerships, and the Enablement team. Deliver strategic, cross-team initiatives that lift core commercial performance — e.g. rolling out a new pricing strategy or supporting new product launches. Operational Excellence Translate revenue strategy into actionable plans and playbooks for Sales and BDR teams, ensuring quality, scalability and alignment with SaaS best practices. Frame business and resource-allocation decisions: identify staffing needs and optimize team structure. Performance Management & Insights Monitor KPIs and execution closely, delivering clear insights to the Executive team. Proactively propose initiatives to improve performance, grounded in data analysis. Recommend quarterly adjustments to the Business Plan.

title: Senior DevSecOps Engineer
description: Our Security and IT team keeps the 360Learning platform secure, compliant and auditable for the 1,500 organisations that learn on it every day. As a Senior DevSecOps Engineer, your mission is to make our infrastructure secure by design, detectable by default, and provable at audit time. 360Learning runs its learning platform on Azure and Kubernetes, certified ISO 27001:2022 and SOC 2 Type II. Over the past two years the technical security workload has grown on every front: a larger and more regulated customer base sending their own scans and security assessments, a wider detection and response scope, more infrastructure to keep hardened and auditable, and a growing backlog of security engineering projects that never reach the top of the queue. We are creating this position to add real technical capacity on the infrastructure side of security, and to move part of our security posture from manual effort to automated guardrails. You will be the bridge between security and platform engineering: deep enough in infrastructure to fix things yourself, and close enough to security operations to know what to look for. “Ours is a small, senior team with a broad scope: information security, compliance, infrastructure governance and internal tooling, with dual audit accountability on ISO 27001:2022 and SOC 2 Type II. That means direct impact and no layers between you and the decision. Roughly half of this role is greenfield build work you will own end to end.” Guillaume Seigneuret, CISO and Hiring Coach.

title: Software Engineer
description: At the start of 360Learning's growth, we were only 10 developers in the R&D department working on a single codebase. Today, we are a team of 60+ engineers divided into 10 product squads. Each squad includes developers, product managers and designers. Our technical teams are paramount to 360Learning’s response to our increasingly demanding customers and are strategic players for the growth of the company. We have the opportunity to: Lead real and complex technical challenges: A complex codebase on which analysis and modeling capabilities are key. Significant traffic (2.3M registered users, 200K unique monthly visitors) with a considerable volume of data to manage. A strong focus on “clean architecture” for long-term growth. Work on an attractive technical stack: We work on MongoDB, Node.js and Vue.js, three of the most popular JS technologies on the market. We are currently migrating to TypeScript. Grow within a R&D team that allows rapid progress: Our decentralized peer review process provides us with qualitative and regular feedback from other team members. We promote pair programming and knowledge sharing.

title: Solution Deployment Manager (m/f/d)
description: Our Implementation team plays a key role in onboarding seamlessly new customers: they are working cross departments (Sales, Product and Customer Success) to understand and document client use cases and requirements and then translate them into the set-up and configuration of the 360Learning platform. You will manage all phases of the implementation lifecycle, from sales turnover and kick off to handover to support. You will drive project management, define 360Learning platform architecture for our clients, facilitate integrations (flat files, API’s) and 3rd party apps, guide and provide assistance in order to ensure the successful deployment of their platform. In addition, you will follow your customers' portfolio along their contract to increase product adoption, as well as to deliver Solutions complementary to the Product like platform audits.

title: Solution Expert
description: Our Solution Expert team plays a key role in supporting strategic customers in RUN phase, by acting as trusted advisors on complex use cases. Working closely with Sales, Product, and Customer Success, they analyze advanced client needs, challenge existing setups, and translate requirements into scalable solutions within the 360Learning platform. You will manage a portfolio of customers throughout their lifecycle to drive product adoption and deliver tailored solutions beyond standard product capabilities. These large and strategic accounts have already deployed the platform and have a strong level of autonomy. They rely on your technical and functional expertise to lead complex integrations (APIs, flat files, third-party tools), redesign platform architecture, run solution audits, and provide high-level recommendations to maximize business impact and long-term value.

title: Solutions Engineer DACH
description: As a Presales Engineer, you will be working at the intersection of Sales, Product and Customer Success, working with top learning and development organizations to align their growth objectives to 360learning capabilities. As the first Presales Engineer for the German market, you will play a crucial role in ensuring the region’s success, but you will have the support from the whole EMEA team. This role will be foundational to 360learning business expansion. Reinforcing a new function in Germany, as a Presales Engineer, you will become an internal expert in our technology, developing a deep understanding of how 360learning is being used by current customers and how it can drive value for future ones. You will bridge the gap between the strategic direction of our product development and the needs of our market.

title: Spontaneous Application
description: We believe there is only one long-term solution to enable humanity to meet major societal challenges, including unemployment, hunger, disease, the environment, political and religious extremism or even space exploration. This solution is education. 360Learning has become the fastest growing EdTech (Education Technology) scale-up in Europe by disrupting the Corporate Learning market since 2013. We are now 100+ employees in New York, Paris & London, supporting 1,200+ customers in 160 countries, such as Dior, Criteo, Safran, Michelin, BNP, Axa & Devialet. Our mission is to help companies become Learning Organizations, by connecting their Leaders with their Learners. With our Learning Engagement Platform, they: - empower internal Business Experts, transforming them into active Leaders who create courses and train the others; - connect Leaders with Learners in a highly engaging, user-friendly, modern web interface where they interact and exchange knowledge (resulting in 90% participation rate vs. 45% on average); - scale fast & effective trainings to the full organization (in a few hours vs. several months), integrating 360Learning seamlessly with other tools such as HRIS and CRM; - optimize courses by leveraging user data to make Smart Recommendations. 360Learning is building a team composed of 100% top performers and a culture of well-being and collective performance. Our goal is to become the top global provider of educational software solutions. Our workplace - Unique decentralized culture: https://360learning.com/legal/convexity-guidelines/ - Complete ownership of your role - Flexible hours

title: Technical Consultant
description: 360Learning is seeking a highly skilled and motivated Technical Consultant to join our Professional Services team. As a Technical Consultant, you will be responsible for scoping custom technical and consulting projects, building custom solutions, coordinating with the Technical Services team and delivering on those projects for our clients. You will work closely with our sales and development teams to understand client needs and translate them into technical solutions. The successful candidate will have a strong technical background, excellent problem-solving skills, and a customer-focused mindset. As a Technical Consultant, you are part of our implementation team, who plays a key role in seamlessly onboarding new customers: you are working cross department (Sales, Product and Customer Success) to understand and document client use cases and requirements and then translate them into set up and configuration of the 360Learning platform as well as specifications for the development of Technical Solutions. You will support and manage all phases of the implementation lifecycle, from sales turnover and kick off to handover to support, mainly on strategic accounts as a technical expert. You will define 360Learning platform architecture for our clients, facilitate integrations (flat files, API’s), 3rd party apps, guide and provide assistance in order to ensure the successful deployment of their platform. As we grow, we need to continue to automatize and find repeatable solutions. Part of your job will be to design tools to either support the rest of the team and specific customer’s requests and avoid time-consuming work.

title: Technical Lead Engineering
description: Our R&D team gathers ~100 engineers divided into ~15 product and technical squads. Each product squad includes developers, product managers and designers. They are paramount to 360Learning’s response to our increasingly demanding customers and are strategic players for the growth of the company. Today, we need someone to drive the Technical vision and coach the other developers in the Analytics Squad. We created the Tech Lead role to help developers with the technical aspects of their jobs, such as coding and planning, and coordinate the delivery timeline with Product Managers and Product Designers. As a Technical Lead you will: be the point of contact for all technical topics from the squad (you can then redirect to another member of the squad) be the coach for the other developers of the squad (do Performance reviews and Career Path assessments) keep coding since management will take ~20% of your time participate in monthly meetings altogether with CTO and Engineering Director to celebrate successes and discuss technical or organizational challenges You will report directly to the VP Engineering & Engineering Director

title: Trainer EMEA
description: The Trainer is our pedagogical and platform expert within the Professional Services (PS) team. Your mission is to empower our clients to build Collaborative Learning organizations by mastering our platform and methodology. You aren't a technical expert; you are a pedagogical and platform expert who ensures that clients don’t just "use" the software, but master it to drive long-term engagement. By owning our "One-to-Many" offer (Engagement Academy & Stadium webinars), you ensure that every client, from their first day of implementation, has the knowledge and confidence to make their project a success. You don't just deliver content; you develop a scalable learning ecosystem that ensures every client gets the best start possible by mastering our Collaborative Learning methodology. You will work closely with the Customer Success Team and Product teams to ensure our training offer addresses the actual friction points and needs of our client base.

title: Certified Home Health Aide (CHHA) : Home Health
description: 21st Century Home Health Services (21HHS) is the fastest-growing home health agency in Northern California. We care for patients across San Francisco, San Mateo, Santa Clara, Santa Cruz, Alameda, Contra Costa, Solano, Napa, Yolo, Placer, El Dorado, Sacramento, Marin, and Sonoma counties. There's a reason for that growth. Words like collaboration, teamwork, and productivity stay buzzwords unless the structure, model, and tools make them real. At 21HHS, we've built a model that combines the best of home health with the structure, resources, and support clinicians need to thrive. Our clinical guiding principles are simple: empower, enhance, educate. When clinicians get real support and structure, the results show up in two places at once: patient outcomes and employee satisfaction. We know our clinicians and therapists provide outstanding care because our patients, their families, and their caregivers tell us so. Check out our Yelp and Google reviews. We're proud of this work. We've also set a new benchmark for employee satisfaction in home health. As a Top Workplace, 21HHS supports growth and recognition through open communication and professional development. Feedback from our team on Glassdoor and Indeed backs this up. Our outcomes, low turnover, rapid growth, and high morale speak for themselves. The 21HHS Standard We give you great tools and resources, and a lot of them, plus the support you need to succeed and enjoy your work. In return, we ask that you use those tools to do your job well. When the right mindset meets the right resources, the payoff is real: high job satisfaction, excellent patient outcomes, and earning potential that's hard to match. That's the 21HHS Standard. Please note: All opportunities at 21HHS require being in the field, visiting patients in their homes. Full time Certified Home Health Aide (CHHA) Territory: Yuba City and Surrounding area Under the direct supervision of an RN Case Manager, you will provide patient care according to the Plan of Care.
